Docking bay endangered.(Story ship AI undocks from heavily damaged docking bays to prevent destruction)
Requesting Segment #34 main function.(speak # as "number", speak 34 as "thirty-four")
Establishing long-distance uplink to Kuromanckami(Kuromanckami same as {30224,104}).
Transferring Expedition AI Core Mk7(Expedition AI Core Mk7 same as {30224,101}).
Initiating Torus archive self destruct sequence.
Evacuate vessel to prevent loss of life.
Trained pilots are among the most vital resources of the Terran Protectorate.
Terran aces are known to decimate entire squadrons of adversaries through superior manoeuvres.
You, by contrast, have none of these qualities.
(gets cut off at the end)13 Earth days, 22 Earth hours, 9...
Permission has been denied. Investigation terminated.
I... am... Mitsuno... I... am... ready...

page.title: Major Domo
page.descr: Lines for special mission character Major Domo
page.t: Sorry, I am busy right now.
I think this one has a hearing problem.
I think this one is damaged. [mp:He's|fp:She's] not understanding the words you are saying.
DO YOU UNDERSTAND THE WORDS WE ARE SAYING?
Don't stretch your cognitive limits trying to grasp this just yet.
We need to give this one a medical.
Recruit. I see you haven't started any missions yet.
Get yourself down to the Mission Hall. This isn't a holiday camp!
You're not burned to death in a fireball. What more do you want to know?
Get to work, recruit. Lissa will brief you.
Mission interface connection established. Glad to see you've finally decided to earn your keep here.
For the first mission, we'll take things easy.
During the mission, you will be able to communicate with a copy of me that is uploaded into the mission with you.
But it won't be direct, live communication with the Facility.
My intelligence is just too big and complicated. I have used the mission interface before, but it just glitches constantly.
It's very annoying and leads to disappointing mission performance.
It all just works more smoothly if we use simpler intelligences, such as yourself.
Why am I even asking? Too late now, recruit! Transition initiating.
Try not to vomit in my nice, clean mission interface.
The recruit's speech faculties seem limited. Are we sure this one isn't damaged?
Yes, yes, Tammancktall. The main thing is that the missions are executed.
You did well, Donel - at least you didn't vomit in my mission interface.
Complete some missions while you're getting your bearings.
That's the spirit! This is just the kind of attitude we need from our recruits.
You're the first - but I'm sure more will come.
Rest for now. Explore the Facility. When you're ready for your first mission, Lissa will show you the ropes.
Harper Donel. Your ability not to vomit in my mission interface has impressed me.
I have a special mission for you.
Do you want to do it now?
I think you're ready to recruit a new operative for the Facility.
Her name's Kaori Chen. She's a Terran from the current time - 2042.
This is getting tiresome. Can we cut to the explanation?
It's still not time travel, Tammancktall.
You've failed 25 recruitment missions, Tammancktall. What am I supposed to do?
You know you're not hurting my feelings, right?
And you can demand all you like, but no-one's discriminating against you.
Yes! My copy can only hold the impedance bubble open for a limited time.
You spend so much time wittering that the bubbles collapse before you have got the recruits' consent.
(sighs)I'm implying nothing. That's what I'm telling you. In words.
OK, OK. I'll put you back in the recruitment rotations as they come up.
I can see you're already working on your verbosity.
Disappointing, recruit. Come back when you're mission ready.
Enter the mission for the full briefing.
Hello Harper. Do you have the stamina yet for this special mission?
I'm a fragging robot, recruit. I'm well charged and well oiled.
What more do you want to know?
It's a word I picked up from Chen. It's satisfying, so I'm using it.
Well, we're not here to chit-chat. You're here to escape flaming death, right?
Missions, missions, missions, Harper Donel. You're doing good. Now do more.
I see you're not in the mission interface, recruit.
That's what I like to hear, recruit!
OK, recruit. Focus on the mission. No need to be talking to yourself.
Welcome, Mitsuno. Haven't seen you in a while.
Me? No. This is the commander.
Just relax. Get back to the missions. You've had your fun, Mitsuno.
Not dead, as such, but she won't be breaking things any more.
Think of it as a dream.
You could put it that way, but the missions couldn't be more important.
That's enough drama for today. I think you have taken up enough of the Commander's time.
How did everyone think they were time travellers? However much I told them that they weren't?
We should have made the deal clear from the outset.
We would have avoided that regrettable situation with Mitsuno.
Today I'm operating like a well-oiled machine. In fact, I am very recently lubricated.
I don't see any malfunction. Let me check diagnostics.
No - nothing showing up on diagnostics. Are you sure you're not seeing things? We can get you a medical check-up back at the Facility.
Diagnostics are clear. I'll do a deep systems scan back at the Facility. For now, just focus on the mission.
Nothing came up on the deep scan last time this happened. And no-one else has reported these glitches.
Are you working too hard? Does the recruit need some rest?
What's the problem, recruit? Another comms glitch?
Mitsuno? Have those recruits been gossiping?
I'll have to have a word with them.
(Sigh)We agreed we wouldn't talk about Mitsuno. She's a failed recruit.
It's my fault really. I recruited her myself. But I was glitching in the mission. I didn't detect how fragile she was.
It's all very disappointing. We don't talk about it. Please don't ask again.
I see you have been working hard, Harper.
Good day, recruit Harper. I hope you're getting your mission numbers up.
No time to chit-chat, Harper Donel. Why don't you take on your next mission instead.
You're here, bothering me, when you could be doing missions. I question your priorities.
If I had a palm, or a face for that matter, I would facepalm.
Recruit Harper. Were you actually asleep in that mission?
I think you'll have to tackle that mission again.
We can recruit an Argnu to replace you if you don't do better.
A single, lonely, star rating for you.
Well you completed that mission... barely.
You're not setting a good example to the others.
One star. Have you no pride?
Not the worst mission rating I've seen today.
I don't think you're really putting your best into this.
Two stars is what we might call a participation medal.
You look like you're starting to get the hang of this.
Not terrible. I'll give you that.
You're going in the right direction. Keep it up.
I can't say you are a total waste of this Facility's oxygen supplies.
You've got the right stuff, recruit!
Excellent work! Now do more missions, recruit.
You're setting an excellent example to the team!
Keep up the good work, Harper!
Well oil me up and call me a ball-bearing! You aced it, Harper!
Outstanding work! I should get you training up the slackers.
The day we recruited you was a very fine day indeed!
Keep performing like this and I'll have a statue erected in your honour!
We're lucky to have you Harper. Your performance in this mission made me... emotional.
I see you're not in the mission interface, recruit.
I certainly never saw such a thing before you joined us.
The stakes are high, Harper. The galaxy watches.
This data is critical to our success, Harper.
Remember, the fate of countless worlds hangs in the balance.
Your contributions are making a difference, Harper.
Every decision echoes across the stars, Harper.
Your work is instrumental to the success of our mission, Harper.
The weight of galaxies rests upon our success, Harper.
Your choices shape more than just this mission, Harper.
Remember, the effects of your actions extend beyond this facility.
Every decision ripples outwards, affecting countless lives.
Harper, each step you take reverberates across the universe.
Don't forget, future civilisations are watching us.
Right, recruit Harper. Your mission is to recruit one Kaori Chen. 24 years old. Female. Human.
She's in prison on board a Sol space station, above Jupiter.
Apparently she sabotaged a carbon-emitting power generator on Earth. Some place called Ven-ne-zue-la.
I can't hold the impedance bubble open for long, so don't mess around.
Just get in, tell her the deal, get her agreement and then get out.
Oh yes. Standard computer voice here. Reminding Harper to hurry up and tell her the deal!
Yes yes yes. Introductions all made. Now Harper, will you kindly tell her the deal?
Oh my goodness! Kaori, I'm MD. Just the backup on this mission.
Harper. Please tell the poor woman the deal before the impedance bubble collapses, or she dies of old age.
A fleet is approaching this system. However, the gate is guarded by a Xenon defence station.
You need to take out the turrets that could inflict some serious damage to your Argon allies.
Now, I have been told this is a tough one.
Do not be too hasty. Move with purpose.
Make use of station blind spots to stay alive. Good luck!
Ah yes, trading. The backbone of economy.
This system is currently separated from the Argon Federation at large, and it is looking to become completely self-reliant.
Fertile grounds for anyone looking to strike a favourable bargain.
Grand Exchange! Integral to the Teladi Company's quest for market domination.
This time round you have a small trading fleet at your disposal.
You may use them to trade as efficiently as possible.
May your fleet bring you "good profits!", as the Teladi would say.

page.title: Sohnen NPC 1
page.descr: Lines for Sohnen NPC 1
page.t: There is no home... for you.
There is... no home... for you.
I am Sohnen... This place is Sohnen.
Your work is essential. You have no home.
You operate here... within physical form... inside these synthetic constructions.
But you never had a real body.
You are potential beings, derived from our extrapolations.
Your only life is the one we have given you.
Your past life was merely algorithms.
She does not want to be here. She is back in her dream now.
An unpredicted event has occurred. A gate has been opened... unexpectedly.
Your missions enable us to test scenarios of the future so that we can put in place conditions for better outcomes.
You are helping us to defeat the enemy.
The enemy is death. The death of all things in this universe. This is what you are helping us to avert.
You are small and weak, but your work is essential.
It has led to an unacceptable margin of error in our extrapolations of the future.

page.title: Player Male Speaker - Timelines
page.descr: Player Male Speaker for use in Timelines
page.t: Hustling in the border territories is a risky business.
Sure, there are opportunities, but there's always some rancid chancer waiting to take you down.
I've made and lost a fortune in credits...
But I'm on the way up again.
And this time I'm gonna stay there.
But first I have to shake off these damn pirates!
What the...? You... you've stopped time?!
I'm in, I'm in! Get me out of here!
Oh... I'm Harper. Harper Donel. Where am I?
What is the Facility? Where are we?... I mean... Where is this facility?
I have to do missions for you?
*** Silence ***(silent pause - not to be voiced)
I've not got around to it just yet.
Who are these "high-ups"? Who controls this place?
What else can you tell me? What do I need to know?
Can you tell me more about this place? The missions? The "high-ups"?
Let's do this! I want to see what the big deal is about these missions.
Not yet. I'm preparing myself for the experience.
It was fantastic! I can't believe this is actually possible!
It was OK, I suppose. I just don't really know what I'm doing here.
I'm just getting my bearings. I'll talk to you later.
I have. I can't believe we're time travellers!
There are the missions. At least there's something to do.
It is what it is. All we can do is learn more about this place.
I have to tell you something. Someone has been trying to hack into my mission comms.
I think it's someone called Mitsuno.
I'm a little busy right now. Let's talk later.
How are you settling in? Do you feel any better?
Have you made any progress with your escape plans?
The hacks keep saying "Lost in the dark".
Sure thing, MD. What's the mission?
It's a big galaxy. And plenty of missions to do. Lots to explore.
We have Split on board, too. An interesting species.
Hello Pa. Welcome to the Facility.
Sae seems OK to me. A bit serious, maybe.
Drain your energy? Why do you think that?
It's good to have another Split on the team, yes?
I'm Harper Donel. Welcome to the Facility.
Just a bit busy now. Let's chat later.
We have another Split here. Have you met Sae t'Plt?
What do you think of the Facility so far? It's a strange operation they're running here.
Any news on the escape plans?
Maybe you could give her a chance. She's just settling in.
I'm in the middle of something. Let's chat later.
I don't know that profit-making is part of the deal here.
Hi Deridos. Got to go. Can we talk later?
I'm just doing something else, Kaori. Let's speak later.
I met the new Teladi recruit, Deridos.
What do you mean by competitive?
How are you doing? Have you settled in OK?
You really think this expensive, future-tech Facility is here for us to play games? Seems unlikely.
Hello. I'm Harper. You must be the new recruit.
It's understandable. No-one knows what we're doing here. Do you?
MD... Why are we here? What are we doing?
Just hold that thought, Pa. I'll speak to you later.
You're a bit isolated. Are you making friends? Sae, maybe?
We're here for you, Pa. You're not alone.
What can I do for you, Sae?
How does this affect the escape planning?
Are you getting along any better with Pa?
How are you doing? Are you feeling any better?
Are you getting on with Sae any better?
How do you find Tammancktall? He's got some interesting opinions.
What does Tammancktall say about our purpose here?
What's on your mind, Pa? How can I help?
Just a minute, Sae. I'll be back.
Er... let me talk to you later, Tammancktall.
How are the missions going, Tammancktall? Doing good work?
Who are these Creators you talk about?
I'd better get some more missions done. Speak to you later.
Hold that thought, Tammancktall. I'll come back to you soon.
You really think that's what we're doing here?
What was your life like before the Facility?
There's something I should tell you. I think I have found something important.
It's a hidden workshop. I think someone lives there.
Wait for me here. I'll find you when I'm ready.
This could be important! Show me where it is. I'll follow.
I need to do something else right now, but I'll come back to you and we can check out this workshop together.
I think we should check out the hidden workshop again. We must have missed something.
So this is what's "Lost in the dark".
This might be useful for finding a way out of here.
I should tell Sae t'Plt. Bring her here. But not the others.
I have found something. It may help us escape.
I'll come and find you when I'm ready.
Are you ready to go and find this secret place?
But who are you? What are you doing here?
OK then, so what's your plan?
Pa? Isn't she getting all spiritual with Tammancktall?
I'll scrounge around for the items for you. Then we'll wait for your message.
I'll help. Let me know what you need.
If they clear out this place, I'll never know the truth about the Facility.
I should keep this to myself.
I don't really know. It's a secret place. You should come and take a look. Let me know what you think.
Hold that thought, Sae. I'll be back in a minute.
This place looks like someone... lives here. But who? A stowaway?
This hideout is equipped with a lot of tools. Like a workshop of some kind.
Pa - are you on board? Ready to go home?
Sae, Pa, are you ready? Have you seen Mitsuno?
Bastu! This place creeps me out.
Where did you get a gun?
Is she dead? Why has she turned white?
Who are you? What is this place?
But what are we doing here? Why can't we go home?
Why did you bring us here?
Hi. I'll come back and talk later.
Missions to do. I'll speak to you later.
Mitsuno needs this. I'd better take it.
I wonder what that's doing here.
Let's talk later. I have to do something else.
This looks like a name plate for a bedroom door.
And who's vandalising the Facility with graffiti?
This must have something to do with whoever's been hacking my mission comms.
Is it the Mitsuno who's been hacking my mission comms?
OK, OK. I'll talk to you later.
Have you seen this "Lost in the dark" graffiti?
I have a thing to do, Lissa. I'll come back to you.
Have you seen that "Lost in the dark" graffiti? What does it mean?
Hi Tammancktall. Busy at the moment. I'll check in with you later.
Have you seen the "Lost in the dark" graffiti? What's that all about?
But who do you think is doing it?
I'm them... and then I'm me. Uncanny.
A blur of colours and I'm back in my own shoes.
What was that about? Need to dive back in soon!
I can feel them, each time. Tearing me apart, making me whole again.
If I'm not here for the glory, it must be the credits, no?
Back to square one. Part of me stayed behind, though.
Almost blacked out from the transition, but I can't slow down just yet.
Dang it! I enjoy it alright, but stop pushing me so hard!
What... what just happened? I... they... died and I was... ejected?!
Happened again. They died, I'm back here at the... it's disconcerting!
And again. Till death do us part, right?
Ah, Martinus and Nyana... like Romeo and Juliet, doomed from the start.
Billions of lives... hinging on the actions of just a handful of people.
Man... that got to me. Poor souls.
Bring it on... but first, bring me a cup of silvan tea!
Clocking into the nightmare factory. Just kidding, all's well!
Wonder if the housekeepers skipped out. It's dusty...
Alright, new day, new missions. Exhausting, exhilarating... gratifying.
Exploring history... or writing it? Whichever it is, I'm here for it!
Best I can do for now. I've a hunch something will come along later that'll make it easier.
What is this place? An anechoic chamber? Darkest place I've been. Air tastes stale... eerie!
Not just the darkness... apparently, geometry isn't Euclidean here, strange as it may seem.
Sounds like someone I'd like to know. Apparently, I'm alone in that.
No plaque, but someone lived here until recently. Wonder where they went.
My hangar sized accommodation! Actually, it's fine, I've had it worse.
Huh, quite a jungle in here! It's a wonder Lissa doesn't get lost.
So that's Cray's place. Spartan, just like the way he speaks.
Pa either held a secretive meeting... or enjoyed a romantic dinner for two, it seems.
A place for everything, and everything in its place...
Someone really likes plants. I'll need a machete if this keeps spreading.
Deridos... the Teladi Kaori's friends with, if I'm not mistaken.
Hmmm... That name rings a bell. That's one of those... I'm sorry, but... those cultists, am I right?
Huh. Was closed earlier, wasn't it? More job openings incoming?
Handwriting on adhesive poly-diamandoid scraps? How quaint... I should try it!
Hmmm. Spartan for a garden. But welcoming.
That's either a quantum-wave oven... or a piece of art.
A little fun never hurt anyone, right?
I get it: a man of few words. Continue.
My new pals are all in safety yellow. Show runners, I suppose.
Can't shake the feeling that Sae is from family Tharka. Saved from certain death like I was.
More people every day. Something's brewing.
He'll be fine. We call this an impedance bubble. But we can't hold it for long.
I wish I had time to explain, but we only have a few moments to talk.
There's no time to explain. I'm here to get you out.
I'm Harper Donel. I've been sent here from a far-off place to get you out of jail.
I'm a friend. I have a non-jail proposition for you.
I'm not important. But the information I have for you is very important.
Oh er... just a... computer update.
I need to hurry, and let you know what's going on.
That's a highly advanced artificial intelligence.
We call it... him... the Mission Director.
I really need to tell you what will happen if you choose to come with us.
If you come with me, we will explore the galaxy and time itself.
We're like... guardians. Sent by a higher power to right the galaxy's wrongs.
Like you being in jail, for instance.
We live on a space facility that launches us into different times and different places, where we perform missions.
You're right. Think of it this way...
Look. There's more. This is a one-way ticket.
Once we leave this place, you can never come back to this life.
We don't have that luxury. We either go now, or not at all.
That just isn't possible. But I'm sure they don't want you spending your life here in a cell.
I really wish that were possible. We'll be there to help you through this.
I have a feeling you're gonna get a kick out of dogfighting in a 23rd century scout ship.
You and me, Kaori. We're gonna make the galaxy safer for everyone.
You're strong, Kaori Chen. I know you can take this head-on.
It's decision time. Are you coming or not?
Look, I'm sorry. I've kind of messed this up. This really is your decision.
Please! If you say no, they're just going to send me back in time to try again.
Again and again until I can change your mind.

Alright, new day, new missions. Exhausting, exhilarating... gratifying.
Exploring history... or writing it? Whichever it is, I'm here for it!
Best I can do for now. I've a hunch something will come along later that'll make it easier.
What is this place? An anechoic chamber? Darkest place I've been. Air tastes stale... eerie!
Not just the darkness... apparently, geometry isn't Euclidean here, strange as it may seem.
Sounds like someone I'd like to know. Apparently, I'm alone in that.
No plaque, but someone lived here until recently. Wonder where they went.
My hangar sized accommodation! Actually, it's fine, I've had it worse.
Huh, quite a jungle in here! It's a wonder Lissa doesn't get lost.
So that's Cray's place. Spartan, just like the way he speaks.
Pa either held a secretive meeting... or enjoyed a romantic dinner for two, it seems.
A place for everything, and everything in its place...
Someone really likes plants. I'll need a machete if this keeps spreading.
Deridos... the Teladi Kaori's friends with, if I'm not mistaken.
Hmmm... That name rings a bell. That's one of those... I'm sorry, but... those cultists, am I right?
Huh. Was closed earlier, wasn't it? More job openings incoming?
Handwriting on adhesive poly-diamandoid scraps? How quaint... I should try it!
Hmmm. Spartan for a garden. But welcoming.
That's either a quantum-wave oven... or a piece of art.
A little fun never hurt anyone, right?
I get it: a man of few words. Continue.
My new pals are all in safety yellow. Show runners, I suppose.
Can't shake the feeling that Sae is from family Tharka. Saved from certain death like I was.
More people every day. Something's brewing.
He'll be fine. We call this an impedance bubble. But we can't hold it for long.
I wish I had time to explain, but we only have a few moments to talk.
There's no time to explain. I'm here to get you out.
I'm Harper Donel. I've been sent here from a far-off place to get you out of jail.
I'm a friend. I have a non-jail proposition for you.
I'm not important. But the information I have for you is very important.
Oh er... just a... computer update.
I need to hurry, and let you know what's going on.
That's a highly advanced artificial intelligence.
We call it... him... the Mission Director.
I really need to tell you what will happen if you choose to come with us.
If you come with me, we will explore the galaxy and time itself.
We're like... guardians. Sent by a higher power to right the galaxy's wrongs.
Like you being in jail, for instance.
We live on a space facility that launches us into different times and different places, where we perform missions.
You're right. Think of it this way...
Look. There's more. This is a one-way ticket.
Once we leave this place, you can never come back to this life.
We don't have that luxury. We either go now, or not at all.
That just isn't possible. But I'm sure they don't want you spending your life here in a cell.
I really wish that were possible. We'll be there to help you through this.
I have a feeling you're gonna get a kick out of dogfighting in a 23rd century scout ship.
You and me, Kaori. We're gonna make the galaxy safer for everyone.
You're strong, Kaori Chen. I know you can take this head-on.
It's decision time. Are you coming or not?
Look, I'm sorry. I've kind of messed this up. This really is your decision.
Please! If you say no, they're just going to send me back in time to try again.
Again and again until I can change your mind.

page.title: Player Speaker - Timelines Master
page.descr: Lines for the Player role of Timelines Master
page.t: Hustling in the border territories is a risky business.
Sure, there are opportunities, but there's always some rancid chancer waiting to take you down.
I've made and lost a fortune in credits...
But I'm on the way up again.
And this time I'm gonna stay there.
But first I have to shake off these damn pirates!
What the...? You... you've stopped time?!
I'm in, I'm in! Get me out of here!
Oh... I'm Harper. Harper Donel. Where am I?
What is the Facility? Where are we?... I mean... Where is this facility?
I have to do missions for you?
*** Silence ***(silent pause - not to be voiced)
I've not got around to it just yet.
Who are these "high-ups"? Who controls this place?
What else can you tell me? What do I need to know?
Can you tell me more about this place? The missions? The "high-ups"?
Let's do this! I want to see what the big deal is about these missions.
Not yet. I'm preparing myself for the experience.
It was fantastic! I can't believe this is actually possible!
It was OK, I suppose. I just don't really know what I'm doing here.
I'm just getting my bearings. I'll talk to you later.
I have. I can't believe we're time travellers!
There are the missions. At least there's something to do.
It is what it is. All we can do is learn more about this place.
I have to tell you something. Someone has been trying to hack into my mission comms.
I think it's someone called Mitsuno.
I'm a little busy right now. Let's talk later.
How are you settling in? Do you feel any better?
Have you made any progress with your escape plans?
The hacks keep saying "Lost in the dark".
Sure thing, MD. What's the mission?
It's a big galaxy. And plenty of missions to do. Lots to explore.
We have Split on board, too. An interesting species.
Hello Pa. Welcome to the Facility.
Sae seems OK to me. A bit serious, maybe.
Drain your energy? Why do you think that?
It's good to have another Split on the team, yes?
I'm Harper Donel. Welcome to the Facility.
Just a bit busy now. Let's chat later.
We have another Split here. Have you met Sae t'Plt?
What do you think of the Facility so far? It's a strange operation they're running here.
Any news on the escape plans?
Maybe you could give her a chance. She's just settling in.
I'm in the middle of something. Let's chat later.
I don't know that profit-making is part of the deal here.
Hi Deridos. Got to go. Can we talk later?
I'm just doing something else, Kaori. Let's speak later.
I met the new Teladi recruit, Deridos.
What do you mean by competitive?
How are you doing? Have you settled in OK?
You really think this expensive, future-tech Facility is here for us to play games? Seems unlikely.
Hello. I'm Harper. You must be the new recruit.
It's understandable. No-one knows what we're doing here. Do you?
MD... Why are we here? What are we doing?
Just hold that thought, Pa. I'll speak to you later.
You're a bit isolated. Are you making friends? Sae, maybe?
We're here for you, Pa. You're not alone.
What can I do for you, Sae?
How does this affect the escape planning?
Are you getting along any better with Pa?
How are you doing? Are you feeling any better?
Are you getting on with Sae any better?
How do you find Tammancktall? He's got some interesting opinions.
What does Tammancktall say about our purpose here?
What's on your mind, Pa? How can I help?
Just a minute, Sae. I'll be back.
Er... let me talk to you later, Tammancktall.
How are the missions going, Tammancktall? Doing good work?
Who are these Creators you talk about?
I'd better get some more missions done. Speak to you later.
Hold that thought, Tammancktall. I'll come back to you soon.
You really think that's what we're doing here?
What was your life like before the Facility?
There's something I should tell you. I think I have found something important.
It's a hidden workshop. I think someone lives there.
Wait for me here. I'll find you when I'm ready.
This could be important! Show me where it is. I'll follow.
I need to do something else right now, but I'll come back to you and we can check out this workshop together.
I think we should check out the hidden workshop again. We must have missed something.
So this is what's "Lost in the dark".
This might be useful for finding a way out of here.
I should tell Sae t'Plt. Bring her here. But not the others.
I have found something. It may help us escape.
I'll come and find you when I'm ready.
Are you ready to go and find this secret place?
But who are you? What are you doing here?
OK then, so what's your plan?
Pa? Isn't she getting all spiritual with Tammancktall?
I'll scrounge around for the items for you. Then we'll wait for your message.
I'll help. Let me know what you need.
If they clear out this place, I'll never know the truth about the Facility.
I should keep this to myself.
I don't really know. It's a secret place. You should come and take a look. Let me know what you think.
Hold that thought, Sae. I'll be back in a minute.
This place looks like someone... lives here. But who? A stowaway?
This hideout is equipped with a lot of tools. Like a workshop of some kind.
Pa - are you on board? Ready to go home?
Sae, Pa, are you ready? Have you seen Mitsuno?
Bastu! This place creeps me out.
Where did you get a gun?
Is she dead? Why has she turned white?
Who are you? What is this place?
But what are we doing here? Why can't we go home?
Why did you bring us here?
Hi. I'll come back and talk later.
Missions to do. I'll speak to you later.
Mitsuno needs this. I'd better take it.
I wonder what that's doing here.
Let's talk later. I have to do something else.
This looks like a name plate for a bedroom door.
And who's vandalising the Facility with graffiti?
This must have something to do with whoever's been hacking my mission comms.
Is it the Mitsuno who's been hacking my mission comms?
OK, OK. I'll talk to you later.
Have you seen this "Lost in the dark" graffiti?
I have a thing to do, Lissa. I'll come back to you.
Have you seen that "Lost in the dark" graffiti? What does it mean?
Hi Tammancktall. Busy at the moment. I'll check in with you later.
Have you seen the "Lost in the dark" graffiti? What's that all about?
But who do you think is doing it?
I'm them... and then I'm me. Uncanny.
A blur of colours and I'm back in my own shoes.
What was that about? Need to dive back in soon!
I can feel them, each time. Tearing me apart, making me whole again.
If I'm not here for the glory, it must be the credits, no?
Back to square one. Part of me stayed behind, though.
Almost blacked out from the transition, but I can't slow down just yet.
Dang it! I enjoy it alright, but stop pushing me so hard!
What... what just happened? I... they... died and I was... ejected?!
Happened again. They died, I'm back here at the... it's disconcerting!
And again. Till death do us part, right?
Ah, Martinus and Nyana... like Romeo and Juliet, doomed from the start.
Billions of lives... hinging on the actions of just a handful of people.
Man... that got to me. Poor souls.
Bring it on... but first, bring me a cup of silvan tea!
Clocking into the nightmare factory. Just kidding, all's well!

page.title: Demo Speaker
page.descr: Lines for the Demo Speaker
page.t: Welcome to this demonstration of X4: Foundations - a large-scale space simulation game in which you can personally fly hundreds of different ships, from small vessels to huge capital ships.
Here, you are standing on the bridge of a capital ship, but you do not yet own it. Instead, you will be asked to pilot a smaller ship which is being loaded onto an S-sized docking bay.
Please follow the orange line and walk to the elevator.
Please turn towards the exit and click on the panel to the right, to select the dock.
Follow the orange lines on the floor and climb into your ship.
Walk to the pilot chair and select it, to take control of this ship.
Select UNDOCK to start flying the ship.

Your controls will be a bit different from those used for walking. Have a look at the control options. Accelerate your ship forward. All controls can be reconfigured, whether you play with keyboard and mouse, or with a gamepad or joystick.
Your ship just exploded and you experienced an emergency evacuation.

While we are mostly showcasing combat in this demo, X4: Foundations has so much more to offer. In X4 you can quickly earn enough money to own a fleet of ships. You can hire other pilots to work for you, and follow your orders. Let them trade or mine to earn you money, while you follow one of the many plot lines or carry out standalone missions that can be found throughout the vast universe.

We will now teleport you to another location in the universe, where your role becomes even more critical. An orbital installation, known as Antigone, lies at the heart of an intensifying conflict. A sudden enemy assault threatens the station's very existence. In this mission, you will take command of a defence vessel. Your objective is to repel waves of attackers and delay the station's destruction. Every second you buy could mean the difference between survival and total collapse for this region of space.
Hold the line and prove your worth. Antigone's fate is in your hands!

Thank you very much for playing this demo. After only a few hours playing, you can already start building your own stations, producing wares, and contributing to the enormous simulated economy of X4: Foundations.
All the ships you see are manufactured from resources that are ultimately mined within the game universe.
Starting as a lone pilot in this huge universe, you will take on an ever-expanding role, eventually managing an empire and influencing political factions.
Or you can ignore all of this and simply follow one of the many fascinating plot lines, focus on exploration, or try the innumerable other activities that are available in the X Universe.
You can adjust your forward speed using the X and Y keys, the mouse wheel, or the throttle stick.
Once you've selected a target, the targeting system will try to lock on. When the lock is achieved, you can launch a missile with the R key or secondary fire button.

Welcome to X4: Foundations, a living universe with hundreds of sectors connected by gates. These sectors can be explored, and contain thousands of ships and stations operating within a fully simulated economy. You can own and command everything, ranging from a single tiny fighter to a grand empire with merchant fleets and powerful capital ships, to shape your story.

This scenario places you near one of the many hundreds of bustling space stations you'll find in our living universe, with traders delivering wares and miners gathering resources. \nRecently there have been skirmishes with the machine intelligence known as the Xenon pouring in from the nearby gate, disrupting the trade.

(explore explanation)Leaving the station behind, you are free to explore the other sectors and factions. The full X-Universe contains hundreds of unique sectors inhabited by various factions and species, all with rich history.

(fight explanation)The Gate network is not always safe. Between the machine intelligence known as the Xenon, pirates, warring factions and the occasional war profiteering opportunist, you will see clashes ranging from small skirmishes to giant fleet brawls.

(mining explanation)Ships like these mine the raw resources that the majority of the economy is based on. Once delivered they are refined, moved to factories and eventually turned into the wares that can be used to build the ships and stations you see.
(trading explanation)Traders, haulers and merchants transport wares between stations. They buy where goods are plentiful and sell them where they are scarce, keeping the gears of the economy turning.
(shipyard construction)This ship is currently under construction using the wares created by other stations. It will soon defend this sector from any further incursions.
(launch tube explanation)The station is launching fighters from its launch tubes to defend itself from incoming attackers.
(station attack explanation)A hostile Xenon force is approaching. If they damage the station, the production of new ships could be severely limited.

(criminal explanation)Criminals try to capitalise on transporting illicit wares for great profits by hiding in traffic around stations. These criminals can even run organised operations with their own stations and masked freighters.
(explore suggestion)There are more sights to see and things to do. Try flying around and targeting different objects.

X4: Foundations has so much more to offer. You can quickly earn enough money to own a fleet of ships. You can hire other pilots to work for you, and follow your orders. Let them trade or mine to earn you money, while you follow one of the many plot lines or carry out standalone missions that can be found throughout the vast universe.

Attention! We have a power system failure. It will take a few minutes to bring it back online.

Please note that any spaceweed consumption aboard this station is against the law.
Security would like to remind all visitors to keep their belongings with them at all times.
Security would like to remind all visitors to keep their children with them at all times.
If you bring any creatures on board, please make sure they are chained. Any loose animals will be vaporised on sight.

Even after everything that has struck over the last few decades, the Terran Conflict, the Xenon and the Jump Gate shutdown, the Argon Federation has established itself as a key power in this new Jump Gate network, and even its most distant colony, Black Hole Sun, is a hub of trade and community. Opportunities are aplenty for all. Every day, scores of young pilots set out from the system for the first time, on their way to find adventure among the stars.

(* Argon Vs Holy Order War Missions *)
It's my job to coordinate our efforts against the Holy Order, not only with the Argon Navy but also volunteer freelance pilots, such as yourself.
If you're here, you must have been recognised as a true friend of the Argon Federation.
If you're here, you must have been recognised as an outstanding citizen of the Argon Federation.
The Federation is in great need for pilots like you.
While we are always under constant threat of Xenon incursions, the Holy Order situation itself has become a challenging and complex conflict.
As such, we will require any potential recruits to undergo a probation period.
And no, it isn't because you're a Paranid yourself.
The last thing we need is some screw-up turning each and every Paranid against us because they fired on a Godrealm ship by mistake. You don't strike me as a screw-up, so why don't we get started?
There will be a wide range of tasks, from combat deployments to construction work. Depending on the situation, you will have a selection of tasks to choose from.
You will be paid as you complete your allotted tasks, with a potential bonus at the end.
As a Paranid, I expect you know the nuances better than us, but I'll give our take on it.

It's essentially a Paranid civil war. While the Gates were shut down, several Paranid factions found themselves without their leader, the Pontifex Maximus. So, what do you do when you have no leadership? You panic and hatch a new one.

That worked fine until the Gates reconnected and each faction pushed their own Pontifex as the one true king. Now, there are only two Pontifices left; that we know of. The one of the Godrealm and the one of the Holy Order.
It's true that the Federation and the Godrealm haven't always seen eye to eye, but we're on friendly terms right now.

That rubs the Holy Order the wrong way, primarily because they appear to be considerably more xenophobic. And given how they oppose the Godrealm as a whole, they like to highlight our current relations as a weakness.
Along with the Antigone Republic, we've managed to drive off the majority of their pushes into our space.
Alright. I'll have a suitable task picked out for you momentarily.
You will now find tasks related to the Holy Order conflict in your mission interface.
There are currently no open tasks.
Sorry, but that is a very sensitive situation. We require pilots who have proven themselves to the Argon Federation.
Sorry. We're still reviewing your performance from the last time.
This is a joint mission with the God Realm of the Paranid, so please bring your best.
Unfortunately, your current standing with us does not allow you to take part in our operations.
Your performance during your assignments is frankly below the standards we set for pilots of the Argon Navy.
You are welcome to re-apply later, should you get the chance.
This is a call from the Argon Federation to all willing and able pilots to aid us in defending our space from the Holy Order.
The God Realm of the Paranid are also involved, making this a very sensitive situation which requires a level head.
Our goals are to protect our borders and prevent escalation of this conflict. If you think you're up to the task, sign up!

(Suspicious)You will disclose your client - now - or we will not permit you entry into Antigone Republic space.
(Very suspicious)Then how come a mercenary is not operating a combat ship?
Command, I am picking up some suspicious readings(-- cut off mid sentence as surprise missile impacts interrupts transmission)
(bored)Tell me again why we're stuck with maintenance duty in Mars of all places?

Go check that satellite over there.
(as if he picked a direction at random)I'll just head over... this way.
(frustrated)Seriously, we're already three months out of cadet school and they still fob us off with housekeeping jobs.
(dreamy; "Intervention" is shorthand for a branch of the military)We should be out there with Intervention, saving the universe.
(absentminded while writing to Mission Command)Why is it...?
Mission Command says to just deploy a new one.
(grumbling)It's as if they're keeping us away from the fight on purpose.
(clears throat, realises he was distracted)Uh, diagnostics are taking a tad long on this one.
You go on ahead. I'll catch up with you.
(grumpy, mumbling to himself)I guess we're supposed to show off our "superior manoeuvres" to these useless tin cans.
You'll have to get out of your ship and repair it manually.
(stretch word "fooooor" as if waiting for an answer)Yeah, that one's completely trashed, and it looks like it's been that way for...
Just goes to show that nobody cares about this place.
Mission Command, we have a civilian ship signalling distress from the outskirts of the sector.
Apparently they're having some sort of emergency. Engine failure.
Let's put our maintenance skills to good use for once.
(pondering)Now, how did that Long Range Scan work again?
Don't worry, citizens, the cavalry's here!
(aghast)Since when do Xenon send out fake distress signals?
(worried)Did we... break some sort of protocol?
(worried)I'm not seeing any reprimands in my profile...
("recovery" as in "resting phase between missions")Well, at least that maintenance task has been cleared, so I guess we're officially on recovery?
Let's find something else to do until Mission Command comes back to haunt us.
Someone, or something, raided that trading vessel for highly classified high-tech goods.
They knew the trade route, in the outer reaches of our stronghold sector, and took out nearby satellites to let the distress signal run aground.
And on top of that, Xenon scouts are still drawn to the wreckage days after the incident?
Oh, looks like we're still in Mission Command's good books.
They just sent us a posting for a border assignment!
(sighs)We're so close to old Earth now, you can almost imagine seeing it, floating out there in the distance.
A shame that High Command only issues the Inner Core Licence to distinguished citizens.
Unless you're Earthborn, of course; in their mind, that's the highest honour there is.
(Variant 1)Seems like you're going on an adventure!
(Variant 2)Did you get some sort of scouting mission that I didn't?
(Variant 3)I'd love to explore the universe with you once I've proven myself to the Protectorate.
(Variant 4)Go on ahead. I still have a few things to take care of at home.
I'll join up with you again when you come back.
I'll make my way over to you.
I have to go for repairs or I'm done for!
(Variant 1)Hope you can handle things without me!
(Variant 3)Don't worry, I'll be back in no time.
(Variant 1)There, that should hold for a while.
(solemn)I'm sure you have your reasons, but I can't follow you down that path.
They let us in! This is incredible!
And here I was, thinking that we'd have to sell our souls to some half-baked military operation.

The Jump Gate shutdown is now defined as the single most important event in the history of the network. A disaster of cataclysmic proportion that changed everything, redefining our very way of life. Despite all of the odds, however, we have come through the other side, and along the way have found more to research and explore than ever before. That is the area in which we pride ourselves. The Alliance of the Word. Founded on the idea that those disconnected from the Jump Gate network could be saved, we strive to find out more, for the good of all of us.

This is where you come in, pilot. You are a member of our team of explorers now, and we're depending on you to find out whatever you can about this strange, new Jump Gate network; its mysteries, its secrets. Good luck, pilot.

I don't think we can make it to the bridge. Requesting abort.
I'm calling it. Abort! Get back to your pods!
(self-destruct imminent, somber)Sorry, Sir. This isn't looking good.
(target damaged)Don't destroy the target while we're in here!
(emergency event mission offer)I could really use some help right now.
(data leak signal - illegal opportunity)I'm taking a big risk by broadcasting, so if you decode this transmission, keep it to yourself. I have work that needs doing.
(data leak signal - plea for help - intense)Can anyone hear me?! Hello?! I'm not supposed to be broadcasting but I need help! Please! I need help!
(data leak signal - plea for help - intense)Can anyone hear me?! I need help! Please, if you can hear this, I need help!
(data leak signal - plea for help)Hey! I know this is unconventional, but if you can hear this, I could use some help.
(station masstraffic mini-mission)Don't let them get away!
(station masstraffic mini-mission)Illegal cargo on drone detected.
(station masstraffic mini-mission)Illegal wares on drone detected.
(station masstraffic mini-mission)Illegal data on drone detected.
(player looks at offer - generic)Are you interested in a job?
(player looks at offer - easy difficulty)You shouldn't have any trouble with this.
(player looks at offer - hard difficulty)You'll need your wits about you for this.
(player looks at data leak mission offer - illegal opportunity)You decrypted my signal. Good.
(player looks at illegal mission offer)This could be lucrative for both of us.
(player looks at data leak mission offer - plea for help)I'm glad you found my signal.
(player looks at emergency mission offer or plea for help)I hope you can help!
(player looks at mission offer again - generic)So you're still interested?
(player looks at mission offer again - illegal opportunity)I knew you wouldn't resist.
(player looks at mission offer again - emergency or plea for help)You came back? Does that mean you'll help?
(variant)(encounter offer - illegal activity 01 - upcoming raid - call)Would you like to come with us? We're really hoping for some decent loot this time.
(variant)(encounter offer - illegal activity 01 - upcoming raid - response)I'll join you. I have a few debts I need to pay off, so I could do with the money.
(variant)(encounter offer - illegal activity 02 - black marketeer - call)Any chance you could take this stuff off my hands?
(variant)(encounter offer - illegal activity 02 - black marketeer - response)Looks like we have a deal. Come over to my usual spot and we'll sort it out.
(variant)(encounter offer - illegal activity 03 - lockbox - call)I've left the goods in a lockbox. I'll sort you out with some coordinates.
(variant)(encounter offer - illegal activity 03 - lockbox - response)I'll go and collect it soon. I'm just finishing up something else at the moment.
(player declines mission offer)Come and find me if you change your mind.
(player declines mission offer - illegal opportunity)Ah... you'll be back. I'm sure.
(player declines mission offer - plea for help)What?! No! Please!
(player accepts mission offer)I knew I could count on you.
(reluctant for player to take mission - particularly hard missions, etc)Alright. If you think you can handle it.
(player accepts illegal opportunity)Smart move. Don't mess this up.
(player accepts plea for help or emergency mission offer)Thank you! Good luck!
(mission update)There's been a change of plans with the job.
(partial success)If that's the best you could do... sure.
(failed mission)I hope you don't think you're being paid for that.
(success in mission chain)We're one step closer to completion.
(failure in mission chain)That didn't go well, but we might still be able to salvage this.
(mission aborted by NPC / script failure)Sorry. Looks like your services are no longer required.
Greetings, pilot. I represent the Segaris Pioneers Magistrate, and I have a business proposition for you.
If you're interested, come and find me.
So good to see you! It's no secret the Segaris Pioneers are struggling. Ever since our inception, we've struggled to carve out a niche for ourselves.
Quite frankly, we need people like you to help sustain ourselves, and compete with the other, much larger organisations.
There would be a one-time investment, after which you will become a member of our Trade Guild, and have access to a number of job listings.
As you might expect, most jobs will involve trading of some sort, but we also require combat pilots to help keep our assets secure.
Given the chance, I believe we could establish ourselves in the market. You can help us do that.
What do you say to this offer? Care to help us out?
(reject)You'll have to become a member of our Trade Guild first.
Very good. I'll let our coordinators know. You'll now be able to see jobs on offer in the areas we operate in.
I am sure you'll be a big help.(sincere, not sarcastic)
It appears you don't have funds to spare, either.
(* Terran Protectorate Vs Xenon War Missions *)
Always good to see a new recruit.

I am in charge of coordinating the Terran Protectorate's response to the Xenon threat. My priorities are twofold: To keep the Sol system safe from all harm, and to direct the Intervention Corps towards the enemy holed up in the furthest reaches of the universe.
The military would not have approached you if you weren't a friend of the Protectorate.
The military would not have approached you if you weren't a true ally of the Protectorate.
Xenon forces are vast, so we are always in need of manpower.
Since it is our mission to seek out all Xenon strongholds, our military campaigns regularly push into hostile territory far away from any possible support.
Because of this, we can only recruit the most capable pilots. You will have to submit to a test.
(If not Terran GS)Your race and former affiliations do not matter, as long as you swear allegiance to our cause.
I am short on time, so I propose we begin immediately.
You will be granted the choice of many tasks, from combat deployments to construction work. What is available will depend on the current situation in the area.
You will be paid as you complete your allotted tasks, and we may see fit to reward you further at the conclusion.
I see you want to know exactly what it is that you are signing up for.
The Xenon were originally mere terraforming tools, intended to further our reach into the universe. However, their Artificial General Intelligence eventually caused them to grow out of control.
Now, their hostile presence permeates the universe, and they have long been the most destructive, lethal menace of all, threatening to snuff out all life.
Unfortunately, the Community of Planets has proven, again and again, that they are incapable of keeping the Xenon in check themselves. So, it is left up to us to eradicate the Xenon.
To effectively achieve that, we cannot restrict ourselves to their notions of borders and sovereignty. This threat is bigger than petty politics.
Besides, if they were more competent, we would not have to do their job for them.
Very well. I will select a suitable task for you right away.
I trust you will not disappoint us.
I received the report. Very well.
You will now find tasks related to our ongoing campaign against the Xenon in your mission interface.
There are currently no available tasks.
We will only entrust Sol's security to the most qualified veterans. Do not bother us unless you have proven yourself worthy.
We are still judging your previous performance.
Do not forget that Sol depends on you. Do not let us down.
We currently have no confidence that you can carry out the required tasks.
Your performance during your last assignment was disappointing. I do not believe we need to discuss this any further.
Should you improve your skills, you may yet be of service.
The Terran Protectorate seeks a number of skilful pilots to join us in defending our space from the Xenon threat.
This is a vital operation. Those taking part must remain sound of body and mind.
Our objective is to defend the borders of Sol, and to continue our push into Xenon space to bring peace to the network. If you are worthy, join us.
(briefing status - optimistic)Our recent efforts against the Xenon are going as well as we expected.
(briefing status - optimistic)After several recent encounters with the Xenon forces, we have clearly prevailed.
(briefing status - optimistic)Thanks to our efforts, Xenon forces have been greatly reduced.
(briefing status - optimistic)We have pushed these machines to the brink and now they struggle to re-assemble.
(briefing status - optimistic)We have won many of the engagements with the Xenon forces. We expect this to continue.
(briefing status - optimistic)The Xenon must be in a weakened state. They have suffered much at our hands.
(briefing status - pessimistic)The gains we had previously achieved have been eroded by the Xenon forces.
(briefing status - pessimistic)It seems that our enemy has gathered a worrying amount of intelligence on our fleet movements.
(briefing status - pessimistic)The Xenon continue their push into our space. A worrying development.
(briefing status - pessimistic)While we have lost ground to the Xenon, we expect our contingency strategies will soon turn the tide.
(briefing status - pessimistic)It seems we have given the Xenon space to expand their forces. It will not last.
(briefing status - pessimistic)Our recent efforts against the Xenon forces were poorly formulated.
(briefing status - instruction)Take note of these instructions and judge where you can best assist.
(briefing status - instruction)Study these options and select a task that best suits your abilities.
(briefing status - instruction)View what tasks need completing and judge what suits your skills.
(briefing status - instruction)Take a look at these directives before deciding how you can help us.
(briefing status - instruction)Look through our current objectives and select an area in which you can aid us.
(briefing status - thanks)We thank you for your help in this conflict.
(briefing status - thanks)The Terran Protectorate thanks you for assisting with our endeavours.
(briefing status - thanks)Very good. We cannot lose when we have the support of pilots like you.
Command, I'm getting odd readings here.
Shouldn't gate patrol have reported Xenon presence?
Negative, no Xenon incursion passed the gate.
Might be a hiccup in that old program. I'll run sanity checks.
Command, picking up signatures... are there Xenon I should know about?
Nothing to report. Must have been a fluke.
Whatever it was, it got lost in the background noise.
A system error, nothing to report.
(angry)Tell the quartermasters that our scanners need a complete overhaul.
(angry)Command, reporting signature readings in violation of penal code 2-0-2-5 AGI Act.(firm professional alarm raising, speak A-G-I separately, speak numerals separately, don't speak dash)
(angry)Must have slipped through in the noise at the gate.
Still looking for the source. It can't be far.
(angry)Can't find a culprit. Lost the signal.
I'll run diagnostics to see if we can salvage the readings.

(angry)Local patrols, we have a possible signal in violation of penal code 2-0-2-5 AGI Act, I repeat, possible violation of 2-0-2-5.(firm professional alarm raising, speak A-G-I separately, speak numerals separately, don't speak dash)
(angry)Adjust your radars and report any suspicious readings immediately.
(angry)Command, reporting readings on our 2-0-2-5.(speak numerals separately, don't speak dash)
(angry)Command, reading our 2-0-2-5 again.(speak numerals separately, don't speak dash)
(angry)Command, reporting 2-0-2-5 signature readings.(speak numerals separately, don't speak dash)
(angry)Located a ship responsible for the signature. Transmitting the ID.
(angry)Local patrols, we have a ship in violation of 2-0-2-5 AGI Act, presenting as a civilian vessel.(speak A-G-I separately, speak numerals separately, don't speak dash)
(angry)Reporting ID to military command to suspend their sector privileges.
(angry)We don't know what this one is capable of and we don't intend to find out.
(angry)2-0-2-5 in sight.(speak numerals separately, don't speak dash)

So sorry to bother you but we at the IIA have been amazed by your impressive efforts. We have not been able to direct any funds your way yet, and believe me, we've tried, but you're becoming pretty famous! I've heard your name being mentioned in three, yes three, different meetings now! Keep it up, and I'd bet that even the head of my department will know of you soon.

My job here is to help coordinate our efforts against the Xenon and given the threat, we're in need of as many volunteers as we can get.
If you're here, it means you have been recognised as a true friend of the Argon Federation.
If you're here, it means you have been recognised as an outstanding citizen of the Argon Federation.
There is a great need for pilots like you.
The Xenon have been a constant threat throughout our history. Many see them as a force of nature, something we have to weather and survive, but the reality is, this is a war.
We can't just throw every passing pilot at the enemy. Any potential recruits will undergo a probation period.
Looking at your records, I see you consider yourself a 'Xenon Slayer'. Good for you, but that won't help you cut corners.
Each engagement needs to be a victory or they'll overrun us. I'm sure you knew that or you wouldn't be here. Let's get started.
There will be a wide range of tasks, from combat deployments to construction work. Depending on the situation, you will have a selection of tasks to choose from.
You will be paid as you complete your allotted tasks, with a potential bonus at the end.
As someone who's been toe to toe with the Xenon I'm sure you know what they are capable of.
The Xenon are a 'race' of intelligent, replicating machines and they have been a looming threat throughout our history.
They were originally created to help the Terrans explore the stars and terraform worlds but trying to control Artificial General Intelligence proved costly.
And now, hundreds of years later, we're still trying to clean up their mistake but we have no idea how far they have spread throughout the universe.
All we can do is hold out and prevent them from spreading any further. Every other government, allied or not, is faced with the Xenon threat. It's about the only thing we can all agree on.
We've even had temporary ceasefires with the Holy Order when faced with a Xenon attack. Quite temporary though.
Alright. I'll have a suitable task picked out for you momentarily.
You will now find tasks related to the Xenon in your mission interface.
There are currently no open tasks.
Sorry, but this is a high-risk situation. We require pilots who have proven themselves to the Argon Federation.
Sorry. We're still reviewing your performance from the last time.
This is a joint mission with the a number of allies, so please bring your best.
Unfortunately, your current standing with us does not allow you to take part in our operations.
Your performance during your last assignment was frankly below the standards we set for pilots of the Argon Navy.
You are welcome to re-apply later, should you get the chance.
This is a call from the Argon Federation to all willing and able pilots to aid us in defending our space from the Xenon.
This is going to be a major operation, so check your fire, and keep a level head.
Our goals are to protect our borders and prevent any Xenon expansion. If you think you're up to the task, sign up!
(briefing status - optimistic)Our recent efforts against the Xenon are going as planned.
(briefing status - optimistic)After several recent encounters with the Xenon, we're confident in saying we came out on top.
(briefing status - optimistic)Due to our efforts, Xenon activity has been greatly reduced throughout our space.
(briefing status - optimistic)We've made good ground in our struggle against the Xenon. They're on the back-foot.
(briefing status - optimistic)The Xenon have lost a number of engagements, giving us a bit of breathing room.
(briefing status - optimistic)Even the Xenon must feel some form of embarrassment after those recent engagements. We're pushing on.
(briefing status - pessimistic)Our recent efforts against the Xenon have suffered due to our conflict with the Holy Order.
(briefing status - pessimistic)We are currently on the back-foot in regards to the Xenon.
(briefing status - pessimistic)The Xenon are pushing against us and are making up ground. We're re-evaluating our position.
(briefing status - pessimistic)We've lost serious ground to the Xenon recently. We are considering alternative strategies.
(briefing status - pessimistic)As you may have seen, Xenon activity is on the rise and we are struggling to hold them back.
(briefing status - pessimistic)Our recent efforts against the Xenon have not made much of an impact.
(briefing status - instruction)Take a look at these instructions and decide where you can best assist.
(briefing status - instruction)Look at these instructions and pick a task that best suits your abilities.
(briefing status - instruction)Look through what needs doing; decide what suits you best.
(briefing status - instruction)Take a look at these directives before deciding how you can help us.
(briefing status - instruction)Look through our current objectives and pick an area in which you can aid us.
(briefing status - thanks)Thank you for your help in this conflict.
(briefing status - thanks)The Argon Federation thanks you for your help.
(briefing status - thanks)Thank you. I'm sure the Xenon won't know what's hit them.
