(Sly, conspiratorial tone)Technically, all sides have committed to a peace treaty, and the Secret Service's directive is to not interfere with Argon affairs.
This is why we've approached you.
(Not Terran GS)Not being a Terran citizen, you are what the intelligence community refers to as a floater agent.
(Terran GS)While you are a Terran citizen, you have no documented ties to the Terran Secret Service.
Without a traceable connection to us, you will be able to operate in Argon space without much restraint.
We have identified an Antigone Republic Civil Servant we believe is willing to sell confidential Argon information to the highest bidder.
You are to meet said informant, and, should his intel prove to be of value, obtain it for us.

(Lots of gravitas)At this point I have to inform you that this is a strictly covert operation, and should you be compromised, the Terran High Command will deny any knowledge of, or responsibility for, your actions.
(Slightly annoyed)What are you waiting for, agent? Get out there. Sol security is at stake!
Ah, I see that you have made your way into Antigone space, despite the complications.
The informant you are about to contact goes by the name of Saman Red.
He is a Public Servant in the Antigone Republic Defence Department.
You are to bribe him for the information, but I recommend that you are subtle about it.
In order to be able to transmit the data to us, you will have to set up a satellite in close proximity to the station.
To properly encrypt that traffic, it has to be an Advanced Satellite(see {20201,20401}).
I'm sending Dal the pertinent information now.
(Slightly annoyed)Agent, you still haven't met with the Antigone contact. What's going on?
(CovOps Chapter 2 - Secret Service Contact Voice Lines)
(Very matter of fact, businesslike tone)Thank you for verifying that this lead was a dead end.
It would have been too risky to send one of our own agents, but we had to be sure nonetheless.
We will make sure we properly compensate you for exposing yourself to these risks once you have completed your task.
Now, since we did not obtain any useful intelligence, we will have to approach this from a different angle:
Although the Antigone Memorial system now belongs to the Antigone Republic, its major planet, Sandwell, is still under Argon jurisdiction.
Sandwell, as hostile an environment as it is, is host to the biggest data archive in the Argon Federation. Accessing it could unearth invaluable strategic information.
It is understandable, therefore, that the security of this underground complex is very tight.
Luckily, we won't have to access the planetary archive itself.
According to our reports, the Antigone Republic operates a relay station with direct access to the Sandwell Archives.
It was set up at an undisclosed location to maintain contact between the planetary archives and distant Argon fleets.
You will help us find that relay station.
Doing so will require a Security Decryption System with which to hack into Argon systems, as well as an EMP(pronounced E.M.P.) bomb, and a spacesuit bomb launcher.
Once you've managed to get your hands on all of the required items, we will be able to manipulate the Argon workforce database.
(admiring, approving tone)I see you already have these items with you. Well done for coming prepared!
The Security Decryption System makes it possible for us to access the station's internal workforce database, in order to rewrite job offers.
We may not know which station acts as the relay, but someone on the Argon's payroll definitely does.
The Argon Federation would not delegate maintenance to any external services, so if we convincingly fabricate a distress call, their response will give away the station's location.
I'm sending the relevant information now.
(Pleased)I see things are proceeding as planned!
Now we wait for a repair crew to take the bait.
(CovOps Chapter 3 - Secret Service Contact Voice Lines)
(Annoyed, but not surprised)Well, I suppose this is the downside of sending untrained personnel to do a professional's job.
I wasn't sure if you were up for the task, so I had another agent follow the ship as well.
Luckily, we were able to intercept some short-range transmissions that gave away where they were heading.
(Disgusted at the displayed incompetence)Unbelievable! These naive fools just yield their space to the Xenon without any effort to contain the threat.
It just goes to show how their complacency puts the entirety of the human species at risk.
Now we have confirmation of which station hosts their relay servers.
We still need you to dock at the station and do some reconnaissance work.
See if you can pinpoint the location of the Server Room, but be inconspicuous about it.
(Matter of fact, unsurprised)Unsurprisingly, this station's security is tight.
I am confident that we can get you access, though.
Give the Secret Service some time to set things up.
We need to move a few of our assets into place, and work on forging the necessary security clearance.
While we prepare the infiltration, we want you to complete some tasks for us.
They will help weaken the Argon Federation's position without showing our hand.
We have been running a program to fund and arm organisations opposing the Argon Federation, and we intend for them to play a part in the next stage of our operation.
You will supply them with whatever they need to assist with our undertaking.
In addition, we also aim to undermine the Argon Federation's economic position.
Set up a station that undercuts their most profitable exported wares, and the ensuing financial losses will weaken them.
I am sending Dal the relevant briefings as we speak.
You will have to repeat the hacking process to get another target lined up.
(CovOps Chapter 4 - Secret Service Contact Voice Lines)
Our intelligence officers have concluded their preparations.
(Quite forceful)Agent, I require you to join us for the final briefing.
Our preparations are going as planned, but you need to keep working on destabilising the Argon Federation as well.
(CovOps Chapter 5 - Secret Service Contact Voice Lines)
It is a forged Sandwell Archive Pass.
You will need it to access the planetary database once you are inside the server room.
Now, how you will gain entry to that room in the first place is another matter.
A matter for which I have asked our associate here to join us.
The Scale Plate Pact fleet will provide us with a diversion.
Yes, Antigone security will have their hands full.
Once the fighting starts, you should be able to gain entry easily.
All of their marines should be otherwise engaged.
Agent, set up in close proximity to the station, and wait for the diversion to commence.
(Tense)Better get ready. This is going to be the most crucial part of the entire operation.
Word just got back that you managed to escape the station.
Hopefully you picked up enough data to really cripple the Argon Federation.
We will sort the details out together.
Meet me for the final debriefing. Bring whatever data you have gathered.
(Curious but annoyed)Any progress to show for the relay station hack? Did you get your hands on anything useful yet?
(CovOps Chapter 6 - Secret Service Contact Voice Lines)
One of the agents we have embedded in Antigone Republic institutions has uncovered a slight complication.
(Annoyed)That nosey Antigone Republic official, Saman Red, has made some connections that he shouldn't have.
I knew we should have played this whole operation even closer to our chest.
He is on his way to meet with Argon Federation officials to reveal what he has learned.
We need to ensure that under no circumstances does he make it to that meeting.
If they realise the Terran Protectorate's role in this operation, we won't be able to leverage the stolen intelligence.
(Dissapointed)It is most regrettable that this operation did not yield the expected results.
For now, we have recalled all of our field agents, and are analysing what caused this operation to go wrong.
After being active for us for so long, the risk of someone connecting you to our government would increase significantly with each operation.
(Cold)We will not approach you again for further clandestine operations in Argon space.
(Cold and distant)Do not shed a single tear over the death of an enemy of the Terran people.
Had we not intervened, all of our work would have been for nothing.
Now, meet me on my ship to hand over the intel!
I have to say, I am surprised you managed to pull this off. Quite frankly, I had my doubts.
(With gravitas)The Terran Protectorate thanks you for your service. We will take it from here.
Naturally, your deeds will never be acknowledged by the Terran High Command, but know that you have an ally in us nonetheless.
We have nothing further to discuss. You are dismissed.
(serious, lecturing; "doesn't do accidents" is meant both in general and right now)Mars doesn't do "accidents", cadet.
Our specialists will take over from here.
(menacing)And you, Cadets, will hear from me... shortly.

page.title: Mission Argon/Terran NPC Male 4 / Terran Cadet Gamestart Character
page.descr: Lines for Mission Argon NPC Male 4
page.t: In the aftermath of the escalating tensions between the United Space Command and the Commonwealth, culminating in the destruction of the Torus Aeternal, the people of the solar system welcomed the seclusion the Jump Gate shutdown brought with it. In isolation they prospered, and soon began to heal, putting the traumatic events of the past behind themselves. After an initial period of instability, the USC government was restructured, and out of the wreckage of the old, the Terran Protectorate was born. Now, having re-established contact with the Gate network, we, the Protectorate, are the shield valiantly standing between its inhabitants and the Xenon menace. The other factions may not recognise us as supreme protectors just yet, but they will.

Ever since I can remember, I have dreamt of seeing Earth, humble origin of our species, up close. Since I was born on a trading vessel in the far orbit around Titan, the core of the solar system remains, according to Protectorate policy, beyond my reach. That is, until I have made a name for myself. Having recently graduated from Cadet School, I aim to do just that.
Do you know what causes those anomalies?
This is gamma team. We're done with our satellites.

page.title: Mission Argon/Terran NPC Female 5 / Pioneer Gamestart Character
page.descr: Lines for Mission Argon NPC Female 5
page.t: The mission statement of the Pioneer Initiative was to expand the Terran sphere of influence past Sol's Gates. Refugee communities, suddenly stranded when the gates disconnected, along with disenfranchised people born on the outer rim of Sol, were brought together under the banner of expanding into the unknown. At first, it was merely a tool established by the Terran government with the express intent of keeping these disparate groups at arm's length, and to create another protective buffer between Sol and the Gate network. Ever since their inception, however, these resolute Pioneers ceaselessly fought to loosen the Terrans' grip over the organisation, in order to turn it into something truly inspiring - and independent.

For us Segaris Pioneers, science is the cornerstone of society. With the few resources we have available to us, it is the only way we could ever hope to make Brennan's Triumph our home, and to truly free ourselves from the Terran yoke. For that reason I could never give up the pursuit of knowledge, no matter what dangerous places it might lead me to.
Do you know what causes those anomalies?
This is gamma team. We're done with our satellites.
It's been years now since the Gate to Aldrin shut down. I wonder how the people there are doing.
Are they scared? Do they miss their loved ones? I wonder if we're ever going to hear from them.
So many technological advancements, and we are still mostly clueless about how the Gates work and what affects them. We just take them for granted.
I wish I could talk to whomever built them, ask them why? Why build a network of Gates and then leave?
So many questions yet to be answered. I guess the upside is that I won't run out of things to investigate any time soon.

page.title: Mission Argon/Terran NPC Male 5 / Yaki Renegade (Obelisk Ikegami) - Yaki investigation
page.descr: Lines for Mission Argon NPC Male 5
page.t: (Terran War Intro - Minor NPC: Yaki Renegade)
(unhinged, close to screaming)Never! This is where their meddling ends. This is where it all ends!
(unhinged, close to screaming)I've watched you and your puppets cower in fear long enough!
(unhinged, close to screaming)Your chains will not shackle me any longer!
(unhinged, almost screaming)Who treads there? One step closer and you're space fly chow!
(unhinged, almost screaming)Fools! I will see you slaughtered for this!
(unhinged, almost screaming)Come, my children! Tear them from their metal coffins!

page.title: Mission Argon/Terran NPC Female 6 / Yaki Civilian - Yaki investigation
page.descr: Lines for Mission Argon NPC Female 6
page.t: (trembling)What do you want? Are you threatening me? I have no further business with you!
(bitter)What's that supposed to tell me? That you're willing to murder the unfortunate until you get what you want? Is that how you negotiate?
(bitter)There are many here like me. People who've found a glimmer of purpose with the Pioneers, after everything else failed them.
(bitter)And day after day, people like you, who just want to ruin our lives for the sake of it, keep showing up.
(determined; "you" refers to the lackeys of the Terran Protectorate)I won't put up with it any more. I can't. You will just keep coming.
(determined)You say you killed one of my friends? Just like that?
(determined, angry)I won't let you hurt anyone else.
(quietly)Maybe it's for the best. Towards the end, he was a danger to himself, and everyone around him.
(sighs)It's true, by the way. He came to me, quite recently. Went on and on about this new piece of cyberware he'd built out of Terran high tech.
(smiles to herself)He was so proud. And of course he wanted me to have it; thought that it would make me reconsider my decision and maybe go back with him.
(sad)He was already so far gone. I couldn't bring myself to say no, and so I took it. Kept it with me, even though I knew I'd never return... there.
(steels herself)Here, I'll make you an offer. You seem... more sensible than I expected, and I have a feeling that you wouldn't stop searching just because I told you to get lost.
You go ahead and take this. See where it leads you.
All I ask of you is to keep an open mind, and don't judge a book by its cover. There are going to be a few ugly ones where you're headed.
(strained, panicking)I really don't want to use this, but you leave me no choice!
(groaning, having trouble speaking)Why isn't this working?
(in pain, having trouble speaking)It hurts. It hurts so much!
(very friendly)Yes? How can I help you?
(eager)Ah, yes, I've been expecting another delivery. One shipment of Terran tech, unloaded and ready for sampling.
(thoughtful)A few of these crates are damaged. That's a bit troubling.
You wouldn't know anything about that, now, would you?
(firrnly)True, but you can't keep going overboard.
(empathetic)I know how much this operation means to all of you, but if Protectorate citizens keep getting hurt, that'll put us all in danger.
(warmly)Here, take this as a token of thanks... and maybe tell Atreides to not overdo it.
(nervous, starts by clearing her throat)Yes, of course. That's something we take very seriously. I will inform the local authorities right away.
(gathers herself)Please, deliver my thanks to Captain Atreides for his bravery.
(nervous)Oh, I see you're not familiar with our customs procedures.
(nervous)Don't worry about it. Here, take this as well. And you'll have to excuse me, but I'm quite busy.
(start with a hrumph)Hello, old friend. This is Tamatha.
(a bit shaky)I'm just a recording, but if there's still good in you, I know you will hear me out.
(more firmly)I believe this person can help you. Consider this my parting gift.

page.title: Mission Argon/Terran NPC Male 6 / Antigone Public Servant (Saman Red) - Covert ops
page.descr: Lines for Mission Argon NPC Male 6
page.t: Ah, forgive me. My schedule is quite busy.
It is easy to lose track in all this administrative madness.
(Friendly)So, what can I do for you?
(Whimsical, proud tone)The Antigone Republic is an inspiring example of human self-determination.
Looking at everything we have achieved, I can't help but be proud of its people.
We have risen above petty squabbles, and have put the interests of the public first.
To see an entity of such considerable power, both economically and politically, arise from what was undoubtedly a most stressful and divisive time in history, fills me with bright optimism.
We have had our differences with the Argon government in the past.
Initially, they wanted us back in the fold.
Antigone Memorial, our home system, was significant to them, because of its location and its importance to their data infrastructure.
After lengthy talks we agreed terms, largely because the Jump Gate shutdown had changed the Gate connections, making Antigone Memorial's current position less valuable to the Argon.
Both parties eventually realised that there was no way of putting the genie back into the bottle, and that there was nothing to gain from fighting amongst ourselves.
(Emphasis on "actual")Not when there are actual enemies at our gates.
Now, we look out for each other. Politics isn't a zero-sum game, after all.
(Dissapointed tone)Now, Terran arrogance will come back to haunt us all.
It is no secret that historically, relations between the Argon Federation and the Terran authorities have been tense.
And more recently, the Terran Protectorate has shown a blatant disregard for Antigone sovereignty as well.
(Worried)It would pain me to see my people caught in the crossfire between the two factions, should things escalate.
(Confused, expecting the conversation to continue)Yes, what is it? You were saying?
(Angry)You will not get away with this!
(Pleading, desperate, very emotional)Stop, please! The people have to know!
Something about our meeting didn't sit right with me, so I started digging.
(Tense)It turns out that I was right to do so; this conspiracy goes deep.
(Teacherly scolding)You should be ashamed of the part you played in all of this.
(More amenable)However, without your help I could not prove the Terran Protectorate's involvement.
So, in exchange for handing over the evidence that allows me to connect them to the raid on our station, I will keep your name out of the reports.
Now, you had best stay alert while I send word to the Argon Federation.
(Tense)Get out there! Keep them busy while I notify the Argon.
I made contact with the Argon Federation and shared my recent discoveries with them, alongside the evidence you supplied.
They have assured me that they will not stand for this kind of interference, and have guaranteed the Antigone Republic their full support.
Things are now being set in motion.
We now know what we are up against, and we will protect ourselves from the Terrans with everything we've got.
(Warm and grateful)Thank you, friend of the Republic.

page.title: Mission Argon/Terran NPC Female 7 / Argon Guard 2 - Covert ops
page.descr: Lines for Mission Argon NPC Female 7
page.t: (Emphasis on "now")I need you to leave, now!
(Angry)That pilot was not authorised to dock!
(Trying to remain calm, but failing)Every marine to their designated position!

page.title: Mission Argon/Terran NPC Female 8 / Yaki Leader - Yaki investigation
page.descr: Lines for Mission Argon NPC Female 8
page.t: (Terran War Intro - Minor NPC: Yaki Leader)
(shouting, a bit uneasy)Obelisk! Obelisk, what are you doing?!
(shouting, commanding)By Moo-Kye's stinking breath, leave them in peace!
(shouting, commanding, but a bit panicked)No! Stop right this instant! You know what it's already done to you!
(sighs, annoyed; Kailan Weaver is a female historical figure; the 'hounds' are Xenon)Guard! Get your hounds under control, for Weaver's sake.
(annoyed, louder; responding to an answer by the guard that the player couldn't hear)I know they don't listen! Handle it!
(furious, interrupts herself at the end)Who are you, and how did you get here? Why...
(catches herself, sighs, then firmly)What a mess! Meet me at these coordinates, immediately. I'm providing you with an escort.
(sigh of relief, stays serious though)Glad you're reasonable, stranger. I'm adding you to the admission list for my office.
Well, where do I start? Where would you start, if you were in my place?
(variant 1)You suddenly barge into our system, in a ship that obviously doesn't belong to you...
(variant 2)You suddenly barge into our system, in a Terran-made warship...
(sighs)Because you're not the first to arrive here.
(disgusted, spit the word 'scientists')Ever since the realignment of the Gates, we're picking up scrappers, adventurers, scientists.
But we can't let anyone die out here. There are already far too few of us.
I'm not asking you to join the Yaki. We all have our allegiances.
(stress 'am')But I am asking you to have a closer look, make your rounds, see how we live.
(mockingly)Oh, have I not made my formal speech yet?
(mockingly, with pathos, switch to serious after 'freebooting')Welcome to the home of the Yaki, freedom-loving, freebooting and who am I kidding.
What you see here is the last remnant of the Yaki. At least the last that we know of.
When those Gates shut down, two generations ago, my people got stranded here together with the Xenon.
Most died in that first week. A few found hiding spots inside an abandoned outpost.
And then, some star-sent augmentation artists found the solution.
These things on my face, they're not just for show, you know?
I don't exactly know how they function, but they keep the Xenon away... most of the time.
("aug-art" is the art of facial augmentation)But that's not all: This aug-art also lets a few of the most "gifted" Yaki... do things to the Xenon, prod them here and there.
It doesn't always work, and you've seen what happens when you indulge too much, but it kept us alive.
And so here we are: Pirates to some, abominations to others, and with the Xenon strapped to our back like a damn tumour.
(resigned)Doesn't matter if we stay or leave. Either way, we're fair game.
Good. Then he's no longer a threat.
Don't get me wrong. It's kind of sad that he's gone. He was a good Yaki once.
But the way he plastered himself with those cybernetics, with no regard for his or our safety?
There's really only one way this could have ended.
I can only hope you regret it.
Tamatha left because she saw the end approaching from lightyears away, but she still tried to help us out from a distance.
(sighs)Seems like it caught up with her first.
Thanks to that fool Obelisk, the war's already under way.
With you on the loose, there'll at least be one more pilot with a brain... and a conscience, I hope.
Another thing: I called you a stranger earlier, and that was a lie.
There's someone I'd like you to meet.
(reproachful)Since you and your friend have already inspected the merchandise, I guess there's nothing else for it.
(firmly)It's time to put all our cards on the table. When you've got a moment, have a look at the briefing I just sent you.
(eye-rolling, a bit theatrically)And before you flip your hatch: I'm not asking you to betray Earth.("flip your hatch" meaning react angrily)
(deliberating, almost mumbling)Well, I guess I am, but, you know, desperate times and all that.
(intense)Think about where you want your loyalties to lie. Mull it over, consider all possible consequences.
(a bit warmer)You're not the first to attempt this mission, but you might just have a shot at success.
(excited)The entire system is talking about you! Well, apart from the Xenon, but they've never been much fun.
I guess I don't really have to say it, but you can help yourself to anything you want.
(backpedalling quickly)Uh, I mean, we'll arrange for something, OK? Our scavengers keep bringing in the weirdest stuff, and there's bound to be something you like.
(gathering herself)And then there's the matter of the amplifier.
Of course. Go and enjoy yourself. The big red button won't be going anywhere.
Well, as you've probably already found out, this system is protected by an arcane mechanism we don't even properly understand ourselves.
Our enemies make one false move, take one step into our home territory, and all the Xenon in this corner of the Gate network will come crashing down on their ships.
That's just a defensive measure, though. A safeguard, in case push comes to shove.
The real deal is this: Thanks to you, we've now got a gun to the Terran Protectorate's head.
That trail of beacons you put down will show the Xenon the path to the greenest pastures they've ever seen... and rid us of them for a while.
One squeeze of the trigger, and both the Terrans and the Xenon are suddenly a whole lot weaker.
We'll be relying on you for the perfect timing. We've only got one shot at this, so make sure you're prepared before you give me the signal.
(concerned)Are you sure? Is this really the ideal moment?
(urgent)It's done! Go and make use of it!
(relieved)Very well. Take all the time you need.
I thought you might be interested to hear that our local Xenon density is approaching nominal levels again.
We're ready for another activation of the amplifier. Just give the signal.
(furious)What have you done? That station was our lifeline!
(whispering loudly)Get out of the system now, or I can't ensure your safety.
(initial pause, then trenchant)What do you want?
(angry, intense)I've got every single Yaki hard-liner banging at my door, demanding my head, because of you fools! Be glad that I held them back from hunting you down!
(bitter)You have no idea what you're talking about.
(bitter)Do you think that taking away the best protection we had against the Terran scourge would somehow give us hope? How delusional can you be?
(serious)You know your people best. No threat short of total annihilation would keep them from scouring the entire Gate network to subjugate or eradicate everyone who dares to oppose them.
(bitter laugh)As if that's going to happen! The moment you step back into their ranks, you're going to tell them that we're here, and that we're vulnerable.
(smug)And then your dutiful superiors are going to suspend you, lock you up, put you under surveillance.
(bitter)You're an abomination now, just like us. It's time for you to face reality. You have nowhere to go.
(dismissive)Make your choice. I'm done with you.
You've been warned. Don't expect me to lift a finger to stop them.
(in thought)Forgive me, but that is a lot to take in.
(gathering herself)I think we should have a talk in private. I'll try to calm the hard-liners down until we've sorted this out.
(intrigued)A little gullish("gullish" German translation: Möwische) told me that the gaze of the Terran Protectorate might have been turned away from us for the time being.
I must say, working with you has been a real rollercoaster.
But it seems that, despite the confusion you keep causing, you've managed to manoeuvre us into a position everyone can be reasonably content with.
(deliberating)We're really running out of rewards here. What would someone like you appreciate?
(deliberating)We don't have much in terms of resources we could share. Everything our freebooters have brought in so far went straight into repairs and research.
(frustrated)If only we didn't have to worry about the Xenon whenever we make a move, we could actually expand our operations...
(composes herself)But that's just wishful thinking at this point.
Go now, hero of the Yaki. Maybe you'll visit from time to time, hm?
(incredulous)Did you just wipe our neighbourhood clean of Xenon? Just like that?
(incredulous)I'm... speechless. I thought that Dal Busta guy was joking!
(grateful, hesitant)I don't know how to reward you. Look at you! There's nothing of value to you that we could still give.
(grateful, but very distracted)Sorry, this is breathtaking. I have to make a load of arrangements right away.

page.title: Mission Argon/Terran NPC Male 7 / Terran Transport Captain / Fleet Commander (Nowak Lee)
page.descr: Lines for Mission Argon NPC Male 7
page.t: (Terran War Intro - Minor NPC: Transport Captain and undercover Fleet Commander)
(unshakably calm, like a pilot on a line flight)Much obliged.
(unshakably calm, like a pilot on a line flight)This is captain Nowak Lee of the Military Supply Transport Silverback.
(unshakably calm, like a pilot on a line flight)Another welcome from me and my crew, and glad to see the Militia is keeping its promises.
(unshakably calm, like a pilot on a line flight)All squadrons, prepare for lift-off.
(unshakably calm, like a pilot on a line flight)This is your captain speaking.
(unshakably calm, like a pilot on a line flight)We're commencing our approach towards the Sol gate.
(unshakably calm, like a pilot on a line flight)Please keep an eye out for resistance.
(unshakably calm, like a pilot on a line flight)Xenon on fast approach.
(unshakably calm, like a pilot on a line flight)Engage while we prepare countermeasures.
(unshakably calm, like a pilot on a line flight)On behalf of the crew of the Silverback, I would like to thank you for your continued support during these turbulent episodes.
(unshakably calm, like a pilot on a line flight)We should be able to manage the last leg of our route without further interruptions.
(imitate slightly bored commercial flight pilot tone from earlier)This is commander Lee of the Terran Intervention Corps.
(add a bit of smugness)It appears that your little experiment has failed, Delilah.
(again completely calm)We will take over from here.
(formal phrase among the military)Long may the Sun shine.

page.title: Mission Argon/Terran NPC Male 8 / Angry Antigone Miner - Terran war Intro
page.descr: Lines for Mission Argon NPC Male 8
page.t: (Terran War Intro - Minor NPC: Angry Miner)
(outraged)The Republic will not stand for this!
(outraged)This is a military occupation of neutral grounds!
(furious)Damage my ship, hurt my crew, and everyone will see you as the oppressors you really are!
(furious, fuming at the mouth)I knew it! Terran scum!

page.title: Mission Argon/Terran NPC Male 9 / Civilian Distress Signal - Terran cadet gamestart
page.descr: Lines for Mission Argon NPC Male 9
page.t: (Terran Cadet Gamestart - Minor NPC: Civilian Distress Signal)
(cutting off at times)... critical engine failure in Mars sector ...
(cutting off at times, "dead in the void" similar to "dead in the water", i.e. unable to move)... Botany Club ... dead in the void!

page.title: Mission Argon/Terran NPC Male 10 / Pioneers Mining Leader - Yaki investigation
page.descr: Lines for Mission Argon NPC Male 10
page.t: (panicked)No, no, no, this can't be happening!
(gathering himself, swallowing nervously)Fleet, defend yourself! Don't let that Yaki take away our hard-earned credits!
(determined)Of course I am sure! We're Pioneers, and we won't be done in by a pirate!
(overacting)Now, friend, I don't know how to thank you.
(overacting)Had you not arrived at precisely the right moment, I don't know if we would have found the courage to stand up against that vile fiend.
(stern)Reuven, please. Give our guest a moment to breathe.
(stern)Maybe collecting the cargo that was scattered during this most heinous attack will help lift our spirits, yes?
Please, friend, give us a hand if you will.
Splendid! Please, friend, do accompany us on our journey. It is just a short hop.
Upon our arrival, I will arrange for you to be generously accommodated.
Say, friend, what leads you to this most remote of places?
Perhaps you heard of the famous Pioneers Initiative and couldn't help but want to see this most honourable endeavour for yourself?
I can proudly say that us Pioneers have dutifully expanded the reaches of Sol ever since our inception, and our glorious tale grows grander by the day!
A Boron! How intriguing. You couldn't possibly be here because of the... planetary beautification program?
(deadpan, then jovial again)Right, too many ears. Well, I'm sure we'll have ample opportunity for a chat once we arrive at our destination, my dear friends.
Capital! Well then, my friend, you go and take the cargo you helped us collect to the customs officer over yonder.
Don't worry, she'll catch on eventually, and you'll get your share.
(boastful)End up here? I was with the Pioneers from the very start! Well, almost.

Mining rights were difficult to come by back in those days, and if you're just some odd-jobber on the edges of Sol, the well-oiled machine of the Terran Protectorate economy treats you like space dust.
No offence, by the way. Don't know if you're affiliated, but you did meet up with us coming from that direction.
(indignant; interrupts himself)Does she now? Gah! The gall of that woman! She's the one who got us into that situation in the first place!
(frustrated)Oh, I'll tell her a story all right, when I next meet her.
(sputtering)Uh, nothing in particular. You know, the usual dangers of long-distance hauling... I mean, mining.
(confident again)Don't concern yourself with that. Right now, all is well, and you're our honoured guest.
(sputtering)She did what? Ah, yes, of course! The bravery!
(gathers himself, boastful again)And when those Xenon started pouring in, and we just blasted them out of the sky? That was glorious, wasn't it?
(boastful)Couldn't have done it without you, friend.
(scoffs)And she told you that? You two must be getting rather close already.
(sighs)Look, I'm not saying she's wrong. I know I jumped the gun. Might have endangered the entire operation.
(embarrassed)I'm sorry I misjudged you. I simply saw a ship I didn't know, arriving at that crucial moment, and tried my best to keep up appearances.
(somber)But I know that doesn't change anything. I... should maybe just stay away from Shani for a while. A very long while.
(grasping at straws)That customs officer has been in cahoots with those pirates this entire time! I wouldn't be surprised if she was a Yaki herself!
(shouting after someone who's walking away)I'm only telling the truth, Reuven! I keep telling you that we can't stand up to the Protectorate!
(pleading)Please don't tell your superiors. Apprehend that customs officer, and this entire mess will be cleaned up, I promise!

page.title: Mission Argon/Terran NPC Female 9 / Pioneers Mining Subordinate - Yaki investigation
page.descr: Lines for Mission Argon NPC Female 9
page.t: (dutiful)Captain, we're approaching our base of operations.
(relieved)Oh, I'm just working for the captain over there.
(hesitant to talk about pirates)It's a well-paying job, all things considered. Especially with all the... pirate attacks recently.
(firmly)You do realise that we're professionals, right? That we've probably dealt with pirates in the past?
(frustrated)That situation could have gone a lot worse. But it also could have gone a whole lot better if we'd made even the slightest effort to de-escalate.
(more friendly)Look, I'm glad you came to help us out, but next time, try to read the situation first. Should probably tell that to the captain, too.
(disgusted)You disgust me, Atreides. We made a promise.
(whispers urgently)OK, OK, calm down. Please don't make any rash decisions.
We're not criminals, all right? We're the neglected stepchild of the Terran Protectorate, and we've got to make ends meet somehow.
Sometimes, one of those Yaki needs something from us, and we need something from them. We didn't expect it to turn sour this suddenly.
Please don't make a fuss. I'll tell you what you want to know.
Hah, that sort of knowledge is way above my pay grade. I only know that it has something to do with all those new research programs that have sprung up in these parts.
Apparently, our scientists are constantly hitting a wall, and those Yaki just so happen to sometimes have the solution... in exchange for high tech components, for the most part.
(deliberating, then warningly)Tamatha might know, but be gentle with her. She's just lost someone, and I imagine she's too worked up to sit through one of your interrogations.

page.title: Mission Argon/Terran NPC Male 11 / Hatikvah Announcement NPC - Diplomatic intro
page.descr: Lines for Mission Argon NPC Male 11
page.t: Pilot, if you are hearing this independent pirate broadcast, you have been invited to join the Hatikvah Free League's Trade Revolution!
Do you want to help create a truly independent, safe haven? Work towards peace and stability for all peoples?
Then we need you! Do not hesitate, check your Mission Offers to join the cause!

page.title: Mission Argon/Terran NPC Female 10 / Workforce Supervisor / Scavenger Salvage Team
page.descr: Lines for Mission Argon NPC Female 10
page.t: I'm a shift supervisor for one of your factories. After speaking to my manager about an issue, we felt it best to approach you.
A number of our workers are going AWOL, and overall productivity is down. Rumour has it that they're frequenting an entertainment centre that recently opened in a nearby sector.

Actually, just the opposite. We think it would be a great idea to incorporate a similar facility on our station. It would be more convenient for our workers, as well as making us more attractive to the skilled workforce market.
...I wouldn't put it quite that way.
No, but I can put you in contact with the guy in charge of the entertainment centre. He seemed rather excited at the prospect of competition.
Maybe take a look around and see if it's something you'd want to invest time in.
I better be getting back. Thank you for your time.
(casual)I'm telling you, the mage class is the way to go! Don't bother with the daily quests; simply grind until you're rewarded with your first fighter ship.
This is salvage team.(calm manner, like Nasa communicating with astronauts)

page.title: Mission Argon/Terran NPC Male 12 / Tidebreak Station Air Control Operator / Twin Pilot Henchman / Casino Manager
page.descr: Lines for Mission Argon NPC Male 12
page.t: (reaction to friendly fire)Hey, will you stop firing?
(reaction to friendly fire)You're wrecking my shields!
(reaction to friendly fire)Why are you shooting at me?
Ah, you're not one of my usual patrons. I assume you're here to keep tabs on your workers.
Oh, of course I do. I have the utmost respect for fellow entrepreneurs, but I have to view them as potential competition. Perhaps even partners.
So, like what you see here? You've joined us during one of the most important races of the season. Unfortunately, you're a bit too late to place a wager.
The odds-on favourite is in the lead with a sizeable gap. Hardly the excitement we were hoping for, but they can't all be classics.
Hmpf. Yet another miraculous comeback that defies all logic. Such outcomes only serve to test my patience.
Let's cut to the chase. You're looking to acquire a blueprint. I have such a blueprint. While I could charge you an extortionate amount, I would rather we had a productive relationship.
The various racing leagues allow all sorts of underhanded tactics to make the events more exciting and unpredictable. This simply breeds cheats, both on track, and behind the scenes.
The recent race outcomes have left me in an unfortunate financial position. If you were able to help me to disrupt even one of these race-fixing operations, the blueprint is yours.
You're busy, I get that. No matter. I'll be here if you change your mind, if I'm still in business that is.
(surprised)You mean it? Don't worry, I'm not planning anything too drastic. First, we're going to need a ship, something to submit as an actual racing craft.
I'll send you the minimum specs for the league.
This is going to be fun!
We're going to beat them at their own game.
Great work in getting that ship.
I see it's even got a nice paint job.
The ship has moved away. Did you not want to use it?
I guess we're back to square one.
Come and speak with me, and we'll get started.
That ship is our ticket into the league; one of the lower ones at least. Don't worry, we're not aiming to enter you into some crazy death race.
The fewer people involved the better. If it all goes well, we can find a pilot later. Until then, you're going to have to show off some of your flying skills.
Don't be so coy. I know you've run a time-trial before, for the Crimson Egg Racing League.
The time-trial here is slightly more challenging. But hey, that's part of the fun!
This time-trail is a bit of a challenge but, with that ship, I think you'll do great.
Once you ace it, we'll be able to get close to some of the shadier characters in the league, without raising too much suspicion.
You're all set to go. Give it your best shot!
(player failed time trail)Not quite there on that lap. Keep going!
Okay, that's not quite quick enough to get us into the league I had hoped, but it'll do for the entry level league.
That's great work. You're a natural!
Just fly through the checkpoints as fast as you can.
Woah. That was a lap record!
Bring the ship back safe and sound, and we'll move on to the next step.
Good job out there. I'll make sure that ship is well taken care of.
I actually think it would be a good idea to find a seasoned pilot, even if it's just to help us avoid suspicion when we start poking around.
You are probably better suited to recruitment than I am. If they're going to be flying your ship, then you should have the final say.
I'm going to chase up some leads. There's another event on soon, and I'm already seeing some very unlikely outcomes being bet upon by the masses.
Drek here. I think I need a bit of help. I started following a pair of race officials but they've split up. I'm sure those guys are up to no good!
I'm keeping an eye on one ship, but I'll need you to find the other one. I'll send you what information I have.
Can you hear me? I'm in a bit of trouble out here.
I've taken damage. Why would they place mines out here? I'm repairing my engines but there's a weird gravitational field that keeps bashing me around.
There you are! I was getting worried.
I'm almost done with repairs, but those mines are getting awfully close. Mind taking them out?
I'm back up and running. Question is, what do we do with this thing? I suspect this is what they've used to create shortcuts during the races.
If that's what it will take, then I'll do my part.
Woah. That's made me a bit dizzy.
Can you hear me? I'm a bit lost but I seem to be safe.
I'll make my way back to the station. You get back safely.
Good to see you in one piece.
Take a look. I entered our ship into the race today, and we seem to be doing quite well.
Now we have to hope that our hard work has paid off. Anyone who tries to use that anomaly as a shortcut will get quite a surprise!
There we have it. A much more palatable result.
I have to thank you for your help. I'll have this module's blueprint transferred to your computer.
Once you've built one, that will make us rivals, I suppose.
I look forward to the competition!
(pronounced Rah-Man-Kits)I do wonder what happened to Raamanckits...
(annoyed)You've spent far too long in that game.
(2a/6)This is Tidebreak, your one and only station robust enough to withstand the Tide, and the only one to never run out of Protectyon!(Tide same as {30251,1}, station name same as {20103,2901})
(3/6)It looks like our star is especially shiny today.
(4/6)If you are not already accommodated at one of our safe havens, or on the way out of the system, we now strongly advise you to engage your travel drive and haste into safety.
(5/6)Of course, we at Tidebreak recommend our own establishment, the 'Drifting Buoy', for your visit.
(2b/6)This is Tidebreak, the station built into an asteroid so massive, it withstands even the most vigorous of Tides!(Tide same as {30251,1}, station name same as {20103,2901})
Welcome to Tidebreak, traveller!(station name same as {20103,2901})
We sincerely hope that you have found your way into safety, as the sun is now erupting.
The Tide will now travel through the system and, with violent force, damage stations and ships alike.(Tide same as {30251,1})
We recommend that all visitors to our station now visit the windows or dock area to enjoy the view.
(1/2)Negative, 'Bestowed in Perpetuity'. Tide is inbound.(ship name same as {30251,205}, Tide same as {30251,1})
(2/2)Could scramble a volunteer rescue team. How many occupants?(recipient male)
Call again should you change your mind. Good luck.(serious tone, not expecting the recipient to survive, recipient male)
Okay, let me take over now.
You should probably leave! This ship is not yours any more...

page.title: Mission Argon/Terran NPC Male 13 / Mellerd's Thug / Vigor Syndicate Pirate / Race Announcer
page.descr: Lines for Mission Argon NPC Male 13
page.t: And here is Lasonnis! She's got a clear lead as they head into the final section.
We're waiting for Lasonnis to clear the nebula and make the run to the finish.
(pronounced Rah-Man-Kits)The ship of Raamanckits has emerged first, coming out of absolutely nowhere to take the lead in this race!
Here comes the driver from the newly formed Drek racing team.
All the ships are taking their positions for the start of the race.
It's Lasonnis leading the pack, followed by the newcomer from Drek Racing.
Raamanckits has once again disappeared. Will we see him make a miraculous comeback, as we did in the previous event?
No, it's Lasonnis who crosses the line to take the lead in this championship!
And a great result for Drek Racing! Second place on their first outing!
Still no sign of Raamanckits. I guess his luck ran out.
(2/7)It has come to our attention that you have been frequenting systems which are under Syndicate protection a lot recently.(authoritative)
(3/7)We don't like it when outsiders come here and shake things up too much.
(4/7)We won't have it! It is bad for business!
(5/7)Now, you can either pay us a fee to allow you to continue going on your merry way, or you back off entirely.
(6/7)And before you try to get one over on us, we will not hesitate to blast you to atoms, right here, right now.
(3/4)Go on then, I guess?(a bit unsure)
(4/4)On second thoughts... you paid us to spare you, not to allow you access to anything in our territory.(more confident again)
(3/3)Oh, and if we see you skulking around here again prepare to be shot down!
(2/3)Stupid! You should have just kept away.
(3/3)Well then, let's go, boys!(aggressive, to his fellow pirates)
(1/7)Our boss wants a chat with you.(addressing male Split)
(2/7)Do not worry. You will be out in no time.(addressing male Split)
(4/7)What reward did you agree to?(addressing player)
(6/7)You have clearance to meet her in her office.(addressing player)
(1a/3)Ma'am, I have a potential target in sight!(talking to Mellerd if Mellerd alive)
(1b/3)Stop right there, I need to establish your credentials!(if Mellerd dead)
(2/3)Affiliation with Empyrean Curs confirmed.(to his team)
(angry)That is what you get for crossing Mellerd!
We are done talking!(shutting the player down)

page.title: Mission Argon/Terran NPC Male 14 / Pirate GS 1 Player / Shady Bar Contact
page.descr: Lines for Mission Argon NPC Male 14
page.t: (* Gamestart Narration * - Pirate DLC GS 1 / Syndicate Runner)

(talking to a female investigator, cooperative, but composed and in control of the situation, "Syndicate" is short for "Vigor Syndicate" {20203,3301}, "Windfall" is a place, same as {20005,9057}, say "protection" as if it had quotation marks, add a little "hmm?" before "No money laundering", "Avarice" is a place, same as {20005,9033}, "runner" means "courier who transports illegal wares", the player can be male or female but is not addressed or mentioned in this line)The Vigor Syndicate, you say? Of course I can answer a few questions, officer. Protectors of Windfall, they call themselves, and their protection is something that upstanding business people tend to pay good credit for. Nothing in the system happens without their knowledge. Any transaction, physical or virtual, that passes through - it's safe to assume they know about it. There is no money laundering that I'm aware of at the present time, no. Large-scale financial transfers, yes, but they're for the most part limited to generous loans to the needy, over in Avarice. What's that? Runners? I don't think you should pay those rumours any attention, officer. Under the Syndicate's watch, there has been no smuggling of illicit substances for as long as I can remember.
(line 2 is spoken by a different character)
(1/2)Yeah, it's for one of the big shots.
(2/2)It does pay well, if that's what you're after.
(3a/6)My boss wants to talk to that Split over there, quite urgently.
(3b/6)My boss wants to talk to the Split in this bar, quite urgently.
(4/6)He is looking for a ride anyway. Just bring him to our place instead.
(5/6)Your reward will be the audience you're looking for.
(6/6)Afterwards, the both of you can fly off again.

(1/2, "Aurora Casino" same as {20103,2701}, speaker is lawyer/accountant who addresses only the player in a stern, dismissive, businesslike tone in all 30287XXX lines unless stated otherwise)Welcome to the Aurora Casino.
(2/2)We need your cooperation for the final validation of your contract. Please come in.
(first greeting in person)Ah yes, you. Let's get this over with, shall we?
(1/2, goodbye)Very well. I have been instructed to wish you safe travels.
(2/2, emphasise "don't")And remember, you don't know me.
(slightly annoyed, player returns)Yes? Did you forget something?
(1/2, answering player's question about their identity)Your handler for today.
(2/2, reproachful)And, quite frankly, I believe that further discussion of this topic is irrelevant to the matter at hand.

(1/2, say "Vigor Syndicate" disparagingly, translate same as {20203,3301}, "Windfall" same as {20005,9057})The Vigor Syndicate is arguably the most powerful organisation in Windfall at the present time.

(2/2)They are comprised of several outfits of varying size and influence. While low- and mid-level bosses are known to occasionally assert claims against one other, Syndicate leadership remains expertly obscure, stable and dependable.

(1/2, "Avarice" same as {20005,9033})Most conspicuously, Syndicate members deal in protection and money lending. Their main source of income, however, remains extortion; especially when it comes to the transit traffic to and from Avarice.

(2/2, well-meant warning)A word of advice between contractors: your file lists multiple occurrances of their thugs having been assigned to you as an "escort" for special deliveries. However, that does not mean that you are safe from them. No one is.
(1/6, warming up to player a bit while prattling on about history)A lesson in history? Very well!

(2/6, "the Dark" is an established term for the era of isolation after the Jump Gates shut down, "Windfall" same as {20005,9057})When the Dark descended on Windfall, this place had an abundance of water, food, spectacular views and luxury residences; a recipe for disaster, if you ask me.

(3/6)I am told that change transpired gradually. The people continued to gamble their lives away. Private security continued to serve the highest bidder, but now ownership of high-tech appliances and organic substance fabricators had become something to fight over.

(4/6, "Realignment" is an established term for the reactivation of the Jump Gates)The Realignment with Avarice brought about the most devastating upheaval this sector had seen in a lifetime, worse by far than the liberating isolation of the Dark.

(5/6, disappointed)How the Syndicate emerged victorious, I cannot tell. Its early hegemony appears to have relied on temporary arrangements with forces in Avarice, though it eludes me to this day why the Riptide should have willingly indentured themselves.
(6/6, coming back to reality)Oh well. Was there anything else we wanted to discuss?
(1/3)In the name of Aurora station and the Aurora Casino, I hereby formally confirm that, with the receipt of your delivery, our contract is satisfied.
(2/3)As per our arrangement, I have been instructed to present you with compensation for your unabated reliability up to this point.
(3/3)You are scheduled to receive a ship modification that will improve your ability to conduct your business undisturbed.
(1/3)I have transferred the location of a local recreational establishment to your navigational device.
(2/3, emphasise "discreetly")Once there, you will discreetly meet with a certificate broker to update your ship registration.
(3/3)In the meantime, Aurora station personnel will perform routine maintenance on the dock.
(1/2)On closer inspection... it appears that the station cannot identify a suitable ship to apply the improvement to.
(2/2)You will therefore receive ship modification parts instead, to be used at your own discretion.
(1/2)I'm not aware of the specifics, but it appears that the modification will reduce the distance at which other ships will be able to spot you on their radar.
(2/2, warningly)Do not treat this as a free pass for customs checks. I have caught runners who thought themselves invisible. They were not.
(intense, spelling it out slowly, word for word)You don't know me.
(1/3)(hopeful, speaks only to the player and addresses them as a fellow prisoner in all 30288XXX lines)Hey, you don't look like a guard... are you with the Syndicate? Here to bail me out?
(2/3)(hopeful, pleading)I promise I won't let myself get caught again! I'm still learning the ropes!
(3/3)(meek, deep sigh before the "okay")No? Okay then...

page.title: Mission Argon/Terran NPC Male 15 / Mad Producer
page.descr: Lines for Mission Argon NPC Male 15
page.t: (introduction, talking only to the player in all 203XX lines, spoken like desperate project lead, with rushed voice, always in a hurry, very hectic)Oh no, oh no... the project is running behind schedule again. Who are you? Wait, are you the new recruit?
(introduction)What? Oh, yes, I'm Keter. Producer at Jinko-Tekina, customer operations division. Big company, tight deadlines. No time to waste.

(ask about research)Uh, producer work. I track project schedules, and make sure all milestones are delivered within-budget and on-time. Very time-consuming for me. Do we really have to talk about this?
(ask about progress - between missions)I still need to schedule a few more tasks, but your delivery has really helped to boost the output of my team members!
(ask about progress - mission active)You have an overdue task. Remember, tight schedules are tight!
(ask about progress - no mission offer available)Operations are running smoothly, for once. But really nice of you to ask.
(ask about progress - first mission offer available)My team is in complete disarray. Stupid producer question: you don't happen to have a slot open for a delivery task?
(ask about progress - mission offer available variant 1)Have a sec? I need to talk to you about your tasks.(translate sec as second)
(ask about progress - mission offer available variant 2)Got time for a task?
(mission accepted variant 1)Please hurry. Time is of the essence!
(mission accepted variant 2)Cool. Please deliver with due diligence.
(mission failed variant 1)Oh no, this will completely derail my project... again!
(mission failed variant 2)Oh my... what else can go wrong?
(mission complete variant 1)Super, thanks! Final sanity check, and we're back on track.
(mission complete variant 2)Within budget, within time... well done.

page.title: Mission Argon/Terran NPC Female 11 / RIP Manager / Scavenger Captain
page.descr: Lines for Mission Argon NPC Female 11
page.t: (reaction to friendly fire)Hey, will you stop firing?
(reaction to friendly fire)You're wrecking my shields!
(reaction to friendly fire)Why are you shooting at me?
(1/3)Hello! It's a pleasure to meet you, Mr Dagobas Lahubasis Yorilos III.(addressing male NPC)(Pronounce III as "three")
(2/3)Let's get right to it.(addressing male NPC)
(3a/3)How much did you say you want to pay for these hull parts?(addressing male NPC)
(3b/3)How much did you say you want to pay for these claytronics?(addressing male NPC)
(3c/3)How much did you say you want to pay for these Energy Cells?(addressing male NPC)
(1/2)I'm not sure where you got that idea from, but we will have to turn down that offer.(addressing male NPC)
(2/2)It is not profitable for our station.(addressing male NPC)
No. The price needs to be higher.(addressing male NPC)
Sure. But the price needs to be higher.(addressing male NPC)
Yes, we can go quite low.(addressing male NPC)
Okay. I believe we have a deal.(addressing male NPC)
(1/2)I will arrange everything, and you can get your trading ships going!(addressing male NPC)
(2/2)It is nice doing business with you, Mr Dagobas Lahubasis Yorilos III.(Pronounce III as "three")(addressing male NPC)
(1/5)Ah, you must be one of Mr Dagobas Lahubasis Yorilos III's trading ship pilots!(addressing player)(Pronounce III as "three")
(2/5)We are looking forward to getting this trade going!(addressing player)
(3/5)You should have access to a special trade offer at our station.(addressing player)
(4/5)Just fill up the cargo hold and get selling.(addressing player)
Salvage team, what is your status?(calm manner, like Nasa communicating with astronauts)
Acknowledged, we are standing by.(calm manner)
We should be able to get there before the Tide.(calm manner)

page.title: Mission Argon/Terran NPC Female 12 / Scrapyard Contact / Vegas Station
page.descr: Lines for Mission Argon NPC Female 12
page.t: (reaction to friendly fire)Hey, will you stop firing?
(reaction to friendly fire)You're wrecking my shields!
(reaction to friendly fire)Why are you shooting at me?
I see that. But where is your ship?(Talking to male NPC)
(1/2)Out there you say?(Talking to male NPC)
(2/2)I see. Out there.(Recognising that the friend's ship is about to be destroyed by a solar event)
Ah. There it is. Always a sight to behold.(Solar event in the background)
(1/2)So, you need a new one?("a new one" referencing a "new ship" which is now being offered)(Talking to male NPC)
(2/2)How much can you advance me?(asking for a monetary down payment)(Talking to male NPC)
(1/2)Sure. You can make that acquisition. I know you do not accept handouts.(Talking to male NPC)
(2/2)I have something cheap for you. But claiming it is a bit hands-on.(Talking to male NPC)
Yes. One of those.(One of those "Scrapyard Salvage" ships)
Is your friend over here a better one?(Talking to male NPC, referencing player as 'your friend', asking if player is a better pilot)
(3/4)You can meet me there, once you are ready for a salvage adventure.(Talking to player)
(4/4)Once the Tide settles, of course.(Tide same as {30251,1})
I'll be here when you're ready.(addressing player)
(2a/2)Let's wait out the Tide and fly off straight after.(Tide same as {30251,1})
(2b/2)Off we go! To the Scrapyard!(Unexpectedly enthusiastic, Scrapyard same as {30251,201})
(1/4)That one looks suitable. I'll drop you off as close as I can. Good luck from there.(addressing player)
(2/4)Once you're in, go to the pilot seat and start flying immediately.(addressing player)
(3/4)Even better, charge the travel drive.(addressing player)
(4/4)Once the laser towers recognise that this ship is back online, they'll almost certainly try to shoot you down.(addressing player, laser tower same as {20221,1041}, plural)
What are you waiting for? We're here.(addressing player)
(1/2)The first laser tower just came online.(addressing player, laser tower same as {20221,1041})
(2/2)You better hurry out of there before they blow you up!(addressing player)
(1/2)To claim the ship, find and scan a Signal Leak using your spacesuit scanner.(addressing player)
(2/2)Once you've done that, you'll be able to dock.(addressing player)
(1/2)I'm sorry to inform you that this product is currently unavailable.(playing a sale about something found on the Scrapyard)
(2/2)The display piece is sadly defunct and, if I may add, quite above your price range.
I'm out, before I get noticed. Good luck, pilot!(addressing player)
It was nice knowing you!(addressing player)
It has also been occupied ever since the Syndicate confiscated it.
Apparently, it was too ambitious and militaristic for us Rakers, which is why it changed hands.
However, they never figured out how to connect turrets to it without blowing them off, so it has been sitting here under construction for an eternity or two.
Heard the current occupant is a rather unfriendly fellow, so better stay clear of it.
Weeeeelcome to...(American TV commercial style, spoken extremely enthusiastically)
... the Aurora Casino!(American TV commercial style)
(enthusiastic American TV commercial style)An exciting experience like no other!
(enthusiastic American TV commercial style)Enjoy, and discover a wide variety of your favourite games!
(enthusiastic American TV commercial style)Xenon Invaders, Ride the Tide, Travelling Teladi.
(enthusiastic American TV commercial style)You name it - we've got it!
(enthusiastic American TV commercial style)Visit our establishment now for a generous starter bonus with the potential to win real credits!
(enthusiastic American TV commercial style)Where else would you show off and improve your skills, if not at the Aurora Casino, which regularly pays out millions of credits!
(enthusiastic American TV commercial style)That's a score for the lucky ones!
(enthusiastic American TV commercial style)Are you the lucky one?

page.title: Mission Argon/Terran NPC Male 16 / VIG Faction Representative
page.descr: Lines for Mission Argon NPC Male 16
page.t: (Promotion ceremony - intro)The kind of stuff we are talking about is best discussed in private.
(Promotion ceremony - cntd, friendly)Management has been pleased with the work you've done for us so far. If you keep this up, you'll go far!
(Promotion ceremony - cntd, allied)You have continuously been one of our top earners, so we want to show you that we appreciate the work you've put in.
(Promotion ceremony - handing over 'medal', friendly)How about I present you with a new rank within this syndicate?
(Promotion ceremony - handing over 'medal', allied)You've risen through our ranks like no other, so here, let me present you with a new rank within our organisation.
(Promotion ceremony)Now, being a part of this organisation comes with some pretty sweet perks!
(Promotion ceremony - fluff line to spread notifications out 1)If you mess up, you'll lose your rank and all its benefits.
(Promotion ceremony - fluff line to spread notifications out 2)But believe me, that would be the least of your worries, my friend!
(Promotion ceremony - fluff line to spread notifications out 3)Hopefully you can put these rewards to good use when it comes to strengthening this little thing we've got going.
(Promotion ceremony - subgroup licence hint)Oh, and don't be surprised if other people come knocking. Lots of people are looking for reliable muscle.
(Promotion ceremony - outro)There is not much else to say, really, other than get back out there!
(Promotion ceremony - outro cntd)Can't wait to see what else you will pull off to make all of us a little bit richer!
(Start of greeting)On behalf of our organisation: (keep space)

page.title: Mission Argon/Terran NPC Female 13 / RIP Faction Representative
page.descr: Lines for Mission Argon NPC Female 13
page.t: (Allied greeting)My heartiest welcome to you, comrade!
(Promotion ceremony - intro)We are very excited to have you among us!
(Promotion ceremony - cntd, friendly)Your support for our people has not gone unnoticed, and has qualified you for a reward.
(Promotion ceremony - cntd, allied)After watching your support for the Rakers, we are eager to reward you for your efforts.(Rakers same as faction name)

(Promotion ceremony - handing over 'medal', friendly)As you've proven your ability to traverse this tide-ridden system, I am pleased to welcome you to our Tide Runners.(Tide Runner same as {20207,5361})
(Promotion ceremony - handing over 'medal', allied)As you've proven impervious to the Tide, it is my honour to present you with the new rank of Tide Breaker.(Tide Breaker same as {20207,5371})
(Promotion ceremony)Of course, this rank comes with prospects.
(Promotion ceremony - fluff line to spread notifications out 1)All benefits tied to the rank are lost if you lose the rank.
(Promotion ceremony - fluff line to spread notifications out 2)But let's hope we don't have to worry about that.
(Promotion ceremony - fluff line to spread notifications out 3)We'll be following what you do with those rewards.
(Promotion ceremony - subgroup licence hint)There may even be opportunities offered to you by other interested parties.
(Promotion ceremony - outro)Continue the good work, comrade!
(Promotion ceremony - outro cntd)We look forward to hearing about your future endeavours.
(Start of greeting)On behalf of our organisation: (keep space)

page.title: Mission Argon/Terran NPC Male 17 / Mad Artist
page.descr: Lines for Mission Argon NPC Male 17
page.t: (introduction, talking only to the player in all 103XX lines, spoken like an extravagant artist with a slow voice "woooooonderful, with this I can fiinally complete my MAAAASTER-piece")Can I help you? You don't seem like a connoisseur of art...
(introduction, slightly annoyed)I'm Arthur. Yes, THE Arthur; the network-famous artist. No autographs.

(ask about research)I produce only the most exquisite pieces of art. From the vestiges of nothing, deep within that monumental castle we call the ego, gloriously expressed through all matters holographic, physical and virtual. I call it "mind bending", because it truly is mindbending! Lately, I can barely keep up with the demand.
(ask about progress - between missions)Why, I'm busy working on my next masterpiece. The items you delivered will, through me, be transformed into something magnificent! Marvellous! Extraordinary!
(ask about progress - mission active)I'm still waiting for my order, how much longer is this going to take?
(ask about progress - no mission offer available)Hmm, yes. I have everything I need at the moment. Now shoo.
(ask about progress - first mission offer available)I'm in need of some very, very specific substances to spark my creativity... maybe you can help me out?
(ask about progress - mission offer available variant 1)Sold! All of them sold in an instant. Can you believe it? I need a new delivery, or they'll think me a slugabed!
(ask about progress - mission offer available variant 2)More, I need more! Quickly, before the spark of creation fades!
(mission accepted variant 1)Please hurry... I can already feel it slipping away!
(mission accepted variant 2)Go, and don't keep me waiting!
(mission failed variant 1)Oh no... how will I ever complete my masterpiece?
(mission failed variant 2)Such betrayal! And no means to capture its essence...
(mission complete variant 1)Wonderful, truly wonderful. With this, I can finally complete my masterpiece.
(mission complete variant 2)Aha, yes! With this, the power of imagination is yet again at my fingertips!

page.title: Mission Argon/Terran NPC Male 18 / Food Smuggler
page.descr: Lines for Mission Argon NPC Male 18
page.t: (reaction to friendly fire)Hey, will you stop firing?
(reaction to friendly fire)You're wrecking my shields!
(reaction to friendly fire)Why are you shooting at me?
What rules? I'm trying to make a living here!(desperate, talking to female bandit)
What does "illegal" even mean in these parts? You're just taking whatever you want!(exasperated, talking to female bandit)
You have no idea how important this is to me. It's all I have left! My family is starving!(growing frustrated, talking to female bandit)
(1/2)You know what? No. Not this time.(determined, getting riled up, talking to female bandit)
(2/2)Riptide! You out there? Want to come and help settle a few scores?(determined, shouting, to nobody in particular, "Riptide" refers to the faction name {20203,3204})
This is it, this is it, come on. Final chance.(muttering to himself, focused, gritted teeth)
They can't come after you if they're dead! Help me, please!(desparate, shouting, to the player)
(1/3)Haha, yes! I can't believe we've done it! Those Syndicate goons will never...(triumphant, emphasize "never")
(2/3)Oh. Oh no. They may have called for backup!(realisation, afraid)
(3/3)Run! Quick, through the Gate, before they come after us!(panicking)
(1/2)Hey, uh, I guess I haven't properly thanked you for helping me out. So... thanks.(embarrassed)
(2/2)Risking your life to save another... that isn't something you see a lot of in Windfall these days.("Windfall" same as {20005,9057})

(1/3)I had to do something, you know? The Syndicate is bleeding us dry. Can you believe it? We're not even allowed to transport our own agri wares, just so they can turn a tiny amount of extra profit!("agri wares" means food, "my people" means his family)

(2/3)Yes, I know it wasn't the smartest idea, smuggling that cargo, but it's the only way I could hope to break the cycle. We scraped together every last bit we had for this shipment.("we" means his friends and family, "every last bit" means money)
(3/3)It'll help the other residents, too, when I sell it. So I'm doing a good thing!(looking for excuses)
(1/2)That's the Gate to Avarice up ahead, finally. Looks like nobody's caught up with us.(relieved, "Avarice" is an area of space, same as {20005,9033})

(2/2)Hold tight, and stay on full throttle until you reach the nearest dock. You don't want to get caught out in the open when the Tide hits.(insistent, "the Tide", same as {30251,1}, is a deadly wave)
(1/3)I can't help this guy. We need to get these resources to safety.
(2/3)With the Tide inbound, there is just no time.(Tide same as {30251,1})

page.title: Mission Argon/Terran NPC Male 19 / RIP Manager
page.descr: Lines for Mission Argon NPC Male 19
page.t: (1/3)Your company needs hard working people like us to sell that Protectyon to!(addressing male NPC, Protectyon same as {30251,2})
(2/3)Is there any deal you'd be willing to make?(addressing male NPC)
(3/3)Anything we could negotiate for that Protectyon delivery?(addressing male NPC, Protectyon same as {30251,2})
You cannot just leave us to the Tide!(Tide same as {30251,1})(addressing male NPC)
(angry)"Good luck with that Tide."(scoffs)(Tide same as {30251,1})
We don't have anything for you, vulture.(addressing male)
Besides, selling out wouldn't cover the cost.
(1/11)You are too late. There is nothing to be done now.(addressing player and male NPC)
(2/11)I shouldn't have sold that last batch so cheaply.(introspective mumbling)
(3/11)But who could have predicted such a price spike?(introspective mumbling)
(4/11)Maybe I should have hired that help.(introspective mumbling)
(6/11)Somewhere along the line, something went very wrong.(introspective mumbling)
(7/11)I might just not be cut out for this line of work.(introspective mumbling)
(8/11)I should have listened to my mother.(introspective mumbling)
(9/11)Could have rejected the job offer.(introspective mumbling)
(10/11)Now that I have crashed that ship, there is nothing to be done about it.(introspective mumbling, did not literally crash a ship but ran the station financially into the ground)
(11/11)Nothing left to do but await the inevitable.(introspective mumbling)
Huh?(player interrupted introspective mumbling, addressing player)
You were saying?(player interrupted introspective mumbling, addressing player)
(1/2)There it comes in all its glory.(solar event destroying the station)
(2/2)All that's left to do is pick up the shards.(solar event destroying the station)
Please leave me alone, I am quite busy.(addressing player)

page.title: Mission Argon/Terran NPC Male 20 / Twins 1 & 2
page.descr: Lines for Mission Argon NPC Male 20
page.t: (reaction to friendly fire)Hey, will you stop firing?
(reaction to friendly fire)You're wrecking my shields!
(reaction to friendly fire)Why are you shooting at me?
(2/3)You cannot afford Protectyon for the next cycle...(addressing male NPC)
(3/3)But that's really not my fault and I have to look out for my company.(addressing male NPC)
There is just nothing I can do for you...(addressing male NPC)
Good luck with that Tide, and good profits in the future.(Tide same as {30251,1})(addressing male NPC)
(2/2)I sure hope you have a good reason for approaching me. I am quite busy, you see?(arrogant)
(1/5)(Player asks to buy a sample)What, just a sample?
(2/5)Such a small quantity won't get you far, if you want to protect yourself from the Tide. Can't afford more, eh?(mocking tone)
(3/5)Oh well, since you seem to be new around here, I'll allow it. Once.(condescending)
(4/5)To get you hooked. Am I not charitable?
(5/5)I will even cut you a special deal, how about that?
(1/4)Here you go. I hope you leave as a satisfied customer!(obviously disinterested)
(2/4)Oh, and by the way - don't for one second think that you can use this sample to engineer a competing product. It won't work. Northriver products are just too ingenious!
(3/4)What... back for more already?(the player returns after the cargo was destroyed)
(4/4)Run along now, I have much more important matters to attend to.
Ah, not even enough money for a sample? Come back when you are serious about this.(when player backs out)
Be on your way, then!(goodbye - impatient)
What a waste of time... honestly!(goodbye - annoyed)
(1/3)So, how is it going? Have you cracked it yet?(mock curiosity, already knowing the answer)
(3/3)As if I, corporate mastermind inventor, would risk giving away my secrets.(aggrandising)
(1/3)Well, of course I can be proud of my accomplishments. I built this company from the ground up! I came from nothing!(boastful)
(2/3)Hard work and dedication, that's all it takes.(fake modesty)
(3/3)And now our Northriver product keeps an entire system of people safe!(obvious pride)
(1/3)Ah, it's not the equipment, it's the minds that make all the difference. (cold and dismissive)
(2/3)You and your fish friend just cannot match my scientific acumen!(belligerent)
(3/3)Strip it all away from me, shut down my company, and through sheer dedication and wit, I would still rise to the top again.(boastful again)
(1/2)Ah, yes, the Midas Touch! The crown jewel of my vast collection. The fastest ship in the galaxy!(genuine pride)
(2/2)It took a lot of money and effort to get it just right, and it is absolutely unique.(more matter of fact)
(1/6)A race, huh? Let me think about it...(genuine surprise)
(2/6)Alright. I don't know why you would want to challenge me, seeing as the Midas Touch is literally the fastest ship out there, but sure, let's go for it!(very confident)
(3/6)And you know what? I'll go one better! (salesmanlike tone)
(4/6)You have been trying so pathetically to analyse the Protectyon, so if you win I will just tell you what you want to know.(stress the if)
(6/6)Bring your fastest ship! I am looking forward to this.
(1/3)Hey! This is not the ship which we agreed on. (player approaches in the wrong ship)
(2/3)You really make me wonder if this whole circus is worth my time.(annoyed)
(3/3)Come back here when you have managed to board the right ship!
(2/6)I was wondering if you would show up, actually.
(3/6)My scans indicate that everything seems to be in order, so we can commence the race.(almost absent-minded)
(4/6)First one to cross the finish line wins.
(6/6)It will be me!(more confident to the player)
(2/8)I can't believe it took you that long!(over the top)
(4/8)Thanks to my far superior ship and piloting skills, you never stood a chance. The Midas Touch helped as well, of course.
(6/8)I don't really have any use for this heap of junk, so I think I'll just scrap it.(matter of fact)
(7/8)This whole farce, just to prove a point.(almost tired)
(8/8)Do not mess with the Northriver Company!
I have no time for you now. Business awaits.
(1/2)Ah, yes, the Astrid! The crown jewel of my vast collection. The fastest ship in the galaxy!(genuine pride)
(2/6)Alright. I don't know why you would want to challenge me, seeing as the Astrid is literally the fastest ship out there, but sure, let's go for it!(very confident)
(4/8)Thanks to my far superior ship and piloting skills, you never stood a chance. The Astrid helped as well, of course.
Playing dirty, huh? It won't make a difference!(if player flies off too soon)
(2/2)We agreed to do these resupply runs together, to cut down on the time we actually spend hauling this stuff back to our distribution centre.
(2/3)I had Northriver Company business to deal with...
(3/3)Apparently a sore loser has been snooping around and I had to throw them off, you know?
(2/4)A great job you did! Look who just happened to sneak up on us here!(addressing brother)
(1/3)I can't believe you found our nowhere space...(addressing player)
(2/3)Seven years! We managed to keep this place secret for seven years...(frustrated)
(3/3)What do we do now, Lee?(addressing brother)
(1/2)Well, this is something best discussed in person.
(2/2)You! Come on over for a little chat!(forceful, addressing player)
So you came? Wise choice!(clearly relieved)
This one has a good business sense, I can tell...(slightly condescending)
(1/2)Yes, and we will get to that.
(2/2)Now, if you don't mind me asking, how did you find this place?(curious)
(1/3)Ah, yes. I knew that our efforts to clean up should have been more thorough.
(2/3)It seems our contacts in the Vigor Syndicate are slipping.(disappointed)
(3/3)I paid them an obscene amount of credits to make you go away, and look where that has left us!(frustrated, agitated)
(1/6)Yes, well, clearly that did not work. So, how about we approach this from a different angle, hmm?(calm)
(2/6)As you probably figured out, this here is our very own golden goose.
(3/6)We have no idea what this whole construct is about, but we did figure out that we can use the condensate surrounding it as shielding against the Tide.
(4/6)We are in a very unique position.
(5/6)The people of Avarice absolutely need it. Only we can provide it.("Avarice" same as {20005,9033})
(6/6)Are you able to follow along so far?(slightly condescending)
(3/6)Because we can, of course!(delighted, emphasis on "can")
(4/6)As far as we can tell, the reserves here could supply the entire galaxy for centuries, and we would not run out.
(5/6)This stuff is highly potent, highly advanced.
(6/6)But who'd be willing to repeatedly pay us obscene amounts of money, if they knew that?
(3/10)I was just returning from a trade run when the Tide hit my ship and pushed it into the anomaly.
(4/10)I don't know exactly why, but I could immediately tell this system was different.
(5/10)Put that down to my entrepreneurial spirit, huh?(back to being boisterous)
(6/10)Anyway, my ship was pretty badly damaged from the impact, so it took me a while to get everything back into shape.
(7/10)Once it was operational again, I eventually came across the derelict station and the Protectyon.
(8/10)Someone else must have come before us, though. I was able to interface with technology that was very similar to ours to access the Protectyon.
(9/10)I suspect it was those nomad researchers.

(10/10)It took us a while to figure out how to properly transport and store this stuff. But, from there on out it was just a few lucky breaks and knowing which people to pay, both to figure out the product at hand and to make any troublemakers disappear.
(1/6)Good, then you probably know where we are heading with this.(at ease)
(2/6)Now, obviously we need you to keep quiet about this.
(3/6)We could try and kill you, but as you might have noticed we are not thugs, and our ships are certainly not made to shoot at anyone.
