(mission update)There's been a change of plans with the job.
(partial success)If that's the best you could do... sure.
(failed mission)I hope you don't think you're being paid for that.
(success in mission chain)We're one step closer to completion.
(failure in mission chain)That didn't go well, but we might still be able to salvage this.
(mission aborted by NPC / script failure)Sorry. Looks like your services are no longer required.
I can't pinpoint the exact location.
I am terribly sorry to disrupt your magnificent focus.
The ordnance you are using does not appear to be particularly suitable for the job.
I recommend switching to EMPs.(pronounced Ee-Em-Pees)
I recommend switching to explosive charges.
I wish you good luck on your mission, assistant.
It appears that we have another chance.
Could you please come and see me when you have a moment?
Once you return, I can get started.
(directions to a location)Please follow my directions.
My other assistant politely inquired on your progress before he continued on his quest to analyse some very intriguing financial records.
You have a task to perform, you know?
...I seem to be broadcasting... Can nobody hear this? Hello? Hmm, maybe if I... Yes, that should be better. Hello, anyone?
I'm in a rather unfortunate situation. Is anyone able to help me? My work is quite time-critical, so if you can, please contact me soon.
Ah, that should do it. I had to disable my voice filter. I was beginning to think my messages were being intercepted by those Split fellows. I'm a little disappointed that it was this easy.
I don't suppose they sent you did they? Oh, that would be quite devious.
Hmm, what should I call them. I suppose captors is quite apt. Employers? They let me work on my own projects some days you see.

Ah, yes. You see, I'm in a spot of bother. I am in the middle of some important scientific research which I'm unable to pursue personally from my current location. I'm looking for an assistant to aid me.

I see. I expected a more positive response to a mysterious distress call with mention of science. Hmm, perhaps I'll describe it as 'exciting' or 'stimulating' next time for a better outcome. Oh, you're still there? Thank you for your time.
I'll send the task to your ship computer. This is rather exciting!
Wonderful! I have managed to place the device on a nearby docking area. You should be getting the coordinates now.
Very good. I see you have found the device. This will allow me to monitor your activity and perform experiments remotely. Please keep it safe.
Oh my. It seems that your pulse is elevated. You must be very excited to take part in this expedition. I'm glad!
I do wonder how my homeworld is faring. It has been such a long time since we have heard news of it.
Should we ever get to meet face to face, I do hope that you can bring me some fresh BoFu. The nuggets the Split give me are more stale than their humour.
Is that BoFu? You remembered! My friend, this makes me so happy!
So, shall we begin? I will attempt to direct you in the best way possible. Please be patient with me.
I don't expect you've spoken to too many Boron before. Allow me to introduce myself. My name is Boso Ta and it is a pleasure. I do wish it were in person but my current situation is quite precarious.

You must be very curious on what a old lonely Boron is trying to achieve. There are still so many mysteries and unanswered questions. Are Spaceflies sentient? Where are the lost Boron systems? Is faster than light telepathy possible?

It is our task to push the physics of this universe to the breaking point and see if it answers any of those questions! My current employers only seem happy when my research results in novel weapon modifications. Very curious people, those Split.
I do hope they move me to a new tank soon. My tentacles grow weak.
You appear to be getting close to where I detected an anomaly.
I've uploaded new software to your ship systems.
Could you please try using the Long Range Scanner to search for an anomaly in this vicinity.(for LRS name see {20108,1001} )
Ahha! There it is. If reports are to be believed, these anomalies are tears which may lead to other areas of space, much like the Jump Gates.
So, how adventurous do you feel today? Thanks to my research, I do have a fair idea of where you may end up. Of course, the quickest way to confirm my theory is to put it into practice!
Can you hear me? It took a moment to realign the frequency. It is just as I thought. You have made it through the anomaly and emerged in a distant region.

Your location is actually of great interest to me. Over the years, I have managed to pull sensor logs from passing ships to help further my work. I highlighted this as a prime location for my research, should I ever get the chance.
I'm sorry to interrupt, but it seems that you have arrived at a rather curious location.
I suggest you mark the location of the anomaly on your map.
Oh, it appears you have found another anomaly! How interesting.
Are you having trouble locating the anomaly in the area I have stated? I suggest you use the Long Range Scanner to help find it.
(having trouble getting through the anomaly)Hmm, it does seem quite tricky getting through the anomaly. It appears to require some speed to punch through.
(having trouble getting through the anomaly - joke)It looks like you're trying to enter an anomaly. Would you like help with that?
I don't mean to distract you from your business but do you intend to investigate that anomaly further? My fins are tingling in anticipation of the science we will achieve!
While the previous anomaly is interesting, my findings point to something else here which I expect will lead to a groundbreaking discovery. Allow me to guide you to a particular area.
I am currently evaluating what equipment we will need to make the most of this location.

Space here is wounded, with a scar in its fabric which seems to have healed multiple times. There is no record of any abnormal activity at these sites. To everyone else, this is simply an empty area of space.

In my search for signals from long-lost Boron I have detected multiple scars in space which continue to spew a multitude of particles and radiation. In a bustling sector such as this, it would only be seen as background noise. However, some of the noise seems to have artificial form.

We are going to tear this scar wide open and peer inside! Of course, the universe is a fickle thing. One miscalculation and we may well destroy this whole system. Ha! Such stakes make this all the more exciting!
Before we get started, allow me to reimburse you for your help so far. I do hope the Split don't mind me using their credit account to help fund our venture.
Now, the experiment. You will first need to place a satellite around this area in order for us to better understand its nature and how to best provoke the invisible anomaly.

I suggest you also deploy a resource probe so that we can see how the anomaly has affected the local environment. You should be able to acquire these deployable items from stations which offer upgrades.
I know of such a station near your location. I will add the information to your map.
It has been a great many years since I've had such a feeling of freedom. While the Split moved me to several locations as a part of my work, nothing quite beats going on a scientific expedition.
Hmm, no. That satellite is not placed in a favorable position. You can collect it and redeploy if you wish.

Ah, good work. I am receiving a much clearer signal from the tear. Almost immediately, I can see that there are far more gravimetric shears here compared to any other anomaly ever documented. That indicates mass, but of what?
This shows some similarities with a Jump Gate event horizon but there is something else. Could it be a temporal distortion? Perhaps dimensional? Very interesting.
Would you please deploy a resource probe in the specified area, I am curious of this environment.
I see that you have already placed the resource probe in a suitable location. Very good.

You will now be able to see the yields of the resources in the area, should you wish to extract them. As for our research, it seems that nearby objects are covered in exotic particles, possibly spewed from the anomaly.
I hate to be a bother, but I have an idea on how to proceed.
Blowing up your only ship does not seem like a smart approach!(stammering voice of desperation)
I suggest you at least buy a second one, before you engage in a lengthy space walk that might exceed your oxygen supply.(hissing sounds of worry)
I have revealed the location of the nearest Wharf on your map!
You can interact with it and buy a ship remotely.

We will need a ship to be flown to a very precise location, near the anomaly. If we fit the ship with the right equipment, we may be able to open the tear wider and have a better idea of what is on the other side.
This will likely end up in the ship's destruction so I will help cover the expense of acquiring a new ship for the task.
Be sure that the ship is evacuated. It's far too early in this experiment for needless casualties.
The ship is in the correct position but is missing some of the required equipment. Please take a look at the details I have provided.
Very good. We seem to be ready for the initial test. I would advise that you clear the area as there are a number of unknowns.
The area must be clear of any obstacles!
(something goes wrong)Well then... I suppose we will have to try again.
I have successfully interfaced with the ship. I am increasing the output of the power-plant while reducing the shielding of the antimatter containers to see if that affects the anomaly.
Wonderful, we are getting a reaction! The ship is beginning to show strain but I will continue to push it further. Keep your distance.
The tear is expanding, it is about to reach the ship! The antimatter will most likely detonate!
Please check your mission briefing for the equipment the ship will need for the experiment.
(1/2)I have calculated that the ship will need to contain a small number of Antimatter Cells.("Antimatter Cells" same as {20201,201})
(2/2)The nearest station that has this ware available has been revealed for your convenience.
What is this? Some large artificial structure? So, this is what was on the other side of the tear? It does seem that our investigation has lead to some potentially groundbreaking discovery!

Now my friend, this is where we must proceed with both haste and caution. While I admit, tearing through space-time with an antimatter explosion was far from restrained, we now have something in front of us of untold scientific value. We would be fools to continue carelessly.

For the benefit of the universe, let us hurry and claim our prize before someone can beat us to it! I'll be damned if some passing Teladi junk dealer decides to break it down for spare parts. Or worse yet, the Ministry of Finance Science Division.
I will begin to interface with the structure remotely. Do you mind flying around it so I can make some additional readings.
I'm marking a location of particular interest.
These markings are not quite as 'alien' as I would have expected from such an object. Could this be a top-secret installation? Oh my. I do hope we haven't hijacked some distant Terran station.
It does seem somewhat unfinished, and the materials it is constructed from are quite strange. Even the computer pathways I am navigating are unconventional.
I cannot yet ascertain the function of this asteroid like mass in regards to the rest of the station. Given these readings, it may well be a power source. How interesting.
Ah, progress. It seems that this station is in an emergency state, possibly due to our actions. However, it appears that there is a backdoor protocol to resolve this. Give me a moment.
Wonderful! You see? The station is now under our control. I have access to much of its systems, although some are so alien I will need to take time to investigate them.

There appear to be connection points for additional station modules and they do seem to conform to our standards. If we wish to physically interface with the station without damaging it, I suggest constructing an area to land.
Oh, it appears I must go. My Split employers are approaching and they do sound agitated.
I will be in touch when I am able. As I have said, see if you are able to merge their technology with our own by building a dock.
(1/3)First, place a new Dock Module. You can put it wherever you desire.
(2/3)I would award you imaginary style points for attaching it to the structure, but you are, of course, free to express your artistic virtuosity.
(3/3)Once you are satisfied with the placement, confirm your changes.
(1/2)Now, allocate sufficient credits to the construction site.
(2/2)I recommend accepting the estimated construction budget.
Lastly, you need to hire a Builder.("Builder" same as {20221,5021})
(1/3)Notice how your map interface is automatically filtering for the correct ship type.
(2/3)If you expand the scope of your map, you may be able to spot one of these contractors, just wandering about!
(3/3)If you have no luck, consider deploying more satellites to improve your visual range, and inch even closer to omniscience!
(1/2)Provided that you have allocated sufficient funds to the construction site, other traders will now begin to deliver the required materials.
(2/2)You can observe the containers being stockpiled at the Build Storage - a small, temporary structure on the outskirts of the station build plot.("Build Storage" same as {20104,80101})
(player under attack)Oh. You seem to be having some issues. I'll call back later.
Have you heard the Split legends regarding the 'Space Duck' of Namek? A creature so majestic it brings even the Split to tears. I heard my captors speaking of it in passing.
(plot as in plot of land)Allow me to cover the cost of the plot licence.
Well done! I have been watching your progress with much interest.
When you dock see if you can access any of the internal structure from an elevator.
Hmm, no. It appears we are still locked out from direct access.
It seems I have no choice. I must leave my current location and join you on that station.
I didn't expect I would need to enact this escape plan so abruptly.
Your help would be greatly appreciated. I will send instructions.
A fast combat ship is preferable.
I must admit, I am beginning to feel a bit tense. I do hope this goes to plan.
I have further refined the plan. Please take a look.
As you can see, I wish to escape the station via a chartered freighter.
There are actually multiple ships involved as to confound anyone wishing to track me.
I would like you to protect any ship which should get into trouble.
Please wait for the ship to conclude its 'business'. It will launch shortly.
Please protect this ship from any harm. While it is a decoy, I would rather no harm comes to the crew.
I am successfully aboard my transport and en-route to the installation.
Oh, that didn't take long at all. It seems that my disappearance has been noticed.
I expect my ship is at a safe distance. I can't say the same for the others. Please be alert.
I am successfully docked. I will begin my work.
My, this structure is far more impressive in person than I expected.
Once the ships are safe, please join me.
When you land, enter the elevator.
Aha! At last, we meet face to face!
This installation is equipped for habitation of all races and this room seems to be some sort of research area.
I expect I could spend years poring over the data contained in these systems.
I believe we will need help to run this station effectively. You could look to employ a manager.
Come see me when you have a moment. I have made some progress.
Yes, I already have made some progress.
There appears to be several things we can research at this facility.
As you can see, there is much to do.
I personally find mention of this 'Teleportation' irresistible but I leave it to you to decide what we research first.
Please note that these research items have certain requirements.
If you could, please gather the required materials.
I will need some materials to get started.
There are certain requirements for me to start that research.
This research requires certain things to be fulfilled first.
This will allow you to gain blueprints by scanning leaks on certain modules.
This will allow you to craft standard equipment modifications.
This will allow you to construct much improved equipment modifications.
This will allow you to construct superior equipment modifications.
Good choice. I will begin right away.
Very good. I will let you know when I am done.
I look forward to seeing how this turns out.
I expect this will be revolutionary!
I have come to the end of my research
I have concluded my research and the results are astounding.
The results of my research are far beyond my expectations.
It appears some Terran technology was being used to research teleportation over long distances.
I have finished the teleportation research.
I am yet to test it on a lifeform. Given that I am monitoring your life signs anyway, perhaps you could do the honours.
I believe I can improve the range of the teleporter with only a miniscule chance of complete cell collapse.
You should find the teleporter now has a much larger range.
You should find the teleporter now has a much larger range.
This seems to be the primary focus of this facility; research into parallel universes. This confirms my theory that we have pulled this object from a universe similar to our own.
I believe this will enable us to send objects to other universes.
I am finally done with the research! You should now be able to construct a module capable of sending objects to other universes.
I see you have made quite the discovery.
I am always in the search of knowledge.
I have added a secondary task to your mission interface.
I must say, I'm glad that we met. I have had so much fun working alongside you.
You will find that new research items available.
Oh, it appears the my former captors have found us.
Do you mind taking care of this? I'm afraid that I'm of little use in this situation.
I will at least activate our defences.
You will do no such thing!
Well. I don't expect they'll be bothering us again.
Well. That was anticlimactic. I'll get back to work.
Please deliver 75,000 microchips for my research.
You can now attempt to create an engine mod.
I am curious to see a shield mod in action.
Let us see if such a ship mod lives up to expectation.
I suggest you now attempt to create a weapon mod.
This seems to be rather experimental, requiring some preparation and excessive amounts of resources.
Engine modifications will push a ship to its structural limits!
Thrust, speed and manoeuvrability are simply qualities to be exceeded.
Seeking even more speed? I can have our ships rival even the top racing craft!
Further engine modifications are indeed possible, albeit at risk of breaching speed and safety regulations.
Greater control over shield output will open the door to new levels of fortitude.
Improved shield capacity and recharge rates can turn a lowly scout ship into a capable combat craft.
Shield efficiency is vital to ensuring a ship can perform its task safely. I believe we can push it further.
There are still gains to be made in shield modification technology. We shall extract every last joule of protection.
By directly modifying the chassis of a vessel, we can unlock hidden potential and versatility.
Improving hull strength while also reducing mass sounds like an engaging challenge.
Such ship modifications soon run into the limitations of the craft's super-structure, but we are not there yet.
Refining a craft to such a degree certainly pushes known engineering practices to the limit.
My time with the Split saw me working on rather destructive weapon modifications.
I am, of course, capable of improving other aspects such as cooling and efficiency.
Given the available variety of weapons, it is not surprising that there are still more gains to be made.
I am confident that we can achieve even greater weapon performance without risking rapid and dramatic equipment failure.
You are still missing the other resources.
There is a task you must do before we can start.
Now then. We should be able to begin our research.
I now have everything I need to start the research.
All of the required resources are available.
We have gathered all the data we need.
The research has been successfully completed.
You seem to have stumbled upon an abandoned station.
It appears that some components are active, albeit heavily damaged.
Perhaps you could take a closer look.
I expect that a repair laser may be able to bring this back to a functional state.
That seems to have resulted in activity elsewhere on the structure.
There seem to be data stores still active. How exciting!
Please do try to access the data.
I do hope such a facility had off-site backups.
I am rather interested in early Earth history.
Much of it was lost to time and replaced with fantastical stories.
The development of Terraformer technology shaped the future of billions, and not for the better.
The rise of the Xenon and the fear of repeating mistakes of the past have brought about dark times indeed.
Ah, those do sound like wonderful times. An age of exploration and discovery.
There has been much conflict and destruction in our history. The fact that we persist is quite admirable.
There are still those today who remember these historic events. I do hope they also record their accounts.
This is quite a recent entry. I do wonder who created these stations and why they are so damaged.
There must be more of these facilities elsewhere.
I implore you to seek them out.
The quest for knowledge is the noblest of pursuits!
I shall spend some time collating what we have found.
I expect someone is quite interested in this entry.
Greetings, my esteemed assistant. I am happy to report that this facility is now under our control, and I can begin a number of interesting projects.
The origin of this station is still somewhat of a mystery, but I will strive to unlock its secrets.
It seems that we can expand its capabilities by adding more modules to it.
The systems of this station allow me to explore avenues of research I did not think possible.
I would encourage you to visit the research interface and make a suggestion as to what we should focus on first.
(1/3)I have become painfully aware that you had to accept an illegal mission offer from a Signal Leak to come to my aid.
(2/3)This reckless, if well-intentioned violation of the local customs must surely rest heavily on your conscience.
(3/3)If you seek lawful employment, I recommend perusing the regular Mission Offers in your map interface instead.
(1/3)Have you heard the latest news about the Hatikvah Free League?("Hatikvah Free League" same as {20203,901})
(2/3)Apparently, they are trying to distance themselves from those thoroughly unpleasant Scale Plate Pact fellows.("Scale Plate Pact" same as {20203,1001})
(3/3)If I were a restless assistant, looking for adventure, I would seek out the source of this intriguing turn of events, without delay.
(1/3)It appears that this laboratory came pre-installed with a Safe Deposit Storage facility!("Safe Deposit Storage" same as {20109,9001})
(2/3)If you ever find yourself in possession of objects of dubious origin, do not hesitate to leave them here.
(3/3)You may even be able to order your pilots to deposit their personal inventory!

(2/3)When you fly close enough to a station module, it gets highlighted in a new colour, depending on its type.
(3/3)Imagine the information you could gain about a station if you scanned all of its modules this way!
(1/2)Did you know that standard-issue spacesuits come fitted with an engine boost?
(2/2)No need to trundle along at a Maja Snail's pace!("Maja Snail" is singular of {20201,1901})

(1/3)There are rumours that certain individuals find it enjoyable to hack a station's storage and forcibly eject its cargo into space.
(2/3)I certainly hope that these ruffians are aware that, by collecting said cargo, they shatter any and all illusions that the station personnel may have had about their systems malfunctioning.
(1/3)Have you come across materials for equipment modification yet, maybe as a reward from some Guild Mission?("Guild Mission" singular of {1001,3333})

(1/2)Did a blinking light ever catch your eye while you were mining your own business in an asteroid field?(it says "mining" on purpose)
(2/2)The Teladi traders that pass by our Headquarters simply cannot stop talking about how to best find these crystals, and how much they manage to sell them for.
Well, I suppose you don't know that many other Boron.
I believe we have a situation.
Perhaps it is best if you return.
I can not be sure, but it seems like we have an intruder.
Perhaps some long dormant entity has awoken inside this facility.
Or maybe beings from the parallel realm have found a way through.
Intruder, would you be so kind as to take two steps back so that I can enact the purge protocols?
A plan which hinges on the conduct of criminal madmen is not much of a plan at all.
You will do no such thing. This is my laboratory!
(slightly annoyed)I would rather you did not.
(annoyed)It feels as if my hospitality is not being reciprocated to an adequate degree.
(annoyed, addressing male NPC)And I must say, your pseudo-scientific blustering is starting to get on my...

(warningly)I believe I already mentioned several times that this outpost was abandoned by the Terrans, a civilisation so unfathomably advanced and ingenious that they managed to nearly wipe themselves out on multiple occasions.
(warningly)It is paramount that we explore its integrated functions carefully, delicately, and, most of all, cautiously.
How curious. It appears that these drones have been tinkered with.
(worried)This is all getting a bit much for me.
(worried)I would really rather not lose my assistant on some suicidal adventure.
Those shapes do seem to align with my research into Paranid cocoons.
Interesting. The crystalline formations' surfaces suggest some form of preservation technology.
It would appear that these lucky fellows are being securely stored for some special occasion.
I fear this might not be quite as simple as you seem to think.
A galaxy does not have an end, you know.
But by stretching the definition somewhat, I suppose you might find an "end" of sorts, either at the very core or somewhere along the outer rim.
None of those criteria apply in this case, however.
I do believe that the impressively long-lived Argon female employed an idiom.
Whatever we're supposed to find would appear to be hidden inside that rather ominous-looking haze.
I advise you to be cautious.
There are field discharges in this area that will quickly deplete your shields.
I am detecting a small number of scattered navigational devices in your general vicinity.
Scanning them might lead us to valuable information, hidden treasure, ancient artefacts!
I can barely contain my excitement!
My analysis suggests that these beacons were placed to indicate a safe route for someone in possession of the correct credentials.
Do not worry about your deficiencies in advanced cryptography, assistant.
I shall be your master password.
If you can find more of them, I might be able to more accurately triangulate the intended guidance direction.
I don't mean to interrupt... (short pause before 'whatever')whatever it is that you are doing.
I am detecting a ship with an obfuscated signature, lifting off from that station.
Do not be downhearted, my sensitive assistants.
We have gained the valuable insight that dark and mysterious forces are watching our every move.
Using a relay from your spacesuit sensors, I might be able to perform a few scans remotely.
The connection quality is rather disappointing, but it might be enough to give a hint now and again.
I'm picking up some unusually strong heat signals from your suit's sensors.
You would drag these poor, defenceless souls into your plan to manipulate an entire people?
Be advised that my tentacle-like appendages can cause significant trauma on impact.
I expected them to have much greater mass than that.
A most commendable choice, but I am afraid that the other energy core still remains stricken with explosives.
These Paranid fellows seem to take her words quite literally.
(sad)The venerable Argon lady sacrificed herself, Dal.
The venerable Argon lady performed exceptionally!
We need to commend her for her initiative.
Assistant, let the bony sticklers win!
I am detecting multiple allied military vessels approaching rapidly.
They appear to be carrying a combination of technology similar to the ship that my assistant tracked down a while ago.

While our Paranid friends have ceased attempting to slay their own siblings, I have made some great progress on the cocoons you so deviously pilfered.
Please return to my science laboratory.
I sense that Dal has something on his mind.
(joyously)Perhaps our triangular friend was in a state of crippling self-doubt?
Do not worry, my ethically immaculate assistant! Indoctrination is a very natural thing to these Paranid fellows.
These are all the supplies I need!
What an intriguing turn of events!
(addressing NPC)Your plan was a success, Dal. And this quickly, too!
I am overjoyed to have you back in one piece, assistant.

Please return to my laboratory forthwith!

I am transmitting the station's positional data now.
I have located a suitable station to trace the funds for the mission against loyal Split.
I have located a potential Signal Leak for our purposes.
I have located a potential Signal Leak to double-check the former business partners' claims.

Incidentally, your bio-signature indicates somewhat elevated stress levels.
Ah, yes, my beloved BoFu! Indeed you did!
(1/2)Oh! Her delightful Majesty! Yes, well, not quite the Queen.
(2/2)I may have hijacked your mission communications a tad, just to imbue this delivery with some alacrity. However, the BoFu shipment is very much appreciated.
(1/2)Fret not! I shall assist you by extricating my intervention from your mission communications.
(2/2)Indeed, I see you are behind on a number of very important royal duties.
(2/3)As you are well aware, I am considered by some to be the most consequential scientist living today.
(3/3)Not only have I demolished paradigms in three unrelated scientific fields, but I was instrumental in connecting a Jump Gate to Kingdom End.
(1/3)And yet, I seem to spend far too much of my time managing this recently acquired research facility. This is a distinct inconvenience.

(2/3)To fully submerge myself in my studies, I seek a subj... an assistant to manage my affairs. Mainly this station.(attempted to say "subject" but corrected himself to the nicer framing of "assistant")(Pause before "assistant")
(3/3)Considering the faith Her Majesty has in your abilities, perhaps you might be a suitable candidate.
(1/3)With your sufferance, I have transferred control of the facility into your responsible care.
(2/3)Now that you bear the burden of the occasional caretaking of this station, we may both return to our work.
(3/3)I wish you the best of luck!
(1/3)It seems as though you are attempting to build the wrong Dock Module.
(2/3)The M and S designations in the Dock Module's name indicate the number of docking pads of the corresponding size on the module.
(3/3)Make sure you select the correct one.
(1/2)The station is missing a required module.
(2/2)Make sure that you have not confused the requested module with another.
The station is missing the required turrets.
The station is missing the necessary shields.
The station is missing the required turrets and shields.
You will need to assign or hire a Builder to start construction.
The station is missing a Pier module.
You should purchase a plot licence from the sector owners to avoid repercussions for building illegally.
The station is missing a Dock Module.
It appears that you and I have already completed this venture in another multiverse...(player plays multiple saves and has completed a venture in the other)
One of your ships has returned from a venture.
I cannot wait to read the report on its discoveries.
The venture was a complete success.
I expect the data it gathered to be pearls of wisdom, waiting to be extracted from their oysters.(excited voice)
Oh no, disaster has struck! The expedition we sent out on a venture has not returned.(worried voice)
It appears that the expedition we sent was not able to reach its assigned objective.(very worried voice)
I am detecting a signature in your sector, corresponding to multiverse travel...
It looks like we have a visitor.
Now that we have everything in place for safe traversal of the branes of the multiverse, I've summarised the information we have on the map.
Please go ahead and have a look.(at the map)
There seem to be new activities in the multiverse.
I suggest you open the MULTIVERSE map and consider joining these activities!

My research has proven the existence of the multiverse and while you took great personal risk volunteering in the first experiment, I have been devising ways to enable us to do this in a safer and more routine manner.
While pondering the mysteries of the Great Reef Nebula, one of my brains had this ingenious breakthrough.
I have prepared a list of equipment that is required to allow us to venture into the unknown.
Ah, there is so much to discover and my tentacles are being simultaneously pulled in so many captivating directions.
Wonderful! Construction of a venture platform has started.
Ah, finally. Construction of a venture dock has started.
Wonderful! I see you are taking steps to explore the limitless possibilities offered by my revolutionary multiversal research.
Be sure to also construct a Venture Platform.
Be sure to also construct a Venture Dock.
Be sure to check the remaining requirements.
Since we already have a Venture Platform, we will soon be able to send ships off on daring ventures into the grand multiverse.
Since we already have a Venture Dock, we will soon be able to send ships off on daring ventures into the grand multiverse.
We will soon be able to send ships off on daring ventures into the grand multiverse.
I am so glad to see you propitiously expanding on our venture research!
I can barely wait until construction is complete and we are able to send ships out on promising ventures throughout the multiverse!
Construction of one of the modules needed to send ships out on ventures was just completed.
Now we only need a functional Venture Platform.
Now we only need a functional Venture Dock.
... however, we have not yet constructed all station modules required for ventures.
... however, we do not yet have all equipment required for ventures.
I believe that we now have everything we need to start the first of many ambitious ventures.
I suggest we prepare an expedition.
Oh no, your only Venture Platform was destroyed.
Oh no, your only Venture Dock was destroyed.
Oh no, one of our venture modules was destroyed.
Oh no, a module which is an absolute requirement for ventures was just destroyed.
We have neither a Venture Dock nor a Venture Platform any more!
Oh no, we no longer have the equipment necessary for ventures!
This means our venture endeavour is halted for now.
This is a major inconvenience for my multiversal observations and experiments.
Please consider rebuilding it, so that I can continue my research!
This will affect the scale of our venture operation, but fortunately we are still operational.
Exploring the multiverse turned out to be even more fascinating than I originally envisioned.
You will not believe what was just discovered during the last exploration venture!
I theorised a lot about the possibility of a multiverse, but this expedition proves beyond a doubt the existence of infinitely many universes.
The most exciting of those, however, are not the infinite number of bizarre ones, but the ones that are most closely similar to ours.
It appears that there is even a near-infinite number of universes where you and I both exist.
The slight differences make these all the more fascinating.
I have started to map out some of the very first we have explored.
This new map is now added to your map.
Please go ahead and have a look!
We are not the first to make ventures into the unknown that is the multiverse.
It is apparent that there are other players at work on this stage... if you know what I mean?(slight emphasis on "players", translate similar to "actors")
Ah... the politics of the multiverse. Yes...
There are indeed alliances already established between some of these universes.
These are exciting times, very much like the first explorers leaving the oceans of their homeworld and finding that they are not alone.
So we can now decide whether we want to establish relations with these metaphorical players by joining a multiverse guild.(slight emphasis on "players", translate similar to "actors")
Before we make such an important decision, however, I advise that we first send out another venture ship with the explicit goal of discovering further alternative multiverse guilds.
After all, we do not want to bet our money on the wrong seahorse, right?
I am thoroughly disenchanted with the universes we have encountered thus far.
It appears that the multiverse is filled with conflicts just like those we see in our own universe.
Now we have to choose which of the multiversal guilds aligns most closely with our interests and is worthy of our membership.
Can there be merit in joining a multiversal war? Or should we stay strictly neutral and only join a guild which maintains its neutrality?
Have a close look at the summary I have made for each of the guilds we have encountered, before you decide which one you want to join.
Just have a look for yourself!
Note that you can only join multiple guilds if they are at peace with each other.
Note that you can only join one guild.
This is not a decision to be taken lightly, since we commit to this for an extended period.
This is not a decision to be taken lightly, since we commit to this for the duration of the operation.
Keep in mind that our other selves in the different multiverses will also be committing to this decision.
Depending on the level of your participation, rewards will be distributed at the very end.
There might be ways to increase the pool of rewards which are distributed.
I have a theory which we can research further to expand our knowledge of the multiverse.
You will find that a new research item is available.
The outcomes of our latest research are so astounding that I had to use several of my brains to index the sheer number of new possibilities.
I took the liberty of constructing some storage based on a similar technology we use for Ventures.
It appears I... or another me... or possibly even multiple "me"s(explanation: 'Me' from another multiverse) had the same idea and are already using the storage.
I suggest you take a look to see if there is anything of interest already stored inside.
This vessel appears to have an unusual number of mounting points for weapons but, interestingly, most of them are empty.
Thinking about the hypothetical danger it would pose when fully armed is a truly fin shivering thought.(ending with the typical Boron sound signifying shivering)
There are also an unusual number of life signatures, for a vessel in such a state of disrepair.
We can only hope those people on board are okay.(Boso naively hinting about *many* people onboard, which are actually Marines)
I wonder what my assistant is doing.
My assistant should arrive any minute now...
Assistant?(small pause) Assistant, where are you?
There appears to be an issue with the power grid.
Uh, where did all of this equipment come from?
I am sure there are nicer rooms, more suited to your purpose.(Boso trying to get Dal to move out)
Do you not have any plotting to do?(asking Dal)
Do you not have Governments to topple?(asking Dal)
Perhaps you should make an audio recording.
This room used to be so nice and quiet...(hint for Dal to leave)
My view is being significantly obscured by these tiny yellow sticking papers...(by Dal putting notes on the boron tank)

Personal log. I have come up with an ingenious idea of how to rid my tank of these bothersome sticky notation papers(post-it notes). Now, where can I find an operational Phased Shockwave Generator these days?
Oh, it appears that someone is trying to contact me.
While I am flattered, I must ask; who are you and how did you get this frequency?
A vague introduction is a poor way to propose an alliance.
Welcome to X4: Foundations. In this demo, you can experiment with various gameplay scenarios.
Hello there. As requested, I have set up a number of scenarios for you to experiment with.
I will be guiding you from a safe distance.
Here you see a number of sectors. Your ships and stations are shown in green.
Select one of them and let's see what it's doing.
This ship is mining in an asteroid field.
Ah, this ship has found something quite interesting.
This scout has detected some rather interesting crystal formations on asteroids.
Your station is part way through expanding.
This freighter is looking for some lucrative trade runs.
(describing a menu)From here you can activate the teleporter and visit the location.
This may well be an abandoned listening post.
There seem to be malfunctioning components. Perhaps we can bring it back online.
Several of the damaged elements have been marked on your HUD.
I believe a pulse from your repair laser will do it!
Yes, I'm starting to see activity.
Ah, you appear to have uncovered some sort of data leak.
Could you take a closer look?
Maybe try using the repair laser.
You seem to have recovered some long-lost file.
Ah, a historical article, how fascinating.
I suggest that you return swiftly to your ship, before you run out of oxygen.
Do you wish to visit another location?
Now that you're aboard the scout ship, let's see if you can find those elusive crystals.
I'll mark the most likely candidates.
Reports say that you can spot their glisten at a distance.
It appears that you've found a cluster of crystals.
I expect a few shots from your weapons will help dislodge them.
No matter. I expect you can find many more.
I'll have your sensors begin analysis.
While the computer is working, perhaps you can go to another location.
I believe this crystal is used in the construction of certain items.
I have organised a number of other items to be placed on a nearby station.
With these items, you have everything you need to create an explosive charge.
You can do so at a Crafting Bench.
I must say, I'm curious of the yield of such a device.
Your station is making good progress in constructing the new Smart Chips production.
Your station is making good progress in constructing the new Refined Metal production.
Here you can see the many building drones at work.
You are able to view and edit the station design at any time.
Over time, you can acquire new blueprints for station modules.
You can design and construct vast production complexes or deadly defence stations.
Expanding a station can take a while, but you are equipped with a Singularity Engine Time Accelerator.
SETA is a device which compresses your own bubble of space time; allowing you to watch the universe speed by.
Let us leave the construction vessel to continue its task.
It seems that the production module has been completed.
The construction vessel has completed work on the module.
Your station can now produce Smart Chips.
Your station can now produce Refined Metals.
This ship is equipped for mineral mining.
There is an asteroid field in close proximity.
You can learn more about the asteroids in this area by dropping a resource probe.
Resource probes will also detail any trace gasses worth collecting.
The probe is online and sending data packets.
You will find that your navigational charts have been updated.
Ships of this size serve as a base for mining operations.
To begin, activate the ship's mining turrets.
Very good. The turrets will automatically acquire targets.
This ship contains a number of drones to collect the minerals.
The first drones have taken flight.
Be careful not to leave your drones behind.
Oh, it seems that you may have angered someone by mining in this area.
I'll leave you to focus on this situation...
May I suggest activating the offensive turrets.
Good show. Let's hope the rest of the operation goes smoothly.
You can order the ship to continue the operation if you wish.
In this mode you can identify the different resources by the colour of the asteroids.
This ship is currently on the way to buy some wares.
This ship is currently on the way to sell wares in it's cargo bay.
Even in dangerous areas of space, you will likely find freighters attempting to turn a profit.
We should allow this ship to continue it's trade run.
Such fields may hold many different resources.
I have ordered construction of the required devices.
The materials will be sent down as soon as possible.
The current terraforming project has completed.
We have completed our current terraforming project.
And the results are even better than expected!
Oh no, our terraforming project failed...
But there seems to be some silver lining at least.
And, as if that were not disappointing enough, there were additional complications!
Oh, how wonderful! The ice has begun to melt down there!
A facility on the planet has requested a delivery.
We have been offered the opportunity to invest in a speculative business.
Details are in the terraforming overview.
We failed to get a return on our investment...
Our investment has paid off handsomely!
I will begin preparations right away!
The competition is starting, how exciting!
The competition is over, we should do this again.
The top contestants have accepted your job offer and are waiting on this station.
(with audible excitement)I have just thought of a fin-tingling endeavour! If you are interested, do come and talk to me and I will explain.
(reminder if player has not talked to him after a long time)My mind is unable to cease considering that endeavour I would like to propose. Please come and talk to me about it!
Are you here for my proposal?

Very well. Now that we have the ability to relocate this station, I have been thinking about the opportunities that would open up from our station being in another location. And what I have come up with is...
Originally a Terran term... obviously, I suppose. It is the process of transforming a world's environment to more closely match the narrow parameters that complex life requires.
The effort and materials required truly boggle even my mind, but they are necessary if we intend to bring a new and welcoming equilibrium to a currently inhospitable world.
This station's technology, combined with a mind as sophisticated as mine, contains truly remarkable depths of potential which we have not yet plumbed.
We appear to have all the different kinds of modules that we require, but I have no idea whether there is sufficient storage space. Logistics bore me so much!
Still, we will need to extend this station in order to produce the required technology. Your mission overview will have the details.
Now, before you ask, do not expect this to turn a profit! Even if you do end up developing a strong economy, any possible returns will be utterly dwarfed by our expenditures.
But is profit really more important than leaving a lasting and positive mark on the galaxy?
(after player disagreed)That was supposed to be a rhetorical question...
I have taken the liberty of researching specific opportunities and adding them to your mission overview. Peruse them at your leisure, and simply accept the one that most takes your fancy!
Oh joy! We have successfully made this world habitable!("Oh joy!" sincere, not sarcastic)
We have now started the production of Terraforming Drones.
They will carry the required resources to the planet. The drones will remain there, and the resources will be consumed as part of the current Terraforming Project.

(worried)I really hope you know what you are getting us into... They are not going to make it easy, and will surely try to retaliate down there as well as stop us up here. We need to be prepared on all fronts.
We successfully claimed a district from the Xenon.
We successfully destroyed a Xenon district.
So much for that. They are not going to rebuild in that area any time soon.
Ooh, I do hope this works!
Well, that did not work. But we knew the odds were against us. Shall we try again or use a different approach?
We... we did it! It actually worked, I can hardly believe it!
Another core successfully sabotaged. It never gets any easier, but I am sure you agree, the reward is still worth it.
The Xenon on the planet are more alert.
The Xenon on the planet are on high alert!
The Xenon on the planet seem to be scaling down their activity.
The Xenon on the planet are standing down.
Those Xenon are trying to reclaim a district. Should we stop them?
The Xenon have reclaimed a district.
The Xenon are beginning to rebuild a destroyed district. Should we stop them?
The Xenon have finished rebuilding a district. Is that good or bad?
The Xenon have started to turn a district into industry. This is probably bad for us, so maybe we should try to stop them?
The Xenon have finished their industrialisation efforts.
Unfortunately, the Xenon have finished their work before we could stop them...
We have successfully frustrated the Xenon's efforts.
(panicked, squeaking)The Xenon are coming for us! Protect me!
(bubble-blowing squeal of relief)The Xenon seem to be leaving us alone, at least for now.
That was the first of the three. Should we take a little breather or tackle the next one right away?
Only one core left! No use in slowing down now. Let us finish this!
We actually did it! And they called us mad. Mad! Who is laughing now? Hahahaha!("Hahahaha" voiced as an awkward Boron attempt to mimic laughter)

This individual contacted me through a... mutual friend they called it? Apparently your name has been going around certain circles, and not in a "they're(translation note: singular they're referencing the player) a problem" kind of way, either! They seem very interested in the rumours that we might be able to make planets habitable, and I do find the prospect of reducing piracy somewhat appealing.
Did you hear that? They called me ingenious!
Excuse me, but I feel I must alert you to an evolving situation.
I do not usually spend much time analysing the minutia of military conflicts across the universe, but it seems that a Xenon incursion is causing much concern.
I will send you what information I have.
Oh my, it appears that the Kha'ak are also present in high numbers! What is transpiring?
I implore you to investigate first-hand but, of course, with great caution.
It appears that the local forces are struggling with this onslaught.
The local forces are beginning to get the upper hand.
My word! It has been many years since I have seen a Kha'ak ship of such a scale.
The Kha'ak are jumping into the system at an alarming rate.
The Xenon fleet is heading out of the system, possibly to escape the indiscriminate Kha'ak attackers.
I believe the Kha'ak have ceased jumping into the system.
I am starting to analyse the data from this incident. I will contact you when I have come to a conclusion.
Excuse me. I really must have your undivided attention.
Come to my lab and I will explain this dire situation.
I implore you to visit me. This matter concerns a potentially devious Xenon plot! Time is not on our side.
I have activated a timer in your interface. This shows how much time remains. I have also sent you the information that I have gleaned so far.
Speak with me before the timer expires. Failure to do so will certainly result in the Xenon enacting their plan with little or no resistance.
The timer for the impending Xenon threat is about to expire. Should this happen our options become very limited.
There is still time for action but I must explain face to face.
Should you wish to let the timer expire and face the threat head-on, I will support you but I do not expect it to be a simple campaign. There will be heavy losses.
That incident with the Xenon and the Kha'ak, which caused so much devastation, is likely a precursor to further attacks.
I have devised a potential solution to the problem, but it will require my full attention and sufficient funds.
I cannot guarantee results, but it is our best chance to prevent further incidents.
The alternative is to join various military forces to repel this onslaught. There will be many losses, but we will likely gain better information to formulate a lasting solution.
Will you give me the funds to potentially stop this before it starts? Or, are you willing to face the oncoming threat and drive them back with force?
Are you content with your decision?
Very well, I will make my preparations.
I do hope that you forgive me for shirking my usual tasks while I take care of this business.
Oh, you do not seem to have enough funds at the moment.
Very well, we shall face it together.
Many governments, friend and enemy alike, have been discussing this threat with great fervour.
The speculated change in Xenon behaviour has shocked many, but I believe this is simply a further example of an intelligence we have failed to understand.
The speculated change in Xenon behaviour has shocked many, especially the Terrans, but I believe this is simply a further example of an intelligence we have failed to understand.
I will provide you with whatever information we possess regarding this situation, so you can better prepare.
It is a potentially dire situation. Dal has left to meet with contacts from various governments.
Please excuse me. I am rather busy.
Alert! We have identified the target of the next Xenon and Kha'ak incursion.
If you are able to observe the early phases, we may glean some insight into what drives these events.
There! Is that a Kha'ak ship among the Xenon? It does not appear to be happy with the situation.
The Kha'ak ship has escaped the situation by jumping away.
I have a bad feeling about this.
The Xenon appear to be heading to a Jump Gate.
The Xenon appear to be heading to an Accelerator.
The Xenon appear to be heading out of the system.
They are likely to cause much destruction in their wake.
It seems that the Xenon are aggravating the Kha'ak in such a manner that they are essentially summoning them.
The Kha'ak are a threat to all, including the Xenon, which is why the Xenon are attempting to escape the sector.
While fascinating, this is a dire situation.
It appears that the Kha'ak have ceased their attack.
While we have learned much since the President's End tragedy, it is clear the Kha'ak can still cause sudden and overwhelming devastation.
There is another sector set to be attacked!
Blast! I was not quick enough. Another sector will be attacked.
I am making progress in my investigation of this new Xenon tactic.
This will take more time. I do hope to come up with a solution before the next attack.
I expect to have information for you shortly.
We have a lead on the Xenon activity.
I am sending you a location.
I suggest you bring sufficient firepower. Make haste!
The information I sent you is now outdated. Give me some time.
There! That massive structure. I believe it to actually be a ship!
Wait, could it be? Yes, yes! It is a CPU ship!
This must be the source of the new Xenon tactics.
It is a shame to neutralise such an impressive specimen, but it may be the only way to stop these attacks.
It appears to be charging a Jump Drive!
Darn, the ship has escaped! I will attempt to find it again, but it will take some time.
I have found the CPU ship again.
Damage the ship before it has time to charge its Jump Drive.
The CPU ship seems to have entered some kind of hibernation state.
I am reading an immense defensive field which will likely prevent us from fully destroying it.
All other systems appear to be in a low power mode.
This may be all that we can do. Whether it stops any further attacks, we will have to wait and see.
I... suggest leaving some forces to guard the behemoth.
Your attention, please! The inert CPU ship has suddenly disappeared!
Please come and see me to discuss the matter.
With the disappearance of the CPU ship, we must assume that the attacks may start again.
Now that we have a better understanding of the situation, I believe I can prevent further attacks but it will require funds.
Do you wish for me to enact my plan, or will we once again fight them back?
Very well. We shall face them and drive them back once more!
A sensible decision. I will enact my scheme.
We have Kha'ak jumping into the system!
The large ship appears to have jumped away.
I believe that you have just had an encounter with an elusive CPU ship.
Oh, you appear to be in a troublesome situation. Good fortune!
(2/2)It appears that the Twins have put a bounty on your head, and the entirety of the Vigor Syndicate is looking to collect.
This sector has experienced a supernova event unlike any I have seen!
It must have been a spectacular sight to behold, and an enlightening moment for any scientist who recorded it!
The magnitude of this discovery is simply immeasurable!
What a delight it is to confirm that element 126 is real and stable!
The Ektoberyll has rendered invaluable service to the scientific community!
The resonance of this knowledge will elevate us all!
Kaori Chen! I am so pleased to meet you at last! My assistant has briefed me on your amazing tale!
You are too kind! But I assume you have not come here to chit-chat.
My word! I fear there is more to discover in this one rock than can be accomplished in my lifetime.
How may I be of service, venerable Kaori?
What did the asteroid tell you?
But there is so much we have yet to learn from you!
I swear, we shall do our utmost. Safe travels, Grandmother.
Well well well! That Kaori Chen is a singular person, indeed!
We really have no way of knowing.
These beings are clearly far beyond our understanding.
Perhaps... just perhaps... they are the intelligence behind the gate technology itself.
I fear that joining the rest of the known galaxy may upset their peaceful equilibrium.
We should do what we can to assist them in this transition.
While you are here, I do have other matters to discuss.
I had my suspicions that the asteroid at the heart of our HQ is no ordinary space rock.
Kaori has most definitely explained why this is the case.
Assistant! There is something highly unusual about this vessel.
I do believe... yes... I am certain... the telemetry you are sending from this ship is... connecting with the HQ asteroid.
I suspect this is exactly the stimulus the asteroid is looking for.
Do search for similar artefacts. We must learn more about the asteroid's mysterious capabilities.
You have found another ship that I can research further in our HQ.
Do see if you can find any more of these artefacts.
Please come and see me at the HQ. There are matters we must discuss.
Assistant! I have discovered some troubling signals.
Please hurry to the HQ to see me as soon as you can.
I may need to engage your skills in matters of great importance.
Welcome my dear assistant! I am so grateful you were able to join me.
I must inform you of some very strange goings on.
The asteroid at the heart of this HQ does not seem to be an ordinary space rock.
Well... to be brief... it is... emanating.
I shall have to study further, but there are distinct signals permeating through the structure.
I should jolly well think so!
Indeed. As far as I can tell, the asteroid is some sort of mineral-based... brain.
A brain of considerable power. And it seems to be reaching out.
That is an excellent question, assistant.
The signals seem to be reaching out in quite random directions. However, there is something else.
Beyond Ianamus Zura, something seems to be signalling back.
I need you to investigate. By all accounts there should not be anything notable in that location.
Oh. Quite. Well, do please hurry back.
I'm so glad you could rejoin me. There is much I have to relay.
Jolly good! However, there is more.
I mentioned that the mineral brain seems to be searching in all directions.
I have a theory that it seeks some kind of stimulus. As though it is... hungry.
Please do be alert to any artefacts you may encounter that could have a connection with the asteroid.
Your abandoned vessel retrieval has certainly had an impact on the asteroid.
Please do be alert to any more such artefacts that could have a connection with the asteroid.
By parsing the telemetry through the asteroid brain, we were able to generate new research opportunities.
Good day to you, assistant. I see you have found your way to Ianamus Zura.
I have my suspicions that the dormant gate may have reopened.
My word! You have indeed detected a newly active Jump Gate!
I believe further exploration is in order!
However, this does open up a new possibility for further research that we can conduct.
The new sector you found, Mitsuno's Remembrance; something there seems to be signalling back.
I need you to investigate this further. Get to the bottom of this mystery, assistant.
My goodness! That is astounding! This Kaori person must be in possession of some highly advanced technology.
You must bring her to me so that we can collaborate in more depth.
However, there is more to discuss.
There is a senior Ministry of Finance official based not far from your current position.
His name is Gogoeolos Yahandis Yoyunis II. I should warn you. He has a rather... grumpy... reputation.
But perhaps he might be able to resolve this predicament.
Interstellar diplomacy is an alluring interdisciplinary pursuit - part science, part etiquette, part curiosity.
If you so wish, I will undertake this compelling research on your behalf. Consider it your first tentative step into a larger dialogue!
Splendid! You have now completed all required research and obtained the necessary certifications to engage in diplomatic affairs at the Embassy.
I look forward to your contributions to interstellar relations!
I hope this finds you well!
With your newly acquired expertise, you may now invite diplomats from friendly factions to your Headquarters.
Diplomats are authorised by their governments to ratify blueprint sales.
They may also organise promotional ceremonies on behalf of their factions - this means you would be climbing the ladder!
Good-faith participation is, of course, anticipated; should relations deteriorate, foreign diplomats may be recalled.

page.title: Boron NPC 2 / Boron Trader
page.descr: Lines for Boron NPC 2 and Boron Trader
page.t: (Metadata, do not translate)[boron] male female basic
(Goodbye - staff)Glad to have been of assistance.
(Greeting - rejected - big ship)We have nothing to say to you.
(* Honorifics - addressing crew in calm situations *)
The request came from a police vessel.
(suggestion for dealing with bad situation)Get us out of here!
(variant)(refusal to do something)No, I do not think I will.
(chosen reward)Please take one of these as thanks.
Sorry, I am busy right now.
(variant)(refusal to surrender - finds it funny)Ah, a joke. Most amusing!
(variant)(refusal to surrender - in danger)I will not submit to you.
(informing player)I was asked to drop my cargo.

(manager / captain response to sabotage, hacking or suspicious activity)Launch emergency fighters.
Make sure service crew know to fix the damage.
(call to security forces - minor)Look out for any suspicious activity.
(call to security forces - major)Tell us of any suspicious activity immediately.
(call to security forces - search)Scan for suspicious activity.
Look only for our target resource.
(NPC moves onto player's ship)I'm aboard your ship and ready to go.
(NPC moves off player ship)That was a pleasant journey. I thank you.
(No room on player's ship)You don't have enough room on your ship right now.
(NPC wants to leave ship)Drop me off at the nearest station.
(Player receives licence)Congratulations on your new licence.
(greeting - black marketeer - on introduction)(@voice confident but not drawing attention)If you're looking to find some black market merchandise, I'm the one to talk to.
(Friendly greeting)It's good to see you, friend.
(Allied greeting)It's an honour to see you here.
(Start of greeting)On behalf of our organisation: (keep space)
We need to damage the target further.
(to marine)Alright, get out of there. Abort.
(on failure, somber)May the waters take you.
(boarding pod launched)Pod launched. Moving to target.
(begin breach)We're making our way through the hull.
(marine lost during breach)Man down! Watch out for countermeasures on the hull!
One of the teams is pinned down.
(lots of fighting noise)We're taking heavy losses.
(lots of fighting noise)We're pushing through. Lots of resistance.
We've secured several sections. Moving on.
We have lost the commander! We are being overrun!
I have a team working on bypassing a lockdown.
The crew seems to be abandoning ship.
The self-destruct has been activated. We're working on disabling it.
I don't think we can make it to the bridge. Requesting abort.
I'm calling it. Abort! Get back to your pods!
(self-destruct imminent, somber)Sorry, Sir. This isn't looking good.
(target damaged)Don't destroy the target while we're in here!
(emergency event mission offer)I could really use some help right now.
(data leak signal - illegal opportunity)I'm taking a big risk by broadcasting, so if you decode this transmission, keep it to yourself. I have work that needs doing.
(data leak signal - plea for help - intense)Can anyone hear me?! Hello?! I'm not supposed to be broadcasting but I need help! Please! I need help!
(data leak signal - plea for help - intense)Can anyone hear me?! I need help! Please, if you can hear this, I need help!
(data leak signal - plea for help)Hey! I know this is unconventional, but if you can hear this, I could use some help.
(station masstraffic mini-mission)Don't let them get away!
(station masstraffic mini-mission)Illegal cargo on drone detected.
(station masstraffic mini-mission)Illegal wares on drone detected.
(station masstraffic mini-mission)Illegal data on drone detected.
(player looks at offer - generic)Are you interested in a job?
(player looks at offer - easy difficulty)You shouldn't have any trouble with this.
(player looks at offer - hard difficulty)You'll need your wits about you for this.
(player looks at data leak mission offer - illegal opportunity)You decrypted my signal. Good.
(player looks at illegal mission offer)This could be lucrative for both of us.
(player looks at data leak mission offer - plea for help)I'm glad you found my signal.
(player looks at emergency mission offer or plea for help)I hope you can help!
(player looks at mission offer again - generic)So you're still interested?
(player looks at mission offer again - illegal opportunity)I knew you wouldn't resist.
(player looks at mission offer again - emergency or plea for help)You came back? Does that mean you'll help?
(variant)(encounter offer - illegal activity 01 - upcoming raid - call)You could join us on this little escapade if you like.
(variant)(encounter offer - illegal activity 01 - upcoming raid - response)I would very much like that!
(variant)(encounter offer - illegal activity 02 - black marketeer - call)These items are a little... warm. Would you be able to deal with them for me?
(variant)(encounter offer - illegal activity 02 - black marketeer - response)I would be happy to buy them. Please meet me at my usual location to make the exchange.
(variant)(encounter offer - illegal activity 03 - lockbox - call)The lockbox is at these coordinates. You should find the items within.
(variant)(encounter offer - illegal activity 03 - lockbox - response)I am a bit busy at the moment, but I will collect them later.
(player declines mission offer)Come and find me if you change your mind.
(player declines mission offer - illegal opportunity)Ah... you'll be back. I'm sure.
(player declines mission offer - plea for help)What?! No! Please!
(player accepts mission offer)I knew I could count on you.
(reluctant for player to take mission - particularly hard missions, etc)Alright. If you think you can handle it.
(player accepts illegal opportunity)Smart move. Don't mess this up.
(player accepts plea for help or emergency mission offer)Thank you! Good luck!
(mission update)There's been a change of plans with the job.
(partial success)If that's the best you could do... sure.
(failed mission)I hope you don't think you're being paid for that.
(success in mission chain)We're one step closer to completion.
(failure in mission chain)That didn't go well, but we might still be able to salvage this.
(mission aborted by NPC / script failure)Sorry. Looks like your services are no longer required.

Ha-ha! Take that, you purportedly animated, yet hitherto faceless, antagonists!(shouting, pronounce the "ha-ha!" as an enthusiastic gotcha, like gentlemanly duellist; this character is a Boron who has never met the player and tends to speak very sophisticatedly and politely, and is rather full of himself; whenever it is not explicitly stated who this character is talking to in the 302538XX lines, he is talking to the player, who could be male or female, and who is roughly equal to the speaker in the military hierarchy)
You may applaud as you feel appropriate, Tinfi Ga.(smug, Tinfi Ga is a female friend)

By the Queen, it would require the presence of a Lar to converse with you in this emotional state!(indignant, throws up his hands, implying that she's been teasing him, a "Lar" is a special gender of Boron whose presence is known to ease tensions between other Boron, speaking to a female friend)
Pah! You know full well that the only Lar on this ship is currently preoccupied ensuring the triumph of this mission!(indignant, speaking to a female friend)

Tinfi Ga, what are they doing?(hissing in a way that it sounds like whispering but is still audible, "Tinfi Ga" is the female friend the speaker is talking to, "they" refers to the player wo could be male or female)
(1/2)Ha. Ha.(drily, responding to a female friend poking fun at his uptightness)
(2/2)Pilot, you may approach!(formally, clears his throat before speaking, the "pilot" is the player who could be male or female)
Yes, what is it you require?(magnanimously, response to player starting a conversation with him for the first time)

The ancient nemesis? Let loose upon our vessel? How peculiar!(response to player starting a conversation with him for the first time, alternative greeting for when the player is a Split, "ancient enemy" refers to the Split)

(1/4)Evidently it was wise to rely on Leda We to send me a suitably pugnacious replacement.(context: he's just lost a pilot, and the player has arrived to replace them; "Leda We" is the speaker's superior, the "replacement" is the player who could be male or female)

(2/4)You see, one of my most experienced pilots was struck down with space sickness, and is confined, for the time being, to an aqua-chamber.("space sickness" is a condition Boron sometimes get when they spend too much time isolated in cramped environments in space)
(3/4)Consequently, there remains a fully operational corvette anchored within the hold of the Menelaus' Reminiscence.("Menelaus' Reminiscence" is the name of a carrier ship, same as {30253,262})
(4/4)If you promise to treat this honourable ship with the respect she is due, she shall be yours until we have concluded our mission.

(1/4)Nonsense! Nothing of the sort!(a bit startled, tries to hide his insecurity by flaunting self-assuredness and pathos, responding to the player suggesting that the speaker just got teased by a female friend)
(2/4)I am merely unaccustomed to the lack of pheromonic communication. And these incapacious suits make nothing easier.
(3/4)My comrade-in-arms, who is yet to experience the splendour of Nishala's oceans, exploits her advantage brazenly and mischievously.(the "comrade-in-arms" is a female friend)
(4/4)It is evident that for the duration of our joint undertaking, it falls to me to teach this backwater Boron the manners pertinent to her position.(the "backwater Boron" is a female friend)
(1/3)We are her Majesty's Lilac Fin, armed to the trunk, the froth of the froth!(proudly puffing out his chest, "Lilac Fin" is a flight of ships, "froth" means "sea froth")
(2/3)Though traditional Boron conduct stipulates prudence and caution, our corvettes proceed boldly to quash any perils before they grow rampant.(proudly shaking his fist)
(3/3)And as you have no doubt observed, a good smack on the appendage makes these Kha'ak retreat like any other foe.
My subordinates shall be honoured and proud to do battle by your side!
Very well, but do not keep me waiting.(friendly reminder, not reprimanding, response to player pausing the conversation)
Shall we continue, then?(player starts the conversation again after pausing it earlier)
We are patiently, but eagerly, awaiting the inception of our newest acquisition, Commander.(the "acquisition" is the player who could be male or female, speaks to male superior)
(1/2)In these dark and narrow tunnels, the Kha'ak will have to approach the carrier rather closely.(speaks to the player again)
(2/2)I recommend that you pre-empt them by manoeuvring to the marked position.(meaning that the player is supposed to wait for the enemy to approach, not head them off)
(1/3)Pilot, I confess that I am about to exploit your position as a newcomer to trial a tactic recommended to me by Tinfi Ga.("Tinfi Ga" is a female friend)
(2/3)As you may already have sensed, your flight assist automatically makes your ship move synchronously with the carrier, provided you stay close enough.("flight assist" same as in {1001,5330})
(3/3)This convenient mode of operation allows you to rotate your ship freely and align your weapons with approaching Kha'ak, mimicking an exceptionally large turret.
Kha'ak!(drawn-out shout when the enemy is spotted, like Captain Kirk's "Khaaaan!" in Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan)
Flying like this almost makes one forget the incommodiousness of these suits!(elated, fully in his element)
Imagine how swiftly our ships will scuttle past these Kha'ak once the highway is complete.(optimistically musing about a bright future, talking to a female friend)
Indeed, I would like to see that!(encouraging, response to a female friend who suggested reckless behaviour in a fight)
(1/2)Azure Fin, it appears that your courageous defence will suffice for the remainder of this voyage.("Azure Fin" is a flight of ships, talking to a group of friends)
(2/2)The commander has bestowed upon my flight fresh, and indeed pivotal, orders. We shall depart forthwith.(talking to a group of friends)
(1/2)I am delighted that you have heeded my call.(serious, about to spill the bad news, talking to group of friends)
(2/2)Feast your eyes on this emerging cataclysm.(serious, the "cataclysm" is the amassing enemies further down the road which haven't attacked yet, talking to a group of friends)
Gathering for what exactly, I feel compelled to ask.(responding to a male superior suggesting that the enemy ships are gathering)
(1/2)You are suggesting that this location may hold societal value to the Kha'ak?(serious, intrigued, responding to a female friend)
(2/2)A holy place within their sanctuary? A jump beacon? Is this a ceremony of procreation?("sanctuary" deliberately alludes to the name of the sector, {20005,9005}; responding to a female friend)
(1/2)Commander, I object!(serious, responding to a male superior)
(2/2)We are severely outnumbered.(serious, responding to a male superior)
Ha-hah, observe! Our adversaries bolt in panic!(excited, with pathos, talking to a group of friends)
(1/2)Commander, I must hereby confess my burgeoning worry.(actually sounding a bit worried, showing cracks in his gentlemanly demeanour, talking to a male superior)
(2/2)If the Kha'ak are able to engage their jump drives at a moment's notice, why did these ones fall astern to guard the retreat?(talking to a male superior)
(1/2)Now is not the time for gloom and introspection, Commander!(encouraging, talking to a male superior)
(2/2)Those Kha'ak must have thought us securely ensnared. But now it is they who will be caught unawares!(encouraging, talking to a male superior)
Our adversaries are on visual!(proclaiming contact with the enemy, talking to a group of friends)
(1/2)The enemy retreats!(with pathos, talking to a group of friends)
(2/2)We have successfully enveloped their hearts with fear!(with pathos, talking to a group of friends)
... Polypheides.(friendly reprimand; talking to a female friend, who just said "Queen Menelaus" instead of "Queen Polypheides")
21 full years have passed since the late Queen Menelaus concluded her reign.(friendly reprimand, talking to a female friend)

Tinfi Ga, they are doing it again!(excited, whispering to a female friend called "Tinfi Ga", "they" refers to the player who strangely is not approaching to talk to the speaker and who could be male or female)

Do not interfere, simply watch.(whispering to a female friend, meaning that the other person should not say anything else to the player who is for some reason not approaching to talk to the speaker and who could be male or female)
Fellow pilot.(imagine a curt nod, response to player starting the conversation with him)

(1/9)You request my assessment of our mission? Or of your personal performance?(response to the player asking about his assessment; he deliberately dodges the question about the mission and instead dispenses praise)
(2/9)Allow me your indulgence for this small jest.(starts with a short, polite chuckle)

(3/9)Your skill in battle was, of course, nothing short of exemplary. Much like that of my fellow Fin leader Tinfi Ga, for whom I continue to hold great respect.(a "fin" is flight of ships, the respect is genuine)
(4/9)I am likewise impressed by the ebullient and audacious decisiveness of our good Commander Leda We.(he is first and foremost happy that Leda We does as he is told, "Leda We" is male)

(5/9)My distaste for provincial mentality and custom seems to be entirely unfounded in his case.(by "provincial" he means the previously cut off Provinces Adrift, that most of the other characters are from)

(6a/9)To my knowledge, he has already received high accolades for his role.(meaning that Leda We has been commended for a previous mission; the speaker has learned about this only recently, and is pleasantly surprised)

(6b/9)I understand that you have both already received high accolades.(meaning that Leda We and the player have been commended for a previous mission; the speaker has learned about this only recently, and is pleasantly surprised)
(7/9)And from none less than Her Majesty the Queen Polypheides herself, I might add!(earnestly impressed)

(8/9)I warrant that the skills of such an astute and auspicious leader are utterly wasted on mere local administration or a humble captaincy.(he's playing some kind of game here; he knows that Leda We is insecure and has much to learn; the "leader" is male)

(9/9)I shall look forward to hearing more about your rapid rise in our freshly interconnected galaxy. And indeed, that of Leda We.(by interconnection he means the newly built highways, and the recent contact with the other species and factions; "Leda We" is a male superior)

(1/4)Why, I shall return to my station and await Her Majesty's further instructions, of course!(a little bit indignant, by "station" he means his post and not a space station; response to the player asking about his plans for the future)
(2/4)I am, after all, a dutiful member of Her Royal Wardens.
