(3/4)Some of my compatriots may be tempted to enjoy their well-deserved leave and retirement. But I am of the persuasion that to serve is a privilege.(admonishing his fellow pilots who might be listening)
(4/4)And I am furthermore minded not to painfully lodge my appendages in one of these constraining suits for the foreseeable future.(disgusted)
Naturally.(magnanimously, response to the player requesting to pause the conversation)
You were saying?(imagine a raised eyebrow, response to the player resuming the conversation)
(1/5)Indeed, as he well should have!(excited to show something off, response to the player saying that the commander told them to go and talk to the speaker)

(2/5)Since Lilac Fin was merely a temporary arrangement to aid the mission in Sanctuary of Darkness, some of my subordinates are now looking towards new opportunities.("Lilac Fin" is a flight of ships, "Sanctuary of Darkness" same as {20005,9005})
(3/5)This is, of course, all well and proper.(nodding to himself)
(4/5)One of my most promising pilots has made a request to be transferred to your command. Naturally, I heartily endorse her request.
(5/5)She is anticipating your review in this very room.(imagine him stretching out his arm in a wide gesture to introduce someone)
My word! I must say I am rather preoccupied.
Shoo! I have business to attend to.(not too harsh, carefully shoving the player away)

page.title: Boron NPC 4 / Heavy Squad Leader
page.descr: Lines for Boron NPC 4 and Heavy Squad Leader
page.t: (Metadata, do not translate)[boron] male female basic
(Goodbye - staff)Glad to have been of assistance.
(Greeting - rejected - big ship)We have nothing to say to you.
(* Honorifics - addressing crew in calm situations *)
The request came from a police vessel.
(suggestion for dealing with bad situation)Get us out of here!
(variant)(refusal to do something)No no, that is out of the question.
(chosen reward)Please take one of these as thanks.
Sorry, I am busy right now.
(variant)(refusal to surrender - finds it funny)Amusing, very amusing. No.
(variant)(refusal to surrender - in danger)Despite my peril, I will not submit.
(informing player)I was asked to drop my cargo.
(informing player)I was forced to drop my cargo.
We need to perform a transfer.
(first warning - generic)We cannot tolerate your actions.
(first warning to an attacking ship)Stop your attack immediately.
(warning of consequences - generic)You will now suffer the consequences.
(warning of consequences - opening fire)You are now being targeted.
(warning of consequences - sending ships)Ships are now being dispatched.
(warning of consequences - reporting)You will now be reported to local security forces.
(report of attack - ships)Reporting an attack against this vessel.
(report of attack - stations)Reporting an attack against this station.
(law enforcement confirms report, after something like Affirmative)Criminal record has been updated.
(report of attack generic)Reporting a criminal offence.
(variant)(ship complies to police instructions)All things considered, that was a good decision on your part.
(ship does not comply)You have refused to comply.
(reporting)This is sector security reporting criminal activity.
(variant)(aboard a smuggling multi-crew ship)Do be careful. Sector security patrols are frequent.
(variant)(aboard a smuggling multi-crew ship that is caught)They have found us. How terribly inconvenient.
(variant)(response to above - rushed suggestion)We had better get rid of the cargo.
(variant)(ship complies to pirate instructions)Thank you for your cooperation.
(report on enemy activity)Too risky to engage.
(capital or M-sized ship / station hit without taking serious damage)We were hit.
(capital or M-sized ship / station hit without taking serious damage)Something hit us.
(capital or m-sized ship / station hit without taking serious damage)We're taking hits.
(variant)(multi-crew ship attacking - serious threat threshold on attacked ship reached)They are weakening.
(variant)(multi-crew ship attacking - serious threat threshold on attacked ship reached)The poor souls will not last much longer.
(multi-crew ship attacking - captain response)Continue to attack the target.
(multi-crew ship attacking - captain response)Keep up the pressure on the target.
(variant)(multi-crew ship attacking - life threat threshold on attacked ship reached - captain response)Let their pleas go unanswered.
(variant)(multi-crew ship attacking - life threat threshold on attacked ship reached - captain response)We must continue if we are to defeat them.
(variant)(small ship hit, in danger, panic)I would much rather be elsewhere.
(variant)(small ship hit, in danger, panic)What a dire situation!
(variant)(small ship hit, in danger, panic)All is lost!
(variant)(taunt line - response-capable)I am quite sure that I am a better pilot than you.
(variant)(taunt line - response-capable)I am not the soft target that you seem to think I am.
(variant)(taunt line - generic)My skills may surprise you.
(variant)(taunt line - generic)Are you underestimating me? I think you are.
(variant)(generic - life threat threshold reached)I urge you to show mercy!
(variant)(generic - life threat threshold reached)Please be merciful!
(variant)(multi-crew ship / station hit - life threat threshold reached)Take pity on us!
(variant)(multi-crew ship / station hit - life threat threshold reached)The damage to our ship is extensive. Please show some mercy.
(variant)(single-crew ship hit - life threat threshold reached)I am done for. Spare my life, please.
(variant)(single-crew ship hit - life threat threshold reached)I cannot take any more. Stop now, please!
(fleeing from combat)This is too much! I must flee!
(pilot bailing from ship)Spare my life! I am leaving my ship!
(relief line)It is wonderful to have survived.
(congratulations after combat from captain)Well done, everyone!
(new attack orders for multi-crew ship coming in)We have new attack orders.
(new attack orders for multi-crew ship coming in during target)New attack orders!
(preparing new attack orders)Prepare to open fire on the target.
(preparing new attack orders during combat)Attack this target!
(reaction to friendly fire)Hey, will you stop firing?
(reaction to friendly fire)You're wrecking my shields!
(reaction to friendly fire)Why are you shooting me?
(enemy ship or station exploding)It's going to blow!
(variant)(single-crew ship hit without taking serious damage - response-capable)Just a small hit. Not enough to put me in any danger.
(variant)(single-crew ship hit without taking serious damage - response-capable)A mere glancing blow.
(variant)(single-crew ship hit without taking serious damage - generic)I am all right. Yes, definitely all right.
(variant)(enemy destroyed - taunt)I should probably have warned you that that would happen.
(variant)(enemy destroyed - report)I see no further signs of activity from the target.
(variant)(small ship hit, not in danger - response-capable)I cannot just let you get away with that!
(variant)(small ship hit, not in danger - response-capable)You really should not have done that.
(variant)(response to small ship hit, generic - small ship)That is just the first of many.
(variant)(response to small ship hit, generic - big ship)It was very unwise of you to think that you could defeat us.
(variant)(response to small ship hit, panic - small ship)I will try to make this painless for you.
(variant)(response to small ship hit, panic - small ship)I am very sorry, but I do not think you will survive this encounter.
(variant)(response to taunt - small ship)I may be a Boron, but I am not afraid of a fight.
(variant)(response to taunt - small ship)Do not try to threaten me, please.
(variant)(response to taunt - small ship)You are attempting to intimidate me?
(variant)(response to taunt - small ship)Your aggressive language does not impress me at all.
(variant)(response to life threat threshold - small ship)Certainly not!
(variant)(apology for friendly fire)I am really terribly sorry about that. It will not happen again.
(variant)(taunt - silent enemy)I cannot allow you to continue to exist.
(variant)(single-crew ship hit without taking serious damage - xenon)These awful machines should never have been given weapons.
(variant)(single-crew ship hit without taking serious damage - silent enemy)Stop it!
(variant)(threat)I can hold my own against any pilot.
(variant)(threat)I am capable of putting up a good fight.
(variant)(missile use)What else do we have? Ah yes, missiles.
(variant)(torpedo use)I may have to use a torpedo.
(variant)(losing an enemy)I really need to stop them from following me.
(variant)(losing an enemy)I need to get away from here.
(variant)(small ship hit, not in danger - generic)Uhoh! Let me check... ah, good, everything is fine.
(variant)(small ship hit, not in danger - generic)Gosh! I think everything is still working.
(variant)(response to small ship hit, generic - small ship)I have barely begun.
(variant)(response to small ship hit, generic - big ship)You will surely be destroyed if you continue to fight.
(variant)(NPC attempts bribe)Perhaps we could make a little deal?
(variant)(NPC bribe succeeds)Oh, I am glad to hear that.
(variant)(NPC hired)That is a generous offer. I look forward to working with you.
(variant)(NPC fired)Very well. I wish you fair seas.
Last order could not be completed.
(order added to queue - informal)It's been added to the list.
The order might take longer than expected.
Pass on new coordinates to following ships.
Inform me when all ships have arrived.
All ships have arrived at destination.
(command)Tell group leader we've spotted enemy activity.
(relay report)They say it's safe to engage.
(relay report)They say it's too risky to engage.
One of our wingmen is asking for backup.
(escort leaves)You're on your own from here.
(grateful)Might not have made it without you.
(during combat)Get on the line! We need backup, now!
(group of small ships - winning)We're all over them!
(group of small ships - winning)We've got them now!
(group of small ships - losing)They're all over us!
(group of small ships - losing)We can't stand this.
(response to distress call - singular)Hang on! I'm on my way!
(response to distress call - plural)We've received your call. We're on the way.
Please follow directions to designated docking position.
They've marked our docking position for us.
Get the crew to ready a docking bay.
It's an honour to have you aboard.
We're pleased to welcome you aboard.
(Informing player ship will soon undock)The ship will be undocking soon.
(Informing player ship will not undock before they return)I'll wait for you to tell me to take off.
(Informing player they will have to manually tell the pilot to take off)Let me know when you want to take off.
There's a ship preparing to undock.
Departing ship, you are clear to undock. Safe travels.
Bring away from the docking position. Slowly.
Use these criteria for the search.
I've found a trade offer matching our criteria.
Tell that station we are on our way.
(when a repair / upgrade order comes in)Which ship needs the work?
(variant)(fluff - moving from one part of the ship to another)Hm, did I leave it over here?
(variant)(fluff - finished repair)That is better. I am happy with that.
(variant)(fluff - completed upgrade / repair)So much better. A real improvement.
(variant)(fluff - finishing up pt. I)Give me a moment or two. I will be with you shortly.
(variant)(fluff - finishing up pt. II)There, all done. Now, how can I assist you?
(order for new units)Let's make an order for new units.
(order for new ammo)Let's make an order for some more ammunition.
(cap ship repair)Ask the station to start repairs.
(cap ship / station repair)Launching repair units now.
(law enforcement respons to comms - followed up by comms greeting)This is sector security.
(ship scan warning - cargo)Please halt. We will be scanning your cargo hold.
(ship scan warning - inventory)Please halt. We will be scanning your inventory.
(variant)(ship scan result - nothing found)The scan showed nothing unexpected. Thank you for your time.
(ship scan result - something found)We've detected contraband.
(ordering to drop cargo/contraband)Release your contraband immediately.
(variant)(ship scanned by police - compliant)Feel free to scan whenever you are ready.
(variant)(ship scanned by police - nothing found)That is good to hear. May the rest of your day be peaceful.
(variant)(ship scanned by police - something found)Oh dear... I do not know what to say.
(report to superior)My ship is being scanned.
(variant)(ship scan warning)What do we have here, then.
(variant)(ship scan result - nothing found)I am almost disappointed to say that nothing has been found.
(variant)(ship scan result)I am afraid that we may have to impound some of your cargo.
(variant)(ordered to drop cargo - releases under duress)Take my cargo, but leave me in peace, please.
(variant)(ordered to surrender ship - surrenders under duress)I will give up my ship in return for my life.
(station / ship sabotaged - explosives)I'm noticing a small breach. It looks like someone used explosives on the hull.
(station / ship sabotaged - EMP)Electronics have gone dead somewhere. Someone used an EMP device.
(station / ship hacked)It looks like someone's hacked us.
(station security saw suspicious activity)We've picked up suspicious activity.
(station security saw suspicious activity - report inside managers office)Security vessels are reporting suspicious activity.
(manager response to sabotage, hacking or suspicious activity)Send out additional security vessels.
(manager / captain response to sabotage, hacking or suspicious activity)Launch emergency fighters.
Make sure service crew know to fix the damage.
(call to security forces - minor)Look out for any suspicious activity.
(call to security forces - major)Tell us of any suspicious activity immediately.
(call to security forces - search)Scan for suspicious activity.
Look only for our target resource.
(NPC moves onto player's ship)I'm aboard your ship and ready to go.
(NPC moves off player ship)That was a pleasant journey. I thank you.
(No room on player's ship)You don't have enough room on your ship right now.
(NPC wants to leave ship)Drop me off at the nearest station.
(Player receives licence)Congratulations on your new licence.
(greeting - black marketeer - on introduction)(@voice confident but not drawing attention)If you're looking to find some black market merchandise, I'm the one to talk to.
(Friendly greeting)It's good to see you, friend.
(Allied greeting)It's an honour to see you here.
(Start of greeting)On behalf of our organisation: (keep space)
We need to damage the target further.
(to marine)Alright, get out of there. Abort.
(on failure, somber)May the waters take you.
(boarding pod launched)Pod launched. Moving to target.
(begin breach)We're making our way through the hull.
(marine lost during breach)Man down! Watch out for countermeasures on the hull!
One of the teams is pinned down.
(lots of fighting noise)We're taking heavy losses.
(lots of fighting noise)We're pushing through. Lots of resistance.
We've secured several sections. Moving on.
We have lost the commander! We are being overrun!
I have a team working on bypassing a lockdown.
The crew seems to be abandoning ship.
The self-destruct has been activated. We're working on disabling it.
I don't think we can make it to the bridge. Requesting abort.
I'm calling it. Abort! Get back to your pods!
(self-destruct imminent, somber)Sorry, Sir. This isn't looking good.
(target damaged)Don't destroy the target while we're in here!
(emergency event mission offer)I could really use some help right now.
(data leak signal - illegal opportunity)I'm taking a big risk by broadcasting, so if you decode this transmission, keep it to yourself. I have work that needs doing.
(data leak signal - plea for help - intense)Can anyone hear me?! Hello?! I'm not supposed to be broadcasting but I need help! Please! I need help!
(data leak signal - plea for help - intense)Can anyone hear me?! I need help! Please, if you can hear this, I need help!
(data leak signal - plea for help)Hey! I know this is unconventional, but if you can hear this, I could use some help.
(station masstraffic mini-mission)Don't let them get away!
(station masstraffic mini-mission)Illegal cargo on drone detected.
(station masstraffic mini-mission)Illegal wares on drone detected.
(station masstraffic mini-mission)Illegal data on drone detected.
(player looks at offer - generic)Are you interested in a job?
(player looks at offer - easy difficulty)You shouldn't have any trouble with this.
(player looks at offer - hard difficulty)You'll need your wits about you for this.
(player looks at data leak mission offer - illegal opportunity)You decrypted my signal. Good.
(player looks at illegal mission offer)This could be lucrative for both of us.
(player looks at data leak mission offer - plea for help)I'm glad you found my signal.
(player looks at emergency mission offer or plea for help)I hope you can help!
(player looks at mission offer again - generic)So you're still interested?
(player looks at mission offer again - illegal opportunity)I knew you wouldn't resist.
(player looks at mission offer again - emergency or plea for help)You came back? Does that mean you'll help?
(variant)(encounter offer - illegal activity 01 - upcoming raid - call)We have a small operation planned. It would be nice if you could join us.
(variant)(encounter offer - illegal activity 01 - upcoming raid - response)Oh yes, I would very much like to come along.
(variant)(encounter offer - illegal activity 02 - black marketeer - call)I really must sell this. Do you think you could possibly buy it from me?
(variant)(encounter offer - illegal activity 02 - black marketeer - response)Yes, I can buy that. Let us make the necessary arrangements at my usual place on the station.
(variant)(encounter offer - illegal activity 03 - lockbox - call)It is all in a lockbox, not too far from here. These coordinates should help you to find it.
(variant)(encounter offer - illegal activity 03 - lockbox - response)I will go and collect it as soon as I possibly can.
(player declines mission offer)Come and find me if you change your mind.
(player declines mission offer - illegal opportunity)Ah... you'll be back. I'm sure.
(player declines mission offer - plea for help)What?! No! Please!
(player accepts mission offer)I knew I could count on you.
(reluctant for player to take mission - particularly hard missions, etc)Alright. If you think you can handle it.
(player accepts illegal opportunity)Smart move. Don't mess this up.
(player accepts plea for help or emergency mission offer)Thank you! Good luck!
(mission update)There's been a change of plans with the job.
(partial success)If that's the best you could do... sure.
(failed mission)I hope you don't think you're being paid for that.
(success in mission chain)We're one step closer to completion.
(failure in mission chain)That didn't go well, but we might still be able to salvage this.
(mission aborted by NPC / script failure)Sorry. Looks like your services are no longer required.

Covering fire for the firebrand, everyone!(a bit eye-rolling, but still dutiful; this character is a Boron who has never met the player, but still prefers a friendly, chummy tone instead of the traditional, flowery Boron politeness; whenever it is not explicitly stated who this character is talking to in the 302538XX lines, she is talking to the player, who could be male or female and who is roughly equal to the speaker in the military hierarchy)
Construction site is cleared of hostiles, Commander.(dutiful, talking to a male friend)

Still think that these suits are not "perambulatory" enough?(friendly teasing, chuckles a bit in the beginning, imagine that she just did a little dance with somebody despite both of them being in hulking space suits, speaking to a male friend)

Really? Then why do you not go and fetch one?(friendly teasing; the "one" she asks her male friend to fetch is a Lar, a special gender of Boron whose presence is known to ease tensions between other Boron)

Comrade. It appears that we have a visitor! Just as you were calming my emotional state.(still smiling and tongue-in-cheek, speaking to a male friend, the "visitor" is the player who could be male or female)
Have you tried issuing a formal invitation, with the official seal of Her Majesty?(friendly teasing, "Her Majesty" refers to the queen of the speaker, speaking to a male friend)
*** Quizzical Grunt ***(like a grunted version of "hmm?", intrigued, friendly, response to player starting a conversation with her for the first time)
(1/2)Huh, a... Split?(a little bit incredulous, response to player starting a conversation with her for the first time, alternative greeting for when the player is a Split)

(2/2)Well, if Leda We let you on board, who am I to complain?(shrugs, "Leda We" is a male friend, response to player starting a conversation with her for the first time, alternative greeting for when the player is a Split)
(1/3)Would you look at that! Fresh meat for the fleet!(sizing up the player)
(2/3)As luck would have it, one of my pilots has requested a discharge to rejoin his relatives in Atreus' Clouds.("Atreus' Clouds" is a sector in space, same as {20005,2001})
(3/3)If you are willing to take his place, there is a well-equipped, and only slightly battered, gunboat waiting for you in the carrier's internal storage.
(1/4)Oh my! I am of course fully and entirely capable of employing the verbose and ostentatious mannerisms of my people!(tongue-in-cheek, deliberately flowery phrasing)
(2/4)Unless I want to tease the adorable stickler over there.("stickler" refers to a male friend who is in the same room)
(4/4)Really, no time for flowery antics during a battle, so best get used to it.(well-meaning, winking, not harsh)
(2/4)The Queendom of Boron and the Argon Federation worked closely together in preparation for the Dark.("the Dark" is an era in history)
(3/4)Turrets, military doctrine, efficient subdivision of aerated interiors, uncomfortable chairs...(starts sincerely, but the part about chairs is tongue-in-cheek)
(4/4)If you pay attention, you can see their influence everywhere!(carry that tongue-in-cheek attitude from the previous line)
(1/3)Gunboats are built to provide fire support. So that is exactly what we do.(matter-of-factly)
(2/3)Corvettes and heavy fighters may bring the battle to a close, but our turrets dictate its flow.(matter-of-factly)
(3/3)How does that sound? Want to join?(earnestly offering, warm)
Sure, go and review your options first.(encouraging, doesn't feel disrespected; response to player pausing the conversation)
I am elated and ecstatic to welcome your return, pilot.(tongue-in-cheek, deliberately verbose, player starts the conversation again after pausing it earlier)
(1/2)All ships ready for action, Commander.(speaks to male friend)
(2/2)Well, almost.(starts speaking to player again, who could be male or female)
(1/2)Pilot, we still need someone to hug the carrier, in case the Kha'ak try something.("hug" in the sense of staying really close to something)
(2/2)Park your ship close to the turret that I have marked on your heads-up display.
(1/3)Notice how the carrier seems to drag you along when you are close enough?
(3/3)It allows you to rotate your ship freely, so that your turrets can face approaching enemies.
The Boron will be truly united again.(response the a male friend daydreaming about a bright future)
Cannot wait to retire to some nice cosy place deep under the sea after these escapades.(focused on fighting, talking to herself)
Twist my flippers! I wonder if I would be this reckless if I had a jump drive like them!(surprised by her opponents' sudden movements, busy dodging shots, "them" are a group of enemy Kha'ak)

(1/3)Looks like you can handle the heat, Lilac Fin.(tongue-in-cheek, suggesting that the fight is so easy that her allies can handle it alone, "Lilac Fin" is a flight of ships, talking to a group of friends)
(2/3)Leda We has just ordered us to move on ahead to a scouting position.(careful: "Leda We" is the name of a male friend, this line does not read "Leda, we..." ; talking to a group of friends)
(3/3)See you in the void!(meaning see you soon, talking to a group of friends)
(1/2)It is good that you are all here.(serious, about to spill the bad news, talking to group of friends)
(2/2)Watch this.(talking to group of friends, pointing out amassing enemies further down the road)
(1/3)Look, they are warping in and out!(focused on the footage, intrigued by the enemies' movement, talking to a group of friends)
(2/3)Are they planning a mass attack on the highway?(focused, hint of worry, talking to a group of friends)
(3/3)And yet, this feels as though we are intruding on something very private.(focused, furrowed brow, considering implications of what she's seeing in the footage, talking to a group of friends)
We have stirred them up!(excited, worried, "they" are a group of enemy Kha'ak, talking to a group of friends)
That was no retreat, was it?(worried, focused on the fight, talking to a male friend)
Leda We, what is happening?(focued on the fight, worried, talking to a male friend)
They are attacking the supply transport!(spotting enemies ahead, talking to a group of friends)
I dearly hope it lasts this time.(a bit worried, responding to her commander proclaiming that the enemy has retreated, talking to a group of friends)
(1/2)Woo-hoo! Victory!(very excited, talking to a male friend)
(2/2)Praise Queen Menelaus!(talking to a male friend)
What?(confused, talking to a male friend)
Oh.(dumbfounded, as in "you're right, I'm sorry", talking to a male friend)
Awkward...(whispering to male friend, the person who's "awkward" is the player who is not approaching to talk to the speaker and who could be male or female)
Hello there!(cheerful, response to player starting the conversation with her)
(1/4)After that awesome and scary battle, you mean?(response to player asking her how she's feeling)
(3/4)We both made it out in one piece, and that is what really counts.(cheerful again)
(4/4)You kept it together well out there, by the way.(conspiratorially, imagine her giving the player a cuff on the shoulder)
(1/8)Well, I am going to retire to some nice cosy... (response to player asking her what she will do now, stops herself when she realises that she has told this story before)
(3/8)Anyway, all this fighting is getting a bit old.
(4/8)Or maybe it is I who is getting old.(tongue-in-cheek, she is actually quite old)
(5/8)I am thinking... Jamshala or Ayeshma.(scratching her chin, pretends to honestly consider, "Jamshala" and "Ayeshma" are planets)
(6/8)Jamshala's main perk is that I still have a lot of extended family living down there, from before the Dark.(pretends to honestly consider, "the Dark" is an era in history)
(7/8)So Ayeshma it is!(pretending to cleverly come to the conclusion of her internal debate, eureka!)

(8/8)I would ask you to come and visit, but you seem so very busy travelling the Gate network, right?(tongue-in-cheek, there's a mutual understanding between her and the player that she wants to be left alone, emphasise "so very busy")
Sure, sure.(encouraging, not dismissive, response to the player pausing the conversation)
Back again?(cheerful, response to the player resuming the conversation)
(2/4)One of my flight members was so impressed by your performance that he asked to join you.(earnest, honestly impressed)

(3/4)Or perhaps he simply wants to grab the opportunity by the trunk and go exploring somewhere other than the Provinces. Pardon me; the Queendom.(smirking, cuts off after "Provinces" and corrects her mistake, the full title would have been {20203,3401}; "trunk" like the nose of an elephant)

(4/4)In any case, Leda We has already signed off on the transfer, so turn around and assign your new pilot.("Leda We" is a male friend, "turn around" in the sense that the new pilot is literally standing behind the player)
Kind of busy right now, sorry!(apologetically)
Should you not be on your way?(smirking)

page.title: Boron NPC 5 / Boron Herald 1
page.descr: Lines for Boron NPC 5 and Boron Herald 1
page.t: (Metadata, do not translate)[boron] male female basic
(Goodbye - staff)Glad to have been of assistance.
(Greeting - rejected - big ship)We have nothing to say to you.
(* Honorifics - addressing crew in calm situations *)
The request came from a police vessel.
(suggestion for dealing with bad situation)Get us out of here!
(variant)(refusal to do something)If you think I will comply, then you are mistaken.
(chosen reward)Please take one of these as thanks.
Sorry, I am busy right now.
(variant)(refusal to surrender - finds it funny)Haha, hahaha. Oh, you were serious. Then no.
(variant)(refusal to surrender - in danger)I will not yield to you.
(informing player)I was asked to drop my cargo.
(informing player)I was forced to drop my cargo.
We need to perform a transfer.
(first warning - generic)We cannot tolerate your actions.
(first warning to an attacking ship)Stop your attack immediately.
(warning of consequences - generic)You will now suffer the consequences.
(warning of consequences - opening fire)You are now being targeted.
(warning of consequences - sending ships)Ships are now being dispatched.
(warning of consequences - reporting)You will now be reported to local security forces.
(report of attack - ships)Reporting an attack against this vessel.
(report of attack - stations)Reporting an attack against this station.
(law enforcement confirms report, after something like Affirmative)Criminal record has been updated.
(report of attack generic)Reporting a criminal offence.
(variant)(ship complies to police instructions)A most sensible choice. Well done.
(ship does not comply)You have refused to comply.
(reporting)This is sector security reporting criminal activity.
(variant)(aboard a smuggling multi-crew ship)There are security patrols, so be careful.
(variant)(aboard a smuggling multi-crew ship that is caught)Oh bother! They have spotted us.
(variant)(response to above - rushed suggestion)Dispose of the cargo as quickly as you can.
(variant)(criminal cursing)What is that word they use? Ah yes, Shimatta!
(variant)(ship complies to pirate instructions)How very cooperative.
(report on enemy activity)Too risky to engage.
(capital or M-sized ship / station hit without taking serious damage)We were hit.
(capital or M-sized ship / station hit without taking serious damage)Something hit us.
(capital or m-sized ship / station hit without taking serious damage)We're taking hits.
(variant)(multi-crew ship attacking - serious threat threshold on attacked ship reached)They cannot hold out much longer, poor souls.
(variant)(multi-crew ship attacking - serious threat threshold on attacked ship reached)Their defences are crumbling. The end is near for them.
(multi-crew ship attacking - captain response)Continue to attack the target.
(multi-crew ship attacking - captain response)Keep up the pressure on the target.
(variant)(multi-crew ship attacking - life threat threshold on attacked ship reached - captain response)We must steel ourselves and ignore them.
(variant)(multi-crew ship attacking - life threat threshold on attacked ship reached - captain response)With sad hearts, we must ignore their pleas.
(variant)(retaliation)There will be consequences for your actions.
(variant)(small ship hit, in danger, panic)I am in peril!
(variant)(small ship hit, in danger, panic)I am a Boron. Get me out of here!
(variant)(small ship hit, in danger, panic)Things are looking bad.
(variant)(small ship hit, in danger, panic)Oh no. No, no, no!
(variant)(taunt line - response-capable)I scored top marks in my combat training, I will have you know.
(variant)(taunt line - response-capable)I am more than a match for you.
(variant)(taunt line - generic)I am a more skilful pilot than you might expect.
(variant)(taunt line - generic)You were expecting to beat me easily, but you were mistaken.
(variant)(generic - life threat threshold reached)Please stop now, I beg you!
(variant)(generic - life threat threshold reached)I do not want to die!
(variant)(multi-crew ship / station hit - life threat threshold reached)On behalf of my entire crew, I ask you to have mercy on us.
(variant)(multi-crew ship / station hit - life threat threshold reached)Our ship is leaking badly. Please stop, and let us live.
(variant)(single-crew ship hit - life threat threshold reached)Please, please stop!
(variant)(single-crew ship hit - life threat threshold reached)I would really appreciate it if you could stop shooting.
(fleeing from combat)This is too much! I must flee!
(pilot bailing from ship)Spare my life! I am leaving my ship!
(relief line)It is wonderful to have survived.
(congratulations after combat from captain)Well done, everyone!
(new attack orders for multi-crew ship coming in)We have new attack orders.
(new attack orders for multi-crew ship coming in during target)New attack orders!
(preparing new attack orders)Prepare to open fire on the target.
(preparing new attack orders during combat)Attack this target!
(reaction to friendly fire)Hey, will you stop firing?
(reaction to friendly fire)You're wrecking my shields!
(reaction to friendly fire)Why are you shooting me?
(enemy ship or station exploding)It's going to blow!
(variant)(single-crew ship hit without taking serious damage - response-capable)That is not sufficient to put me in any danger.
(variant)(single-crew ship hit without taking serious damage - response-capable)Your best efforts are clearly not enough.
(variant)(single-crew ship hit without taking serious damage - generic)Superficial damage only.
(variant)(enemy destroyed - taunt)There is little joy in destroying an enemy, but maybe some satisfaction.
(variant)(enemy destroyed - report)The target has ceased to be a threat.
(variant)(small ship hit, not in danger - response-capable)You will most definitely regret that!
(variant)(small ship hit, not in danger - response-capable)That was a bad move on your part.
(variant)(response to small ship hit, generic - small ship)I can keep doing that all day.
(variant)(response to small ship hit, generic - big ship)You did not think this through properly, did you?
(variant)(response to small ship hit, panic - small ship)Any pain you feel will hopefully be mercifully brief.
(variant)(response to small ship hit, panic - small ship)Make the most of your final moments.
(variant)(response to taunt - small ship)Your jibes have no effect on me.
(variant)(response to taunt - small ship)I will not be intimidated by you.
(variant)(response to taunt - small ship)Your belligerent words slide off me like water.
(variant)(response to taunt - small ship)I am deeply unimpressed.
(variant)(response to life threat threshold - small ship)Sorry, no.
(variant)(apology for friendly fire)Oh dear me, what a terrible error. I am very sorry.
(variant)(taunt - silent enemy)Time to remove you from my Gravidar.
(variant)(single-crew ship hit without taking serious damage - xenon)Artificial intelligence and sophisticated weaponry should not be allowed to mix.
(variant)(single-crew ship hit without taking serious damage - silent enemy)Get off me!
(variant)(threat)You will regret engaging in combat with me.
(variant)(threat)We Boron may be peaceful by nature, but that does not mean we are weak.
(variant)(threat)If you insist on a fight, then I will surely give you one.
(variant)(torpedo use)A torpedo would probably work best here.
(variant)(losing an enemy)I just... need... to lose them.
(variant)(losing an enemy)I should really get away from them now.
(variant)(small ship hit, not in danger - generic)All systems still appear to be operational.
(variant)(small ship hit, not in danger - generic)I think that sounded worse than it actually was.
(variant)(response to small ship hit, generic - small ship)I have no intention of stopping there.
(variant)(response to small ship hit, generic - big ship)Your destruction is, sadly, quite assured.
(variant)(NPC attempts bribe)Is there, perhaps, some sort of, ah, deal we could come to?
(variant)(NPC hired)I will accept your offer of employment, and will work to the best of my ability on your behalf.
(variant)(NPC fired)Such a shame. I was quite enjoying that job.
Last order could not be completed.
(order added to queue - informal)It's been added to the list.
The order might take longer than expected.
Pass on new coordinates to following ships.
Inform me when all ships have arrived.
All ships have arrived at destination.
(command)Tell group leader we've spotted enemy activity.
(relay report)They say it's safe to engage.
(relay report)They say it's too risky to engage.
One of our wingmen is asking for backup.
(escort leaves)You're on your own from here.
(grateful)Might not have made it without you.
(during combat)Get on the line! We need backup, now!
(group of small ships - winning)We're all over them!
(group of small ships - winning)We've got them now!
(group of small ships - losing)They're all over us!
(group of small ships - losing)We can't stand this.
(response to distress call - singular)Hang on! I'm on my way!
(response to distress call - plural)We've received your call. We're on the way.
Please follow directions to designated docking position.
They've marked our docking position for us.
Get the crew to ready a docking bay.
It's an honour to have you aboard.
We're pleased to welcome you aboard.
(Informing player ship will soon undock)The ship will be undocking soon.
(Informing player ship will not undock before they return)I'll wait for you to tell me to take off.
(Informing player they will have to manually tell the pilot to take off)Let me know when you want to take off.
There's a ship preparing to undock.
Departing ship, you are clear to undock. Safe travels.
Bring away from the docking position. Slowly.
Use these criteria for the search.
I've found a trade offer matching our criteria.
Tell that station we are on our way.
(when a repair / upgrade order comes in)Which ship needs the work?
(variant)(fluff - moving from one part of the ship to another)Back and forth, all day long. My work is never done.
(variant)(fluff - completed upgrade / repair)A job well done, if I say so myself.
(variant)(fluff - finishing up pt. I)Almost done. I will soon be ready to assist you.
(variant)(fluff - finishing up pt. II)My work is done. Do you have something else for me?
(order for new units)Let's make an order for new units.
(order for new ammo)Let's make an order for some more ammunition.
(cap ship repair)Ask the station to start repairs.
(cap ship / station repair)Launching repair units now.
(law enforcement respons to comms - followed up by comms greeting)This is sector security.
(ship scan warning - cargo)Please halt. We will be scanning your cargo hold.
(ship scan warning - inventory)Please halt. We will be scanning your inventory.
(variant)(ship scan result - nothing found)The scan came back clear. Thank you for cooperating.
(ship scan result - something found)We've detected contraband.
(ordering to drop cargo/contraband)Release your contraband immediately.
(variant)(ship scanned by police - nothing found)Jolly good.
(variant)(ship scanned by police - something found)I can explain. At least, I think I can.
(variant)(ship scanned - illegal)Hey, what are you doing?
(report to superior)My ship is being scanned.
(variant)(ship scan warning)If we find anything suspicious, you may find yourself in trouble.
(variant)(ship scan result - nothing found)All clear! You may continue.
(variant)(ship scan result)Well well, what do we have here?
(variant)(ordered to drop cargo - releases under duress)Take it! Take it all. Just let me go.
(variant)(ordered to surrender ship - surrenders under duress)If you let me go, then I will let you take my ship.
(station / ship sabotaged - explosives)I'm noticing a small breach. It looks like someone used explosives on the hull.
(station / ship sabotaged - EMP)Electronics have gone dead somewhere. Someone used an EMP device.
(station / ship hacked)It looks like someone's hacked us.
(station security saw suspicious activity)We've picked up suspicious activity.
(station security saw suspicious activity - report inside managers office)Security vessels are reporting suspicious activity.
(manager response to sabotage, hacking or suspicious activity)Send out additional security vessels.
(manager / captain response to sabotage, hacking or suspicious activity)Launch emergency fighters.
Make sure service crew know to fix the damage.
(call to security forces - minor)Look out for any suspicious activity.
(call to security forces - major)Tell us of any suspicious activity immediately.
(call to security forces - search)Scan for suspicious activity.
Look only for our target resource.
(NPC moves onto player's ship)I'm aboard your ship and ready to go.
(NPC moves off player ship)That was a pleasant journey. I thank you.
(No room on player's ship)You don't have enough room on your ship right now.
(NPC wants to leave ship)Drop me off at the nearest station.
(Player receives licence)Congratulations on your new licence.
(greeting - black marketeer - on introduction)(@voice confident but not drawing attention)If you're looking to find some black market merchandise, I'm the one to talk to.
(Friendly greeting)It's good to see you, friend.
(Allied greeting)It's an honour to see you here.
(Start of greeting)On behalf of our organisation: (keep space)
We need to damage the target further.
(to marine)Alright, get out of there. Abort.
(on failure, somber)May the waters take you.
(boarding pod launched)Pod launched. Moving to target.
(begin breach)We're making our way through the hull.
(marine lost during breach)Man down! Watch out for countermeasures on the hull!
One of the teams is pinned down.
(lots of fighting noise)We're taking heavy losses.
(lots of fighting noise)We're pushing through. Lots of resistance.
We've secured several sections. Moving on.
We have lost the commander! We are being overrun!
I have a team working on bypassing a lockdown.
The crew seems to be abandoning ship.
The self-destruct has been activated. We're working on disabling it.
I don't think we can make it to the bridge. Requesting abort.
I'm calling it. Abort! Get back to your pods!
(self-destruct imminent, somber)Sorry, Sir. This isn't looking good.
(target damaged)Don't destroy the target while we're in here!
(emergency event mission offer)I could really use some help right now.
(data leak signal - illegal opportunity)I'm taking a big risk by broadcasting, so if you decode this transmission, keep it to yourself. I have work that needs doing.
(data leak signal - plea for help - intense)Can anyone hear me?! Hello?! I'm not supposed to be broadcasting but I need help! Please! I need help!
(data leak signal - plea for help - intense)Can anyone hear me?! I need help! Please, if you can hear this, I need help!
(data leak signal - plea for help)Hey! I know this is unconventional, but if you can hear this, I could use some help.
(station masstraffic mini-mission)Don't let them get away!
(station masstraffic mini-mission)Illegal cargo on drone detected.
(station masstraffic mini-mission)Illegal wares on drone detected.
(station masstraffic mini-mission)Illegal data on drone detected.
(player looks at offer - generic)Are you interested in a job?
(player looks at offer - easy difficulty)You shouldn't have any trouble with this.
(player looks at offer - hard difficulty)You'll need your wits about you for this.
(player looks at data leak mission offer - illegal opportunity)You decrypted my signal. Good.
(player looks at illegal mission offer)This could be lucrative for both of us.
(player looks at data leak mission offer - plea for help)I'm glad you found my signal.
(player looks at emergency mission offer or plea for help)I hope you can help!
(player looks at mission offer again - generic)So you're still interested?
(player looks at mission offer again - illegal opportunity)I knew you wouldn't resist.
(player looks at mission offer again - emergency or plea for help)You came back? Does that mean you'll help?
(variant)(encounter offer - illegal activity 01 - upcoming raid - call)Would you like to take part in a little... event that we have planned?
(variant)(encounter offer - illegal activity 01 - upcoming raid - response)Very much so.
(variant)(encounter offer - illegal activity 02 - black marketeer - call)Do you think you might be able to buy this stuff? I could really do with disposing of it.
(variant)(encounter offer - illegal activity 02 - black marketeer - response)That should not be a problem. Meet me at my usual place on this station.
(variant)(encounter offer - illegal activity 03 - lockbox - call)Here are some coordinates to a lockbox. You will find the items inside.
(variant)(encounter offer - illegal activity 03 - lockbox - response)Since there is no hurry, I will fetch them at my leisure.
(player declines mission offer)Come and find me if you change your mind.
(player declines mission offer - illegal opportunity)Ah... you'll be back. I'm sure.
(player declines mission offer - plea for help)What?! No! Please!
(player accepts mission offer)I knew I could count on you.
(reluctant for player to take mission - particularly hard missions, etc)Alright. If you think you can handle it.
(player accepts illegal opportunity)Smart move. Don't mess this up.
(player accepts plea for help or emergency mission offer)Thank you! Good luck!
(mission update)There's been a change of plans with the job.
(partial success)If that's the best you could do... sure.
(failed mission)I hope you don't think you're being paid for that.
(success in mission chain)We're one step closer to completion.
(failure in mission chain)That didn't go well, but we might still be able to salvage this.
(mission aborted by NPC / script failure)Sorry. Looks like your services are no longer required.
(1/2)What are you waiting for? Consult your mission manager to find out.
(2/2)I am truly curious about your destination.
(2/6)Surely they have a convenient supply of BoFu secured?
(3/6)I am afraid you may have drawn the short straw.
(5/6)I am responsible for establishing a defence treaty with the Argon Federation.
(6/6)I wish you the best of luck! Farewell, dear friend!
(1/4)The time has come to carve out our own path!
(2/4)For my journal, I will first visit the Alliance of the Word to learn about its place within the Commonwealth.
(3/4)I want to learn about everyone who is out there, beyond our gate network; those who are still adrift but in contact through messenger drones, and maybe those lost without trace.
(1/2)I will continue my journeys to visit all the different communities, make countless new friends and learn about their customs.
(2/2)I intend to write a journal about my travels, to inform our kin about the wonders of the world beyond the Queendom, and delight their curiosity.
That is very kind of you!
Let us not keep Her Majesty waiting.
Meeting our beloved Queen felt quite historic!
Her Majesty is strikingly charismatic in person!
Did you ever believe you would meet a monarch?
What was your impression of the Alliance representative?
That is the last of them.
The shipyard is hailing us. Putting it through.
A capital ship is finishing construction and preparing to launch.
That is the last of the drones. The corvettes are standing down.

page.title: Mission Boron NPC 1 / Nila
page.descr: Lines for Mission Boron NPC 1
page.t: Sorry, I am busy right now.
(reaction to friendly fire)Hey, will you stop firing?
(reaction to friendly fire)You're wrecking my shields!
(reaction to friendly fire)Why are you shooting me?
(1/3)Oh my! Aliens!(emphasis on Aliens, but joyful and not afraid)
Greetings! I am so pleased to make your acquaintance!(very friendly)
(1/3)I do not have any official capacity as such, but it is marvellous to be seeing actual people from beyond the disconnected gate.
(2/3)How did you get here? Has a gate reopened? Are we connected once more?(curious)
(3/3)Oh, I knew it would have to happen eventually! What joyous news!(happy)
(1/4)You are in contact with Kingdom End?!(excited, hopeful)
(3/4)It has been decades since we were cut off. We have heard nothing in all that time.
(4/4)The severing of the connection with Nishala has been indescribably distressing for all of us.(saddened)
More than you know, Boso Ta. We have all mourned this loss.
(1/3)After the severance there was a period of chaos, until a Royal Steward was appointed.
(2/3)I have had dealings with him. It would be my pleasure to make an introduction.(friendly)
(3/3)Follow me, you cavalcade of curious creatures!(enthusiastic)
I am Nila Ti, adventurer extraordinaire! I would be delighted to spend time with you.
(2/10)From your own experience, you understand the pain of separation.(compassionate)
(3/10)I doubt other species appreciate the biological depth of our harmonious societal interconnection.
(4/10)It was worse than its is now. It used to be that all our systems were isolated.(mournful)
(5/10)Severed, not just from Kingdom End, the Queen and homeworld Nishala, but also from each other.
(6/10)Fortunately, several of our systems reconnected to each other eventually. But none received word from home. Reorganisation became a necessity.

(7/10)The Provinces Adrift - as we call ourselves - were only ever intended to be temporary. But under the Royal Steward it has grown into a comprehensive governing body.(Provinces Adrift same as {20203,3401})
(8/10)But some of us have never given up on Kingdom End.(defiant)
(9/10)Your communication with the homeworld is momentous in the extreme.
(10/10)Not a soul in these systems has found evidence of whether Kingdom End even still exists.
(1/4)I must warn you. The Provinces Adrift are not awash with the luxuries of the old Kingdom.(sombre tone)
(2/4)The pain of severance has been constant. But our economy has also suffered.
(3/4)The shortages of essential goods have cut deeply.
(4/4)Reconnection with the network may alleviate some of... these issues, at least...(emphasis on 'these issues', to indicate that there are other, more complex issues as well)
(1/3)More than that, Royal Steward! I bring momentous news!(excited)

(2/3)The fleet. This Paranid-led fleet... it came from the dormant gate in Watchful Gaze! They have communicated with Kingdom End!(jumbling words due to excitement; "Paranid-led" as in led by a Paranid, not led by Paranid forces)
(3/3)They have no Kingdom End gate. But they have communication! We are connected to the network once more!
The delegation seeks an audience. May I...(interrupted)
Royal Steward. Would it be in order for me to accompany the delegation?

Please. Royal Steward. With your permission.(interrupts the previous speaker. We're not pitching for girly. Nila is being deferential to mollify Leda We because he's insecure, and she figures her deference will get her what she wants.)
By the glistening waters of Nishala!(surprised, indignant)
(1/2)Leda We! They are trying to connect us with Kingdom End!(frustrated)
Please...!(worried, not knowing what to say)
(1/2)*** Sigh of frustration and discontent ***(a long sigh)
(2/2)The Steward and I have had our differences in the past. But I had no idea he would be so stubborn.
(2/4)I am so very sorry that you had to witness that embarrassingly discordant display.(apologetic)
(3/4)Leda We and I disagree on much, but he is not a bad person, you know?
(1/2)I think... he is scared of falling short.(Pause before line start and after "I think")
(2/2)He carries the weight of the expectations of the entire Provinces. He wants to keep everyone safe, and I think he fears that your expedition will exacerbate an already dangerous situation.
(2/8)The Provinces lie uncomfortably close to Kha'ak territory.
(3/8)When Sanctuary of Darkness first connected to the Provinces, it triggered regular attacks.
(4/8)We barely managed to protect ourselves with the meagre military that we could cobble together.
(5/8)Thankfully the waves have calmed for now. The Kha'ak incursions eventually ceased.
(6/8)All attempts to communicate with these enigmatic creatures have failed.
(7/8)So I would hesitate to call it a ceasefire. It is more of a lull in hostilities.
(8/8)As you can imagine, the situation remains rather fragile.
(1/10)Oh, you took note of that, did you?(surprised)
(2/10)Time after time I approached Leda We for the resources to find our way back home.
(3/10)But he has come to the conclusion that efforts spent on this endeavour come at an immediate cost to our people.(frustrated)
(4/10)I would hate for you to get the impression that I do not care for my fellow Boron here.
(5/10)Out on the fringes, I am truly seeking to make a difference for the people.
(6/10)Serving the Queen's subjects is a duty for me.
(7/10)You see... I do not like to draw too much attention to it, but I am myself the progeny of stranded minor royals.
(8/10)Before you bow or anything like that, I am not part of the direct line of succession!(humorous interjection)
(9/10)And that is not how our monarchy works, in any case.(dismissive)
(10/10)Yet it drives me to find a path back home, for the people to once again delight in a reunited, merry realm.
Such luck that I stumbled upon your expedition when I did!
(1/2)I am already familiar with the gate in Ocean of Fantasy.(Ocean of Fantasy same as {20005,2016})
(2/2)If you supply me with the necessary equipment, and provide me with a few pointers as to what exactly I am to do, it would be my deepest pleasure to assist.
(2/3)Then we are quite lucky that our systems were not connected directly to a Xenon stronghold.
(3/3)There is no way we would have survived, given the state of our military.
(1/3)But be careful! Take great care when navigating!(Concerned; Addressing the player)
(2/3)We must honour our word and avoid the Kha'ak. You will also need to be cautious of the region's other hazards.
(3/3)I recommend that you stick close to the asteroids. They seem to be an exceptional indicator of where your ship will not be harmed.
I have arrived at my designated inactive gate. I shall commence taking readings immediately.
(1/2)Yes, your display of skill was altogether impressive.
(2/2)I just hope this commotion does not result in a more severe and unwelcome reaction!(worried)
How very impressive! Commendable! You went to extraordinary lengths to avoid violence, regardless of the imminent danger.(excited and impressed)
(2/3)But I am afraid that things are not going well in Ocean of Fantasy either.
(3/3)The system's planet is devastated and completely uninhabitable.(saddened)
We shall reconvene once we have seen to our tasks! Good luck!
(1/3)Boso Ta has informed me of your exciting plans!(eager)
(2/3)You must let me accompany you. In fact... I will not take no for an answer.(insistent)
(3/3)The Alliance is in the midst of their preparations. I have to say, the deluge of scientific jargon leaves me cold. I much prefer action.
(2/2)May I ask you a personal question?(careful)
(1/2)What makes you choose to remain out there, all alone in that tiny tank of yours?
(2/2)Are you not tempted to reunite with your kind, now that we are reconnected?
(1/2)So what is behind your enduring fascination with Great Reef?(Great Reef same as {20005,2006})
(2/2)If you will forgive my candour, you seem to be rather fixated on this particular system.
But wait... that would mean you are at least...(pausing, calculating in her head)
Absolutely incredible! I never imagined I would ever meet someone so aged and venerable!(in absolute awe)
(2/6)Our life span is short, at least in comparison to the other known, sentient species.
(3/6)When you think about it, very few Boron of the Provinces Adrift will recall Kingdom End, or the benevolent leadership of our monarch.
(4/6)Yet ask any one of them... and finding a way back home will be their preeminent priority.
(5/6)How is it that we are driven to pursue such things, even on the thinnest of leads?(wondering)
(6/6)Is this inherent Boron naiveté? Or an innate scientific drive?
(3/4)Can you not simply account for the interference, and adjust your readings accordingly?
(4/4)Or reposition the ship a little for cleaner measurements?
(1/3)You will need Spacesuit Bombs to detonate the asteroid.(Spacesuit Bombs same as {20201, 12201})
(2/3)Allow me to drop some for you to use at your discretion!
(3/3)Oh, a word of warning: do not let the authorities find you with this contraband!(casual, as if she almost forgot)
(1/2)EMP Bombs will not destroy the asteroid.
(2/2)Change your equipped bombs to Spacesuit Bombs!
Wait... a message written in the stars? For... you?(doubtful)
Explorer, do not for a nanosecond think that I am not coming with you.(driven)
I wonder what exactly is exercising Boso Ta's ballast glands quite so thoroughly.
Well, the Expedition Leader did suggest that he would keep us up to date over the coming years.
Stay alert! Let us not be defeated by hubris!(tense, reassuring)
But does it lead to Kingdom End?
(1/6)What a marvellous turn of events indeed!(happy)
(2/6)And it is reassuring to see the seat of Boron civilisation faring so well.
(3/6)They have weathered isolation far better than the Provinces, that is for certain!
(4/6)A strong economy. Political stability. No signs of strife or unrest.
(5/6)They seem to be at peace!(in veneration)
(6/6)Now we can finally bring the Provinces Adrift back into the fold, and my people can finally share in that sweet tranquillity.
(1/2)It is such an honour to be here, your Grace.
(2/2)Just to be here; to see the home planet is all the reward I will ever need.
(2/7)The situation in the former Provinces is improving with veritable alacrity!
(3/7)The Boron government immediately implemented an aid package designed to restore our economic buoyancy.
(4/7)And I helped put it together!(very pleased)
(5/7)Now that the worst has passed, I shall take some time off to explore.
(6/7)You cannot imagine how much it means to the Boron to be reunited again.
Finally reunited with the Queendom! Oh, how very exciting!
(2/11)The Boron aid to the Provinces once-adrift has been a phenomenal success!
(3/11)There is still much more to do, but I have been convinced that this matter is in competent fins!

(4/11)There is a growing movement of historians, scientists and politicians who are exploring the possibility of replicating the Jump Gate experiments to find other systems that are still disconnected and adrift.
(5/11)All this is such a relief. Yet with the struggle over, I cannot help feeling somewhat useless.
(6/11)I have also reconnected with some family on Nishala.
(7/11)They are urging me to visit them and I may spend some time on the planet.
(8/11)I am uncertain how long I can be planet-bound before the urge to return to space overtakes me. It may take some time.
(9/11)So for now at least, this is goodbye.

page.title: Mission Boron NPC 2 / Boron Leader Outer Bubble
page.descr: Lines for Mission Boron NPC 2
page.t: (1/2)Nila Ti! You bring us guests! Outsiders! With a fleet, no less!(excited)
My word! The... if...(genuine confusion as to the implications of this)
Yes, yes, of course! There is so much to discuss. So much to consider!...(Interrupting the previous speaker, excited)
I am sure you have other things to do. Diplomacy is not the same thrill as exploration.
... of course, Nila Ti. By all means accompany the delegation.(agreeing, but clearly not happy about it)
(1/4)My rhopalium near explodes with the joy of welcoming esteemed visitors. This historic occasion is the first of its kind!(excited, rhopalium is an anatomical term)
(2/4)I am Leda We, Royal Steward of the Provinces Adrift.(official; Provinces Adrift same as {20203,3401})
(3/4)On behalf of Her Majesty the Queen, and as her loyal servant, it is my profound pleasure to welcome an Emissary of the Paranid Empire.
(4/4)And once business is out of the way, I insist you join me on a more informal tour!
(1/2)My, my! But do you have letters patent from the Empire?(Empire in reference to the Paranid Empire, not really listening to what the previous character just tried to convey)
(2/2)The Provinces Adrift are in dire straits. We must negotiate terms of assistance.
(1/3)There are so many implications to consider...(half talking to himself)
(2/3)This really is momentous...(half talking to himself)
(3/3)I am afraid I must decline your request... for now. We cannot be precipitous.(To the delegation. Settled on a course of action)
(1/5)Nila Ti. This obsession with finding home is entirely yours.(trying to be calm)
(2/5)You may have the luxury of gallivanting around the galaxy in search of miracles, but I...(accusatory)
(3/5)I have responsibilities. I have the welfare of billions of souls to consider.
(4/5)Our guests have already made clear that the outside network - with all its resources - has been unable to connect with our homeworld.(frustrated)
(5/5)The priority at this juncture is the welfare of our people. And I shall not be distracted from that.
(1/2)Enough, please. I understand your request, but I do not think you understand what is at stake.(trying to be amicable but forceful)
(2/2)Please have patience. But for now, the matter is settled.
There is nothing to be gained from trading insults.
Ah. The silent one from our disappointing introduction.(recognising the player, calmed down)
(1/2)Your expedition commander hardly seemed in the mood for positive solutions.
(2/2)I cannot imagine that you presume to speak for him.
(1/5)I am fully aware of Nila Ti's royal connections.(slightly hostile)
(2/5)Is it your opinion of me that I am some petty functionary who can be bought and sold? Bribed? By the highest bidder?!(offended)
(3/5)You misjudge me, and you misjudge Nila Ti. For all our disagreements, I cannot conceive that she would be party to such a grubby approach.(calmer, but still colder)
(4/5)Of course I desire the return of the Provinces Adrift to the warm embrace of the homeworld.(emphasis on "Of course")
(5/5)But what kind of servant would I be if I did so at the expense of the welfare of those under my charge?
(1/2)Well well, this is an unexpectedly kind offer from the Alliance of the Word. (friendly, considering the offer)
(2/2)I must admit that security assistance in these uncertain times would indeed be a welcome reassurance.
(4/7)I understood that you entered our provinces in pursuit of scientific enlightenment, not bloodshed!(outraged)
(5a/7)You casually countenance atrocities as though they were insignificant.(if player Terran Cadet)
(6a/7)Were you brainwashed by the militants of Sol?(if player Terran Cadet)
(5b/7)Do these fins look like Terran appendages to you?(if player not Terran)
(6b/7)Not all of the inhabitants of this galaxy are driven by unmoderated barbarity.(if player not Terran)
(7/7)No thank you. If we can maintain peace, we shall do so. (calm, dismissive of the player)
(1/2)Your commendable commitment to peace is as welcome as it is unexpected.(pleasantly surprised)
(2/2)The Alliance of the Word is to be lauded for its respect for our peaceful ways.
(1/6)I... regret my approach at our meeting. You see... I have not hosted a diplomatic function in decades.(deliberate, after a pause)
(2/6)Unfortunately, I am simply not in the habit of communicating with anyone other than Boron. You see?
(3/6)We Boron converse amongst ourselves, relying on complex structures of pheromones; not just mere words.
(4/6)There was so much to communicate. So much to cogitate upon...
(5/6)Yet the words failed to convey my meaning.
(6/6)You must imagine it like painting an ocean, yet having only a single shade of blue with which to do so.(forlorn)
(1/9)You are correct, of course. There is no harm in reaching for common ground.(measured response)
(2/9)I am embarrassed to say that our defensive capabilities are woefully inadequate. Ashamedly so.
(3/9)Our economy is so fractured, we struggle to construct anything larger, perhaps, than a frigate.(melancholy; if no shipyard)
(4/9)We cannot even resource and operate a full-scale shipyard.(if no shipyard)
(5/9)For half a century of isolation we Boron have had little need for a comprehensive military. I fear that we are wholly unprepared for the myriad dangers lurking beyond the gate.
(6/9)And should word spread of the valuable equipment and facilities proposed by the Alliance of the Word...
(7/9)It might be akin to painting a target upon ourselves for any nefarious actors in the vicinity.
(8a/9)One moment... I have, even now, received word of Split incursions.(small pause, checking some monitor in the distance; If Split DLC)
(9a/9)If we had anything of value to loot, we would not be discussing skirmishes. They would descend upon us in hordes.(If Split DLC)
(9b/9)Pirates from across the network would converge upon us like Ma-nola smelling blood in the water.(fictitious species of predatory fish; only play if no Split DLC)
(1/15)From time to time I spend the waking nights pondering the very same question.(considering the player's question)
(2/15)It would be misleading to cast blame for all our miseries on the great shutdown.
(3/15)In fact... when we were first riven from the wider network, the vast majority of our Boron systems remained connected between themselves.
(4/15)Isolated from external threats, we commenced a new age of reflection and scientific endeavour.
(5/15)And while this period of peace brought the wealth of Kingdom End to fabulous new heights...
(6/15)...we were not complacent. Resources were stockpiled throughout the queendom... a precautionary measure.
(8/15)Yet, in truth, we were far from it.
(9/15)We Boron are inherently connected to each other, you see? We thrive on a collective sort of... innate affinity.
(10/15)Once that connection was severed, each system found itself in complete isolation. Things fell apart quite quickly, I am afraid to say.
(12/15)Stockpiles were depleted far more rapidly than anticipated. And there was no way to replenish them.
(13/15)After years of disarray, Great Reef finally reconnected with Barren Shores. Later, it was joined by several other systems.(Great Reef same as {20005,2006}, Barren Shores same as {20005,2002})
(14/15)The Provinces Adrift were founded. But by then the damage was done. We still lacked crucial resources.
(15/15)I contend that it was the collective psychological toll of the severance that caused this. More so than the evident logistical challenges posed by the shutdown.(confident about his conclusion)
(1/2)I find no reassurance in your words. Only distaste.(contemptuous)
(2/2)My principal concern is the welfare of the Boron of the Provinces. Your expedition will expose them to needless jeopardy.(certain of his choice; Provinces short for Provinces Adrift)
(1/3)Blackmail? You, Numanckaret, are no scientist. You are a brigand and a charlatan!(accusatory)
(2/3)And yet, you leave me no choice but to accede to your dangerous demands.(frustrated)
(3/3)But mark my words. You have made no friends here in the Provinces Adrift. Some day you may regret that.
(2/5)My instinct is that your expedition is honest in its intent. However, I find your judgement questionable.
(4/5)I feel that I must allow you to proceed in your mission.(defeated)
(5/5)However... I ask of you... do not make me regret this.(pleading)
(1/4)I must say how thoroughly reassured I am.(friendly, warm)
(2/4)And again, please accept my most profound apologies for our earlier... miscommunication?(amiable)
(3/4)Clearly, our values are in auspicious alignment. I am confident that you will ensure no harm befalls my charges.
(4/4)Please. Do proceed with my blessing, and my people's support for the success of your historic mission.
(1/5)With the gate in Watchful Gaze reactivated, to our knowledge only three more dormant gates remain in Province space.(trying to move on from the previous topic; Watchful Gaze same as{20005,9009})
(2/5)One is located in Ocean of Fantasy, another in Barren Shores. The final one was discovered by scouts in Sanctuary of Darkness.(Ocean of Fantasy same as {20005,2016})
(3/5)If Sanctuary of Darkness sounds foreboding, you may find that the name is fitting. It is host to a significant Kha'ak infestation.
(4/5)Eurgh... even uttering the name makes my fins tingle. Yet I must remain firm on the matter.(shudders)
(5/5)Do not, under any circumstances, engage with the Kha'ak. Every interaction with them results in horrific conflict.(firm reiteration)
(2/3)And may I bestow upon you a gift?(friendly, trying to reach back out)
(3/3)We have prepared for you a fighter ship. A humble gift, but hopefully it will be of use to you in the times ahead.
The Provinces Adrift have suffered too much. We must focus on rebuilding what we have.
(2b/3)As a sign of good will to move past our altercation?(only if worst outcome)
(2/4)Thanks to the newly opened trade routes, we have commenced rebuilding our shipyard.
(3/4)You are, of course, most welcome to aid us in our undertaking.
(4/4)Your efforts will, of course, be lucratively compensated.
(1/5)Oh no! How could you?(worked up, disappointed)
(2/5)I am beset by a terrible sadness and despair.(resigned, sad)
(3/5)All I asked of your expedition was to not engage the Kha'ak. And yet you tore down one of their installations?!(angry)
(4/5)We have no idea how many others like that could still be out there!
(5/5)And no way of gauging the consequences of your careless, wanton violence!(frustrated)
Oh, please do be cautious! Do not give me cause to regret helping you!
(2/3)The Provinces Adrift finally have a fully functioning shipyard!
(3/3)In no small part, thanks to your contributions! Thank you!(grateful, If the player contributed)
(1a/4)As Royal Steward of the Provinces Adrift, I have something to ask of anyone willing to help our ailing community:(If triggered outside of story)
Oh no! And with such calamitous timing!(very worried)
Abort! You must halt the experiment immediately! Re-assess!(panicked)
I do believe I may have inked myself.(quiet, embarrassed)
Oh my goodness. I feel quite nauseous.(exhausted, relieved)
(1/2)I may be able to assist in that regard.
(2/2)And I cannot deny how thrilled I would be to come aboard as ambassador to my long lost Boron brethren.

(1/2)Dear passing pilots of assorted heritage and disposition.(official announcement; this character is a Boron who knows the player, so while he generally follows the usual rules of friendly and polite Boron speech when talking to the player, his tone can drift into something more familiar when appropriate; whenever it is not explicitly stated who this character is talking to in the 302538XX and 302539XX lines, he is talking to the player, who could be male or female and who is a subordinate of the speaker)
(2/2)By the grace of Her Majesty the Queen, it is our privilege to aid the reintegration of the Provinces Adrift into the venerable and resilient Queendom of Boron.(official announcement)
(1/2)Regrettably, there appears to be an ongoing misunderstanding with the inhabitants of this otherwise picturesque sector.(official announcement, tiniest hint of worry)
(2/2)I hereby call upon your civil courage, and request that you join us!(official announcement, steadfast again)
(1/2)Pilot. I may have neglected to bring something rather important to your attention.
(2/2)You will be pleased, no doubt, to hear that your ship will be automatically repaired when docked at our carrier. For the duration of this mission, that is.
(1/2)Well well... have you witnessed how the Kha'ak attempt to jump away when in peril?(intrigued)
(2/2)At least, when it concerns their own safety, our efforts to prevent senseless butchery seem to align...(thoughtful, emphasis on "their own")
(1/3)Oh my, are you quite all right?(worried)
(2/3)I shall dispatch a scout ship right away, which will attempt to scoop you up safely!
(3/3)Upon your return, you may board one of our replacement vessels and rejoin the operation, should you so desire.
(1/2)My goodness, it seems to have happened again!(worried, these two lines play if the player's provided ship gets destroyed the second time)
(2/2)Well, at the very least you are now familiar with our patented lifesaving procedure.
(1/2)Azure and Lilac Fin, delay the aggressors!("Azure Fin" and "Lilac Fin" are flights of ships, talking to a group of subordinates)
(2/2)Your carrier shall arrive shortly and with due haste.(talking to a group of subordinates)
(1/2)Outstanding work, fin leaders! I expected no less!(a "fin" is a flight of ships, talking to a group of subordinates)
(2/2)Please direct your subordinates to dock for debriefing, maintenance, and of course, refreshments.(talking to a group of subordinates)

(1/3)Queen Polypheides and the Queendom of Boron bid you a peaceful welcome aboard.(friendly, but a bit stiff, as if the speaker has already made this announcement countless times; this is a direct quote from earlier games, except for the name of the Queen)
(2a/3)Oh my, it is you! How favourable and fortuitous that our paths should cross again!(speaker loses all stiffness and gets excited)
(2b/3)Oh my, a new pilot to bolster our illustrious ranks, how fortunate and fortuitous!(speaker loses all stiffness and gets excited)
(3/3)Please, do approach me on the bridge, I insist!
Ahem! Hello there?(confused why the player doesn't approach him, a bit quieter than his original greeting)
(1/2)It is delightful to make your esteemed acquaintance!
(2/2)I am Leda We, formerly steward of the Provinces Adrift, and now commander of this intrepid defence mission.
(1/3)I hope your journey to our ancient homeland was sprinkled with success.
(2/3)As you may have keenly registered, my position has somewhat evolved since we last had the pleasure of meeting!

(3/3)While I await the summons of Her Majesty's royal council for redevelopment of the former Provinces Adrift, I have pledged myself to this intrepid defence mission.("Her Majesty" is the queen of the speaker, "Provinces Adrift" refers to {20203,3401})
(1a/4)Nothing less than the construction of an advanced, state-of-the-art, cross-sector highway!(answer to player asking what the speaker is currently defending with his fleet)
(2a/4)Preparations began as soon as the connection to Kingdom End was established, and most of the resource shipments have already arrived.
(1b/4)The fortification of the Sanctuary of Darkness cross-sector highway!("Sanctuary of Darkness" same as {20005,9005})
(2b/4)Thanks to extensive preparations, the construction is already completed. Yet the dangers lurking in this sector begin to stir.
(3/4)Once our mission is complete, Boron ships will once again traverse safely between all known sectors of the Queendom, without disturbing the local inhabitants.
(4/4)If only these inhabitants had received as thorough a briefing, by the Queen herself, as I have on this matter...("the Queen" refers to the Boron Queen)
(1/3)Indeed. As you had the pleasure of witnessing mere moments ago, the Kha'ak refuse to acknowledge the merits of this undertaking.
(2/3)Precisely as I warned, when this gruesome and dreary sector's rehabilitation was first presented to me!
(3/3)We intrude upon their dark sanctuary and, naturally, they seek to divest themselves of our presence.("dark sanctuary" deliberately alludes to the name of the sector {20005,9005})

(1/6)Thanks to their unique warp technology, Kha'ak ship clusters continue to harry our construction ships.(a "cluster" of Kha'ak ships consists of a handful of smaller ships attached to a medium ship)
(2/6)Even if these do little damage to our operation, they keep us perpetually on edge, unable to discern our opponents' grand strategy.
(3/6)Consequently, there can only be one response, even if it pains me to go against my deepest Boron instincts...(visibly uncomfortable with this line of thought)
(4/6)We shall... sally forth!(makes a small break, pulls himself together to propose his plan)

(5/6)By taking a forward position, we may gain valuable intelligence and divert Kha'ak attention away from our construction site.(not completely sure about his plan, but it's the best he got; line 6/6 is on ID 30253940)

(1/5)Tragically, we have recently recorded unacceptable losses. Hence, the invitation to any spirited pilots in the general vicinity.(translators: the "losses" aren't deaths, just pilots leaving for other reasons, this is cleared up later)
(2/5)Of course, you far exceed the required qualification. Yet nevertheless, I would be honoured and grateful to take you, temporarily, into the employ of Her Majesty's expeditionary flotilla.
(3/5)You may choose between one of our two most renowned flight leaders, and fly a well-equipped military ship for the duration of this mission.
(4/5)... unless you prefer to risk your own ship, of course!
(5/5)Once you are settled, we shall embark! Like a school of Nishalan mudwranglers on the first day of swelter season!
(1/7)They are Tinfi Ga and Huka Bo.("Tinfi Ga" is a female subordinate, "Huka Bo" is a male subordinate, answer to player asking who the speaker's sub-commanders are)

(2/7)At first, I had reason to question their compatibility, but this recent engagement has rapidly evaporated such worries.(he means their compatibility with each other, since they're both squad leaders)

(3/7)Royal Warden Huka Bo leads Lilac Fin, a flight of corvettes sent to our aid from Kingdom End itself!(proud; the Royal Wardens are a group that's close to the Boron Queen, "Lilac Fin" is a flight of ships)
(4/7)I do not know him well, but it is apparent that he brings a thrilling ferocity rarely seen among our kind.(still proud, but hints of worry)
(5/7)Tinfi Ga, on the other appendage, has defended the Provinces Adrift for longer than I served as Royal Steward.("Provinces Adrift" same as {20203,3401}, "Royal Steward" same as {30253,152})
(6/7)Despite her mannerisms, she leads our gunboats with a cool stoicism.

(7/7)I can also personally attest to her unswerving loyalty and commitment to our people.(unusually intense, because there exists another person who the speaker does not respect as much and who shares some of Tinfi Ga's characteristics)
(2/3)Since it appears that we will not have the pleasure of further reinforcements at this time, I shall commence preparations for our embarkation post haste.
(3/3)We shall speak again once you have conferred with Tinfi Ga and Huka Bo.
Yes, yes, of course...(player pauses the conversation)
Ah, is it time to continue?(player starts the conversation again after pausing it earlier)
(1a/3)Tinfi Ga has just confirmed the transferral of your, uh... "bucket".("Tinfi Ga" is a female subordinate, "bucket" is derogatory for "ship")
(1b/3)Huka Bo has just confirmed the transferral of your corvette.("Huka Bo" is a male subordinate)
(2/3)To retrieve your ship, I suggest you peruse one of the ship consoles next to our M-class docking pads.("ship consoles" is the plural of {20109,5901})
(3/3)Though, I would never prevent you from reverting to your own vessel instead, should you so desire.
(1/2)Ah, I see you have engaged the lift.
(2/2)Observe how your ship rises, majestically, from the depths.(dramatic, proud to show off the technology of the ship lift)
(1a/2)Fin leader Huka Bo!(a "fin" is a flight of ships, speaking to a male subordinate)
(1b/2)Fin leader Tinfi Ga!(a "fin" is a flight of ships, speaking to a female subordinate)
(2/2)May I request a general readiness report?(speaking to an NPC subordinate who may be male or female)
(1/2)Fleet, we are commencing our highway tunnel patrol.(speaks to the whole fleet)
(2/2)May I cordially invite you to stay on high alert, since we expect a measure of Kha'ak harassment.(speaks to the whole fleet)
As expected, they are diverting a portion of their forces to investigate our movements!("they" are the Kha'ak, the current enemy)
