(1/2)We have arrived at our destination! And may I say I am delighted that this is the case.(talking to a group of subordinates)
(2/2)Fleet. May I request that you shoo away the remaining Kha'ak to unburden our posteriors?(talking to a group of subordinates)
(1a/3)Oh my! We have received word from Azure Fin.("Azure Fin" is a flight of ships, talking to a group of subordinates)
(1b/3)Oh my! We have received word from Lilac Fin.("Lilac Fin" is a flight of ships, talking to a group of subordinates)
(2/3)Their scouting mission has resulted in new and exciting, yet also somewhat worrisome, discoveries.(talking to a group of subordinates)
(3/3)While we approach the rendezvous point, you have the opportunity to dock at the carrier and have your ship automatically repaired.(talking to a group of subordinates)
(1/2)I am truly torn between awe and apprehension.(dumbstruck, both amazed and worried by what he's seeing, talking to a group of subordinates)
(2/2)I think we may have uncovered a Kha'ak gathering place.(talking to a group of subordinates)
(1/2)Though I concur with your doubts, the military implications of this discovery are undeniable.(worried, talking to a group of subordinates)
(2/2)It pains me to say that we must disperse this congregation. And without delay.(gathers himself, talking to a group of subordinates)
(1/2)Worry not, Huka Bo.(talking to a male subordinate)

(2/2)The sturdy hull of the Menelaus' Reminiscence shall protect you and your ships.("Menelaus' Reminiscence" is the name of the carrier ship that the speaker is standing on, same as {30253,262}; talking to a male subordinate)
(1/2)Fleet. We are on the cusp of engaging a dauntingly large school of Kha'ak.("school" as in a school of fish, talking to a group of subordinates)
(2/2)Do not hesitate to dock for your own safety, should the need arise.(talking to a group of subordinates)
Retain your vigilance! There are still Kha'ak remaining.(talking to a group of subordinates)
A justifiable question indeed, which... oh, dear!(calm at first, then getting suddenly worried, talking to a male subordinate)

(1/2)I may have just received the confirmation that indeed it was not.(trying to stay calm, worried, trailing off in the end, responding to a female friend suspecting that the disappearance of the enemy was not a retreat)
(2/2)Lilac and Azure Fins, I require all of you to re-dock at our carrier at once!("Lilac Fin" and "Azure Fin" are flights of ships, pulls himself together, talking to a group of subordinates)
(1/3)I fear that I am about to do something very reckless, my old friend.(pensive, talking to a female friend)
(2/3)But recent developments have taught me that it behoves a leader to weigh the risks and to be bold in the face of crisis.(pensive, talking to a female friend)

(3/3)Fleet. Our fellow Boron at the construction site have sent word that the Kha'ak are attacking in force. We shall cross the blinding barrier to come to their aid.(more confidently, "blinding barrier" refers to a dangerous and very bright area in space that damages ships, talking to a group of subordinates)
(1/2)Oh, such a blunder!(worried, self-conscious, talking to himself)
(2/2)I sincerely hope that our friends will be able to fend off the assault for a while longer.(worried, self-conscious, talking to himself)
All ships. Please fan out and provide our allies with relief.(talking to a group of subordinates)
(1/2)There are too many!(meaning that there are too many attackers, talking to a group of subordinates)
(2/2)I am sending drones to provide you with assistance!("drones" are small space craft, talking to a group of subordinates)
(1/3)No further Kha'ak are appearing on our radar.(still a bit unsure and worried)
(2/3)Oh my! A colossal weight has been lifted from my mind!(immensely relieved)
(3/3)Please. Let us meet in person for a debriefing. I insist!
How gracious and polite of you to come!(cheerful, response to the player entering the room the speaker is in)
... if I am the reason you came, that is.(self-conscious remark if the player doesn't approach)
(1/5)Yes, indeed!(answer to player asking if the speaker wanted to see them)
(2/5)I would like to give you my most heartfelt thanks and appreciation for supporting us in this darkest hour.
(3/5)You and everyone else far exceeded my expectations, especially considering the unfortunate turn of events...(visibly unhappy with the events, gets a bit lost in thought towards the end)
(4/5)Of course, I also remember the reward that was mentioned in the official posting!(remembers the reward that was promised, snaps back to attention)
(5/5)... though, I will need you to restore your temporary ship assignment to us.(a bit meekly, meaning that the player has to give back the ship they were provided with for the mission)
(1/6)Am I truly that easy to read? Oh well...(a bit meekly)

(2/6)You see, in the moment, it seemed to me that our attack on the Kha'ak conclave was unavoidable. That they were most likely planning an attack even before our intrusion.(trying to cope and explain)
(3/6)Huka Bo assures me that I have done the Queendom proud, and that I made the proper and logical decision.(self-conscious, a bit lost in thought, "Huka Bo" is a male subordinate)
(4/6)But there remains a lingering doubt; a fear that I have betrayed my conviction for no palpable gain.(visibly unhappy and lost in thought)
(5/6)But please, do not concern yourself with such considerations.(tries to pull himself together, fails)
(6/6)There is a victory to be celebrated today.(pulls himself together, a bit forced, doesn't quite manage to come across as cheerful)
(1/8)We... do not know the answer to that, not with any certainty.(pensive)
(2/8)It seemed, though, as if they had realised that without capital ships, their attacks against our construction operation, and our carrier, could only serve as a distraction.
(3/8)The true target, therefore, may have always been our supply transports.
(4/8)The Kha'ak may have even deliberately eschewed them in the beginning to make us think of them as mindless drones!
(5/8)Tinfi Ga has raised such a possibility with me. And I greatly value her loyalty and experience.(again making an effort to praise Tinfi Ga, a female friend)
(6/8)She also thinks that we forced the Kha'ak into a corner. That they were forced to devise a radical and risky plan, despite little prospect of success.
(7/8)Fortunately, events such as these are now a thing of the past.(holds the previous thought, tries to cheer himself up)
(8/8)The highway will drastically limit the likelihood of our species interacting in future. So perhaps we are now safe from them... and they from us.
(1/4)I never doubted your honesty and trustworthiness!(glad, not apologetically)
(2/4)And I am pleased to bestow upon you the due reward for your highly esteemed contributions!
(3/4)But, as I have just been informed, that is not all.
(4/4)Please consider paying a visit to the crew quarters, where someone should be waiting for you!
And my eternal gratitude shall accompany you!(formal, response to the player saying that they will take their leave)
(1/3)I trust the hiring ceremony has gone well?
(2/3)Then I believe this ultimately concludes our cooperation. Permanently, this time!
(3/3)Let me again wish you farewell and safe travels.
My friend! Are you not needed somewhere else?(more intrigued than reprimanding)
Please accept my sincerest apologies, for I am needed elsewhere!
(2/2)We will be through this shortly.("this" refers to a dangerous region of space that the speaker's ship is passing through)
(1/3)Oh my! The ship that we furnished you with seems to have wandered out of the mission sector.(a bit worried, giving well-meaning advice)
(2/3)I should remind you that this mission depends on the fortitude and commitment of courageous pilots such as yourself.
(3/3)Please, return the ship to Sanctuary of Darkness without delay.("Sanctuary of Darkness" same as {20005,9005})
(1/2)I must say, I am enormously disappointed that you have excused yourself from this important task. Yet simultaneously, I find I am strangely intrigued.(reprimanding, but also curious)
(2/2)The urgency of whatever alternative task you are pursuing evidently exceeds that of our royal mission.
(6/6)I do hope that this proves to be a strategically sound approach.(not completely sure about his plan, but it's the best he has got)
Thank you so much for inviting, entertaining and having me!
Yes, but first some history is essential and required. Tell me, friend, are you familiar with Ocean of Fantasy?

It is true and undeniable, a sour and bitter aroma in the bouquet of our history. But what if I told you that a way has been found to heal, mend and restore? To bring this world back to lush, blue-green life? To...(interrupted)
The pleasure and delight is all mine!

Please indulge me as I reply with a question that is also a metaphor. Think of someone who suffered a terrible accident. Does the doctor say "No matter how well I heal these wounds, they are going to leave scars, therefore I shall not even endeavour to try."? No, of course not! They do everything they can to the best of their ability.

I also invite and encourage you to think of these scars, not as regrettable failures but as poignant reminders of what one has experienced and survived. We must not forget the history of this world and these scars will serve as bittersweet memorials and testaments.

Ah yes, two very stirring and electrifying topics! Oh the lively and impassioned debates we had about them! But we always reached the same point of ethical contention: is it right, good and becoming to interfere and meddle in the natural order of evolution and extinction? In the end we reached the harmonious consensus that our work, labour and effort is of a different nature. We are undoing a single, unnaturally induced calamitous catastrophe. Once the planet has a healthy ecological cycle, we will relinquish our controls and leave life to find its own way, as it always, invariably and inevitably does.

We are not going to begin settlement until the ecosystem has reached a balanced and stable equilibrium. Until then, the only people visiting the planet will be trained and competent professionals, not tourists. This is a restoration effort, not a theme park!

(emphasis on We at the start)We did it! So many wonderful, generous and talented people have contributed; I was merely a facilitator. Above all I want to thank and express gratitude for the one person who made all of this possible in the first place, without whom we would not have dared to dream and fantasise about a miracle such as this. If you are listening right now, and I hope you are, you know my gratitude, and that of the Boron people, knows no bounds. The history of this world will forever be intertwined with the name (brief pause near the end before Boso Ta)Boso Ta!

page.title: Mission Boron NPC 3 / Boron Leader Inner Bubble
page.descr: Lines for Mission Boron NPC 3
page.t: With our successful connection of the Kingdom End Jump Gate, we are once again reunited with, at least some of, our lost kin. A great rift within our people can now begin to heal. But our systems, once drifting in the dark, now also connect to the Commonwealth. Diplomatic relations must be established with its peoples, old and new. For this task, your Queen calls upon you, her heralds.

The Alliance of the Word shall be our aid, and expedition leader Numanckaret shall guide you. My heralds, reach out to the very deepest corners of the gate network and deliver our message: the Queendom has returned.
(1/7)Greetings, travellers!(addressing a congregation of people, player included)
(2/7)It is our great pleasure as reigning monarch of the Queendom of Boron to receive you all in this historic moment.
(3/7)Leda We, steward of the Provinces Adrift in our most regrettable absence, has told us much of your fraught pursuit of knowledge and unity.
(4/7)Our Royal Steward positively gushed with praise for his allies. And so I wish to thank each one of you who was so critical in bringing these long-lost systems back into the fold.
(6/7)Fearless leader, without whose vision and doggedness an expedition of such scale would never have been possible.
(1/6)Nevertheless, we are heartened to see the alliance of which we are a part achieve such a feat!
(2/6)Nila Ti. Our loyal subject and long-lost kinswoman.
(3/6)You have done your utmost to maintain the safety and security of the severed realm, despite hardship and adversity.
(4/6)And Steward Leda informs us that not for one moment did you let the dream of Kingdom End die.
(5/6)Without your invaluable insight and guidance, the expedition would surely have failed.
(1/4)You have proven yourself to be a capable leader. As such, a seat in government will always be open to you.
(3/4)Boso Ta. You spent a whole lifetime away from home, isolated from all fellow Boron in the most unimaginable manner. And yet, you did not let these dreadful circumstances deter you.
(1/5)And then of course there is you:(directed at the player)
(2d/5)Yololios Sanduras Rusiris XI.(speak XI as "eleven")(Player address variation)
(2o/5)The most resourceful, courageous explorer.(Player address variation)
(3/6)You have risen above ancient animosities to meet the occasion as a true hero.(if Split)
(4/6)We have been informed that your grit and fortitude were the backbone of this venture.
(5/6)Without your endeavours, it is doubtful that the Boron of Kingdom End would now be reunited with their brethren. Or the Commonwealth at large.
(6/6)We thank you from the deepest well of our being.
(1/8)Now, Numanckaret, we expect that you and your science team will be quite busy for some time to come.
(2/8)Exchanging your findings with our own scientists, and making sense of all that has occurred here.
(3/8)Yet still, we have a favour to ask of you.
(4/8)We shall never neglect our neighbours. However, our immediate concern must be to aid those formerly isolated Boron systems that have fallen into disrepair.
(5/8)It has been a long time since we last shared the network with other species.
(6/8)We anticipate that many things have changed.
(7/8)The Alliance of the Word facilitates collaboration between vastly different groups.

(8/8)We ask that you use your expertise to coordinate a mission to reach out to our old allies and adversaries. Let them know that the Boron of Kingdom End have returned!(final line of her big speech, put some emphasis on the "have returned" bit)
(1/5)We can only thank all of you again. You are great friends to our people!
(2/5)But now we are afraid that we must ask you all to take your leave.
(3/5)With the formerly untethered Boron subjects once more under our care, there is much for us to do.
(4/5)Our royal duties cannot be postponed any longer.
(2m/5)Nobonis Ganatos Yohiris IV.(speak IV as "four")(Player address variation)
(1/2)With parliamentary ratification complete, I am delighted to announce our newly established defence pact with the Hatikvah Free League.
(2/2)Our Queendom will now provide Boron military ships to the Free League, which will be used to patrol and protect Free League space and installations against intruders.
(1a/2)I am delighted to announce that the realm has successfully established diplomatic relations with both the Godrealm of the Paranid and the Holy Order of the Pontifex.
(1b/2)I am delighted to announce that we have established diplomatic relations with the Realm of the Trinity.
(2/2)We shall seek further cooperation between our peoples, and work towards a peaceful and prosperous future together.
(1/3)It is my pleasure to announce that diplomatic relations with the Terran Protectorate have been established.
(2/3)Our friends are kindly constructing a Boron habitat for the future comfort of our diplomatic mission.
(3/3)May this usher in a bountiful new era of peaceful trade and cooperation.
(1/2)We joyfully celebrate the institution of formal diplomatic ties with the Riptide Rakers of Avarice.
(2/2)Working together, we endeavour to support this hardy band as it matures into a valued ally.
(1/2)We are pleased to announce the reestablishment of diplomatic relations with the Teladi Company.
(2/2)Our proud societies have much to gain from a thriving commercial partnership.
(1/6)After so many years riven apart, it is most gratifying to be able to announce the resumption of our oldest and closest alliance.
(2/6)We welcome the hand of friendship of the Argon Federation.
(3/6)Together, we shall initiate the Bilateral Battlegroup.(Bilateral Battlegroup same as 20204,17101)
(4/6)This joint defence fleet will operate as two task forces.
(5/6)One shall be based in the Queendom, and the other shall be in Federation space.
(6/6)This mutual defence pact sends a clear message to all: an attack on one is an attack on both.
(1a/3)It is with profound regret that I announce that our attempts at diplomacy with the Zyarth Patriarchy were to no avail.
(1b/3)With great sorrow, I must report that our attempts at diplomacy with the Rhak Patriarchy were without success.
(2/3)The senseless animosities between our peoples prevailed and shall remain.
(3/3)Nonetheless, I extend my gratitude to our herald, who has returned to us alive and well. At times, even that seemed an unlikely outcome.
(1a/7)I once again welcome you, honourable representative Numanckaret and of course, you, my brave heralds.
(1b/7)I once again welcome my brave heralds.
(2/7)The task entrusted to you demanded your bravery, loyalty, wits and tenacity.
(3/7)It is thanks to your endeavours that the Queendom has not only returned to the Commonwealth, but is widely recognised therein.
(4/7)I hereby release you from your duties to the Queendom.
(5/7)As promised, you may keep the ships entrusted to you, and use them at your own discretion.
(6/7)Once again, I bid you farewell; though not as heralds, but rather as adventurers, free to pursue whatever you desire.
(1/3)I welcome you, honoured representative Numanckaret, and of course my pioneering heralds.
(2/3)The task entrusted to you is no less than the reintegration of the Queendom into its place within the galactic community.
(3/3)The Alliance of the Word has offered its aid in this endeavour. And so it falls upon Numanckaret to lead you, my heralds, to the farthest corners of the gate network.
(1/12)My heralds, you carry a message of Boron camaraderie.
(2/12)Seek out others wherever they may be found.
(5/12)All we have in this endless universe is each other.
(6/12)Be not discouraged if you face harsh words or cynicism.
(7/12)Be understanding, for Boron kindness has been absent from their lives for so long.
(9/12)May starlight guide you in your duties.
(10/12)And on completion of your mission, we bestow upon you the gift of these ships.
(11/12)May they bring you fulfilment and accomplishment in your voyages thereafter.
(12/12)We bid you farewell, brave heralds, and wish safe travels upon you.
(8/12)Create a beneficial ripple throughout the known systems.
(1/1)I wholeheartedly wish you safe travels, my herald.

page.title: Mission Boron NPC 4 / Boron Terraforming Contact
page.descr: Lines for Boron Terraforming Contact
page.t: Hello, friends, pals and buddies, and welcome to Making Waves, the number three show about all the happenings that make our collective fins tingle. I am your host, Halilo Gi, and for our first segment, Current Events, I am joyful, euphoric and buoyed to be joined by Leda We, Royal Steward of the Provinces Adrift.
You are here to explain and illuminate a very special and ambitious project.

(sad gurgling noises)Who is not? Such a lamentable tale. Mere decades ago, it was a beautiful and idyllic world, when its life was tragically cut short by the heedless and foolhardy conduct of unenlightened beings.
Why, that sounds like the loveliest idea I have ever heard! But before we go into details, a quick word from this week's sponsor.

(in ad-reading mode)Do you often miss your friends, family and loved ones? Do you wish you could smell, taste and savour them whenever and wherever you want? Then Lar Inaus' Pheromone Packs are for you! Use the offer code...(audio fades out at the end)
And that concludes this week's Current Events. Thank you again, friend Leda, for explaining what is happening on Ocean of Fantasy. So exciting!

Before we say goodbye and farewell, let us answer some questions sent in by our listeners. Here is one by Hafi Gi from Great Reef who writes: "Last week you explained that some of the damage and loss can never be fully reversed. Does that not make this a peculiarly fruitless and frivolous exertion?"
Very moving and inspiring, friend! Up next, Lansu Pu from Barren Shores wants to know: "What is your fin-care routine?" I am so glad you asked! I am using...(audio fades out at the end)
(fading in)...utterly and completely indefenestrable!(literally means impossible to throw out of a window but exact translation not important)

(speaking slowly, filling time while looking for the next question)Let me see here... ah! This next question comes from Ion Tolman from Sandwell in Antigone Memorial. The full message is... remarkably verbose and meandering. It also makes frequent references to an obscure and mysterious cultural artefact, I think, but they are basically asking about the ethics and safety of resurrecting extinct species.
And what about the issue of safety?
I am sure tickets would sell out very quickly if it was. I am afraid that is all we have time for this week...(audio fades out at the end)

page.title: Mission Boron NPC 5 / Boron Announcer
page.descr: Lines for Boron Announcer
page.t: All rise for Her Royal Highness. The benevolent and wise Queen Polypheides!(announcer, official)
(1/2)By the grace of Her Majesty, you are now receiving the royal broadcast from the Queendom of Boron.
(2/2)It is my honour and pleasure to announce Her Majesty, Queen Polypheides.
(3/3)Her Majesty Queen Polypheides will now see you.
(1/5)By the grace of Her Majesty, Queen Polypheides of the Queendom of Boron, you have been granted an audience.(you plural, talking to crowd)
(3/5)Our honoured guest, Numanckaret, representative of the Alliance of the Word.
(4a/5)The Queen's Heralds: Pala Mo, Kulu Mi and Fomo Fi.
(3/3)You are invited to hold your inaugural mission briefing at the designated venue.
The royal audience is concluded. Please find your way to the mission briefing.
The Queen's Heralds are reminded not to broadcast their private observations publicly.

page.title: Mission Boron NPC 6 / Boron Scientist
page.descr: Lines for Boron Scientist (not Boso)
page.t: (1/8)I am a retired wormhole scientist from Kingdom End.
(2/8)You might have heard about the Jump Gate project I was a part of in my prime.
(3/8)We kept revising and rechecking our calculations and it all seemed perfectly fine, but something was amiss.
(4/8)Now, of course, we know that we were missing the cipher discovered by the Boron scientist on the Commonwealth side.
(5/8)When our Jump Gate surprisingly spun up and opened, it was not even targeting the gate in Sanctuary of Darkness.(Sanctuary of Darkness same as {20005,9005})
(6/8)We were aiming for Heretic's End. Though I do recall that the Sanctuary of Darkness coordinates were also stored within our Jump Gate, among many others.(Heretic's End same as {20005,9015})
(7/8)Do excuse my meanderings. This is all ancient history by now.
(8/8)I am now part of an exchange program, and have the happy luxury of spending my time meeting the Commonwealth's most learned scientists.
(1/3)As a matter of fact, I did hear a commotion from the upper level. An unusually agitated Boron with ceremonious markings then rushed down and straight out the door.(male Boron rushed out)
(2/3)He left in a hurry before I was able to intervene.
(3/3)I do hope he is alright and well.
Did he leave anything on the upper level?

page.title: Mission Boron NPC 7 / Boron Herald 2
page.descr: Lines for Boron Herald 2
page.t: (1/5)... and transition is achieved. Green lights across the board.(calm, addressing mission control)
(4/5)There is a fleet of Commonwealth ships! Right here!(surprise, excitement)
(5/5)Greetings, friends! Please tell me you are with the Alliance of the Word!
Judging by the equipment surrounding this Gate, would it be presumptuous to imagine that you had a hand in activating the Jump Gate from this side?
(2/3)Our scientists have been endeavouring to achieve this for countless tides. But to no avail.
(3/3)Then suddenly, without warning, something changed and we were able to interface with the Jump Gate!
(1/2)You simply must share your findings with us!(fascinated)
(2/2)And of course... our most venerable and beloved Queen Polypheides wishes to receive you and your subordinates, to thank you for all you have achieved.
(1/2)In the meantime, we will harden the gate defensive positions and establish patrols.
(2/2)We will also need to instigate ties with the local administration.
(1/2)You fly on ahead, the Queen is expecting you.
(2/2)It may be considered rude to make her wait unnecessarily.
(1a/2)I am assigned to deliver a sample of our home waters to the Terran Protectorate.
(1b/2)I am assigned to propose peace to the Zyarth Patriarchy.
(1c/2)I am assigned to propose peace to the Rhak Patriarchy.
(1d/2)I am assigned to establish relations with the Vigor Syndicate.
(1e/2)I am assigned to establish relations with the Antigone Republic.
(2/2)May you travel with speed, and without unforeseen events!
(1/6)I am extremely glad to have returned to the Queendom!
(2/6)What I learned is that the Commonwealth manners are not for me.
(3/6)Especially those Split! They were so thunderstruck at seeing a Boron in an official capacity, that they did not know whether to send me back whole, in pieces, or not at all.
(4/6)While they were discussing their preferred options for my demise, I managed to engage the travel drive, under fire, and make my escape.
(5/6)I cannot imagine the Jump Gates closing on me, cutting me off from my fellow Boron!
(6/6)That fear alone will keep me in our system henceforth. I long for the sweet ammonia taste of my home waters.
(2/2)What will you do with your new ship after our herald duty?
(1/2)That does indeed sound most fabulous! My curiosity is already stimulated!
(2/2)I am anticipating great delight in reading your journal.
I will gift the ship to my sibling. He is embarking upon a significant step in his life, which calls for a celebration.
The time has come to receive our mandate!
Yes, indeed. When she looks at you, it is like you are the only person for twenty parsecs.
Never! Nor would I have expected to have the honour of such an important responsibility.

page.title: Mission Boron NPC 8 / Boron Newscaster
page.descr: Lines for Boron NPC 8 and Boron Newscaster
page.t: From the depths of our sacred waters, may peace flow like gentle currents. I, Lar Lyganeus, bring word by the grace of our beloved Queen.
With excited serenity, we announce the awakening of two dormant gates - one in Ocean of Fantasy, the other in Atreus Clouds.
Their stirring may be linked to computronium samples from the Ancients' presence cloud, or may perhaps be a gift from the Sohnen.
The gates now stand in harmonious alignment, ready for new trade currents, and our beautiful Queen has dispatched an exploratory mission to test these waters.

page.t: (Accepting invitation)Oh why, yes, we will gladly accept the invitation that you have so graciously extended to us. I will make my way to your embassy post-haste!

(Promotion ceremony - intro)We are glad that you came in person.
(Promotion ceremony - cntd, friendly)We have been watching your accomplishments with great interest, and believe you deserve a reward for it.
(Promotion ceremony - cntd, allied)We are elated that you have continued to be a staunch defender of the Queen. You deserve the utmost respect and recognition.
(Promotion ceremony - handing over 'medal', friendly)I am pleased to present you with a new rank within the Queendom.
(Promotion ceremony - handing over 'medal', allied)It is an honour to present you with a new rank within the Queendom.
(Promotion ceremony)You will find that this rank comes with wonderous benefits.
(Promotion ceremony - fluff line to spread notifications out 1)These benefits are tied to the rank, so if you lose the rank, the benefits will go too.
(Promotion ceremony - fluff line to spread notifications out 2)But with your character, I am sure we have nothing to worry about.
(Promotion ceremony - fluff line to spread notifications out 3)I hope you find these rewards acceptable. Please, make the most of them.
(Promotion ceremony - subgroup licence hint)You may now find that certain organisations within the Boron Queendom will take interest in you joining their ranks.
(Promotion ceremony - outro)Once again, I thank you for your continued efforts.
(Promotion ceremony - outro cntd)We look forward to working with you more in the future.

We live in dark times. For centuries the Paranid lived in peace. Strife between us was a relic of the past. So dependent are we on the Pontifex that when the Jump Gates shut down and the Pontifex could not contact us, chaos ensued. Life fell into ruin. We searched desperately for guidance - some even going so far as to birth new leaders, each with their own perspective, each with their own ambitions. When the Jump Gates re-aligned, it could only end in conflict. Each Pontifex believed they were in the right; each unwilling to back down. Civil war was simply a matter of time.

I am proud to serve in this fight, on the side proven to be just. Now a single faction remains that refuses to return to the Godrealm. It is my duty to protect our people from their heresy, and to destroy any that would threaten our way of life.

(mission update)There's been a change of plans with the job.
(partial success)If that's the best you could do... sure.
(failed mission)I hope you don't think you're being paid for that.

(failure in mission chain)That didn't go well, but we might still be able to salvage this.
(mission aborted by NPC / script failure)Sorry. Looks like your services are no longer required.
My responsibility is to coordinate our forces in our campaign against the heretics of the so-called 'Holy Order'. Pilots such as you have been encouraged to join our cause.
Your being here means that you have gained recognition as a worthy friend of the Paranid Empire.
Your being here means that you have gained recognition as a true champion of the Paranid Empire.
There will always be place for pilots who share our ideals.
This schism within the Paranid has humiliated us beyond measure. Our once proud race has been likened to that of squabbling infants, all because of ineptitude and cowardice.
Our foe are fellow Paranid, so any victory will not be easy. As such, we require you undergo a trial.
I am curious to see how you fare compared to my Paranid brethren.
We will grant you the choice of tasks, from combat deployments to construction work. What is available will depend on the current situation in the area.
You will be paid as you complete your allocated tasks, and should we see fit, you will be further awarded.
It is rare for one such as yourself to be so interested in Paranid matters. I will indulge you.
Is it a rather deplorable situation. During the time of the deactivated Jump Gates, many Paranid found themselves cut off from our home systems.
Without the Pontifex Maximus to guide them, a number of factions took the action to hatch a replacement. It was a desperate act, but somewhat understandable.
However, on reconnecting with us, several factions refused to submit to the true Pontifex leading us to strike them down.
And now, only the heretics of the 'Holy Order' remain. Even when shunned by many, they still find the means to wage a war against us.
Should they concede and put their capabilities to use in the Empire, we would find ourselves unmatched.
I will select a suitable task for you momentarily.
I look forward to your return.
You will now find tasks related to our conflict with the Order in your mission interface.
There are currently no open tasks.
We will not simply have anyone interfere in our matters. Do not bother us unless you have proven yourself worth our time.
We are still passing judgement on your previous performance. Leave us.
Do not bring us shame with a poor performance.
We do not currently deem you worthy of aiding us in our cause.
Your performance during your last assignment was far below our standards. Begone.
Should you improve yourself, you may yet get a chance to aid us.
The mighty Paranid Empire calls for skilled pilots to join us in crushing the heretics.
Those wishing to join must be unyielding in their ideals and willing to fight for the one true Pontifex.
Our goals remain to repel any heretic aggression and quash their rebellion. If you believe yourself worthy, join us.
(briefing status - optimistic)Our recent efforts against the Order are going well, as expected.
(briefing status - optimistic)In our skirmishes with the Order, we very clearly prevailed.
(briefing status - optimistic)Our efforts have pushed the Order deeper into their territory.
(briefing status - optimistic)The Order are at the brink of losing large swathes of territory.
(briefing status - optimistic)Many engagements against the heretics have ended in victory.
(briefing status - optimistic)We continue to humble the Order at every turn. They will soon fall.
(briefing status - pessimistic)The Order continue to deal decisive strikes against our forces.
(briefing status - pessimistic)Like a cornered animal, the Order has launched desperate attacks, some of which effective.
(briefing status - pessimistic)The Order occasionally use their Paranid intellect to conjure effective strategies. We will adapt.
(briefing status - pessimistic)We have lost some ground to the Order but it will not change the outcome of this conflict.
(briefing status - pessimistic)The Order has found the zeal to give us pause but we will soon retaliate.
(briefing status - pessimistic)Our recent efforts against the Order were poorly formulated.
(briefing status - instruction)Take notice of these instructions and judge where you can best assist.
(briefing status - instruction)Study these options and select a task that best suits your abilities.
(briefing status - instruction)View what tasks need completing and judge what suits your skills.
(briefing status - instruction)Take a look at these directives before deciding how you can help us.
(briefing status - instruction)Look through our current objectives and select an area in which you can aid us.
(briefing status - thanks)We thank you for your help in this conflict.
(briefing status - thanks)The Paranid Empire thanks you for your help.
(briefing status - thanks)Very good. May you survive to join us in victory.
You are in the presence of Rikmanckassor, Honour Guard of the True Pontifex and anointed Priest Guardian of His righteous claim.
You are hereby commanded to remove yourself from these premises, or be struck down by the wrath of the Prophets.
In the name of His Holiness, may He be forever bathed in the light of the Sacred Three-Dimensionality...
Your vessel will now be destroyed and your remains disposed of.
(generic line outside of plot)You will remove yourself from these premises or be obliterated.
(coming to the rescue, proclaiming grandiosely)You have wisely chosen to promptly divest yourself of the most obstinate non-believers, on this occasion.
(coming to the rescue, proclaiming grandiosely)Though it appears that you are in need of assistance.
The Pontifex observes your endeavours with great interest, Tarnished Prophet.
We see that you have pledged yourself to a most powerful being for protection.
...have proven yourself in battle once again.
It has been an honour for you to fight at Our side.
The false Pontifex must have grown desperate to have sent his advisors right into the claws of his enemies...
(defiantly)And yet, the claim of our righteous and true Pontifex remains unchallenged.
There is truth in the Tarnished Prophet's words.
United, we could crush the enemies of the Paranid!
You simply lack conviction, legate Xatenmanckett!
Were these 'negotiations' a ruse to attack our holy cathedral?
Protect the Prophet from those heathens!
Our enemies have tried to sabotage the negotiations all along!
You are hereby issued a standard copy of the Sacred Axioms of Paranid Bashra, First Disciple of the Holy Three-Dimensionality, minus the appendices.
May you find enlightenment in your studies and hospitality on your travels.

My task here is to help coordinate our forces in our campaign to quell the aggression of lesser races, the Argon in particular. This is no small task and requires aid from pilots such as you.

There will always be place for pilots willing to represent our cause.
This conflict is a taxing one. The misguided Paranid of the Godrealm have sought aid from the many other races, involving them in our holy struggle.
The Argon are foes which are particularly troublesome. We will not risk low-skilled rabble jeopardising our operations, so we require you undergo a trial.
Of course, with you being Argon yourself, we will hold you under much scrutiny.
We will grant you the choice of tasks, from combat deployments to construction work. What is available will depending on the current situation in the area.
You will be paid as you complete your allocated tasks, and should we see fit, you will be further awarded.
If you expect me to divulge sensitive information, you are quite mistaken. However, I will humour you.
The Paranid Empire has had a history of conflict with the Argon, and now it has fallen to us to stem their expansion towards our space.
I am sure that many have described this conflict as blind xenophobia on our part, but that is far from the case. While we deem them lesser beings, we are not opposed to coexistance.
However, they choose to side with the Godrealm as well as ignore our warnings on encroaching on our space. We will do what we must to protect our interests.
I expect a number within our ranks do wish for their eradication but I am far more benevolent. A crushing defeat will do.
I do hope they will give us battles worthy of mention in the annals of Paranid history.
I will select a suitable task for you momentarily.
I look forward to your return.

There are currently no open tasks.

We do not currently deem you worthy of aiding us in our cause.

This is not a trivial matter. Those wishing to join must be righteous and relentlessly loyal.
Our goals remain to hold our space from Argon aggression and quash their ability to wage their little war against us. If you are worthy, join us.

(briefing status - thanks)Very good. We hope you survive to see our victory.

My position among the Holy Order gives me authority to judge and enact our military strategies against the pitiful wretches of the Godrealm. I also shall pass judgement upon you.
Your being here means that you have gained recognition as a worthy friend of the Holy Order.
Your being here means that you have gained recognition as a true champion of the Holy Order.
There will always be place for pilots willing to represent our cause.
This conflict is one the likes of which the cosmos has never seen. Only fellow Paranid can stand against us so.
Because of this, we will not risk any passing pilot tarnishing our path to victory. You must undergo a trial.
And yes, we are accommodating enough to give lesser races the opportunity to aid us.
I have much to do so I propose that we begin.
You will be granted the choice of many tasks, from combat deployments to construction work. What is available will depend on the current situation in the area.
You will be paid as you complete your allotted tasks, and we may see fit to reward you further at the conclusion.
It is rare for one such as yourself to be so interested in Paranid matters. Rarer still for us to indulge. Very well.
It is a shameful story. Our once proud Paranid race has been humiliated before all of the lesser races. A 'civil-war' they call it.
The 'Godrealm' believe themselves bathed in holy light when they are in-fact blinded by it. They can not fathom that their false Pontifex has been surpassed; a natural reaction I suppose.
Unfortunately, we must do what we can to silence those who speak against the true Pontifex, even if they were once brethren. They will abandon their ways and join us or they will be cast aside.
And let us not forget the damnable Argon, those whom our fellow Paranid have run to for aid.
'Tis no matter. Our cause is just and our strength is unmatched.
Very well. I will select a suitable task for you momentarily.
I trust you will not disappoint us.
You will now find tasks related to our conflict with the 'Godrealm' in your mission interface.
There are currently no open tasks.
We will not simply have anyone interfere in Holy Order matters. Do not bother us unless you have proven yourself worthy.
We are still passing judgement on your previous performance. Begone.
Do not forget that you are representing our glorious order. Do not bring us shame.
We do not currently deem you worthy of aiding us in our cause.
Your performance during your last assignment was pitiful. I do not believe we need to discuss this any further.
Should you improve yourself, you may yet get a chance to aid us.
The resplendent Holy Order seeks a number of skilful pilots to join us in defending our space from the heretics of the Godrealm.
This is a vital operation. Those taking part must remain sound of mind.
Our goals are to defend our borders from the Godrealm and continue to push into their space in the name of the true Pontifex. If you are worthy, join us.
(briefing status - optimistic)Our recent efforts against the Godrealm are going as we expected.
(briefing status - optimistic)After several recent encounters with the Godrealm forces, we clearly prevailed.
(briefing status - optimistic)Due to our efforts, Godrealm forces have been greatly reduced.
(briefing status - optimistic)We have pushed the Godrealm to the brink and now they cower behind their defences.
(briefing status - optimistic)We have won many of the engagements with the Godrealm forces. We expect it to continue.
(briefing status - optimistic)The Paranid of the Godrealm must feel great shame at this time. They have suffered much at our hand.
(briefing status - pessimistic)The gains we had previously achieved have been eroded by the Godrealm forces.
(briefing status - pessimistic)It seems that our enemy is still capable of employing intelligence worthy of a Paranid.
(briefing status - pessimistic)The Godrealm continues to push us, backed by a number of lesser species. A revolting turn.
(briefing status - pessimistic)While we have lost ground to the Godrealm, we expect our alternative strategies shall soon confound them.
(briefing status - pessimistic)It seems we have given the Godrealm opportunity to expand their forces. It will not last.
(briefing status - pessimistic)Our recent efforts against the Godrealm were poorly formulated.
(briefing status - instruction)Take notice of these instructions and judge where you can best assist.
(briefing status - instruction)Study these options and select a task that best suits your abilities.
(briefing status - instruction)View what tasks need completing and judge what suits your skills.
(briefing status - instruction)Take a look at these directives before deciding how you can help us.
(briefing status - instruction)Look through our current objectives and select an area in which you can aid us.
(briefing status - thanks)We thank you for your help in this conflict.
(briefing status - thanks)The Holy Order of the true Pontifex thanks you for your help.
(briefing status - thanks)Very good. We shall not lose with aid from those such as you.

page.title: Mission Paranid NPC 1 / Paranid Story - Duke
page.descr: Lines for Mission Paranid NPC 1
page.t: Has the last remaining pretender finally acknowledged my presence?
No. It cannot be the Holy Order who sent you.
Decades have passed and barely a soul has strayed into this wasteland.
So the musings of the Holy Three-Dimensionality have guided your steps toward this most remote of places?
I go by the name Kromancketslat.
I have witnessed the holy gates close and open again...
...and I have reaped a bountiful harvest from the void in between.
But somewhere along that path, the purpose that once drove my kin was torn asunder.
When the Pontifex' thralls arrived to claim new territory...
...only a shadow remained of the once daring, free people that called this place their home.
Witness this sea of ruin, this irredeemable haven of hubris.
May it be a lesson to those who put ambition before unity.
The realignment, as glorious as it might seem in the grand scheme of history, planted the seed of the conflict we witness today.
Their desire to be whole again had already driven the many isolated parishes to appoint grand leaders from among their own congregations.
When the Holy Three-Dimensionality finally reached out and tied together the lost gates ...
...every Pontifex, whatever their character, saw their claim challenged by a horde of pretenders.
This civil war is a travesty; a mark of shame for all Paranid.
Invoked by desire, sparked by obtuse geometry, and fuelled by blind dogma and zealotry.
The Pontifices, both pretenders in their own way, may attempt to reach out and guide us into their light.
But this conflict has defined us for too long and the promise of personal gain weighs too heavy for some.
No physical wall has been planted between my brethren...
...and yet, despite our three eyes, we have lost sight of each other... (slight pause before 'and thus')and thus of ourselves.
I have decided to conclude my contemplative isolation.
You are among the chosen few who will help pave the way for my grand return...
...or for the ultimate defeat of my cause.
There is no need for such formalities.
I am painfully aware of the ignorance of unholy creatures like you.
A Paranid is not simply chosen, he is created; destined to serve the Realm to the best of his abilities.
The high priests, created in the most intricate rituals of holy procreation, are indeed a marvel to behold.
But as many priest-scholars have done before, so did I dare to pose this question, half a century ago:
What if there has been a mistake?
What is the fate of those, whose potential surmounts their assigned purpose?
And I pray that none of my brethren will have to walk this path.
We approach the site of our first confrontation.
The time has come to once again wear that dreaded face.
We will require Our entourage to ensure that We remain undisturbed.
Our negotiations with the Holy Order leadership were brief and inconclusive, as We expected.
However, it appears that Our endeavours have not gone unnoticed by more sceptical elements of the Holy Order.
These heretics need to be removed from Our presence.
(in combat, grandiosely)The tides of battle are turning!
(after combat, politely)We should have expected your intervention.
The zenith of Our efforts is nearly upon Us.
Rikmanckassor's cooperation certainly arrived at an opportune moment.
But now We shall meet the legate of Priest Emperor Xaar in person.
We have decided to face these impossible odds alone.
You shall act as an observer only, but be ready to intervene should We fail once again.
She will provide the necessary details.
Enlightened beings, these words are for you alone.
We are gathered here, on this momentous occasion, to discuss a matter of the utmost gravity.(translate 'gravity' as importance, not as pull towards a mass)
Xatenmanckett, honoured and ordained legate of Priest Emperor Xaar, your presence gleams like a ray of holy light in this abyss of discord.
This was declared hallowed ground long before these unfortunate quarrels.
Without question, the blinding truth must, by now, have found its way into your inquisitive minds.
The Paranid realms are beset on all sides by unholy creatures who know nothing but senseless destruction.
There is no question that anyone would dare to propose a permanent schism.
Our third eye is an accolade.
A reminder to all of you of what We have given to one day see this realm unite.
(calm)It is truly a pity that it has come to this.
(calm, slight pause before 'disappear')I am afraid that all these bystanders will need to... disappear.
Is this transmitter operational, or did some fool forget to configure it again?
Your immediate presence is required at our headquarters, follower.
I am in deep contemplation. Speak to my advisor, Dal Busta.
(angry)These three-eyed imbeciles are refusing to allow the negotiations to progress beyond the stage of ceasefire!
(grumpy, looking to the side)It was a different era, and I was a different sort of leader then.
I must commend you on your work, my faithful followers.
I have meticulously screened all hatched Paranid for their capabilities and chosen the ideal candidate for the grave and momentuous position of Third Pontifex.
The remaining candidates will form a mighty entourage for this most powerful being.
The support of these most brilliant High Priests of our own making almost assures the cooperation of the Holy Order.
However, the Godrealm will most certainly refuse to join our pact until their sacred scriptures clearly state that a Third Pontifex is in accordance with their contrived geometry.
The vast archives of the Alliance of the Word contain holy writs of each and every age, capable of convincing these dogmatic fools of any genuine or invented truth.
Go now and fetch them for me, follower.
Your wretched plan to manipulate my people has ultimately served me well.
The Paranid will thrive and prosper as they once did.
Do what you want with that turgid tome. I have no use for it.
This intimidating station shall henceforth be a grand buttress of my holy conquest.
I will require control of this sector to persevere with my operations.
Your loyalty will not be forgotten.
Power comes in many forms, and I had almost forgotten the sustaining vigour that this one carries with it.
I can feel it almost driving away the weariness wrought by watching my brethren wither under the yoke of the weak and misguided Pontifices.
Do not think for one moment that I have forgotten the role you played in that wretched plan to manipulate my people.
However, in return for opening my eyes to the grim finality of war, I offer you a simple choice.
Fight alongside my reborn armada, or watch idly as the cleansing tempest passes you by.
May my enemies find enlightenment as they burn!

page.title: Mission Paranid NPC 2 / Paranid Story - Generic
page.descr: Lines for Mission Paranid NPC 2
page.t: (choleric)Heresy! The wrath of Xaar should tear you to pieces at this very moment!
Our worst enemies stand right before Us!
You defile the teachings of Bashra with your flagrant disregard for the sacred geometry!
Countless pretender realms have already been quashed, and the Heretical Order will suffer the same fate!
To even suggest the coexistence of two Pontifices is nothing short of heresy!
(intensely)You have shunned your kind for far too long to be able to understand what any true believer would dare to do.
Certainty will be gained through grasping the entirety of our three-dimensional reality.
(pitying)And how could you ever achieve that, with only two eyes?
(cruel)It is a mark of shame, born of trying to take what belongs to the Pontifex alone!
And this realm will unite under the true embodiment of the Holy Three-Dimensionality alone, one way or another!
Have you led Us into a trap, Kromancketslat?
Even if it is our last deed, you shall die for this treachery, apostate!
It appears that we need to put aside our quarrel for the time being, Rikmanckassor.
These unholy creatures require our attention.
(cold)All this effort, only to betray your kin and erase all of our futures?
Finally, something we can agree on, brother.
Your puny vessel shall be torn asunder by the righteous fury of Xaar's faithful!

page.title: Mission Paranid NPC 3 / Terraforming Story - Yaki Scientist
page.descr: Lines for Mission Paranid NPC 3
page.t: Is this creature qualified?(Referring to non-Paranid Player)
Is this one qualified?(Referring to Paranid Player)
You must be the new assistant.
Let us put you right to work!

My other assistant(female assistant), your colleague of sorts going forward, is currently testing a new alloy composition with magnetic shielding, which should protect her from the hazardous zone she is currently in.
However, she seems to be having trouble with other onboard systems and has not yet been able to escape the caustic cloud.
Apparently the radiation messes with the navigation systems, otherwise she could have simply left at any point.
Do not worry. Her supplies are quite sufficient to hold out for quite some time.
If she complied with her task instructions, she should have left navigational beacons around the hazardous zone before conducting this experiment.
Locate them and find out what frequencies she is monitoring in order to establish contact.
Take note of the locational information I am about to transmit to you.
It seems your colleague(female colleague) was exceptionally cautious, and I advise you to be the same.
She installed protective measures to deter meddling Terrans and other criminals.
As long as you appear non-threatening, no harm should befall either your mechanical or your biological vessel.
If you lack Nav Beacons, you had better pick some up.('Nav Beacon' same as {20201,20801})
We will need them later to establish a link to your colleague.(female colleague)
Deal with the countermeasures evasively or violently as you see fit.
I will bill our Segarian contractee for the equipment cost.
This wreckage before you is what is left of your predecessor's ship(male predecessor).
As you can see, he was not proficient enough to navigate this dangerous space.
Needless to say he was relieved of his duties after that incident, and sent to join a maintenance crew.
Let this be a cautionary tale to you, assistant, for you will need to avoid his mistakes if you do not wish to share his fate.
Very well, we know now what frequency she is looking for to find her way out.
You should send her some calibrated Nav Beacons, to use as fixed points to navigate her way out of her misery.('Nav Beacon' same as {20201,20801})
Push a Nav Beacon into the hazardous area so that your colleague(female colleague) can receive the signal.('Nav Beacon' same as {20201,20801})
Be aware that your Nav Beacons will probably suffer corrosion themselves, so it might take a few attempts.('Nav Beacon' same as {20201,20801})
The sooner you two meet up, the sooner you can get on with your next task.
It looks like the Nav Beacon has reached the end of its life.('Nav Beacon' same as {20201,20801})
To allow your fellow assistant(female assistant) to escape her misfortune you will need to send in another Nav Beacon.('Nav Beacon' same as {20201,20801})
She is now able to move out of this radiation zone!
The alloy composition protected the systems inside from any damage!
This experiment was a thorough success!
The minor navigational issues should not pose a problem once you join my assistant(female assistant) as pilot.
The two of you will make a great expedition team!
This ship, you see, was built for an archaeological expedition.
It will survive the radiation inside the Torus wreckage.
Additionally, the systems inside are built to interface with the old Terran hardware and software.
The modified Mk7(speak "Mk7" as Mark Seven) Computational Unit will be able to extract the terraforming data that our mutual researcher friend is yearning for!
Be warned that the Terrans might not be too keen on us rummaging through their forgotten garbage pile.
Once you are ready, leave your ship somewhere safe and join my other assistant!(female other assistant)
The systems inside are built to interface with the old Terran hardware and software.
Our Segarian employer is eagerly awaiting this expedition's results.
Use your Long Range Scan to locate the Nav Beacons, but be careful to stay clear of the hazardous region.('Long Range Scan' as in {10002,433}, 'Nav Beacon' same as {20201,20801})
Do not try to test your colleague's shield in the hazardous zone.
You will need it in the mission to come, so it will not be activated unless it becomes necessary.
I suggest you get out before I am forced to find yet another assistant for the job.
You made it in. The masked ship ID worked!
Very good. It appears you two are ready for the next field test!
I purchased a forged ship ID which will allow you two to reach the Torus wreckage without questions being asked.
If you can avoid patrols, that is.
You can download the forged ID at a station and apply it directly to your ship.
My business partner, you see, was very eager for anonymity.
Good, good. Now you two should pass as Terran agricultural police, or whatever they do these days.
However, you will still need to avoid Terran police patrols.
Let us just say that not all of the modules you are equipped with are exactly legal in this space.
The police patrols in particular are equipped to recognise odd signature readings at sensor range.
But, please, do reach the Torus wreckage eventually.
But do not get complacent. You will still need to avoid Terran military patrols.
The larger ships, in particular, are equipped to recognise odd signature readings at sensor range.
Be wary, there are Terran pests in this sector.
Assistant, load the patrol roster.(female assistant)
Your colleague will warn you should you get too close to their patrol ships.(female colleague)
Avoid getting within their scanner range altogether.
Best case, they kick you out; worst case, they start shooting.
Get out and let your colleague reconfigure the ship signature before you try again.
You are strongly advised to leave Terran space.
Behold this miniscule shard of Terran hubris.
We will excavate your secrets and leave more acquainted with the technology of the Terraformers.(addressing station)
I do wonder if they are still capable of their ancient deeds.
Your colleague(female colleague) is requesting your assistance.
Enter the structure in your space suit and try to open that door to let you both in.
There have to be switches to control the main airlock doors.
There should be a maintenance switch, which you might be able to access from the spacesuit.
Switches in this structure react to the polarisation of the Hand Laser(same as {20113,1061}) and the Repair Laser(same as {20113,1001}) to toggle between states.
Other means of damage should also suffice; the switches are sturdy enough to handle most kinds of abuse.
Do not worry about that door.
You will find another way out after collecting the data.('You' plural, place referring to Torus Wreckage)
There seems to be an airlock in place.
That means another maintenance job for you.
There should be service tunnels to get you to the other side of that door.
Manually overriding those doors is a tedious endeavour, but you are getting there.
You are in a hazardous area, get out!
Now you need to open the inner airlock door.
It looks like an old security system has reactivated.
You have reached a hub for transferring ships to various parts of the Torus.
There should be controls to open the correct door.
I do not think security still work here...
That is an odd power fluctuation for a reboot.
The energy supply must be damaged.
This would have been a convenient route. Too bad it has collapsed.
This door is sealed shut. There must have been some hasty repairs during segment-separation.
Splendid! Proceed! This path should get us to the data centre.
This would be the way back, but we did not acquire any information on the Terraformers yet.
Check the walls surrounding the door. The ventilation switch should be behind some sort of shutter.
The turrets are consuming all remaining energy at this storage unit.
You will not be able to open the next door until all turrets are taken down.
We are approaching the location where your colleague(female colleague) can interface with the Torus's archives.
We have what we came for!
Let us get out of here!
You have reached the central data storage!
Now you will have to interact with the panels to release the file transfer.
Now you will have to interact with the switches to release the file transfer.
Activate all panels to grant your colleague(female colleague) access.
Activate all switches to grant your colleague(female colleague) access.
Not all the panels are accessible right away. Ignore the unresponsive ones.
Not all the switches are accessible right away. Ignore the unresponsive ones.
Pay attention to the outcome of your interactions; the panels are affecting each other.
Pay attention to the outcome of your interactions; the switches are affecting each other.
This might sound unintuitive, but it may be necessary to undo an activation in order to solve the pattern.
The security system is trying to shut us out.
Do not leave your colleague(female colleague) behind. You are both mission-critical!
If the security system manages to self-destruct you probably do not want to be there.
So, you have found your colleague!(female colleague) However, believe it or not, she will not be able to see you.
We will need to find her Nav Beacons to find out which frequencies she is monitoring before we can help her escape this unfortunate situation.('Nav Beacon' same as {20201,20801})
You got out of there! I was already wondering about possible malfunctions...
Did the data transfer go through?
Splendid! Deliver the data to this location before any pests get to you.
And that will conclude my part in our cooperation.
Both of you have been quite adequate assistants.
And I expect that both of you will work together to properly conclude our project.
The best of luck, and farewell!

page.title: Mission Paranid NPC 4 / Pioneers Civilian 1 - Yaki investigation
page.descr: Lines for Mission Paranid NPC 4
page.t: My people are spread far, and I consider it my holy duty to travel the Gate network and give spiritual guidance to those in need.
One day, these Pioneers will perceive that their work is guided by the sacred geometry of the cosmos that shaped us all.
However, I have realised, with great regret, that not even my Paranid brethren among the scientific elite can spare the time for my counsel.
Truly a tragic display of hubris. I had no choice but to withdraw to this humble place, so that I may meditate, and resume my service among the lowest of the low.
These people desperately need someone to teach them serenity and contentment. This area of the Gate network houses so many disparate peoples, so much potential for strife.

(sighs)And even on this station, there is scarcely a moment of peace. Not so long ago I observed a pilot with a terribly asymmetrical face storm through these serene halls, assailing innocent bystanders.
(pitiful)It would truly be a shame if this budding community were to wither in senseless conflict.

page.title: Mission Paranid NPC 5 / Workforce Supervisor / Welfare Research / Twins Story Race Cutscene / Buccaneer Air-Traffic Control
page.descr: Lines for Mission Paranid NPC 5
page.t: I appreciate you meeting with me.
I am a shift supervisor for one of your factories. After speaking to my superior about an issue, we felt it best to approach you.
A number of our workers are going absent, and overall productivity is down. My sources suggest that they are frequenting an entertainment centre that was recently established in a nearby sector.

That was my initial thought, too, but no. I believe we would benefit from incorporating a similar facility on our own station. It would lead to a marked improvement in worker morale, which in turn would attract more skilled workers.
I do not, but I can arrange a meeting with the administrator of that entertainment centre. He seemed rather interested in the prospect of competition.
That is my proposal. I do hope you will give it some thought.
I must return to my post. I thank you for your time.
Bah, I refuse to acknowledge this game of trinkets as a test of true intellect. Join me for a game of Triskele and I will show you how superior it is to your 'chess' in every regard.
(1/2)Approaching vessel, you are neither authorised for delivery nor for inspection.(addresses only the player in a holier-than-thou manner in all 30229XXX lines)

(2/2)In the name of the Errant Duke, the lodestar, the liberator, you are hereby commanded to vacate these premises and seek righteous plunder elsewhere.(translate "errant" as "travelling", just in a medieval-poetic way)

page.title: Mission Paranid NPC 6 / Axiom
page.descr: Lines for Mission Paranid NPC 6
page.t: (reaction to friendly fire)Hey, will you stop firing?
(reaction to friendly fire)You are wrecking my shields!
(reaction to friendly fire)Why are you shooting at me?
(* Gamestart Narration * - Pirate DLC GS 2 / Stranded)

(boastful blathering, slightly slurry speech, talking to a group of random patrons in a bar, give a boastful laugh before "Oh yes...", overly emphasise "humungous", "dashing young scoundrel" refers to the player who can be male or female, "Ministry of Finance" same as {20203,701}, trailing off at the end of the voice line)Have I ever told you about the time we went head-to-head with an armada of pirate hunters? Oh yes, things were going all sorts of sideways, and then a second, humungous fleet showed up! In a blinding revelation from the holy triangularity itself, one of us had the idea to... actually, this won't make sense unless I wind back a bit further! So, bear with me, I was in something of a spot of bother, when this dashing young scoundrel single-handedly overwhelmed the entire guard detail of a Ministry of Finance military station...
(line 2 is spoken by a different character)
Blessings, Chipmunk.(Translate 'Chipmunk' same as {30252,110}, nickname for the player, greeting)
Blessings, Wildcard.(Translate 'Wildcard' same as {30252,111}, nickname for the player, greeting)
How may my sacred teachings guide you today?(tongue-in-cheek)
Best go talk to the Maestro now.(before meeting with the Maestro)
So, the captain of this here outfit, reckons our band of misfits could do with another pilot of worthy mettle? Don't mess up the delivery!(after meeting)
(1a/6)There [mp:he|fp:she] is, my former cellmate! The chosen one!(tongue-in-cheek when referring to chosen one, pirate GS)
(2a/6)It's good to see you have recovered from our arduous escape!(Pirate GS)
(1b/6)Ah, you must be the newest member of the Empyrean Curs! I am most pleased to make your acquaintance, fellow Cur!(jovial tone, Empyrean Curs same as {30252,10}, not pirate GS)
(2b/6)I am The Axiom, but you can just call me Axiom! I'm called upon whenever the Maestro needs access to secured systems.(not pirate GS)
(2c/6)Men of lesser understanding might call me a "hacker", but I prefer the term "Counter-Security Specialist"!(from the tone it is obvious he is not quite serious, not pirate GS)
(3/6)The Maestro said you performed well on your first smuggling run.
(4/6)Despite your most unfortunate run-in with the law.(if player was approached by police)
(5a/6)That bodes well for the task at hand, my two-eyed apprentice!(if not Paranid)
(5b/6)That bodes well for the task at hand, my three-eyed apprentice!(if Paranid)
(6/6)Are you ready to have bestowed upon you, the divine knowledge of taking a station for all it is worth?
(1/8)Ah, yes... that was merely a ploy to get your attention!(pirate gs only)
(2/8)I decided I would spin a yarn to capture your imagination, and get you interested in helping me break out.(pirate gs only)
(3/8)May the three-pointedness forgive me for my transgression!("three-pointedness" not something a Paranid would usually say, pirate gs only)
(4/8)The boring truth is, that breaking out of the prison was always part of the Maestro's plan to scout that station.(pirate gs only)
(5/8)I was to gather intelligence from the deepest bowels of the station, where it would have been impossible to get to, without being caught.(pirate gs only)
(6/8)Somewhat creatively, the Maestro worked out that breaking out of the jail would be a safer bet than trying not to get caught breaking into the station, so he planned accordingly.(pirate gs only)
(7/8)However, due to a slight miscommunication, I was placed in the wrong cell!(pirate gs only)
(8/8)And there I would have stayed, rotting away, if it weren't for the... well, chosen one who was put in the cell meant for me. Stroke of luck!(pirate gs only)
(2/2)Accessing a station's security, always requires a security device of some sort. Usually crafted out of three different materials!

(1a/4)Excellent! You managed to gather all three of the elements required to assemble a Security Decryption System.(Security Decryption System same as {20201,11301}, if player came across the items during mission)

(1b/4)I can see you are already carrying with you, all the items required to craft a Security Decryption System!(Security Decryption System same as {20201,11301}, used if player carries craftable materials already)

(1c/4)What is that...? You're carrying a Security Decryption System already? Look at you coming well prepared!(Security Decryption System same as {20201,11301}, used if player already carries the crafted mission item)
(2/4)You can craft inventory items at a Crafting Bench, which you can find at a station's trade corner.
(3/4)I took the liberty of setting the closest station as your destination.
(4/4)But apprentice, be wary of patrols! The closest station is planted firmly in law-abiding waters!("waters" is meant tongue-in-cheek, line triggers if closest station is in policed space)
(1/4)Our next objective is to infiltrate a station which is worth hacking. One that is producing wares of value.
(2/4)The Maestro has informed me of which wares we require, so I took the liberty of identifying a suitable station for you to infiltrate.(conspiratorial)
(3/4)And by infiltrate, I mean dock at. No need to make things harder on yourself than they have to be!(matter of fact, in contrast to the preceding line)
(4/4)But, if you ever want to hack a station which won't allow you to dock, you can always get aboard a ship heading for that station and circumvent its docking security that way.
Splendid! Now make your way into the Engineering Section without attracting too much attention!(Engineering Section same as {20007,1051})
(1/2)Look for a terminal marked "Storage System Control Panel" and insert the Security Decryption System.(Storage System Control Panel same as {20109, 3701})
(2/2)These hacking devices are single-use, so make sure you hack the correct terminal.
Apprentice, that was not the right panel. We need to hack the storage!(player hacked the wrong panel)
(1/2)I can see you have compromised their system. The station is ejecting wares into space.
We have collected all we can. This certainly was a very successful endeavour. Pull back now!
The cargo crates were destroyed! Very unfortunate. We'll have to make do without them.(when the cargo crates were destroyed before pick up)
Someone else interfered and took the spoils that were rightfully ours! Those miscreants!(when someone not from the pirate crew collects cargo)
(1/3)We have collected all we can. This certainly was a very successful incursion.
(2/3)Chipmunk, oh chosen one! You executed your role flawlessly!(friendly ribbing)
(3/3)Allow yourself to be proud of your achievements!
Hast thou not yet seen to all the tasks appointed to you by the Maestro? Well, you probably should get to work, then.(jocular, grandiose tone for first sentence, more matter of fact for second)
It is the Security Decryption System! Ignore the other items for now!(when opening the menu)
(2/7)I see you have recovered from our first lesson! Magnificent!
(3/7)The Maestro has probably told you that he is currently hatching a plan.
(4/7)It is shaping up to be a plan of unprecedented proportions, and I have been asked to acquire blueprints as the first step.
(5/7)If we were in good standing with the Teladi people, we could buy the required blueprint.
(6/7)But they are expensive, and we are pirates...
(7/7)So, I have decided to turn this into another lesson!
(1/19)Because I don't take myself too seriously?
(2/19)Or rather, because I do not take the Paranid dogma too seriously?
(3/19)Well, it is quite simple, actually. I do not believe in it, like the others do.
(4/19)You see, even a Paranid is not born religious.
(5/19)That zeal is the result of a lengthy indoctrination, which starts immediately after a Paranid leaves the cocoon it develops in.
(6/19)It is not uncommon in Paranid society to store unhatched cocoons in stasis pods, in order to access them when a specific kind of Paranid is required.
(7/19)My cocoon was stored on a Paranid station in Windfall before the Jump Gates shut down.

(8/19)As the connections between systems slowly grew unstable, the Pontifex decreed that all Paranid stored outside of Paranid space should be transported to the nearest Paranid system in order to shore up the supply of Paranid progeny.
(9/19)I never made it outside of the Windfall system.
(10/19)A marauding group of pirates attacked the vessel in which my pod was transported.
(11/19)My pod drifted through space for a time, until I was picked up by a group of merchants that happened to pass by.
(12/19)They weren't familiar with Paranid technology, so they activated the pod and hatched me by accident.

(13/19)With the Windfall system cut off from Paranid society, I was not able to receive the customary indoctrination. And the window in which a Paranid is receptive to the religious teachings is limited.
(14/19)Now, I can fake being religious well enough if the situation calls for it, but it is an act.
(16/19)And I do not wish to hide.
(17/19)The way I am, there is a good chance I'd be shunned by my Paranid brethren. Or even killed.
(18/19)I am the victim of a frustrating situation that came about through no fault of my own.(mournful)

(19/19)But I refuse to let the weight of it all break me. Humour helps; I make light of the Paranid customs sometimes and, in its own special sort of way, it helps me cope. In my defence, these customs can appear quite funny.
(1a/7)Very well, then. As with all Counter-Security operations, success depends heavily on preparation.
(1b/7)A lesson which clearly my disciple has taken to heart! I can see you are already carrying an EMP bomb!(if player owns EMP Bomb)
(2/7)You need to acquire an EMP bomb. You can do this by crafting or by buying one from a Black Marketeer.(EMP pronounced EH-EHM-PE)
(3/7)You will also need a Bomb Launcher to attach the bombs to the station.
(4/7)And, I can see you already own a Bomb Launcher!
(5/7)I have marked a black market, where I know that the required items are in stock.
(6a/7)If you want to save some credits, you can, of course, also craft a bomb instead.
(6b/7)You already possess all the materials you require to craft an EMP bomb, so you do not need to buy one!(if player owns materials)
(7/7)Now, let us set out on our quest to steal classified blueprints!
(1/3)Chipmunk! You have acquired everything you need to steal the blueprint!
(2/3)I have identified a suitable station. The Ace has been courteous enough to drop me off there already, so that I can monitor things from the ground.
(1/2)Hey, I can see your vessel approaching!(joyous excitement)
(2/2)Now fly to the connection module I have highlighted for you.
In order to place an EMP bomb, you'll need to change into your spacesuit.(EMP pronounced EH-EHM-PE)
Good! Now attach an EMP bomb to the module that I have highlighted for you, then detonate it!
(1/2)That was the wrong type of bomb! We are not looking for structural damage.(when the player deploys the wrong bomb type)
(2/2)Switch to EMP bombs, then try again.
(1/3)There is nothing quite as satisfying as triggering an EMP bomb!
(2/3)You will see that the detonation created Signal Leaks that you can scan.
(3/3)Switch into Scan Mode and approach the Data Leak to intercept the information coming from it.
(1/5)You'll notice that you now own a blueprint for this specific station module.
(2/5)That module can now be used in the construction of your own stations.
(3/5)We can also analyse the blueprint to gain a better understanding of the target of our heist!
(4/5)Unfortunately, we can currently only steal the blueprints of non-vital Connection modules this way.
(5/5)With enough time and resources, maybe someone could find a way to circumvent that limitation.(if no research - no Boso)
It actually seems like you are already way ahead of me on that one. Incredible; the disciple is teaching the master for once!(if research)
(1/2)Curses! The security breach seems to have triggered a silent alarm on the station.
(1/4)Oh, that is not good at all. Hold on, I am trying something...
(2/4)Accessing the station mainframe... running counter-security routine... entering...(Mumbling hastily to himself)
(3/4)*** Incoherent mumbling ***(you cannot make out words any more, just a low mumble, about 3 seconds' worth)
(2/7)I am Aimanckuvaik, evangelist diplomat in the services of the Holy Godrealm of the Paranid!(very dramatic, to the patrol)
(3/7)I shall shortly forward to you, the identification issued by the hallowed authority.(to the patrol)
(4/7)Why in the name of the holy three-dimensionality are you accosting my personal escort?(enraged)
(5/7)I sent for transportation to take me off your heathen station!(obviously frustrated)
(6/7)Talks between our peoples have not gone well at all.
(7/7)By the divine triangle, do not turn this into a full-blown diplomatic incident just because, in your endless incompetence, you held up the wrong chauffeur!(righteous fury)
(3/3)Better pick me up and take me off this station right away. That identification will not hold up to any scrutiny.
(2/2)Let's get out of here! I feel like our little performance could catch up with us at any second!
(2/3)That was quite an exciting turn of events.
(3/3)But now, at least, we have the blueprint we need to gain an insight into internal station geometry!
You have to be careful handling any type of explosive. You wouldn't want to blow yourself up!
Chipmunk, you need to attach the EMP to the correct module! Check your radar to see the one I have highlighted for you!(when player attaches to the wrong module)
(Greeting)Bless you.(pun on the other greetings as this Paranid is blasphemous, might only work in English.)
(3/3)I joined the Curs right before you did.('Curs' same as {30252,10})
I was working on an improvement to the hacking attack.
Understood! We'll go with whoever finishes first.
Also eager to steal the latest tech from the Ministry Science Division?(Same division as {10201,30201092})
(1/8)While you'll be running around in Woodworm, I'll be hacking the turrets for our escape.(Woodworm same as {20102,2301}, short for the prison station name Woodworm Scrubs)
(2/8)I've developed a special Security Apparatus Chip(same as {20201,55301}) to not only overload, but overwrite, the Ministry turret Friend/Foe recognition.(Ministry same as {20203,704})
(3/8)If it works, then instead of shutting down, the turrets should start shooting in our favour.
(4/8)Unfortunately, I had to eject my cargo when I ran into Ministry police.
(5/8)Let me give you the coordinates to pick it up.
(6/8)Once you've found the chip, use it to craft the Security Apparatus and deliver it to me.(same as {20201.55201})
(7/8)I'll stay here and write a workaround for their latest firewall update.
(8/8)Maestro wouldn't like it if I left any turrets up and running, just for them to regain their primary functions.
(3/3)Let's go out there and show them what the Empyrean Curs are made of!(Empyrean Curs same as {30252,10})
I am waiting for the Security Apparatus.(same as {20201,55201})
