You should hurry, before Ace beats us to it and Maestro recalls us.

(addresses only the player in all 302526XX lines, "cheeky heretics" is a play on Paranid fanaticism)Cheeky heretics have upped their security since our last visit. We'll have to find a different exit once we're done here.
(line is specific to the prison gamestart)And here we are again, back where we started. Oh, how I've missed this place.
(triumphant)And just like that, we have free reign over level 2. They can't stop you now!
(Lucca is male)According to our intel, Lucca should be somewhere on this floor.
(1/2)Hmm, that console's connection to the cell doors has been severed. Standard procedure.
(2/2, say "adjust" as if in quotes)This will slightly raise our profile, but I should be able to... adjust it remotely.
(1/2, "triangularity" is a deliberate play on "three-dimensionality", a Paranid religious idea)If the triangularity wills it... there we go!
(2/2)The door controls should be enabled now. Try them.
(1/2)While you two were busy chatting, I've found a way to temporarily disable security in the hangar. That's where we'll hitch our ride.
(2/2)Head for the 2nd level. The Ministry seems to have installed more switches. They'll require some adjustment, but I know you love a good puzzle.
(urgent, player met a male prisoner)I feel sorry for the little lizard, I really do, but we can't compromise this mission in the name of charity.
(sceptic, player freed a male prisoner)Charitable, eh? Be careful where that mindset leads you.
(2/3)That exhaust fan may impede your movement, but it won't make our mission impossible!
(3/3)See those alcoves? That's where I'd hide if I were you, whenever the fan is blowing at full speed.
(Lucca is male, by "taken care of" he means busting him out of prison)I'm still busy making sense of the schematics for the 2nd level. Have you taken care of Lucca yet?
These airlocks are shut, so you'll need to find a way to bypass their locks.
(1/2)Magnificent! That'll give you access to half of the switches.
(2/2)There must be another console nearby that will let you remove the second cover.
(1/2)Both covers confirmed open. Let's flip some switches.
(2/2)Both covers must be open to access the manual overrides.
Excellent. You're approaching the internal hangar now. Our getaway ship is right over there.
The Raven is secured with clamps. Destroy them to release it!(Raven ship type same as {20101,22501})
If we want to make it out of here, you'll have to destroy the clamps on the hangar doors.
(Lucca is male, "triangle" is a deliberate play on "three-dimensionality", a Paranid religious idea)Holy triangle, that's the station alarm! Lucca and I are going to make a run for the ship!
(1/2, variant 2, tongue in cheek)All fugitives on board.
(nervous)By the prophets, get those hangar doors open!
(1/3)Right on time! I've just managed to override the controls.
(3/3, Lucca is male)Now, jump on board and get us out of here! I'll look after Lucca.
Indeed. This little counter-security spectacle that we cooked up will serve as a handy distraction, should things go haywire.(if Axiom mission)
(2/2)They'll not expect you to use their precious ship for the getaway.("you" addressing the player)
(3/6)I have to admit, I am nervous!
(4/6)Sure, I have been involved in large-scale operations before, but never quite like this.
(5/6)I just hope the Maestro can keep his cool throughout it all.
(6/6)The fact that his brother is now involved, is weighing heavily on him. Mellerd sure knew how to provoke a reaction!
Okay, this is it! Initiating docking.
(1/3)You know what to do, right? I will spoof your credentials, so that you can gain entry into the prison complex again.
(2/3)Then locate Lucca. I'll talk you through the rest.(Lucca is male)
(1a/3)You are leaving in your spacesuit?(if player leaves ship in spacesuit, surprised)
(1b/3)What just happened? You disappeared!(if player teleports away, surprised)
(2/3)That is not part of the plan!(slightly annoyed)
(3/3)I will continue on my way. We shall reconvene on the station!
Thrice blasted! Mellerd deployed a capital ship to head off the Arcadian Endeavour!(nervous)
The Arcadian Endeavour is taking heavy fire! We need to do something!(worried)
(1/3)I will now execute the software that I injected into the station's system.(if Axiom mission)
(2/3)I have taken control of the station's turrets. Calculating new targets...(if Axiom mission)
(1/2)Yes, I have already taken all the readings that were required, while we were heading back to the Arcadian Endeavour.
(2/2)This data will go a long way towards making our pirate incursions more efficient.
(1/2)Wildcard, this is the wrong ship...? Oh no!(first confusion, then horror)
(angry)Why'd you do this? We were wrong to trust you!(accusatory)
(1/2)The Ministry is working on some fascinating technology.(fascinated)
(2/2)This will take me some time to work through.(lost in thought)
Wildcard, are you coming along?(when player takes too much time to board)
This prototype ship does not appear to have an emergency eject system. I assume it was supposed to be added later.(nervous, optional if emergency eject disabled)
Ah, to die in a blaze of pirate glory!(almost appreciative, when character dies)
(2a/3)The hangar is on the top floor.
(2b/3)The hangar with our getaway ship in it, is on the top floor.
(3/3)We'll need to work our way up.
(1a/4)Access to the top floor is restricted, but you should be able to unlock it from the floor below.
(1b/4)Access to the top floor is restricted, and there is also a giant fan you'll need to turn off, but you should be able to resolve this from the floor below.
(2/4)Luckily for us, their whole power supply ended up a bit unstable when they added the hangar to the structure.
(3/4)You'll find the switches that manage the top floor power supply, somewhere around the second floor.
(4/4)Once you shut them off, we're in.
(2/2)They haven't found me yet, and I'll keep my head down, but eventually I'll need to join you two to get off the station.(you two refers to player \053 male NPC)
(2/2)See if you can find a way to open them.
(3/3)There will be shutter controls on the same floor as the shutters.
(2/2)See if you can find a way in.
There should be an access switch somewhere around the airlock.
(1/2)That was half of them!(Player opened half the switches)
(1/2)The other half of the floor is only accessible through the airlock.
(2/2)Get in there to open those shutters!
You'll need access to all switches to shut down the power supply.
(2/2)Turn the switches off to cut the power supply to the upper level.
(2/4)The switches are also setting the state of their neighbours.(Neighbouring switches)
(3/4)You'll have to find a combination which turns them all off.
(4/4)I don't think a game of whack-a-mole will get you there. Though... actually, it might!
(2/3)And it turned off the darned fan!
(1/3)We got it! The ship with the secret compartment.
(2/3)The mod on this ship conceals illegal wares from police scans.
(3/3)This will revolutionise smuggling once it hits the market!
No, no! You need to turn them off, not on. We need the red light.(player turned all switches on instead of off)
(whispering, speaks only to the player and addresses them as a fellow prisoner in all 30288XXX lines)Psst, hey!
(whispering, louder)Over here, in the other cell.

(1/3, no more whispering, but still somewhat softly, "Hinu" is pronounced "Hee-nuh")Looks like this is your lucky day, two-eyes. That's the bunk of Hinu Hurricane, legendary pirate. Ministry "disappeared" her before she got the chance to escape.

(2/3, softly)Not before prepping her cell, though. "Golden ticket", the inmates call it. The guards never found out, but for some thrice-forsaken reason they haven't stuffed anyone else in there, ever.

(3/3, softly, "triangularity" is a deliberate play on "three-dimensionality", a Paranid religious idea)Ah, but that's exactly where you ended up, didn't you? And by the triangularity, you'll be the one to finally get us out of here.
(softly, enthusiastic)What are you waiting for, check every nook and cranny! There's got to be something to that tale.
(softly)That panel by the door, maybe? Mine's punched in tight, but that could be it.
(jubilant)Praise the twinkling stars, you did it!

(impressed that the player solved the puzzle without help, translate freely to something blasphemous for a Paranid)Well, draw a square on my forehead and brand me a heretic, you figured that out all by yourself?
Let's have a little chat, shall we?
(tongue in cheek)Be welcome at my threshold, chosen one.
I'm The Axiom, but you can call me Axiom; my pleasure. These Ministry goons think I'm a hacker, but that only shows how grossly they underappreciate my craft.
(1/3)Here's the deal: if you can get me out of this cell, then I'll get you off this station.
(2/3, say "gaining access" as if in quotes)I've already tried hacking... I mean, gaining access to the security system, but the power fluctuations are resetting it constantly. Probably on purpose.
(3/3)If you can tamper with the generator, and make the station module switch to backup power, I'll have a brief window to open my cell.
(1/3)Here, take this communicator so we can coordinate.
(2/3)I have insider information on the prison layout, and I'll guide you remotely. Don't ask, it's part of my job.
(3/3, tongue in cheek)I'll wait here and tidy up my cell. Looks like I'll be released early.
(amused)Sure, have a look around first. I don't have any other plans today.
(1/2, amused)Leaving so soon? And I thought you'd share your good fortune with a fellow inmate.
(2/2, amused)Suit yourself, but you won't get far without me.
Don't bother, that console is disabled without a guard present. Would've been too easy.
(slightly annoyed)Don't you have somewhere else to be?

(1/3, alternative to 30288103 if player is Paranid, no more whispering, but still somewhat softly, "Hinu" is pronounced "Hee-nuh")Looks like this is your lucky day, three-eyes. That's the bunk of Hinu Hurricane, legendary pirate. Ministry "disappeared" her before she got the chance to escape.
Enter the airlock and get into your spacesuit.
Enter the airlock to get out of your spacesuit.
That door is locked shut, don't bother trying to get through.
The power switch should be somewhere nearby.
(1/3, triumphant)Aha! See, now there's a barrier I hadn't anticipated.
(2/3, stops himself from saying "hacker")Good thing you're carrying a master ha... I mean, security specialist in your pocket!
(2/2)You're supposed to cause a power outage so that I can escape my cell!
(1/2, grumbling, just got left behind, the "cell neighbour" is the player)That's one terrific cell neighbour I ended up with. Truly endearing.
(2/2, grumbling)Looks like I'll have to do it all by myself... again.
(1/2, amused, comically overemphasise "chosen one")Surprised to see me, chosen one?

(2/3, lecturing tongue-in-cheek, "Bashra" was a Paranid spiritual teacher, fumbling at the end while trying to remember a saying, switching to an indifferent attitude when saying "eh, whatever")Well, as old Bashra used to say, our three-dimensional reality is a prison, and I'm its... I'm... eh, whatever.
(3/3, indifferent)I ended up bribing a guard.
(1/2, tongue in cheek)Well done! Looks like the holy whatever consecrated the right guy.
(2/2)And there's our ride out. Ahead of time. I hope they're not drawing too much suspicion.
(1/3)On with the show! Triangulating possible escape vectors.
(2/3)Our optimal extraction point looks to be an airlock located on the lower level of the maintenance tunnels.
That will do it, now return to the airlock!
(2/4, "triangularity" is a deliberate play on "three-dimensionality", a Paranid religious idea)And if the holy triangularity allows... no, it's still locked.
(3/4, sighs)Looks like you'll need to find a weapon to get through.
(4/4)Try searching the other cell blocks, sometimes weapons are confiscated and put in storage.
Your new laser is low powered, but if you keep it aimed at the lock, it will break eventually.
(1/2)Truly magnificent work, and our getaway ship is about to arrive at the dock as well.
(2/2)Keep a few eyes out, I'm on my way.
(tongue in cheek)I have boarded our noble craft. What are you waiting for, chosen one?
Approaching the dock. I'll be with you in a moment.
Leave the other prisoners, we can always come back later. It won't do them any good if we let ourselves get captured now.
(2/2)If you get back into your spacesuit, you're on your own.
(1/2)(worried)That's a dangerous path you're taking, but good luck out there.
(2/2)("triangle" is a deliberate play on "three-dimensionality", a Paranid religious idea)If the divine triangle wills it, we'll meet again.
("Arcadian Endeavour" same as 30252,201)Setting course for the Arcadian Endeavour.
(1/3)There's a lot of activity in that sector, so our rendezvous should go unnoticed.
(2/3, tongue in cheek, grave)Rejoice, two-eyes! You'll meet the Maestro soon.
(3/3)He has a... peculiar kind of charm, so stay on your toes. I assure you, you'll want to end up in his good books.
He's an independent entrepreneur. One who has a great interest in acquiring new talent; people who display a strong affinity for "doing the right thing". Like you.
(1/2, "Arcadian Endeavour" same as 30252,201)The Arcadian Endeavour, our ship. Don't ask me about the name, something to do with woolly terran animals and crime in paradise.
(2/2)The Maestro thought it prudent to get hold of a mobile base, and I tend to agree. You'll see soon enough.
There's a gate up ahead. We're about to enter lawless space, so strap yourself in.
There she is! Our very own pirate... I mean, adventurers' base. Isn't she a beauty?
(tongue in cheek)Now, observe my impressive docking manoeuvres, mortal!
(1/4)Ah, sweet familiar premises. I think I'll make a visit to the bridge to catch up with the rest of the crew.
(2/4)Now run and find Maestro, our captain, and tell him I sent you. He'll give you something to do to take your mind off that turbulent episode.
(3/4)And remember to conduct yourself properly. Yes, he's brilliant and compassionate and all that, but he's still a Split.
(4/4)I don't want to have to come over and scrape what's left of you off the walls.
Oh, I almost forgot, our getaway ship is already written off. Consider it your initiation gift.
(2/3, alternative to 30288182 if player is Paranid, tongue in cheek, grave)Rejoice, three-eyes! You'll meet the Maestro soon.

page.title: Mission Paranid NPC 7 / BUC/TEM Faction Representative
page.descr: Lines for Mission Paranid NPC 7
page.t: (Allied greeting)May the skies be cleansed by the Duke's will.
(Promotion ceremony - intro)You were ordered to appear before Us, and now you are here in the flesh.
(Promotion ceremony - cntd, friendly)We recognise that, despite the limited potentialities before you, you have served our good Duke well enough.
(Promotion ceremony - cntd, allied)Your zealous exploits continue to impress our warriors, which is why We are commanded to present you with a singular opportunity.
(Promotion ceremony - handing over 'medal', friendly)We are therefore pleased to welcome you to the ever-growing ranks of His faithful Buccaneers.
(Promotion ceremony - handing over 'medal', allied)Our righteous Duke has personally requested your admission into His Honour Guard. May His enemies cower before you.
(Promotion ceremony)This new standing provides you with the ideal tools to do battle in the Duke's name.
(Promotion ceremony - fluff line to spread notifications out 1)However, you would do well to remember that the sword of His judgement may just as easily turn against you.
(Promotion ceremony - fluff line to spread notifications out 2)If you continue to serve us, this will remain a mere shadow of a possiblity.
(Promotion ceremony - fluff line to spread notifications out 3)We otherwise grant you permission to use these privileges as you see fit.
(Promotion ceremony - subgroup licence hint)Once word of your exaltation reaches them, certain lodges among our war host may deign to approach you.
(Promotion ceremony - outro)Go now, and continue to serve as the instrument of our conquest.
(Promotion ceremony - outro cntd)Duke's will be done.
(Start of greeting)On behalf of the Duke's faithful: (keep space)

page.title: Mission Paranid NPC 8 / TRI Faction Representative
page.descr: Lines for Mission Paranid NPC 8
page.t: (Promotion ceremony - intro)It was provident of you to heed Our call.
(Promotion ceremony - cntd, friendly)Through diligent persistence, you have proven yourself to be a faithful servant of our people.
(Promotion ceremony - cntd, allied)You have graciously taken the opportunity We have given you, and used your new-found power in service of the realm.
(Promotion ceremony - handing over 'medal', friendly)Our attention rests favourably upon you, and We shall see to it that the entire realm recognises your merit.
(Promotion ceremony - handing over 'medal', allied)As of now, you shall therefore be known as a Seeker of the Holy Light, and carry forth the Pontifices' will.
(Promotion ceremony)As you carry this esteemed title with dignity, fate shall open its gates to countless new possibilities.
(Promotion ceremony - fluff line to spread notifications out 1)Be aware that, should you misstep along your path, these gates may very well close again before you.
(Promotion ceremony - fluff line to spread notifications out 2)However, We have verified the calculation, and such a future appears to be improbable.
(Promotion ceremony - fluff line to spread notifications out 3)You will henceforth go, and enjoy the rewards We have gifted you.
(Promotion ceremony - subgroup licence hint)Certain congregations within our realm may seize this opportunity to approach you. Prepare yourself.
(Promotion ceremony - outro)May you never stray from your consecrated path.
(Promotion ceremony - outro cntd)The Pontifices will it so.
(Start of greeting)On behalf of the Realm of the Trinity: (keep space)

page.title: Mission Paranid NPC 9 / ALI Paranid
page.descr: Lines for Mission Paranid NPC 9
page.t: The connection that binds us as an interstellar community is fragile, even tenuous. Nothing has proved that more than the Jump Gate shutdown and the resulting turmoil. As the Alliance of the Word, we strive to strengthen the bond between the peoples inhabiting our galaxy. And you, too, shall do your part!

As the Commonwealth begins to regroup, to reconnect, the continuing isolation of our Boron allies is shrouded in mystery; our only means of communication, irregular messenger drones, through which we have, just now, received word from Kingdom End again! The Boron are thriving, and seemingly investigating Jump Gate technology! We are now dispatching a research expedition to investigate further, and you have been accepted to join our endeavour.
(1/3)The Alliance of the Word seeks enquiring minds. Interested scientists should convene at our expedition staging grounds in Heretic's End.(as a broadcast, not just addressed to the player)
(2/3)We intend to illuminate the mysteries of Jump Gate technology.
(3/3)All are welcome. Science knows no boundaries of race or faction.
(1/4)This automated message is being broadcast exclusively in the proximity of Heretic's End.(as a broadcast)
(2/4)Signs indicate that we will imminently witness the extraordinarily rare reactivation of a Jump Gate.
(3/4)The Alliance of the Word has assembled an expedition to study this rare event.
(4/4)A reactivation - able to be investigated scientifically - is an exceedingly uncommon opportunity. You are welcome to join us!
(1/17)I, Numanckaret, welcome you, in my capacity as Commanding Officer of this expedition.(addressing a gathering of people, official tone)
(2/17)In our complacency, we treated the gates as an eternal gift from a higher power. We did not make sufficient effort to understand the technology.
(3/17)This is how the galaxy has found itself in this predicament.(contemplative)
(4/17)The Alliance of the Word is a collective of scholars and scientists, intent on advancing understanding through cooperation.
(5/17)Word reached us from the Boron of Kingdom End some months ago, via the messenger drone network.
(6/17)It seems they may be making some headway with their gate technology experimentation.(Kingdom End same as {20005,2009})
(7/17)At first, I will admit, we dismissed the notion.
(8/17)So many scientists have tried, and failed, to interact with the gate network.
(9/17)But now the dormant gate at Heretic's End is showing infrequent, but undeniable, signs of activity.
(10/17)This may or may not be related to the Boron experiments. But the timings coincide too starkly to ignore.
(11/17)It is the talk of the galactic scientific community.
(12/17)This expedition was tasked with resolving the many unknowns of this situation.
(13/17)If the Boron have truly succeeded in manipulating the jump gate... the consequences are beyond significant.(talking more to himself than the audience)
(14/17)But let us not get ahead of ourselves.(More matter of fact)
(15/17)We could be reuniting with our Boron brethren. Equally, we could find ourselves welcoming a fleet of Xenon destroyers.
(16/17)We need scouts willing to help us explore this unknown space.(If player accepted mission offer)
(17/17)We know nothing of what lies beyond.
It would be best to come well prepared.(If player accepted mission offer)

Of course, everyone is welcome to attend the investigation. Though please do remain at a safe distance until the risks are more clear.(If player did not accept mission previously, just happens upon the scene)
(1/2)I am delighted to see that everyone has made it!(If player has accepted mission and established connection with the expedition)
(2/2)Explorer, please fall into formation to accommodate the remaining attendees.(if player not on board Alliance ship but has accepted mission)
(1/2)Initial scans indicate some activity. We will need to get closer for a more thorough read on the situation.
(2/2)Mission Specialist, approach the gate nacelle and interface with it to initialise a direct datastream for our on-board science team.(addressing female mission specialist)
(2/2)Mission Specialist, remain here and establish an outpost to derive a complete reading of the Gate's coordinate data.(talking to female character)
You there! You may join our expedition if you wish. We can always use another capable explorer.(warm, inviting; referring to player, if not yet accepted the mission)
(1/2)It does not look like events will unfold any time soon. I do not think we are in an immediate rush.(calm and composed)
(2/2)Fulfil your obligations to the Terran Protectorate, then return to us once more.(addressing player)
It seems like a tear in...(observing a phenomenon, interrupted mid-sentence)
(1/6)This is an historic expedition, without compare in a lifetime. I am overjoyed to see you here.(welcoming, speaking directly to the player)
(2/6)We were rather hoping to be enjoying a reunion with Kingdom End after gate reactivation.(Kingdom End same as {20005,2009})

(3/6)The most recent Boron missive indicates that this has been the overwhelming focus of their civilisation's scientific resources. So you will forgive us, perhaps, for being seduced by the possibility.
(4/6)One thing is clear; what lies beyond this gate is not Kingdom End.

(5/6)Telemetry shows that this system is annotated as "Watchful Gaze". Yet we cannot detect whether it is itself isolated, or connects further to any number of other systems.(Watchful Gaze same as {20005,9009})
(6/6)In any case, this unknown space will need charting, and its mysteries beg to be uncovered.
(1/2)Preliminary scans indicate that this system is uninhabited.(matter of fact)
(2/2)No sign of Boron or any other kind of life, biological or artificial.
(1/3)Take heart, Boron exile. You may yet be a step closer to your reunion.(reassuring)
(2/3)Explorer. We need some detailed system mapping. The task is in your hands.
(1/4)Coordinates and timing are relevant but not conclusive. The fact of the matter is that this is definitively not Kingdom End.(matter of fact)
(2/4)Interstellar messenger drones are not the fastest form of communication. We do not know what has occurred on the Boron side since their last message.
(3/4)Theoretically, a connection between the two gates is possible. But that is just a theory.
(4/4)It could well be that the systems were linked in the distant past.
(2/3)At this point, any further hypothesis would be mere speculation. Until we have more evidence, keep your ideas off general comms.
(3/3)If you must elaborate your theories, feel free to put them in writing.
(1/2)The Alliance of the Word thanks you for your support.(official sounding, grateful)
(2/2)We shall proceed alone from here on. Our military friends are needed elsewhere.
Let us get this system mapped. Your ship's long range scans will be of particular benefit when exploring vast distances!
(1/2)Preliminary data has identified some points of potential interest. We are having trouble locking on to exact locations at this range.
(2/2)See if you can pinpoint them for us.
(1/2)The Alliance has little use for a miner. Explorer, keep the ship.
(2/2)Do with it what you wish. Do not neglect to crew the vessel appropriately, if you wish to make optimal use of it.
(2/2)Whatever it is, it has been thoroughly plundered. There is not enough data for our algorithms to work out what it was originally.
(1/3)Explorer! You have an unidentified ship on an intercept trajectory!(agitated)
(2/3)This is our first contact in the newly opened network. We have no idea of who they are... or their intentions.
(3/3)Investigate and, if possible, make contact. But maintain vigilance!(slightly worried)
(1/2)Incredible! Finally, contact with our aquatic allies!(happy, astonished)
(1/2)As appointed delegate of the Alliance of the Word, please allow me to extend my greetings to you and your people.(authoritative)
(2/2)It is an honour to make your acquaintance, Nila Ti.
(1/5)Momentous news indeed, although we are less than clear on how this has occurred.
(2/5)There was speculation that the Boron triggered the gate reinitialisation.
(3/5)Messages from your scientists indicated that they were working on such a task.
(4/5)Please. Can you direct us towards Kingdom End?
(5/5)We must make haste. There is much to be discussed with your leadership.(reassuring)
(1/4)We must not lose heart. The opening of this gate means that change is ahoof.(reassuring)
(2/4)We must press on if we are to solve this mystery.(determined, emphasis on must)
(3/4)The reconnection of this part of the network gives us much to explore and understand. This is our mission.
(4/4)But without access to Kingdom End, your Queen and parliament, how do you govern yourselves?
Thus, we embark into the unknown once more. Be alert to dangers ahead.
(1/2)Explorer. You have displayed some usefulness thus far.
(2/2)I am tasking you with joining us in meeting the Royal Steward. I may have need of your insights.
(1/3)Esteemed Royal Steward Leda We. Thank you for your most gracious welcome.(official-sounding, grateful)
(2/3)You must forgive me. I, Numanckaret, am no Empire emissary.
(3/3)I represent the Alliance of the Word, a diplomatic forum and scientific organisation, funded by various races across the network.
(1/8)I am compelled to reiterate. I do not speak for the Paranid authorities.
(2/8)Though we do bring news which may bring joy.
(3/8)We have been in communication with Kingdom End. Limited, fragile communication... but communication nevertheless.
(4/8)Some months ago we received word from your homeworld.
(5/8)It was heartening to discover that the Boron core has survived the shutdown, and learn of their most ambitious endeavour.
(6/8)Their entire scientific resources are focused on understanding and manipulating Jump Gate technology.
(7/8)We humbly request your permission to investigate the dormant Jump Gates in your territory...
(8/8)...and to set up a scientific outpost in the region, should that be required.
(2/2)We ask for no more than your permission. We certainly have no wish to be a drain on your resources.
(1/3)Honoured host, we will of course expedite communications with the governments of the network.(trying to be amicable)
(2/3)I am sure emissaries are preparing as we speak.
(3/3)Yet... if we could simply...(Grasping for words)
(2/3)The Boron Queen's government itself is racing to reconnect, and you decline to facilitate?
(3/3)What kind of Royal Steward are you?
(1/3)This is absurd! Our work is of the utmost importance.(dismissive, angry)
(2/3)Your obduracy is beyond me. I shall take my leave.
(3/3)Heading to the dock, awaiting pick up.(muttering to someone on comms)
(2/5)You have underestimated both the influence of the Alliance of the Word, and the importance to the network of reconnecting with Kingdom End.
(3/5)As we speak, our representatives are in conference with our allies. The agenda is how, and indeed whether, there should be trade with the Provinces Adrift.(Provinces Adrift same as {20203,3401})
(4/5)Your ludicrous obstruction leaves me no choice but to twist your arms... uh, fins.(flustered at his choice of words)
(5/5)If your economy is your priority, then I hold the keys to unlock it.(threatening)
(1/2)You have our word, Leda We.(reassuring, calm)
(2/2)We shall do everything in our power to avoid undue provocation.
(1/3)We are most grateful. You have been an exemplary host.(grateful)
(2/3)Explorer, you have done well to secure access for us to continue our mission.(addressing player)
(3/3)Please claim the scout ship as your own. May it serve you well.
(1/3)Who does this fool think he is?(worked up)
(2/3)Does he not understand the gravity of our mission?(talking more to himself)
(3/3)Withholding his consent? We shall continue without it if necessary!(angry)
(1/3)Why do you think I remain on this fool's dock? And who are you to tell me to calm myself?(angry at the player, lashing out)
(2/3)I appreciate your contributions to our mission, but do not forget that I remain your superior!(calmer, but threatening)
(3/3)I must clear my head of the fool's petulance before I return to my post.(returning to normal tone)
(1/3)Hmm... you may have a point.(considering what the player said, calm)
(2/3)Perhaps his simple mind cannot grasp all the variables at play.(derogatory towards the other character, but not meaning to be malicious)
(3/3)I wonder if we can help him to see the bigger picture.(pondering)
(1/4)Yes, you are right. That much is obvious.
(2/4)I cannot help but wonder if there is more to the issue than that.
(3/4)Perhaps he is overly attached to his role as prime administrator of the Provinces.
(4/4)A reunion with Kingdom End would inevitably result in him having to relinquish power and standing...
(1/3)Ah, I understand.(acknowledging crucial piece of info)
(2/3)He is worried that our presence will stir up an infestation of the chitterers?(chitterers refers to the Kha'ak)
(3/3)The Alliance of the Word is certainly prepared to provide assurances that our investigation will not leave him exposed to Kha'ak attacks.
(1/6)Well, we are a scientific expedition, so our offensive options are rather limited in that regard.(pondering options)
(2/6)What we can do, however, is make assurances that any valuable equipment that is transported into Boron space will be well-guarded, making it an unappealing target.
(3/6)Furthermore, I am prepared to place several scouts at his disposal, and to establish a network of satellites in Watchful Gaze.
(4a/6)That will give the Split cause to reconsider an incursion into the Provinces.(If Split DLC)
(4b/6)That will give any potential pirates cause to reconsider an incursion into the Provinces.(If no Split DLC)
(5/6)The situation with this steward does indeed seem resolvable. Though I fear he wears my patience thin.
(6/6)Take this matter in hand. Go and see the fool. Perhaps you can change his mind.
We must coordinate with the administrator of the Provinces Adrift before we can continue onwards with our expedition.
We need to investigate the dormant gates to formulate the next step of our expedition.
(1/5)Excellent! The Alliance shall investigate Barren Shores.(excited to get started)
(2/5)That only leaves the matter of the final gate, the location of which is somewhat more... precarious.
(3a/5)Explorer, you have excelled thus far.(commending the player; If SoD unvisited)
(4a/5)Put that new fighter of yours to good use, and find Sanctuary of Darkness.(If SoD unvisited)
(3b/5)Explorer. You know Sanctuary of Darkness. I understand you have been there before.(If the player already visited SoD)
(5/5)It seems that you are best suited to this task.
(2/3)According to our archives there was once a Xenon presence hereabouts in the network.
Now, see if you can locate the inactive gate in this system.
(1/3)Explorer! Do not approach the Kha'ak installation!(worried)
(2/3)We have given Leda We our word that we will not engage them unless they engage us.
(3/3)There is no need for undue provocation.
(2/2)Approach the Jump Gate nacelle. Try to get a reading.
(1/5)Each Jump Gate has two pairs of nacelles. They act as caches for storing operational data, among many other things.

(2/5)We are still not very familiar with this technology, or who created it. But, thanks to recent scientific advancements, we are able to make sense of some of the information that we are retrieving.
(3/5)It seems apparent that some of the data likely represents the coordinates of other Jump Gates.

(4/5)Whether this means that these Gates were connected in the distant past is mere conjecture. Perhaps the builders had reasons unknown to us for certain gates to hold a... special compatibility.(considering the final words carefully)
(5/5)The vast majority of the data in these caches remains a vexing mystery to us all.
(1/2)We have gathered everything we can access from this nacelle.
(2/2)Move on to the one on the opposite side!
(1/2)Yes, some of this data looks rather promising.(absorbed in thought)
(2/2)I am forwarding all of this to our science team, as we speak.
Yes. It appears that our activity has drawn the attention of Kha'ak stragglers.(calm and resolute)
(1/3)Our science team has pored over the data that Nila Ti was able to lift from the cache.
(2/3)While we have not yet completed our examination of the Sanctuary of Darkness cache, it is quite obviously the most promising of the gates.
(3/3)Despite the additional challenges the Kha'ak will represent.
(1/6)Perhaps, once the Provinces have re-established their economy, they can attempt some terraforming.
(2/6)For now, this expedition needs you to map out safe passage for a larger fleet to navigate through Sanctuary of Darkness.
(3/6)You can use Nav Beacons to determine an appropriate route.(Nav Beacon same as {20201,20801})
(4/6)Just stay clear of the Kha'ak installations.
(5/6)And other hazardous regions, obviously.(almost joking, emphasis on the obviously)
(6/6)For a better overview of the task in hand, do not hesitate to consult your map.
(1/3)It appears you lack sufficient Nav Beacons.(Nav Beacon same as {20201,20801})
(2/3)You can acquire them at any wharf, shipyard or equipment dock.
(3/3)I believe we passed a wharf in Great Reef, as we made our way into this system.(if Boron wharf in GR exists currently)
Do you wish to lead us right into enemy hands? That Nav Beacon is too close to the Kha'ak!(confused, exasperated)
Explorer, I am not convinced that this is the best route. We are in extreme proximity to a Kha'ak installation!(uncertain)
I am afraid this route would expose our fleet to unnecessary risks. The Kha'ak are too near to this location.
The Nav Beacon is not close enough to either gate.
The Nav Beacon you just placed is too far away from any other beacon.
You placed the Nav Beacon outside the range of any prior beacons.
This beacon is too far away from either a gate or a previously placed beacon.
What are you thinking? We cannot navigate through hazardous space!
Try a different position! One that does not lead us through hazardous space!
(1/4)Yes, it looks like you have found a route!(happy)
(2/4)Nicely done, explorer!(proud of the player's achievements)
(3/4)Everyone, move in! The expedition shall now establish a scientific outpost.
(4/4)This may be the beginning of a most fruitful phase in our journey together!
Go on, make sure you find your way through Sanctuary of Darkness!
(1/13)We have established a perimeter around the inactive Jump Gate. Now we are commencing the construction of an outpost.
(2/13)Do not elevate your hopes quite yet.(placating the player)
(3/13)Experimentation shall begin soon, but Jump Gate technology is very alien, and highly volatile.
(4/13)We do not know for certain whether we can ever successfully force a connection, particularly without real-time coordination with our Kingdom End counterparts.
(5/13)Nonetheless, we have an ideal candidate Gate for experimentation.
(6/13)The Alliance of the Word has an obligation to our cousins in Kingdom End to try our utmost.
(7/13)These technological marvels have eluded our understanding to date.
(8/13)Something about the interface has remained stubbornly... out of reach.(pause after "stubbornly")
(9/13)The final spark...(more to himself than the player)
(10/13)In any case, explorer, congratulations!(snapping back to the topic)
(11/13)You have performed your part, and you have done so unimpeachably!(admiring tone)
(12/13)We will keep you updated on our progress in the coming years.
(13/13)And, if fate wills it, you might one day find your name in the annals of the great explorers and scientists!
What can I do for you, esteemed explorer?
(2/17)Thanks to your valuable contribution, we are now able to establish a Jump Gate research facility.
(3/17)In theory, for a connection between Jump Gates, one needs the correct coordinates, energy and a means to interface with the technology.
(4/17)Thanks to the cache you analysed, we have the directional information from here to Kingdom End.
(5/17)Next, we set up a mechanism by which we can power the gate.
(6/17)The Boron of Kingdom End have explained how this can be achieved.
(7/17)Fortunately, deciphering the technology to enable that, has been the focus of their research so far.
(8/17)While we are establishing the facility, the science team is working on the local environmental baseline...
(9/17)...taking into account spacetime warping from nearby stellar bodies, and so forth.
(10/17)All that will take some time, but we already know it can be done.
(11/17)In fact, we have done it before! Several times!
(12/17)The most significant hurdle, that we just cannot seem to overcome, is the Jump Gate technology interface.
(13/17)It is an incredibly complex process... but think of it as some sort of activation command.
(14/17)Frankly, making progress on that will be a significant challenge.
(15/17)I am uncertain if that is even within our technological capabilities.
(16/17)Sadly, we have nothing more for you to do at the moment.
(17/17)Our scientists are busy setting everything up.
(1/3)This... discovery that you and Boso Ta have made is tremendously interesting.(fascinated)
(2/3)I cannot yet explain how the two are connected. But, these energy readings seem to be compatible with the Jump Gate.(cautiously optimistic)
(3/3)At least according to the science team's tentative simulations.
(1/8)I do not know whether that can be said conclusively.(matter of fact)
(2/8)These are fantastical claims to be making without any weight of evidence.
(3/8)Perhaps the Jump Gates draw some of their function from anomalous occurrences... such as your synchronised stellar bodies.
(4/8)Or perhaps whoever built these Gates used the blue giant as a constant point of reference.
(5/8)One that is detectable throughout key areas of the network, and used for calibration of some kind.
(6/8)We do not yet have sufficient data... so I hesitate to spring to conclusions.
(7/8)That said, your findings certainly accelerate our scientific timeline.
(8/8)Explorer. Talk to me in person so that I may brief you on how we will proceed.
(1/4)Ah! There you are!(happy to see the player)
(2/4)I have briefed Leda We's administration on our research strategy and experimentation protocols.
(3/4)The science team is making their final calibrations.
(4/4)And, as you can see, the Alliance of the Word has worked strenuously to construct all of the necessary energy infrastructure.
(2/3)I shall defer to your judgement on when we should commence the experiment.
Science team! You have authorisation. You are green to go!(authoritative)
(2/2)Get back out there! Maintain a secure perimeter around the Jump Gate!(addressing the player)
(2/2)Return to us when you have made your preparations.
More are homing in on our position!(warning)
It appears their attack is waning in strength!(relieved)
Everyone, fall back! Regroup at my position!(with urgency)
(1/2)There is only one method for ascertaining the answer to that question.
We are indeed!(friendly, approachable, answering a question)
With the help of the local Boron population, yes!
Yes, we have just made the significant breakthrough that brings everything together.
(1/2)Explorer. You and Boso Ta were pivotal to the success of this entire undertaking.
(2/2)It would only be right for the two of you to join me in my audience with the Queen.
(1/2)Our blueprints were, of course, based on the theories that they shared with us in their transmission.
(2/2)So that should not come as a surprise.
(1/4)Establishing a connection between Jump Gates requires staggering quantities of resources.
(2/4)Yet, it appears that those resources need not be equally balanced between the Gate loci.
(3/4)Thankfully, the Boron have been laying the groundwork for our breakthrough for decades.
(4/4)We suspected that that was the case; hoped so, even. But until now, we could not be entirely certain.
(1/3)You are most welcome, your majesty!(graciously accepting thanks)
(2/3)The pursuit of knowledge and unity is my paramount drive.
(3/3)I could no more relinquish the task than I could cease breathing.
(1/3)I would be honoured to oversee such an undertaking.
(2/3)And I already know the perfect candidate to take up these emissarial duties.
(1/6)To be the first outsiders to step in front of a Boron queen in decades! How incredible!(genuinely excited)
(2/6)And you get a promotion to royal emissary! Congratulations!(happy)
(3/6)I shall do my best to coordinate your tasks and duties.
(6/9)I shall return to the expedition, to oversee the science team.
(7/9)So much data to pore over. So many questions still unanswered!(intrigued)
(8/9)You have performed a great service to the scientific community! Thank you!
(1/2)We did it! We actually opened a Jump Gate!
(2/2)I must report back to the Alliance of the Word headquarters immediately!
(1/4)Before we commence with business matters, may I say that it is a great honour to work with you, heralds, on your royal mission.
(2/4)My part is to provide you with the necessary information for your mission manager, and to monitor your progress.
(3/4)Other than that, I will contact you should the need arise.
(4/4)Please make yourself familiar with your mission manager by activating the training mission we have prepared.
(2/9)Over the course of this endeavour, there will be multiple missions for you to choose from.
(3/9)While it is your duty to complete all missions, the order in which you pursue them is a matter for your own discretion.
(4/9)You are now ready to embark upon your voyage.
(5/9)As mentioned, I will update your mission manager and contact you should the need arise. But for now, you will be left to your own devices.
(9/9)See it through thoroughly to completion, and you will be the pride of the Queendom!
(1/2)You can find all the required information in your mission manager.
(2a/2)See to it, herald(player gender), and serve your Queen!
(2b/2)See to it, herald(player gender), and serve the Queendom!
(2)Our connection was interrupted. The technicians have not yet figured out why, but the issue seems resolved.
(3)Let us get back on course, in the pursuit of Her Majesty's diplomatic endeavours.
(4a)You can find your current tasks in your mission manager.
(5a)Choose which to pursue first, and activate it for further guidance.
(4b)It seems that you have managed to find the tasks in your mission manager.
(5b)Let us see. Which faction will you visit first on Her Majesty's behalf?
(1/5)Ah, the Hatikvah Free League! A shadow of their once glorious forebears.
(2/5)Although support from the Queendom stems their decline, the League will still have far to go.
(3/5)You are to supply them with a wing of Boron fighters.
(4/5)The politicians will follow up with a negotiation for the Hatikvah Free League to acquire more Boron military vessels in the future.
(5/5)I suspect they will be grateful for the military hardware to help deter pirates and Xenon.
(1/2)Great work! This fleet will allow Hatikvah to familiarise its pilots with Boron hardware.
(2/2)Once the politicians ratify a follow-up agreement, I will ensure that you receive the announcement.
Excellent! We can check the Free League off our list.
(2/6)Paranid governments have a troubled history with the Queendom, but major factions try to maintain diplomatic relations even if they are, at times, strained.
(3a/6)The Queendom initiated a diplomatic exchange with both the Holy Order of the Pontifex and the Godrealm of the Paranid.
(3b/6)The Queendom has already commenced exchanging diplomats with the Realm of the Trinity.
(5/6)Ever since he went missing en route to the Queendom, accusations have been flying.
(6/6)It is up to us to find the missing diplomat, and calm the waves.
Great work! I have relayed the situation to the Queendom, and the Paranid diplomat is now proceeding unhindered.
Most gratifying to see my Paranid brethren normalising relations with the Queendom. Mark them off the list.
(2/10)The Queendom has no closer ally than the Argon Federation.
(3/10)However, Argon tensions with the Terrans make Boron relations with the Protectorate a matter of some delicacy.
(4/10)The Terrans have made a gracious offer to construct a Boron habitat to house a diplomatic delegation.
(5/10)To this end, we were supposed to deliver a Nishala water sample, complete with all its salts and microorganisms.
(6/10)Regrettably, our herald was not up to this simple task. He suffered some sort of emotional breakdown, and has returned to Boron space for medical attention.
(7/10)He managed to leave the water sample in a bar, of all places.
(8/10)We could just acquire another sample from Nishala, but our herald will face enough opprobrium.
(9/10)I would rather we resolved this without increasing his shame.
(10/10)The mission is simple. Just retrieve the water, and deliver it safely to the Terran Emissary.
Well, that is resolved at least. We cannot have the Terrans viewing the Boron as emotionally fragile. Good work there, Herald!
Brilliant! We can check the Protectorate off our list.
(2/3or6)It appears that the royal heir, Princess Celeus, was personally distressed upon hearing of the Riptide Rakers' water shortages.
(3a/3)Given the paucity of water in Avarice, Her Majesty wishes to initiate a trade relationship with the Riptide Rakers.
(3b/6)A water shortage is about the most horrifying thing a Boron can conceive of. Yet in this case, it is not as simple as a charitable rescue operation.
(4b/6)Raker territory is completely surrounded by a well-armed syndicate that controls and profiteers from basic resources.
(5b/6)Your mission needs to be discreet. You will run the blockade with a shipment of water to provide immediate relief, while the government works on a longer-term solution.
(6b/6)Do not - I repeat - do not get caught. The Queendom cannot be seen to be flouting the rules of other jurisdictions, no matter how oppressive they may be.
Well done! The Riptide Rakers have sufficient water for now. We can only hope that the royal court has a long term solution in the tank.
We can check the Riptide Rakers off our list!
You will need to purchase a plot licence.
(2/4)The best way to gain productive engagement from the Teladi is through trade.
(3/4)Our task is to establish a modest Queendom station in Teladi space.
(4/4)Once they are selling their wares to the station, Teladi relations will start to warm.
(1/2)However, you are missing some station module blueprints.
(2/2)Before you can build the station, you will need to purchase the blueprints from a Faction Representative.
Excellent! You have acquired all the necessary station module blueprints.
(1/2)I have provided a station construction plan, containing all the required modules, which you can select.
(2/2)One more thing. Submit your receipts when you transfer the station, and Her Majesty's Treasury will process a reimbursement.
(1)Great work. The Boron Queendom will now be able to establish proper diplomatic relations with the Teladi Company.
(2)In addition to your reimbursement for the station-building expenses, Her Majesty wishes to provide you with a new ship, as a bonus!
(3a)You will be able to find, and claim, a new Corvette at your station.
(3b)However, records show that you have already... liberated... a ship from the carrier Menelaus' Reminiscence in Sanctuary of Darkness.(Menelaus' Reminiscence same as 20101,122601)
(4b)Her Majesty has decided to pardon your past transgression.
Most satisfactory! The Teladi Company can be marked off our task list.
This is excellent work! Your colleague has negotiated a treaty of significant consequence.
(1/2)It was quite tense, but your peer, Kulu Mi, did indeed return safely. Eventually.
(2/2)While the Boron insisted on diplomacy with the Split, there was never great optimism that the dextrous appendage reached out would be grasped.
You will find more tasks in your mission manager.
There are more tasks in your mission manager.
Your mission manager will provide you with further tasks.
(1/2)Excellent! We have completed the Queen's missions.
(2/2)Let us head back to Queen Polypheides to find our reward.
(5b)But you will not be getting an additional ship. I am astonished that you thought there would be no consequences for this larceny.
(1/3)And so we meet at the end of our path together.
(3/3)I wish you good fortune in your future travels.
(1/2)Some of you are new additions to our expedition; others have been with us since we set out from Trinity Sanctum.
(2/2)As we approach our destination, allow me a moment for a brief introduction:(leading into the mission accept monologue below, 30253008 onwards)
Everybody! Stay alert!(After GS speech is done)
Explorer. Perhaps your attention is best focused on the task in hand. Why do you not scout ahead?
I am truly honoured to be entrusted with this mission.
(2/2)We must indeed proceed with the mission briefing.

page.title: Mission Paranid NPC 10 / Emissary
page.descr: Lines for Mission Paranid NPC 10
page.t: (reaction to friendly fire)Hey, will you stop firing?
(reaction to friendly fire)You are wrecking my shields!
(reaction to friendly fire)Why are you shooting me?
Boron envoy! Run! It is a trap!
(2/3)That said, I remain entangled in their minefield. I am unable to move, or I risk awakening these monstrous munitions from their slumber.
(3/3)Would you perhaps be minded to help extricate me from this explosive dilemma?
(1/2)A mighty Boron warrior-envoy! I shall relay the tale of your heroism.
(2/2)I thank you for my liberation. I shall be on my way to fulfil my duties at Her Majesty's Court.

page.title: Mission Paranid NPC 11 / Ambush Actor
page.descr: Lines for Mission Paranid NPC 11
page.t: (reaction to friendly fire)Hey, will you stop firing?
(reaction to friendly fire)You are wrecking my shields!
(reaction to friendly fire)Why are you shooting me?
You may rest assured that we will prevent any attempt at diplomacy with the Boron.
There [mp:he|fp:she] is! The Boron envoy! Now we can get them both!

page.title: Mission Paranid NPC 12/ Tammancktall
page.descr: Lines for Mission Paranid NPC 12 / Tammancktall
page.t: Sorry, I am busy right now.
It is your honour to meet me, Argon Donel. It is also a pleasure to have more company in the Facility.
It is perfectly reasonable for an organic creature to be a little confused under these circumstances.
We have all been brought here to undertake these missions for the... "high-ups", as Lissa puts it.
Hello, Argon Donel. Have you undertaken your first mission yet?
Ah. You must be wondering about this place.
The truth is unclear, but we are somewhere very special. And our missions are of great consequence.
The Mission Director is their emissary.
Lissa and I have not seen them ourselves.
We do not even know what they are. But they undoubtedly possess great power.
We are honoured to have been chosen by them.
Experience the missions. They will enlighten you as to your true purpose in life from this point on.
What did you think of the experience? It is somewhat profound, do you not think?
Our purpose here is not to have fun, Lissa Ygon. The Creators of the Facility did not trouble themselves for our entertainment.
Argon Donel. We may not yet fully understand our true purpose here.
However, mark my words, the work we do here is of universal significance.
I do not know why you insist on bringing up this matter repeatedly, Mission Director.
This is quite understandable, Argon Donel.
Indeed. We are truly agents of a powerful and mysterious force.
Be at peace, Argon Donel. All will be revealed in time.
Be at peace Sae. No being here wishes you harm.
You have been chosen, Sae. This is a great honour, beyond any obligations in your past life.
We are the chosen. Our task is to travel through time, righting wrongs on behalf of the Creators.
So you say. I remain unconvinced.
Prepare yourself for a shock, Terran. You are in the year 2042!
"Alien" is not a term that is considered to be polite, young Terran. On my world, it is you who would be considered to be an alien.
Terran Chen. It is my pleasure to make your acquaintance.
We use the device over here to travel through time and across the galaxy, undertaking missions of the utmost importance.
It is our sacred duty to complete these missions. You have the honour of being our newest comrade.
I fail to see why you are no longer assigning recruitment missions to me.
It is essential that the newlings are fully aware of the profound importance of the opportunity with which they are faced.
You are a robot. A suspiciously intelligent inorganic.
In my time, the likes of you would be illegal in most of the galaxy. I demand to speak with your superior on this matter.
You say I talk too much?
You are implying that it is my verbosity that prevents me from completing these recruitment missions satisfactorily?
Perhaps I can make some effort to be more concise in my approaches to the newlings.
I appreciate your candour on this consequential matter, inorganic.
Young Terran. Your trivialisation of our sacred work is profoundly disheartening.
Please respect the gravity of our purpose here.
Is there any question? The Creators have plucked us, a chosen few, and they command us to right the wrongs of the galaxy.
Can there be a higher purpose?
This is no game, Kaori Chen. The Creators have not gone to this immense trouble simply for your entertainment.
Destiny itself depends on the work we undertake here.
I have not lived a hundred jazuras to be given orders by a human child.
When the Creators show themselves, there will be consequences, Terran Chen. These powers should be wielded with reverence.
I am driven by the fire of the Creators' purpose, Argon Donel. What drives you today?
I see you too are fully engaged in this crucial work. People speak highly of your mission performance.
This Facility. These missions. They bear the hallmarks of a higher power.
We are truly honoured to be the agents of the Creators.
I wonder, in fact, if we may have been transformed into guardians of time itself on our arrival at the Facility.
The Creators are bringing peace and justice to the universe.
They cannot be seen by us.
But they are as gods to us.
And we are their agents. We are guardians directed by them to right the wrongs of the universe.
To protect the generations to come.
To wield their swords in the name of peace and justice.
To grow an army of guardians to fight by our side.
We are the Guardians of Destiny.
We are the Guardians of Destiny!
Now let us pray to the Creators.
By the Creators, greetings Harper Donel.
I wish to share with you news of profound importance.
We are Guardians of Destiny, tools of the Creators, righting the wrongs of the galaxy.
I know it! I have felt the call of the Creators more deeply than ever in my before life.
Ah! A miserable existence I had, before I was saved.
Once, I was a priest among my people. Wandering the planets, spreading the teachings of the Creators.
But I was shunned. Ostracised for my faith.
Eventually, I was left in isolation. Placed on an asteroid habitat and commanded never to speak of my faith with anyone.
It is of no consequence, my Argon friend. I now understand this was a test.
Will you pray to the Creators with me, Harper Donel?
I perform my allotted tasks with all the humility you would expect.
The Creators saw my devotion and summoned me to become a Guardian of Destiny.
There can be no greater purpose.
We are correcting mistakes across the galaxy.
The Creators have their reasons, Pa.
If we perform their tasks to the best of our ability, perhaps they will reward us.
Perhaps they will send you home some day.
It is hard to think that I am no more sentient than the Mission Director.
But... I suppose we are doing something for the real creatures of the universe.
Thank you, Harper. You are a wise friend.
Hmmm. We do not talk about Mitsuno. She was not worthy of the Creators.
No-one should have mentioned this name to you.
I strongly advise that you forget this name. And do not speak of Mitsuno with the Mission Director in particular.
The Creators shine on us, fellow Guardian.
May the light of the Creators shine on you, human Donel.
The Creators must be pleased with your work, Harper Donel.
The future of the galaxy depends on our work here.
Ahhh. That has been on my mind.
Were we not all lost in the dark? The dark of ignorance? Before we were elevated to this place?
Perhaps it is a reminder of the darkness of our past lives.
Or of the dark we enter as we travel through time.
I wonder if it is the Creators sending us a message.
Or at least the Mission Director, as their emissary.
I am deep in thought, Harper Donel.
I wish the Creators would give me guidance.

page.title: Mission Paranid NPC 13 / Calm Competent Crewman
page.descr: Lines for Mission Paranid NPC 13 / Calm Competent Crewman
page.t: As part of our joint campaign, the Argon Federation has dispatched a fleet to disrupt the enemy's line of communication.
However, we have just received intel that this particular supplier is heavily guarded by highly efficient anti-capital armaments.
Holy warrior of the Godrealm, you do not have much time.
Take out as many enemy bombers as you can, before our allies arrive.
Admonisher, we have become aware that a fellow subject of the Holy Three-Dimensionality is no longer performing their assigned function optimally.
As decreed by the Priest Duke, it is your honour to take him out so that he may be replaced with someone more genetically well-suited to the task.
However, other subjects might not agree with such strict measures, and so your assigned duty calls for subtlety.
Do not bring undue attention to your work.
Watch your target. Plan your approach.
Mayday, mayday. We have sustained critical damage from enemy forces. Requesting immediate transport of civilians off this station.
Captain, the rescue ship is destroyed. But thank you for your ongoing attacks on the blockade.
Captain, the rescue ship is destroyed. But thank you for your ongoing repairs to our station.
This is your last rescue run. Thank you, Captain.
This is Paranid space. Your station is violating its sanctity.
The Priest Duke will greatly reward anyone helping to destroy these invaders.

page.title: Mission Paranid NPC 14 / Timelines Hub Paranid Recruit
page.descr: Lines for Mission Paranid NPC 14 / Timelines Hub Paranid Recruit
page.t: Sorry, I am busy right now.
We are the Guardians of Destiny.
We are the Guardians of Destiny!
Tammancktall is a prophet among us. Listen to his words.
We are the Guardians of Destiny.
Continue the work of the Creators, Guardian Harper Donel.
The human youngling, Kaori, was right about this place. The Creators have us playing games for them.
Godrealm forces are advancing through the Jump Gate.
Praise be to the true Pontifex!
Calling on all traders in Holy Vision!
The wretched forces of the pretender have started their full-scale attack on our system.
It is your duty as a loyal subject of the Godrealm to keep our factories supplied so that our warriors are sufficiently well-equipped to eventually triumph.
Keep clear of the enemy forces. Keep your head down.

page.title: Mission Paranid NPC 15 / Paranid diplomat
page.descr: Lines for Paranid Faction Diplomat
page.t: (Accepting invitation)Yes, of course we shall accept your invitation. The servants of the one true faith would never pass up any opportunity to widen the reach of the Godrealm.
(Diplomat Arrival Confirmation)Two-eyed creature, I have made my way to your embassy.
(Player deteriorates relations, diplomat leaves)We will not allow ourselves to be insulted like that, especially not by a contemptible heathen such as yourself!
(Player requests military support)The Godrealm is prepared to offer military assistance.
(Faction military support has ended)The military support that we have so far graciously extended to you, is required to fight back against infidels elsewhere.
(Promotion ceremony - intro)You have done well to approach us in person.
(Promotion ceremony - cntd, friendly)We have been observing you and your activities with some interest. Some have called for you to be recognised.
(Promotion ceremony - cntd, allied)It pleases us that you have continued down this path. As such, you will be suitably rewarded.
(Promotion ceremony - handing over 'medal', friendly)I am not displeased to present you with a new rank within the great Godrealm of the Paranid.
(Promotion ceremony - handing over 'medal', allied)It is with great honour that I present to you, a new rank within the great Godrealm of the Paranid.
(Promotion ceremony)As with all honours bestowed by the Paranid, this comes with worthy benefits.
(Promotion ceremony - fluff line to spread notifications out 1)Should you betray us, you will immediately lose these benefits, and shortly after, your life.
(Promotion ceremony - fluff line to spread notifications out 2)As we have judged you worthy, we do not forsee this as a likely possibility.
(Promotion ceremony - fluff line to spread notifications out 3)You will henceforth go and enjoy the rewards we have gifted you.
(Promotion ceremony - subgroup licence hint)There are a number of organisations within our empire that will see our decision as a reason to approach you.
(Promotion ceremony - outro)With our blessing, you are expected to continue your honourable behaviour.
(Promotion ceremony - outro cntd)May the holy fires burn within you.

page.title: Mission Paranid NPC 16 / Holy Order diplomat
page.descr: Lines for Holy Order Faction Diplomat
page.t: (Accepting invitation)The Holy Order will accept your invitation. We shall view it as a tacit admission of understanding that you are dealing with the purveyors of the one true faith.
(Diplomat Arrival Confirmation)The one true Pontifex's representative has arrived at your embassy.
(Player deteriorates relations, diplomat leaves)You will regret defying the will of the one true Pontifex! Heathen!
(Player requests military support)The Holy Order will humour your request for our superior military support.
(Faction military support has ended)The time has come to turn our attention towards more meaningful pursuits. As such, we shall pause our military aid.
(Promotion ceremony - intro)It pleases us that you have come in person.
(Promotion ceremony - cntd, friendly)We have watched as you have performed a great number of exploits within our space. Our Order finds you worthy of some recognition.
(Promotion ceremony - cntd, allied)We remain moved that such fire burns within one such as yourself. It is something worthy of a grand gesture, of which we can bestow.
(Promotion ceremony - handing over 'medal', friendly)In the name of the Holy Order of the Pontifex, I lift you to a new standing amongst us.
(Promotion ceremony - handing over 'medal', allied)With the holy light of the true Pontifex, it is an honour to bless you with a new title.
(Promotion ceremony)You will find that your position will include a number of benefits.
(Promotion ceremony - fluff line to spread notifications out 1)In the event that you turn against us, we will wrench this title from you and serve judgement.
(Promotion ceremony - fluff line to spread notifications out 2)However, with your noble character, we do not expect such a thing.
(Promotion ceremony - fluff line to spread notifications out 3)Go and make these rewards your own. We pray they help you continue on the path to enlightenment.
(Promotion ceremony - subgroup licence hint)You may also find that certain sanctioned groups with our Order will have gained interest in you. You will do well to not reject them.
(Promotion ceremony - outro)I again recognise your holy will.
(Promotion ceremony - outro cntd)May the true Pontifex continue to guide you.

page.title: Mission Paranid NPC 17 / Alliance of the Word diplomat
page.descr: Lines for Alliance of the Word Diplomat
page.t: (Accepting invitation)We cordially accept your invitation in the interest of scientific exchange. I shall journey towards your embassy shortly.
(Diplomat Arrival Confirmation)I have arrived at your fascinating installation.
(Player deteriorates relations, diplomat leaves)It is most shameful that you seem to put your own base interest above the pursuit of knowledge.
(Player requests military support)While the Alliance of the Word is not a military organisation, we shall see what we can do.
(Faction military support has ended)There is only so much our organisation can do for you. It is time for the Alliance of the Word to turn its attention towards more fruitful endeavours again.
(Promotion ceremony - intro)We are honoured for you to approach in person.
(Promotion ceremony - cntd, friendly)You are among the few who appears to have the clarity to see our goals as something worth pursuing. Our group wishes to encourage those such as you to continue.
(Promotion ceremony - cntd, allied)The path you have chosen remains clear and we are happy to walk it with you. The quest for knowledge must be rewarded and recognised by your peers.
(Promotion ceremony - handing over 'medal', friendly)I'm pleased to present you with a new rank amongst our organisation.
(Promotion ceremony - handing over 'medal', allied)It's an honour to present you with a new rank amongst our organisation.
(Promotion ceremony)This rank comes with benefit worthy of such a scholar.
(Promotion ceremony - fluff line to spread notifications out 1)As you would expect, these benefits are tied to the rank. Should you lose it, the benefits will go too. A simple matter.
(Promotion ceremony - fluff line to spread notifications out 2)But with your aptitude, you must recognise that as a foolish outcome.
(Promotion ceremony - fluff line to spread notifications out 3)Our humble group hopes that you find these rewards fitting. May it aid you in your endeavours.
(Promotion ceremony - subgroup licence hint)You may find that certain organisations under our jurisdiction will attempt to recruit you into their ranks. As with all things, consider carefully.
(Promotion ceremony - outro)I Once again thank you for your efforts.
(Promotion ceremony - outro cntd)We look forward to working with you more in the future.

page.title: Mission Paranid NPC 18 / Realm of the Trinity diplomat
page.descr: Lines for Realm of the Trinity Diplomat
page.t: (Accepting invitation)The Realm of the Trinity has agreed to humour your request. Since I will be speaking on behalf of all Paranid congregations, I shall take up my duties in your embassy without delay.
(Diplomat Arrival Confirmation)The representative of all united Paranid has passed your threshold.
(Player deteriorates relations, diplomat leaves)You have strayed from the path too far! Retribution will find you eventually!
(Player requests military support)The Realm of the Trinity is prepared to come to your aid, as long as the Pontifices look upon you favourably.
(Faction military support has ended)Faithful servant! Our military support must come to an end - for the time being.
(Promotion ceremony - intro)It was provident of you to heed Our call.
(Promotion ceremony - cntd, friendly)Through diligent persistence, you have proven yourself to be a faithful servant of our people.
(Promotion ceremony - cntd, allied)You have graciously taken the opportunity We have given you, and used your new-found power in service of the realm.
(Promotion ceremony - handing over 'medal', friendly)Our attention rests favourably upon you, and We shall see to it that the entire realm recognises your merit.
(Promotion ceremony - handing over 'medal', allied)As of now, you shall therefore be known as a Seeker of the Holy Light, and carry forth the Pontifices' will.
(Promotion ceremony)As you carry this esteemed title with dignity, fate shall open its gates to countless new possibilities.
(Promotion ceremony - fluff line to spread notifications out 1)Be aware that, should you misstep along your path, these gates may very well close again before you.
(Promotion ceremony - fluff line to spread notifications out 2)However, We have verified the calculation, and such a future appears to be improbable.
(Promotion ceremony - fluff line to spread notifications out 3)You will henceforth go, and enjoy the rewards We have gifted you.
(Promotion ceremony - subgroup licence hint)Certain congregations within our realm may seize this opportunity to approach you. Prepare yourself.
(Promotion ceremony - outro)May you never stray from your consecrated path.
(Promotion ceremony - outro cntd)The Pontifices will it so.
(Start of greeting)On behalf of the Realm of the Trinity: (keep space)

page.title: Mission Paranid NPC 19 / Duke's Tempest diplomat
page.descr: Lines for Duke's Tempest Diplomat
page.t: (Accepting invitation)In the name of our Duke, we shall accept your invitation. Prepare for the arrival of His honourable delegation.
(Diplomat Arrival Confirmation)The Buccaneers have taken up quarters at your embassy.
(Player deteriorates relations, diplomat leaves)Inconceivable! You shall be met by our righteous Duke's fury for this affront!
(Player requests military support)The Buccaneers shall answer your call! A fleet is heading out as we speak.
(Faction military support has ended)Our military support has ended. The Duke's forces are needed elsewhere.
(Allied greeting)May the skies be cleansed by the Duke's will.
(Promotion ceremony - intro)You were ordered to appear before Us, and now you are here in the flesh.
(Promotion ceremony - cntd, friendly)We recognise that, despite the limited potentialities before you, you have served our good Duke well enough.
(Promotion ceremony - cntd, allied)Your zealous exploits continue to impress our warriors, which is why We are commanded to present you with a singular opportunity.
(Promotion ceremony - handing over 'medal', friendly)We are therefore pleased to welcome you to the ever-growing ranks of His faithful Buccaneers.
(Promotion ceremony - handing over 'medal', allied)Our righteous Duke has personally requested your admission into His Honour Guard. May His enemies cower before you.
(Promotion ceremony)This new standing provides you with the ideal tools to do battle in the Duke's name.
(Promotion ceremony - fluff line to spread notifications out 1)However, you would do well to remember that the sword of His judgement may just as easily turn against you.
(Promotion ceremony - fluff line to spread notifications out 2)If you continue to serve us, this will remain a mere shadow of a possibility.
(Promotion ceremony - fluff line to spread notifications out 3)We otherwise grant you permission to use these privileges as you see fit.
(Promotion ceremony - subgroup licence hint)Once word of your exaltation reaches them, certain lodges among our war host may deign to approach you.
(Promotion ceremony - outro)Go now, and continue to serve as the instrument of our conquest.
(Promotion ceremony - outro cntd)Duke's will be done.
(Start of greeting)On behalf of the Duke's faithful: (keep space)

page.title: Mission Paranid NPC 20 / Olmancketslat
page.descr: Lines for Mission Paranid NPC 20
page.t: (reaction to friendly fire)Hey, will you stop firing?
(reaction to friendly fire)You are wrecking my shields!
(reaction to friendly fire)Why are you shooting me?

We are Lord Chaplain Olmancketslat. As the Pontifex's negotiator to the two-eyes, we led a sacred mission to dictate the Empire's pleasant will unto them. We commanded the Pontifex's mighty galleon Trinity, known as Hyperion by the two-eyes, when it was blinded in a treacherous ambush. We ordered the crew to abandon ship and attempted to save the galleon; but then, the Jump Gates flickered and went opaque. After a fruitless decade of waiting, we had no choice other than to weave our cocoon that would shield and nourish us until such time as the Three-Dimensionality wills us to be restored to life.

An eternity passed like Planck-time. When we uncocooned, the venerable galleon seemed familiar, unchanged; the geometry of space as serene as we recalled. But while we were cocooned, the Godrealm had fallen, only to spring again under the same name, but with a different meaning to its word. No longer was the Pontifex infallible; and declawed limped the Xaar. The Heretic's worship, we were forced to conclude by mischance, is non-Euclidean; what once was true, no longer is. Where once was light, now darkness reigns.\n\nWe want to cocoon again but, alas, we cannot. May the holy Three-Dimensionality have mercy on our soul.
We are Lord Chaplain Olmancketslat, special envoy of the Pontifex Maximus Paranidia of the Paranid Empire.
The onboard computer of this galleon, with grace, prompted us to uncocoon only recently, upon sensing the Jump Gate's eye opening after its long and dreamless slumber.
We believed The Dark had yielded to the break of day. But alas, it had not.
Instead, we found our community upended; every gate overturned.
We found a schism in the holy Paranid realm, fracturing our people into separate ecclesiae, each claiming to hold the true axioms of the sacred Three-Dimensionality.
We found a profound heterodoxy separating the now from the before, threatening the validity of the very axioms of the sacred Three-Dimensionality.
Do you, two-eyes? Then enlighten us where to turn to.
Where to mend the Paranid's proud spirit, where to reapply the sacred axioms, to restore what was lost?
Where to find communion and purpose again?
We have weighed your counsel, two-eyes, and found it convincing enough.
Thus, we shall direct our proud galleon to the Paranid settlement you speak of.
We want to acknowledge the invaluable help and counsel we received from you, now that we have found communion with this sacred congregation that adopted us so readily.
Come join us and be rewarded generously.
Myrna Rae, historian of the Argon Federation!
We have come to respect you for your empathy and understanding more than we thought possible hitherto.
We will abstain from calling you two-eyes henceforth, and wish to extend our gratitude.
Myrna Rae, your words give us both solace and sorrow at once.
Sorrow that the days of old are gone and will never return.
Solace, because the dawn of a new day may be upon us after all.
Our search for truth, for communion and purpose has already begun.
We bid our farewell unto you.
The design of the ship you call Hyperion was so ahead of its time that a decision has been made to put a modernised version into mass production.
You may expect to find the frame available for sale at the shipyard, the blueprints at our faction representative, and Hyperion class ships traversing the void of space.
One of those new Hyperion ships will be your reward.
However, we do have another request for you.
During the decades that the Hyperion's AGI Core commanded the ship, its neural pathways ingrained themselves deeply into the vessel's systems, and now resist extraction.
We would greatly appreciate your assistance in retrieving certain items that speed up the process of extraction immensely.
As a sign of our gratitude, you will be rewarded the original Hyperion.
We will uplink the item list to your onboard computer and will await their speedy arrival.
We wish to extend our gratitude for your continued and invaluable help.
As promised, the dignified galleon - once called Trinity, now Hyperion - shall be gifted into your capable stewardship.
Treat her well, and she will serve you faithfully for the rest of your life.
Technology and scientific understanding have progressed considerably since we cocooned!
A lot has changed, some of which beyond recognition. We will take our time to update our understanding.
This congregation adopted us readily and recognised Our Holy Mission!

page.descr: Lines for Mission Paranid NPC 22 / Paranid Agent
page.t: (Unaffiliated Hello)You dare approach me uninvited? What do you want?
(Unaffiliated Goodbye)Yes, you go now. Your ambitions are beneath me.
(Agent was hired)I shall agree to your terms. On the interstellar stage of politics, we will achieve great things together.
(Player-owned hello, on HQ)I am ready to receive my assignment, Principal.
(Player-owned hello, on mission)Do not interrupt my focus at this critical juncture!
(Fire Agent 1)You dare to let me go?
(Fire Agent 2)Well then... I shall leave this wretched place at once!
(Going on mission)My journey begins, and nothing shall stray me from my course.
(Returned from mission, success)I have returned. As expected, my mission was a complete success.
(Returned from mission, unsuccessful)The mission might have failed, but by the guidance of the Three-Dimensionality I shall live to fight another day.

The great Jump Gate shutdown plunged many lesser civilisations into chaos. As fringe families of the Rhonkar Patriarchy started losing their sectors, great Rhonkar t'Ncct, Patriarch of all Split, ignored his subjects' demands for relief. Instead, he chose to stay silent, arming himself against the inevitable rebellion. When the network ultimately unraveled, our people persevered. Liberated from cruel imperial taxation, we Free Families could finally rebuild our realms, each under the reign of our own Patriarch. Now, the gates have reconnected and the oppression of old has returned. Zyarth, claiming to be Patriarch of all Split, is invading our realms to enrich himself on our economy and purge our identity. This the free Patriarchs will not allow.

My Patriarch, Gau t'Pg, joined the coalition of Free Families to face the Zyarth Armada. I have the great honour of leading our squadron of fighters under Commander Yu t'Knk, and by Gau, I will make my family proud!
