Zyarth, Patriarch of all Split, unites all lesser patriarchs under his rule.
The Patriarch is a survivalist, always on the move.
He made a name for himself fighting Xenon invaders.
The Zyarth family was thriving in the outer reaches.
Then Patriarch Rhonkar failed to keep the empire together.
Zyarth stepped in to prevent the great families from drifting apart.
After the gate realignments, he had outlived all of his former competitors.
And now there is barely a Split alive who would remember another Patriarch on the throne.

page.t: ( Gamestart Narration Player Character, TALK DIFFERENTLY TO THE CURB CHARACTER )

While Patriarch Rhonkar failed his subjects, Patriarch Zyarth made a name for himself fighting the Xenon. When the Jump Gate shutdown disconnected the realms, Zyarth the Provident prevented the Split families around him from drifting apart. After the Gates realigned, Zyarth the Undying had outlived all but wretched Tkr from the Patriarchs of old. Now it is time to pick up the shards of Rhonkar's empire and follow in Thuruk's steps, as High Patriarch Zyarth shall unify all Split once again. We will welcome them all, outcasts, exiles and even the accursed, back into Split society.

As a proud member of Family Nhuut, I joined Zyarth's expeditionary fleet to prove my worth to the empire. Being recognised as an equal among the warriors has never been easy, but it is in my nature to defy tradition.

Under Patriarchy oppression, escaped slave welcome to free more.
Pilot welcome and thanked for service!
Time to declare our legitimacy and worth to all. Free Families and Zyarth Tyranny will learn!
(announcement to the populous)Proud, Free Families' Patriarchs failed to expel Zyarth Tyranny.
(announcement)Invader of Free Families' economy, enforcer of slave rights against Split culture, confiscator of assets in unjust trials.
(announcement)Quarreling Families failed to gather enough forces. Brave Patriarchs died in Fires of Defeat.
(announcement)Patriarchy ways failed us. Split families still quarreling.
(announcement)Split see this before, Patriarch Ghus t'Gllt see this.
(announcement)We are your Curbs, decreed by Ghus t'Gllt.
(announcement)Curbs mustered fleets of all Free Families, quarreling or not.
(announcement interrupted by explosion)Betrayal! All pilots attack!
Victory for Curbs and all free Split.
Tyrannical Patriarchy driven out of Free Families' sectors.
Free Families may decide to rot in independence or submit to victorious Curb rule.
No creature oppose reign of Curbs.
Free Families decide to submit to victorious Curb rule or perish.
Split has restored honour and proven great strength.

page.title: Mission Split Female 2 / Workforce Supervisor / Welfare research
page.descr: Lines for Mission Split NPC Female 2
page.t: Split is shift supervisor for one of your factories. After informing superior of issue, Split felt best to also approach you.
Some subordinates have been seen leaving posts early. Seems they are visiting entertainment centre that recently opened in nearby sector.
No. Split think we should incorporate similar facility on our station. Fellow workers would not have to stray so far and we also gain stronger footing when negotiating new contracts.
Split does not, but can tell you where to find man in charge of entertainment centre. Seemed rather excited at prospect of competition.
Split respect your judgement on this matter.
Split must return to post. Goodbye.

(boasting)Listen to Split tale. Split stood there, victorious. Room full of Paranid, silent, struck by Split glory. Split bested them! Raw skill of Split hands outpacing their 'superior' intellect. They soon asked Split to leave, to wallow in shame.

page.title: Mission Split Male 1 / Maestro
page.descr: Lines for Mission Split NPC Male 1
page.t: (reaction to friendly fire)Hey, will you stop firing?
(reaction to friendly fire)You wrecking my shields!
(reaction to friendly fire)Why you shooting at me?
Chipmunk.(Translate 'Chipmunk' same as {30252,110}, nickname for the player, greeting)
Wildcard.(Translate 'Wildcard' same as {30252,111}, nickname for the player, greeting)
(4/5)Safe to say you do not mind dirtying hands?
(5/5)If true, Split want to offer mission you might be interested in!
(1/2)Good! Meet Split aboard Arcadian Endeavour for further discussion!(excited; "Arcadian Endeavour" same as 30252,201)
(2/2)And bring S-sized ship with sufficient cargo space!
You found your way onto ship. Good!
(1/9)There you are!(clearly pleased to see player)
(3a/9)You already met the Axiom.(if pirate gs)
(3b/9)Split appreciates you helping Axiom escape!(if pirate gs)
(3c/9)Even if your motives may be self-serving.(if pirate gs)
(3/9)Invited creature here because Split noticed you carry illegal wares.(if non-pirate gs)
(4/9)Split and crew, the Empyrean Curs, have embarked on journey towards complete independence.(Empyrean Curs same as {30252,10})
(5/9)Split interested in bringing someone who does not mind breaking laws.
(7/9)Regular smuggler and best pilot, the Ace, has prior engagements.
(8/9)So, crew need someone to smuggle spaceweed.(spaceweed same as {20201,4101})
(9/9)Small assignment. Test if you trustworthy. You interested?
(1/15)Yes, of course!(excited to talk about himself)
(2/15)You ask how come Split commands Empyrean Curs, rabble of pirate misfits?(Empyrean Curs same as {30252,10})
(3a/15)And so far from Split space!(Split DLC active)
(3b/15)When this part of network still disconnected from Rhonkar's domain?(Split DLC disabled)
(4/15)See, Split never part of broader Split culture.
(5/15)Born into small makeshift family of Split during shutdown.
(6a/15)Even though connection re-established, Split not feel at home with ferocious Split families.(Split DLC active)
(6b/15)Even if Split could return, doubt Split would feel at home in ferocious Split society.(Split DLC disabled)
(9/15)Growing up in Windfall, Split really not have choice except fall in with Vigor Syndicate.
(10/15)They taught Split to steal, cheat and kill - if Split must.(very matter of fact)
(11/15)But Split disagrees with direction Vigor heading now.
(13/15)Much more interesting marks out there now.(translate marks as victims)
(14/15)Split and trusted friends decided to strike out on own.
(15/15)Now, crew roam network aboard ship looking for opportunities to make money however crew see fit.
(3/3)Feel free to return if you change mind!
(1/5)Good! Split knew Split could count on you.
(2/5)Crew already transferred spaceweed into your ship's cargo hold.(matter of fact, spaceweed same as {20201,4101})
(3/5)Split let buyer know to expect you.
(4/5)To get to buyer you cross policed space. Careful not be spotted.
Unfortunately, ship you came in not fit package. Return with bigger storage.
(1/5)You just entered system where spaceweed illegal.(spaceweed same as {20201,4101})
(2/5)Most groups in network prohibit at least some wares. Some systems more lenient than others.
(3/5)Crucial to our survival to appreciate such nuances.
(4/5)Keep distance from police ships. Hope they don't spot you.
(5/5)If they do, hope your ship is faster than theirs!
Police heading your way. Quick, put distance between you and law!(worried)
(1/3)You dropped spaceweed? Not good start!(spaceweed same as {20201,4101})
(2/3)If you want to be part of crew, ensure delivery happens!
(3/3)Even if you pay for it out of own pocket.
(1/2)Split squared it with buyer so you can just transfer spaceweed without issue.(spaceweed same as {20201,4101})
(2/2)Cannot usually sell illegal wares to stations without establishing black market first.
Get going! Buyer anxiously awaits delivery.
Did creature make delivery yet? What you waiting for?
No time for law-abiding civilians. Interested in hardened criminals only!
(1/8)Let me be first to congratulate you.
(2/8)Welcome to Empyrean Curs!(warm and friendly, Empyrean Curs same as {30252,10})
(3/8)Before I forget, you might notice Curs do not do names!
(4/8)So, since you will stick around, Split needs to come up with something for you.
(5/8)You competent smuggler; shall call you "Chipmunk"!(clearly very pleased with coming up with the name, translate 'Chipmunk' same as {30252,110}, nickname for the player)
(6/8)Reason why Curs taking on new members is string of recent setbacks. Split lost crew and assets to Teladi Ministry of Finance.
(7/8)Need help getting back on our feet.
(8a/8)Return to Arcadian Endeavour to get to know other members of crew!
(8b/8)Return to our base. Me and the Axiom have tasks for you. You also meet last member of Empyrean Curs!(Empyrean Curs same as {30252,10})
(2/9)Relieved my skills of appraising creature's criminal talents did not betray me!
(3/9)As Split said before, Empyrean Curs very much still growing.(Empyrean Curs same as {30252,10})
(4/9)Crew used to be connected to many black market dealers in policed systems, but Ministry of Finance especially ratcheted up internal and external security.
(5/9)You help us establish new shady connection!
(6/9)Need to buy specific illegal item from black market, but none of current associates carry it.
(7/9)Split mark station with highest chance of criminal elements there.
(8/9)Do not be nervous. Split talk you through process.(trying to be calming)
(2/4)Initial contact with black marketeer occurs through Signal Leaks.
(3/4)Split found one. Marked it for you!
(4/4)Fly close, with Scan Mode on, to intercept signal.
(1/2)Before you can trade, must earn Black Marketeer's trust.
Still need to accept mission before continuing.
(1/3)Peculiar. This signal not what Split looking for.(encountering Boso)
(2/3)Sounded like he needed help. Best pursue on your own time.
(3/3)Still need to find Black Marketeer's signal!
(1/5)You need to deliver Unstable Crystals.(Unstable Crystals same as {20201,17001})
(2/5)Can use crystals to craft Spacesuit Bombs, which is why trading prohibited. (Spacesuit Bomb same as {20201, 12201})
(5/5)Either mine asteroids yourself or look for broken off crystals in regions with concentrated mining activity!
(1/2)Good! You established this contact. Make use whenever you see fit.
(2/2)Now buy Woodworm Security Protocols and return them to me!(Woodworm Security Protocols same as {20201,55401})
(2/6)Split would have sent other members to station, too, but Curs all already well known to authorities.
(3/6)Higher likelihood of arrest. You are new face, less trouble.
(5/6)These leaked security protocols help gain valuable insights into Ministry operations on Woodworm Scrubs.(Woodworm Scrubs same as {20102,2301})
Please see to tasks at hand! Curs need to grow for pirate enterprise to flourish.
(2/2)Chipmunk, back to your ship, grab what you can!
Empyrean Curs really need creature's help!
Can confirm Arcadian Endeavour close by. Ready to grab spoils!
You will see when time is right!
(1/6)Chipmunk! Your contributions make difference!(very energetic and encouraging)
(2/6)Empyrean Curs' funds grown, everyone involved putting in work!
(3/6)While you, Ace and Axiom been out raiding, Split started putting together multistep plan.
(5/6)Also, plan not yet final. Still being worked on!
(6/6)Talk to crew, see how you can contribute further!
(2/8)Curs need to raid station for specific supplies, but station well-guarded.
(3/8)Ministry of Finance very vigilant when it comes to pirate activity.
(4/8)If Curs go in guns blazing, crew will be picked apart by Ministry patrols.
(5/8)Instead, you and the Ace will create diversion.
(6/8)You attack Ministry fleet head on. Draw away from station!
(8/8)Not good distraction if you get blown to bits!
(2/2)If you fast enough you stay out of range of their guns. Do not worry!
Arcadian Endeavour in close proximity to station.(Arcadian Endeavour same as {30252,201})
Chipmunk! Lead them away from station!
Evade fire but do not escape completely!
They are still too close to station. Lead them further!
(1/3)They have lost you!(when the player is too far away)
(2/3)They return to our mark if you too far away.
(3/4)Suppose end result same, no matter approach.
You have undivided attention. Keep going!
(2/4)Another Ministry fleet rapidly approaching your location!
(3/4)Highly unexpected. Fast fighters heading your way!
(1/3)While you two kept Ministry forces busy, Curs took station for all it is worth!
(2/3)Did not go as smoothly as anticipated on your end, but handled well.
(3/3)Return to receive instructions on how to continue.
Cannot see to heist preparation if creature does not lay groundwork. Please do tasks!
(1/5)Welcome back, Chipmunk.(Translate 'Chipmunk' same as {30252,110}, nickname for the player)
(3/5)Too well. Forget old smuggler callsign.(Addressing player)
(4/5)You Wildcard now.(Addressing player)(Translate 'Wildcard' same as {30252,111}, nickname for the player)
(5/5)Planning finished. Time to prepare big heist.
(2/7)She worked with Ministry to sell us out.
(4/7)Ministry now employs her in prison management, running Woodworm.(Woodworm same as {20102,2301}, short for the prison station name Woodworm Scrubs)
(7/7)So to speak, she never properly left.
(1/3)No, Wildcard, profit.(Translate 'Wildcard' same as {30252,111}, nickname for the player)
You should know that place well.
(1/4)Mellerd's station holds Ministry Science Division facility.
(2/4)We target Ministry ship prototype for high security transports.
(3a/4)Cargo spoofing technology currently only available for their prototype ship.
(3b/4)Cargo spoofing technology currently only available for their Raven class ships.(Raven same as {20101,22501})
(2/3)The Axiom will attack security and the Ace will help with fighters.
(3/3)After stealing treasure, you dock at Arcadian Endeavour(same as {30252,201}) for escape.
(2/5)Before we can set plan into motion, we need to prepare.
(3/5)Switch in Mellerd's office needs to be flipped to open back door.
(4/5)She knows our faces. This job for you.
(5/5)Once you done we abuse security issue for break-in.
(2/5)One of her thugs offers job at a bar not far.
(3/5)Ask for audience with boss as reward.
(4/5)Thug will lead you into Mellerd's office.
(5/5)Make sure flipping of switch goes unnoticed.
(1/4)Break into station and steal Ministry ship.
(2/4)For break-in, need to flip switch in Mellerd's office.
(3/4)Find her thugs in bar and ask for job.
(4/4)After petty crime ask to visit Mellerd to secretly flip switch.
(2/2)What petty crime Mellerd make you do?
(1/7)*** Enraged Heavy Breathing ***(fuming as he is shaken by the news of his brother's abduction)
(1/2)Curs will also rescue my brother.(Empyrean Curs same as {30252,10})
(2/2)Curs will fix this mistake.(Empyrean Curs same as {30252,10})
(1/2)All crew back to the Arcadian Endeavour(ship name same as {30252,201}).
Wildcard! Help either of them.(furious, choleric)
(2/2)Split allowed all time Split could spare, for Wildcard to prep.
(2/5)No longer just plan of petty revenge, or even business!
(3/5)Mellerd looking to strike low blow, involving someone who no longer in game!
(4/5)Curs can play game, too, but better!
(1/3)Yes! After prison break-out, Wildcard make way through internal ducts.
(3/3)Then, proceed to make escape in prototype ship.
(1/3)As to how you gain access to station in first place, Axiom will tag along.
(2/3)Hack into their system. Serve as on-ground supervisor.
(3/3)No time to waste. Get to it!(energetic)
(1/2)You made it onto station! Keep guard up!(addressing the player)
(2/2)Do not waste time. Hope Ministry thugs not recognise you!(addressing the player)
(2/4)Alarm must have mobilised more Ministry forces than Split anticipated!
(3/4)Must have been ploy. Bait Curs so Mellerd not have to smoke us out.
(4/4)No matter now. Dock fast, hand Split brother over!(eager)
(3/5)Wildcard, Curs need help! Arcadian Endeavour cannot escape with Mellerd's ship functional!
(4/5)Need to take out turrets and engines.
(5/5)Only chance of escape! Get out of there!
You drawing away their fire. Good!(when the player is engaged)
Taking less damage! Good!(when the player destroys turrets)
(1/2)Their ship's engines dead! Now is window to slip away!
(1/8)Split not expect turning of battle.(when player destroys Mellerd's ship)
(2/8)Wildcard demonstrated nature true to name.(when player destroys Mellerd's ship)
(5/8)Everyone regroup and take time to recover.
(6/8)Wildcard, without you heist would not have been possible.
(2/5)Axiom broke you out of prison!(if pirate gamestart, indignant)
(3/5)Split offered you freedom!(if not pirate gamestart, indignant)
(4/5)(angry)Split took you in as Cur! This is thanks?
(5/5)Curse on your family! Split kill you!(anger)
(1/2)Access Ministry station through Axiom's back door.(if Axiom mission)
(2/2)Executing hack. Tear you apart!(if Axiom mission)
(1/2)Proud now? Serving Curs up to Mellerd?(resigned)
(2/2)Suppose you had no stake in game. No honour either!(resigned)
(2/2)Thousand thanks for getting brother out! And for buying time to flee battle.(grateful)
Where are Split brother and Axiom? Wildcard, this is wrong ship!(worked up, if player delivers wrong ship)
Split not expect to die today!(surprised, when character dies)

page.title: Mission Split Male 2 / Lu t'Cca - Split Brother
page.descr: Lines for Mission Split NPC Male 2
page.t: No, looking for transport.(Answer to "Working for anybody?")
Misery. Split trying to escape family business.(Answer to: What brings you here?)
(1/4)Biggest family left in Windfall during shutdown.(Evading, avoiding the proper answer)(Translate Windfall same as {20005,9057})
(2/4)Split either join or grow up with none. So all Split from Windfall belong to Family Than.(translate Family Than same as {20005,5044})
(3/4)Old history. Split was born into it.
(4/4)Split rather not discuss family trouble publicly.
(1/2)Split earn proper name, earn back honour.
(2/2)For Split, only one place for that kind of thing.
Is glory given by Patriarch, true glory?
Split do not think Rhak will be around for long.
Curbs fight honourable fight for power, but not mine.
It is not Split's place to defend Free Families, nor does Split have reason to fight their oppressor.(Translate Free Families same as {20203,1601})
Split believes should not discuss such matters with outsiders.
Yes. They seek proper glory not petty piracy.
Free Families disorganised. No honour in politics.
(2/6)Split get cheap ship in outskirts, far from Xenon.
(3/6)Could attempt settling on planet. Some planetary Split populations in the network.
(4/6)But most likely Split keep head down at safe station and wait for news of gates reopening.
(5/6)At some point gates to Split must open.
Not enough space on your ship. Go buy better ship.
This Curs business?(angry, Empyrean Curs same as {30252,10})
Split done with Curs!(angry, Empyrean Curs same as {30252,10})
You horrible pilot. Go to flight school, then pick Split up again.(angry)

(1/2, furious, talks only to the player, who deeply wronged him but is also his only hope, in all 302526XX lines, means himself when he says "Split")You! Creature! Worst taxi driver Split ever met! Creature blind or just stupid?
(2/2, furious)Split kill you after escape! Beat first, then kill! Or pretend Split is taxi driver, deliver creature to blood-traitor, then beat, then kill!
(1/2, furious)Split not calm down! Creature calm down first, or... or...!
(2/2, actually calming down, but still hostile)Split realise creature still here. Why come? What else creature want but gloat?
(1/3, agitated, by "Curs" he means the "Empyrean Curs", his former crew)Split want nothing to do with filthy, dishonourable Curs! Except if making amends!
(2/3, a bit more amicable, rambling)Split tried make peace, leave past behind. Brothers, sisters, friend-foes, conflict, tangle, chaos! No honour! Only choice was no choice.
(3/3, collects himself, agitated again)Enough talk! Creature take responsibility, now! Help Split escape, then Split not kill. Maybe!
(agitated)What creature waiting for? Open cell or eat fist!
(still angry, but excited/impatient about player helping him to escape)About time! Split find hiding spot!
(whispering loudly, angry, says this when player talks to him while he's hiding)Creature reveal Split hiding spot! Creature nothing better to do?
(whispering loudly, angry, says this when player stops bothering him)Split thought so!
(1/2, whispering loudly, angry, by "friend-foes" he means his former crew members, "Kriss" is female)Split not talk about friend-foes! Kriss went against family. Betrayal followed petty betrayal!
(2/2, whispering loudly, angry, "Windfall" is a place, same as 20005,9057)Way of Windfall, yes. Way of some Split, maybe, but not how real warriors do revenge!
(trying to be professional, but still angry)Split close to dock.
(trying to be professional, but still angry)Split on board.
(calmer, reserved, suspicious)Split on board. Weird Paranid here too.
(1/5)(angry)No! Against better judgement Split trusted creature!(anger at betrayal)
(2/5)(angry)How dare it? Split rip to shreds! Beat it dead!(pure anger)
(4/5)Please, no! Split kill you!(desperation and anger)
(5/5)*** banging noise in the back of the ship ***
(1/4)Split thanks creature for saving Split!(happy and grateful)
(2/4)From situation creature put Split in.(slightly unsure how to process situation)
(3/4)Should not be mad, is Kriss fault!(decisive)
(4/4)Now leave Split to make arrangements to leave system for good!(determined but not unfriendly)

page.title: Mission Split Female 3 / Sae T'Plt
page.descr: Lines for Mission Split NPC Female 3 / Sae T'Plt
page.t: Where is Split? What is this place?
This cannot be! Split has obligations!
Split has much to think about. Please vacate.
Split processing strange circumstances, creature. Kind of you to ask.
This place disturbs Split. Split cannot leave. Cannot go home.
Split distant from proper time and place.
But what are "missions"? Why are recruits doing them? Who are "high-ups"?
These missions do good? Or is Split slaved to malign force?
Indeed. Split sees no escape. Must think further on this.
Concern is kind, Harper. Split must discuss something.
Imprisonment hard for Split. Split desires return to own time.
Split still learning about facility and missions.
Split thinks you also assess this situation.
Split and Harper must speak on this again some time.
We not discuss this with others. Split does not trust.
Someone tried to communicate with Split also.
Harper and Split must find this dark.
Perhaps finding Mitsuno is key to escape.
Creature. Why do you lurk near Split?
Hello, friend of Split, Harper Donel.
Split and Harper must speak soon.
Greetings Harper. You must have heard, Split has recruited new Split.
Pa from prestigious family, but here, she far from her authority. She has tiresome manner.
Split hopes. Perhaps next Split not have superiority pretensions.
Maybe, Harper. Would be good to have another ally as Split seeks escape from this place.
Split has no report. Still analysing Facility and missions.
Only two Split here. Split should be allies but Pa plays pawn to Mission Director.
You cling to high-born authority. In this Split time your family long fallen.
Split change no future. Perform tasks, yes - missions... missions...
But reality is here. On this rock. Escape necessary.
Benefits? You think these creatures will reward? Split are expendable.
Recruit is Pa t'Snt. Split troubled new recruit may drain energies.
Split appreciates Harper's interest. Split adapts as Split must. But still seeks path home.
Split early judgement may have been over-harsh. Split are in same situation.
Split superiority? You tread these halls like princess, expecting gracious fawning.
Safe? Captured and imprisoned far from home?
Listen to Pa, human Lissa. Pa speaks sense.
Thank you Pa. That is exact point.
Lissa. You serve these "high-ups" so willingly. But you no use to those you call comrades.
Split Pa was so irritating. But now Split has these feelings.
Split abdomen pounds when see Pa.
This is Split tragedy. Split will escape. Split must escape. Pa wants escape.
But Pa home not Split home. Her time not Split time.
Only way to stay with Pa is if Split not escape. But giving up on escape will betray her.
So Split must fight to escape. To send Pa to her time.
This excellent news, Harper. You must show Split.
Split has found clue to escape. Must share with human friend.
There is hidden workshop in facility. Harper must follow Split.
Is Harper ready to follow Split?
What, Harper? What have you found?
Split ready. Lead way, friend Harper.
We may need help. Split bring Pa t'Snt.
She made clear to Split her feelings on this. Pa also wishes for freedom.
It is agreed. Split speak with Pa.
Well, friend Harper. You really have found something interesting.
Whoever it is, they evaded attention of Mission Director.
This person's engineering expertise may be useful for escape plans.
Split and Harper must return to this place. Find mysterious engineer.
Harper Donel. Split friend. Split not expecting to see you here.
Split fears there is little time. Tammancktall is brainwashing cadre of supporters.
They may not tolerate Split existence here much longer.
Are these people dead? Why are they pure white?
This place not for Split. You can find other recruits.
Pa! What is this destiny nonsense?
But Mitsuno... Can you save her?
So you use Split to power... clairvoyance? Split just elements in your... future-reading?
Split hurt. Pa used Split. She has feigned love for Split to spy on us.
Maybe Split should ask Sohnen to return Split to dream.
Perhaps this reality is limited, but it is only reality Split has ever truly known.
Split must find escape. Keep hunting for clues, human Harper.
Cannot draw attention to escape plans. Continue with missions.
This Facility not worthy of Split. We are slaves here.
Split focuses on missions. They distract Split.
If Split was born here, perhaps this home.

page.title: Mission Split Female 4 / Pa T'Snt
page.descr: Lines for Mission Split NPC Female 4 / Pa T'Snt
page.t: Greetings, creature. You must be Harper Donel.
This, strange place. Strange situation. Split still considering place here.
Ah Sae t'Plt. Split recruiter. Split cannot call her comrade at this time.
It Split nature to seek dominance.
Sae misunderstands Split circumstances and pursues such dominance.
Perhaps Split will give her more time.
Split is no pawn. Split must conduct missions to understand Facility.
Knowledge is power and Split seeks both.
Split lies! You speak of future as stone carved. Yet recruits change future every day.
Split will use technology to bring true glory to family.
Sae deluded. Split must earn benefits from this circumstance.
Split has no time for this.
But childish power games will not serve Split here.
Split established foundations, creature Harper. Thank you.
She is complicated. Sae less... egregious than Split first thought.
Paranid creature is wise. Split wonders about his thoughts on our purpose at Facility.
Paranid believes recruits are guardians of higher power. Split cannot discount supernatural forces.
That is laughable. You treat Split like worm.
Split cannot abide your sneering superiority.
Sae speaks truth. Split had no choice. Split wants to go home.
Duress not choice, human. It is coercion.
Yes, human Lissa. Find something useful. Get Split home.
Split... lonely. Split far from home.
Sae t'Plt understands. She was... objectionable. But she also seeks home.
Split find Sae... kind. Under her rigid carapace.
So you think Split has purpose here?
But Split longs to return home. Split trapped here.
You give Split much to think on, friend Tammancktall.
Split thinks answers lie ahead. We not linger here.
Split had to stop Mitsuno from killing Creator. Split are Guardians of Destiny.
Split did not kill Mitsuno! You heard the Sohnen!
He put her back in dream, where she wanted to be!
Everyone looks at Split like murderer!
Split cannot take much more. Split might get self put back in dream.
If they put Split back, Split hopes to forget all this.
Split wonders if Paranid Tammancktall might know something about these Creators.
Split must do missions. Perhaps Mission Director will send Split home.
Split does not wish to speak, human. Leave Split alone.

page.title: Mission Split Male 3 / Patriarch Tharka
page.descr: Lines for Mission Split NPC Male 3 / Patriarch Tharka
page.t: ...and with Split colonies spread all over galaxy, our name, Tharka, shall echo for all eternity!
Planetary colony battling craven machine raid.
Contact to colony lost. Family Tharka fades from this system.
Scouts returned with reports. Fleet heads on to new system to establish family holdings.
Gravidar signals detected. Scout twin gates.
No machine can prevent our way.
Destroy engine to slow their advance!
All engines under repair. Defend position.
Fight glorious battle for Family Tharka!
Tharka fading away. No glory here. Run.
Fleet successfully relocated to new system! Family Tharka shall expand far and wide!
Machine capital ship engaged travel drive.
Machine capital ship gaining on Colony Ship!
Machine capital ship attacking Colony Ship!
Shoot machine capital ship out of travel drive!
Destroy engine to slow machine down!
Machine capital ship shot out of travel drive!

page.title: Mission Split Male 4 / Scenario Terrorist
page.descr: Lines for Mission Split NPC Male 4 / Scenario Terrorist
page.t: ... and if demands not met station will explode.
I see creature! What is it doing?
Split think station fall apart without bomb!
Why is camera off? Split suspicious!

page.title: Mission Split Male 5 / Timelines Hub Split Recruit
page.descr: Lines for Mission Split Male 5 / Timelines Hub Split Recruit
page.t: May the Creators smile on you, Guardian Harper Donel.
Split is in moment of prayer and reflection.
Split admires your work for the Creators.
Split now Quettanaut. Split embrace way of Kaori Chen.
