(variant)(ship scanned by police - something found)Somebody else must have placed that in my ship's storage!
(variant)(ship scanned - illegal)Hey! I know my rights!
(report to superior)My ship is being scanned.
(variant)(ship scan warning)What do we have in here then?
(variant)(ship scan result - nothing found)Sss! What a waste of time!
(variant)(ship scan result)This scan has turned out to be most rewarding.
(variant)(ordered to drop cargo - releases under duress)Take this cargo.
(variant)(ordered to surrender ship - surrenders under duress)The ship is yours.
(station / ship sabotaged - explosives)I'm noticing a small breach. It looks like someone used explosives on the hull.
(station / ship sabotaged - EMP)Electronics have gone dead somewhere. Someone used an EMP device.
(station / ship hacked)It looks like someone's hacked us.
(station security saw suspicious activity)We've picked up suspicious activity.
(station security saw suspicious activity - report inside managers office)Security vessels are reporting suspicious activity.
(manager response to sabotage, hacking or suspicious activity)Send out additional security vessels.
(manager / captain response to sabotage, hacking or suspicious activity)Launch emergency fighters.
Make sure service crew know to fix the damage.
(call to security forces - minor)Look out for any suspicious activity.
(call to security forces - major)Tell us of any suspicious activity immediately.
(call to security forces - search)Scan for suspicious activity.
Look only for our target resource.
(NPC moves onto player's ship)I'm aboard your ship and ready to go.
(NPC moves off player ship)Thanks for the ride. See you around.
(No room on player's ship)You don't have enough room on your ship right now.
(NPC wants to leave ship)Drop me off at the nearest station.
(Player receives licence)Congratulations on your new licence.
(greeting - black marketeer - on introduction)(@voice confident but not drawing attention)If you're looking to find some black market merchandise, I'm the one to talk to.
(Friendly greeting)It's good to see you, friend.
(Allied greeting)It's an honour to see you here.
(Start of greeting)On behalf of our organisation: (keep space)
We need to damage the target further.
(to marine)Alright, get out of there. Abort.
(on failure, somber)Our loss today is insurmountable.
(boarding pod launched)Pod launched. Moving to target.
(begin breach)We're making our way through the hull.
(marine lost during breach)Man down! Watch out for countermeasures on the hull!
One of the teams is pinned down.
(lots of fighting noise)We're taking heavy losses.
(lots of fighting noise)We're pushing through. Lots of resistance.
We've secured several sections. Moving on.
The commander is dead. Our defence is cracking.
I have a team working on bypassing a lockdown.
The crew seems to be abandoning ship.
The self-destruct has been activated. We're working on disabling it.
I don't think we can make it to the bridge. Requesting abort.
I'm calling it. Abort! Get back to your pods!
(self-destruct imminent, somber)Sorry, Sir. This isn't looking good.
(target damaged)Don't destroy the target while we're in here!
(emergency event mission offer)I could really use some help right now.
(data leak signal - illegal opportunity)I'm taking a big risk by broadcasting, so if you decode this transmission, keep it to yourself. I have work that needs doing.
(data leak signal - plea for help - intense)Can anyone hear me?! Hello?! I'm not supposed to be broadcasting but I need help! Please! I need help!
(data leak signal - plea for help - intense)Can anyone hear me?! I need help! Please, if you can hear this, I need help!
(data leak signal - plea for help)Hey! I know this is unconventional, but if you can hear this, I could use some help.
(station masstraffic mini-mission)Don't let them get away!
(station masstraffic mini-mission)Illegal cargo on drone detected.
(station masstraffic mini-mission)Illegal wares on drone detected.
(station masstraffic mini-mission)Illegal data on drone detected.
(player looks at offer - generic)Are you interested in a job?
(player looks at offer - easy difficulty)You shouldn't have any trouble with this.
(player looks at offer - hard difficulty)You'll need your wits about you for this.
(player looks at data leak mission offer - illegal opportunity)You decrypted my signal. Good.
(player looks at illegal mission offer)This could be lucrative for both of us.
(player looks at data leak mission offer - plea for help)I'm glad you found my signal.
(player looks at emergency mission offer or plea for help)I hope you can help!
(player looks at mission offer again - generic)So you're still interested?
(player looks at mission offer again - illegal opportunity)I knew you wouldn't resist.
(player looks at mission offer again - emergency or plea for help)You came back? Does that mean you'll help?
(variant)(encounter offer - illegal activity 01 - upcoming raid - call)Our next incursion will be leaving soon. Will you be coming with us?
(variant)(encounter offer - illegal activity 01 - upcoming raid - response)This sounds like it could be most profitable. I will gladly participate.
(variant)(encounter offer - illegal activity 02 - black marketeer - call)I cannot sell these items on the open market. Would you like to make a private deal?
(variant)(encounter offer - illegal activity 02 - black marketeer - response)This trade seems acceptable. I will be in at my usual spot on this station.
(variant)(encounter offer - illegal activity 03 - lockbox - call)At these coordinates, you will find a lockbox. I have put the items in it.
(variant)(encounter offer - illegal activity 03 - lockbox - response)I will fetch the items as soon as I get a chance.
(player declines mission offer)Come and find me if you change your mind.
(player declines mission offer - illegal opportunity)Ah... you'll be back. I'm sure.
(player declines mission offer - plea for help)What?! No! Please!
(player accepts mission offer)I knew I could count on you.
(reluctant for player to take mission - particularly hard missions, etc)Alright. If you think you can handle it.
(player accepts illegal opportunity)Smart move. Don't mess this up.
(player accepts plea for help or emergency mission offer)Thank you! Good luck!
(mission update)There's been a change of plans with the job.
(partial success)If that's the best you could do... sure.
(failed mission)I hope you don't think you're being paid for that.
(success in mission chain)We're one step closer to completion.
(failure in mission chain)That didn't go well, but we might still be able to salvage this.
(mission aborted by NPC / script failure)Sorry. Looks like your services are no longer required.
Greetings pilot. I represent the well-respected Teladi Trade Guild and I have a lucrative proposition for you.
If you're interested, come find me.
It is good to see you. Our guild is currently seeking to increase our presence in the market.
To retain our lead in the market, we're offering membership to a select number of trusted individuals.
This is a one-time investment, after which you will have access to a number of job listings.
As you can expect, most jobs will involve generating profit but we also require combat pilots.
We must protect our interests and seek out new opportunities. You can help us do that.
What do you say to this generous offer? We would be happy for you to join us.
(reject)You will need to become a member of our guild first.
Very good. I'll update our database right away. You will now be able to see jobs on offer in the areas we operate.
We expect good things from you.
It appears you do not have the necessary funds available.

page.title: Mission Teladi NPC 1 / Diplomat Intro - Scale Plate Lieutenant
page.descr: Lines for Mission Teladi NPC 1
page.t: Well now, Argon. It is a good thing you have turned up. I am glad you haven't wasted my time.
I am well aware of who you are and who you represent.
Well now, what have we here?
I suppose you are here to give me something.
This was a fun little exercise.
I must say, that Dal Busta is a rather interesting man.
He convinced me to give Hatikvah the chance to repay their debts so that we can all move forward.
But there seems to have been a misunderstanding.
(Emphasis on 'you')Yet, here you stand. You must be a trusted ally of Hatikvah, but hardly the figurehead I expected.
If Hatikvah will not show me the respect of submitting to me in person, I am afraid this business arrangement has reached an impasse.
I wonder. Will you reach Hatikvah in time to warn them or will you be greeted by wreckage.

page.title: Mission Teladi NPC 2 / Terraforming contact (18B)
page.descr: Lines for Mission Teladi NPC 2
page.t: Greetings. I am Gantelios Tranoris Wesibalis IV and I speak for a party of individuals that are unsatisfied with the way our culture overvalues fiscal productivity and leaves the unlucky to subsist in destitution. We wish to make this system a haven for the downtrodden, but cannot afford to house and feed them in space. If you provide us with the necessary infrastructure on the planet, we can finally turn this dream into reality.(speak IV as ‘four', not ‘the fourth')
Oh happy day! The first of us have moved in and we are about to have our first council meeting. So exciting!

This world is really turning into a bustling community. People are arriving from all over; luckily we have enough space and food for everyone. Please keep up the good work. I never want to have to turn anyone away! Also, I thought you might like to hear that a school has just been named after you.

We took the grand opening of our art college as an excuse to hold a fundraiser, to try and reward you for your efforts and perhaps enable you to help others! We set our goal at the lofty - but very historic - amount of eighteen billion credits. You may not be surprised to hear that we, um... fell a bit short, but here you go!

page.title: Mission Teladi NPC 3 / Terraforming contact (MoP)
page.descr: Lines for Mission Teladi NPC 3
page.t: You have just entered the competition to make profit more than just a memory. We wish you the best of luck, and look forward to seeing what innovations you bring to the table.
Terraforming? Now that is a novel idea! And absolutely free from any sort of competition... Our sincere compliments on finding a new economic niche and filling it.
We are pleased to see your progress. Your prize is within grasping distance. Do not give up now!
Congratulations, you won! As was promised, you are now the sole supplier of Nividium to the planet-side workshops. May your profits lead to many new fruitful endeavours.

page.title: Mission Teladi NPC 4 / Pioneers Civilian 2 - Yaki investigation
page.descr: Lines for Mission Teladi NPC 4
page.t: I am on a trade mission for the local branch of the Teladi Company.
If things go well, I may soon call myself CEO of the Uguras Foundation, purveyor of progress and business partner of the Segaris Pioneers.
Independence is truly one of the greatest catalysts for profit.
(scoffs)Everyone here is so secretive. It feels as if I am constantly walking on eggshells.
That customs officer is the worst of the entire clutch. If you miss one small bit of the customs code and answer in the wrong fashion, you suddenly find yourself left outside and a deal short.
Have you heard that certain sensory impressions can trigger memories?
For me personally, it's the sight of my credit balance increasing.
A pleasure doing business with you. I can already feel it all coming rushing back to me.
Now, I do vividly remember seeing a man, most likely an Argon, leaving the customs office in a hurry.
As a Teladi, I can't really comment on such things, but one of his kind may indeed have described him as unseemly. His face bore strange markings, possibly from a war injury or a cheap surgery.
That said, I was supposed to discuss a trade agreement today, and my appointment keeps getting postponed.
I've waited quite long enough. Farewell, generous patron.

page.title: Mission Teladi NPC 5 / Scaleplate lieutenant - Covert ops
page.descr: Lines for Mission Teladi NPC 5
page.t: (Surprised)Hey, hang on a moment! I recognise you!
(Amused)You were involved in the Hatikvah mess.
(Thinly veiled contempt)I see you are still a package carrier, only now you seem to have chosen a more powerful master.
You should thank us for untethering you from that Busta guy!
That fool always thought he knew more than he actually did.
(Gleeful)Anyway, these supplies will go a long way towards sustaining our raids in Argon space.
My fleet will stage a raid against the station.
When they inevitably refuse to surrender, we will launch a full-scale attack.
(Malicious)When your subordinate here approaches the station, we cannot simply turn a blind eye to that ship.
(Gloating)It would be a shame if we blow our cover, and our little ruse falls apart just because we did not take action.
In order to really sell this, I have ordered my fleet to shoot down anything trying to pass.
They are unaware of our little arrangement, so do not expect any mercy.
(Arrogant)Run along now, package carrier. We have an attack to prepare.
(Calm)Maintain cover, everybody, until we are in close range.
(Threatening)This is a Scale Plate Pact raid. Disengage defences and allow us entry to your station!

page.title: Mission Teladi NPC 6 / Ambushing Teladi Pirate - Covert ops
page.descr: Lines for Mission Teladi NPC 6
page.t: (Announcing presence)This is a Scale Plate Pact raid!
(Threatening)Drop your cargo and surrender your ships!

page.title: Mission Teladi NPC 7 / Teladi captain - Terran jumpgate discovery
page.descr: Lines for Mission Teladi NPC 7
page.t: (Reading out a message addressed at you)"Dear Yololios Sanduras Rusiris XI, you never were the shiniest egg in the clutch. Your piloting abilities were overshadowed by your egg-sibling Rusiris V, your lack of management skills put to shame by Rusiris IX, and you didn't show as much interest in my endeavours as Rusiris II. Your brazen display of financial incompetence was quite a disappointment. But now, as the final balance is calculated and nothing else matters any more, I finally understand that your interests lay elsewhere."

"At this point I no longer care about the ruination you are about to bring upon your inheritance. You do your own thing and find pleasure in whatever it is that you enjoy. Your mismanagement may even create opportunities for others who are still devoted to finding their happiness in profits. And who knows? Maybe your unconventional methods could even be an advantage in the current market, and benefit you financially. But who am I misleading? Yours faithfully, Sanduras Rusiris Libaras II."(Finish reading with a big sigh) *** Sigh ***
(Teladi vs Terran trade-official bickering - Teladi Speaker)
We are looking for mutual opportunities to make profits.
... but we can surely achieve mutual benefit from...(next speaker interrupts)
Maybe we can persuade you with valuable information about...(next speaker interrupts)
The unrealised profits from this unfortunate loss of opportunity are split equally between each of us.
This is Teladi Trader Lucrative Investment to Terran Patrol.

page.title: Mission Teladi NPC 8 / Ace / Workforce Supervisor
page.descr: Lines for Mission Teladi NPC 8
page.t: Sorry, I am busy right now.
(reaction to friendly fire)Hey, will you stop firing?
(reaction to friendly fire)You are wrecking my shields!
(reaction to friendly fire)Why are you shooting at me?
(* Gamestart Narration * - Pirate DLC GS 2 / Stranded)
(line 1 is spoken by a different character)

(chiding, dragging someone back to reality, by "jolly egg salad" she means "what a load of nonsense", "Axiom" is a male friend, harrumph before "Our Wildcard", "Wildcard" is the player's nick name and the player can be male or female, "bastu" is a common swear word)Jolly egg salad, you are one for tall tales, Axiom! If you do not stop adding another piece of scale-bristling bravado to this story every time you tell it, I will one day foreclose on your bastu! So, let us start again, and kindly from the very beginning! Our Wildcard had just found [mp:himself|fp:herself] in something of a predicament, with ample time to reflect on [mp:his|fp:her] past mistakes.
I thank you for meeting with me.
I am a shift supervisor for one of your factories. After discussing this issue with the manager, I felt it prudent to also approach you.
A number of workers have been leaving their tasks unfinished. They have been visiting an entertainment centre that recently opened in a nearby sector.

Not exactly. I think we can profit from incorporating a similar facility on our station. My subordinates would find it more convenient, and we would have a better negotiating position for attracting new workers.
It is simply limiting our losses.
I do not, but I can tell you where to find the Argon in charge of that entertainment centre. He seemed rather excited at the prospect of competition.
I look forward to your decision.
I must return. I thank you for your time.

I was able to bankrupt myself before the 6th cycle, which is a personal best. I invested in a personal yacht and summarily appointed an Argon as my treasurer. He later donated a sizeable amount to charity.
Hey, Chipmunk!(Translate 'Chipmunk' same as {30252,110}, nickname for the player, greeting)
Hey, Wildcard!(Translate 'Wildcard' same as {30252,111}, nickname for the player, greeting)
Taking major damage, and frankly I am shaking.
(1/6)Ah, hello. You must be Chipmunk!(very upbeat demeanour)
(2/6)I must have just missed you the last time you were here.
(3/6)You see, of everyone in the Empyrean Curs, I am the best pilot!
(4/6)Need someone to lead the charge towards unsuspecting traders, or tangle with the local security forces?
(6/6)Oh, I am Ace, by the way. A pleasure to meet you!
(2/8)I was the first one to join the Empyrean Curs after its founding!
(3/8)It quickly became obvious that, of the four of us, I was the most gifted pilot.
(4/8)In those early years, when the Vigor Syndicate was not quite as established as it is now, we mostly made our profits from targeting the occasional luxury trader.
(5/8)Occasionally we would supplement our income by smuggling illegal wares, during those brief periods when someone ambitious seized control and tried to enforce some semblance of law.
(6/8)The Syndicate has grown stronger and more dangerous, though, and with the gates reconnecting us to other systems, we have started turning our attention outwards.
(7/8)I usually participate in scouting activities, but also take part in combat raids, which are my true burning passion.
(8/8)I like fighting my enemies head on... for the most part.(short but meaningful pause between the two sentences)
(1/6)Yes, but enough with these formal introductions.
(2/6)The Maestro asked me to see how well you perform under pressure.
(3/6)Coming under fire is the truest test of character, after all.
(4/6)So, the two of us are going to rob a trader!
(5/6)Do not be nervous. I will be with you every step of the way.
(6/6)You go ahead now. I will be right behind you!
(1/5)Let us see if we can find a system that is not too heavily patrolled.
(2/5)We would not want you killed in action on our first outing.
(3/5)Whenever we are looking for a suitable target to rob, it is usually a good idea to start at a station.
(4/5)Space is vast, after all, and finding ships can be difficult, but everyone needs to dock at a port eventually.
(5/5)I have now sent you the location of the station I have selected.
(1/4)This station is selling valuable high-tech wares, which do not come cheap.
(2/4)Wares are usually transported from a station by trade ships.
(3/4)Keep an eye out for m-sized High-Tech Traders, they make for especially easy marks!(translate marks as targets)
(4/4)Scan any you come across, to check their current cargo capacity.
You need to change into Scan Mode to be able to scan your target.(when in range to correct ship)
Oh, you do not want to mess with combat ships quite yet!(when scanning combat type ship)
This is a trader, but it isn't dealing in high-tech wares. Keep looking.(wrong type of trader)
This is the right type of ship, but the scan revealed it isn't carrying enough freight to be worth the trouble.(empty cargo)
An L-size ship? Seriously? That is a bit ambitious. Let us keep looking!(wrong size - L)
An S-size ship is hardly worth the trouble. Look for an M-size trader!(wrong size - S)
(1/5)The scan confirms that this ship is carrying cargo. This is our mark!
(2/5)Do not jump the gun, though! We are still close enough to allied stations for them to take notice!(if target close to station)
(3/5)We would not want the whole sector to come down on us!
(4/5)Just trail the ship until it moves far enough away from allied stations, so that it will not immediately be able to request back up.
(5/5)The ship is far enough away from its allied stations; any response will not be immediate.
Let us go on the offensive!
Oh, you went ahead anyway? That is fine, we will just have to move fast.(when attacking in station range)
(1/2)You have inflicted a lot of damage to the ship's hull.
(2/2)Comm the pilot and suggest that they surrender!
Stay out of the turret's line of fire!
(1/2)We lost the ship. There is no way to get to the cargo now.
There it is! The ship dropped it's cargo!
Now leave the pilot be. No sense in killing anyone without good reason.
(1/3)Oh, your ship's storage is too small?
(2/3)Next time, if you are going to rob someone, make sure to bring a suitable ship!
(3/3)Just cover me while I pick it up!
(1/3)Okay, we got what we needed. Let us depart!
(2/3)I will return the booty to the Arcadian Endeavour.
(2a/3)Feel free to keep whatever you gathered, as your cut.(if the player participated in collecting)
We could really use the revenue generated from this robbery.
In my trusty old ship. Perhaps it is time for an upgrade?(more to herself)
We are still too close to the stations to try anything.(after a while following one ship)
Just be patient, that ship is bound to head away from the stations eventually.(after a while following one ship)
That was a classic hold-up. Perfectly executed!(chipper)
(2/7)The Maestro has let you know that everyone is working on a bigger heist now, right?
(3/7)Well, it falls on us to procure an inconspicuous trade ship.
(4/7)You have probably figured out what comes next...
(6/7)In order to efficiently conduct a boarding operation, you need marines aboard your ship.
(7a/7)Return to me once you have hired a contingent of capable marines!(if the player does not have enough marines)
(7b/7)I can see that you already have a group of capable marines in your employment!
Are you ready to take on an L-sized trade ship?
Did you manage to assemble an outfit of marines?
(1/3)That is the ship that the Maestro picked out as suitable.
(2/3)How about you fly closer and scan it?
(3/3)That way we can get a better idea of what we are dealing with here!
(1/3)After the scan, you can see how many crew members are aboard the ship.
(2/3)That, and the ship's general state, will give you a good idea of how much of a challenge boarding will be.
(3/3)This trader here looks to be sufficiently weak. We will not need too many marines to make it ours!
(1/2)First of all, we need to disable the engines and turrets, so that the trader is completely at our mercy!
(2/2)The worse the state of the trader, the better your chances of a successful boarding!
Oh! You want to send your marines without weakening the trader first? Okay then...(if the player sends marines immediately)
(2/2)You can send your marines over to board the ship now!
(2/4)Claiming your first prize under the flag of the Empyrean Curs!
(3/4)I bet that must have felt exhilarating!
(4/4)Now, you just need to order the ship back to the Arcadian Endeavour, so that we can take it off your hands!
Do you want to hand it over now?(prompt to hand over the ship)
Yo, ho! Yo, ho! A pirate's life for me!(in a shanty singing voice)
(1/9)So, we are going to engage the Ministry, I hear?
(2/9)Good! People say that I have a very chipper disposition, but the Ministry of Finance makes me sick to my stomach.(excited)
(3/9)Teladi are not naturally aggressive. We all have an innate instinct to avoid conflict.
(4/9)Very rarely will you find skilled combat pilot material among my people.
(5/9)Naturally, the Ministry needed skilled pilots and marines, so they devised a very unique training regimen for their cadets.
(6/9)It is an intense and gruelling process, intended to completely strip a Teladi of their natural escape reflex.
(7/9)Yet it would be so easy to turn that instinct into an advantage!(frustrated)
(8/9)Not only is the Ministry oppressively policing which goods are allowed, and which are not, but they are also bending and breaking Teladi minds to enforce their arbitrary rules!(spiteful)
(9/9)So no, I do not mind tangling with those guys.(anxious to fight)
(1/2)Do not worry! I will be right beside you.(reassuring)
(2/2)Amazing how huge these ships can seem, up close!
We are taking a lot of heat!
We need to get out of here, right now!(unnerved)
I have an idea. Follow me!
Head for that tear there!(tear meaning rip, referring to an anomaly)
Accelerate! Do not slow down!(very tense and forceful)
See you on the other side!
(3/3)But it seems like jumping through that tear separated...(tear meaning rip, interrupted by another transmission)
Yeah, that is right! Run along now! All hiss and no bite!(smug, reference to "all bark no bite")
(1/5)You are probably wondering what allowed the two of us to make such a dramatic exit, right?
(2/5)Well, some time back, the Maestro came across these weird phenomena, kind of like tears in space.(tears meaning rips)
(3/5)You can use them to jump between systems; we use them for a quick getaway!
(4/5)Only if absolutely necessary, of course! There is no way to control your destination, so if you are unlucky, you can find yourself in a system overrun with Xenon.
(5/5)I am sure someone with more scientific acumen might be able to study these things and get more out of them, but that someone is certainly not us!(if no Boso)
(2/3)I am looking forward to stealing from the Ministry.(Ministry same as {20203,704})
(2/3)He was already with the crew before I joined.
(3/3)But they had a falling-out and he left to seek new opportunities.
I would rather not discuss their private matters.
(1/3)We are going to attack an M-class ship in order to steal it.
(2/3)Do you have a combat worthy ship?
I have a ship for you, tailored for this job.
(2/2)Engage, I will be right behind you.
(1/2)Going somewhere else? I will wait here for you.
(2/2)I will join up with you again, when you come back.
(2/2)I will make my way over to you.
I will be back at the Arcadian Endeavour(ship name same as {30252,201}).
(2/2)Give me a moment to locate another one.
(1/2)Our target will not receive any help in this sector as the police authority does not care for them.
(2/2)So, we do not need to look out for any distress drones while it tries to escape us.
(1/3)First approach it peacefully, and then perform a scan to get an idea of their crew count.
(2/3)Our job will be to keep the ship and ourselves healthy while we try to get each of them to bail.
(3/3)Do not try this on capital ships. Their marines and captains are too stubborn to leave.
Scan the ship so we can get an idea of their crew count.
(1/4)Now, before we attack, do not get hit.
(2/4)If your shield or hull get low, their crew will think they have got a chance and resist the urge to jump into an Escape Pod.
(3/4)You can avoid getting hit by finding a blind spot, or keeping your distance, to evade any turret fire.
(4/4)This ship has shard weapons and turrets, so keep your distance.
If it gets too close, do not be afraid to disengage for a moment.
(1/2)We will need to keep their hull below 75% and their shields down.
(2/2)Once they realise that they cannot escape with their ship, they will jump into their Escape Pods and leave it behind.
Remove the target's shields to prevent it from boosting.(Shields same as {30198,15}, Boosting same as {30198,14})
(1/2)Careful, do not get their hull too low.
(2/2)We do not want it to blow up.
This ship is heavily armed, take care.
Keep the shields down, or else they might feel too safe and comfortable.
Keep the hull down, they are repairing it.
Jolly profit! The ship is abandoned!
(1/2)Now, you could send marines to claim abandoned ships, but they tend to damage it on entry.
Go for a little space walk and claim the ship yourself.
(1/3)Send it back to the Arcadian Endeavour(ship name same as {30252,201}).
(2/3)I will meet you and the crew there.
(3/3)And then we will show those Ministry husks what a true Teladi is capable of!(Ministry same as {20203,704})
(2/2)It is better to go for a small space walk and claim the ship yourself.
(2/3)We have a plan to get in. We will get him out.
(1/2)Let us finish up preparations before we engage.
(2/2)I was about to acquire a better combat ship.
(2/2)Do not worry. We will get him out.
Yes, and my shiny new combat ship could come in very handy, once it is time to disengage!(if Ace mission)
But we will still go after the Science Division prototype, right?(unsure)
(1/3)I am right beside you.(if Ace mission)
(2/3)Thanks to the ship you got me, I can really dish out some damage!(if Ace mission)
(3/3)Fine! Die alongside them, then!(resignation and anger)
Had you already decided that you would stab us in the back, when you helped me acquire a new combat ship?(if Ace mission)
(2/3)I have to be honest, for a second there I thought we were done for!
(3/3)But of course, we prevailed! We had a Wildcard up our sleeve!
This is Ace, signing off!(matter of fact, when character dies)
(1/3)There you are!(elated to have found the player)
(2/3)I have been looking everywhere for you, you traitor!(angry)
(3/3)For the Maestro and the Axiom!(rallying cry)
The Curs shall have their revenge!(very energetic)
No more talking!(shutting the player down)

page.title: Mission Teladi NPC 9 / MIN Pursuing Pilot / Shady Bar Decoy / The Fan
page.descr: Lines for Mission Teladi NPC 9
page.t: Sorry, I am busy right now.
(reaction to friendly fire)Hey, will you stop firing?
(reaction to friendly fire)You are wrecking my shields!
(reaction to friendly fire)Why are you shooting at me?
(1/2)Mayday! Mayday! Ship 'Bestowed in Perpetuity' inbound for Tidebreak.(ship name same as {30251,205}, station name same as {20103,2901}, speak quick and panicked)
(2a/2)Major engine failure. Need engineers for repairs.(quick and panicked)
Just me. Negative on the rescue mission. I will get it to work.('Just me' answering question about the amount of ship occupants)
(2b/2)Any engineers out there? Please hurry to my location.
(2c/2)Ship in need of repairs. Please report immediately.
(2a/3)Quick! Do an EVA and try to fix the engine.(single engine ship)
(2b/3)Quick! Do an EVA and try to fix the remaining engine.(multiple engines ship)
(3/3)I am trying to fix something with the engine control, from in here.
Assist my Repair Drone('Repair Drone' same as: {20101,100201}, singular) and try to fix the engine.
Assist my Repair Drones('Repair Drone' same as: {20101,100201}, plural) and try to fix the engine.
We need to cooperate to make this work!
No! Come back! I will not make it on my own!(desperate)
No! Come back! I need you!(desperate)
(2/3)I will try to start the engine.
Oh no! No no no no no!
(3/5)Broken wiring is interfering with the engine control.
(4/5)You can access and repair some of those using your spacesuit.
What? No, I just fixed that!
Repair the Signal Leaks using your Repair Laser(same as {20113,1001}), do not scan them!
(1/2)Great! That shines some light on the other issues!
(2/2)Keep repairing! I will try to think of some way to fix it from in here.
It has not failed yet. There is still time!
Yes, the Tide is due. It will destroy the ship, so we need to hurry!(Tide same as {30251,1})
We only need to fix the engine. Non-critical repairs can be fixed once it is docked.
(1/3)Alright. It looks like I have to cut my losses.
Please pick me up. I am floating here.(speaker in spacesuit)
You are too far away, come back!
There is no room for more passengers on board your ship! Quick, drop some off and come back.
You are in a spacesuit. Did you not have a proper ship somewhere around here?
I got in. Let us get out of here, before the Tide hits!(Tide same as {30251,1})
Quick, we need to escape the looming Tide!(Tide same as {30251,1})
(1/2)Let us head to Tidebreak. It was built to withstand the event.(station name 'Tidebreak' same as {20103,2901})
(2/2)I also have an acquaintance there who I would like you to meet.
No! The Tide is destroying my life savings! Tide be damned!
(1/3)This station seems like a suitable place to protect us from the Tide.
(2/3)As long as they have Protectyon, we will be safe.(Protectyon same as {30251,2})
(3/3)Let us wait it out for now.
(1/3)That was it. We escaped the Tide.
(2/3)If you do not mind, let us head to Tidebreak.(station name 'Tidebreak' same as {20103,2901})
(1/2)I have made my way to Tidebreak by myself.(station name 'Tidebreak' same as {20103,2901})
(2/2)If you are interested in meeting my acquaintance, you can find us there.
This sector is not safe from the Tide. We should dock at a station which can protect us.(Tide same as {30251,1})
Sure, we are safe from the Tide in this system, but please drop me off at Tidebreak once it is safe to go there.(Tide same as {30251,1}, station name 'Tidebreak' same as {20103,2901})
Do not forget, that I would like to get back at some point.
Hello there. I am still on your ship.
(1/2)My acquaintance is expecting us on Tidebreak.(station name 'Tidebreak' same as {20103,2901})
(2/2)Let us get there. At your leisure, of course.
(1/2)Ah, Tidebreak! You feast for the eyes!(station name 'Tidebreak' same as {20103,2901})
I am waiting for you on Tidebreak.
Friend! I made it!(Talking to female NPC)
An unfortunate victim of the Tide.(Tide same as {30251,1})
Out there, not too far from the station.(Tide same as {30251,1})
There goes my property.(Losing ship to the environment)
Let us say, you will get a share of the first profits.(Talking to female NPC)
You know, I am an inexperienced pilot.(Talking to female NPC)
I will probably not get it out of there without major damage.
Picked me up in my spacesuit, and got both of us out of there!(talking about player)
Thank you so much for helping me!(Talking to player)

(1/3)It is a place where the Syndicate dumps stripped ships, after their collecting sprees.('Vigor Syndicate' same as {20203,3304}, "collecting" ships from people who cannot afford to pay their debts)
(2/3)The Scrapyard is certainly a bleak sight to behold.('Vigor Syndicate' same as {20203,3301}, Scrapyard same as {30251,201})
(3/3)But stealing from their Scrapyard is one form of payback!(Scrapyard same as {30251,201})
Good luck on your journey!(Talking to player)
(1/2)Woah! Do you see that behemoth?(big ship)
Is everything all right with the ship? No unexpected malfunctions?
(1a/4)I am currently at a Riptide station, and will talk to the manager soon about trade and profitsss.(Riptide faction name same as {20203,3204})
(1b/4)I am currently at a station, and will talk to the manager soon about trade and profitsss.(Riptide faction name same as {20203,3204})
(2/4)After my eager consumption of negotiation technique guides, I am sure to strike a great deal!
(4/4)There is profit to be made, and I may be able to teach you a thing or two about trade negotiations.
(1/2)Hey! The negotiations have not yet commenced.
(2/2)Please come, as I am eager to repay you for your troubles!
(1/3)I know it is a low price, but hear me out!(addressing female NPC)
(2/3)You are practically swimming in those wares; they take up storage space and hamper your production.(addressing female NPC)
(3/3)Eager buyers like us are doing you a favour!(addressing female NPC)
Do you even want to sell your product?(addressing female NPC)
I believe we can come to an agreement.(addressing female NPC)
Maybe I could take the wares off your hands for free instead.(addressing female NPC)
(2/2)However, it needs to stay below Commonwealth prices.(addressing female NPC)
A bit higher is fine.(addressing female NPC)
Brilliant! Then we have a deal!(addressing female NPC)
(2/4)I do not believe that we could have achieved a lower price.(addressing player)
(3/4)And we are undercutting the Commonwealth!(addressing player)
(2/5)I believe we could have negotiated a lower price for the product.(addressing player)
(3/5)I do not feel that you were particularly helpful during the haggling.(addressing player)
(5/5)We are still undercutting the Commonwealth!(addressing player)
(1/4)Now it is time to make some profits!(addressing player)
(2/4)Buy wares at this station, and find profitable trades on the market.(addressing player)
(3a/4)Shipyards and Wharfs should be profitable buyers.(addressing player)
(3b/4)Every station outside Avarice needs energy, so finding buyers should be a swim in a pond!(intended Teladi version for "walk in the park"/very easy)
(4/4)Now look for the highest bidders and make a fortune!(addressing player)
You found a buyer! Good job!(addressing player)
You sold it for how much? Did I see that right?(addressing player)
(2/4)You have made a decent profit selling this ware!(addressing player)
(3/4)I believe I have found another huge opportunity in the meantime.(addressing player)
(1/6)You know that Protectyon is the ware that protects stations in Avarice from being damaged by the Tide?(Tide same as {30251,1}, Avarice same as {20005,9033})
(2/6)Well, we are on a station which can not afford a shipment for the next Tide.(Tide same as {30251,1})
(3/6)Mismanaged stations like this are a great opportunity for profits, as the managers will have to agree to sub-optimal deals, allowing us to trade favourably.
(4/6)He is currently talking to Brantlee Northriver, whose company produces and sells their patented Protectyon.
(5/6)Let us walk in and see how that turns out.
(6/6)If it does not go well, we have an opportunity to offer them the deal of our lives!
Do not forget to come. This could be the opportunity of our lives!
(2/3)I am here to help you secure funds for your Protectyon payment.(addressing male)
(3/3)For a price of course. If you have wares to sell at the minimum market price, we will buy everything.(addressing male)
(2/3)Maybe we can try and secure your funds for future favours.(addressing male)
(2/3)We cannot take payments from you.(addressing player)
(3/3)You see, the Syndicate forbids foreign aid, to encourage a free and competitive market.(addressing player)
(2/2)Once we are big enough, we will be able to negotiate deals with such people on a regular basis!(addressing player)
(1/5)We will have to talk to the Syndicate about a loan.
(2/5)That is what they are all about.
(3/5)I know about one of their communication beacons in the area.
(4/5)You need to get close to establish communications.
Now, quick! Get to that communication beacon!
(2/3)We would like to apply for a loan.(addressing female)
(3/3)This concerns a station which cannot afford Protectyon for the next cycle.(addressing female)
(1/2)But... if they do not give us a loan, how are we supposed to...(shocked)
(2/2)Quickly! Come back to the station and let us talk to the manager and sort something out.(addressing player)
(2/6)The invisible hand ought to ensure supply!
(3/6)How is this supposed to be a free and competitive market, if demand is not being met?
(4/6)We have to break the Northriver monopoly!
(5/6)We need a researcher to investigate this Protectyon!
(6/6)Do you happen to know any scientists?
(1/2)I heard one broadcasting from a Signal Leak, but I was too busy with my own business to take their job offer.(referring to Boso, male)
(2/2)We should go out there and see if we can find him!(referring to Boso, male)
(1/6)(1/4, glad to have assistance)Excellent! Now, Protectyon is exorbitantly expensive, but I suppose we will not need an entire unit to conduct your research.
(2/6)(2/4)It might be our best course of action to approach the CEO of Northriver Company directly.
(3/6)(3/4, slightly hopeful)We might be able to buy a small sample from him.
(4/6)(4/4, more matter of fact)If we can find him, that is.

(5/6)(draw out the sss on pleasure cruise especially)It is well known that he occasionally likes to flaunt his enormous wealth. A fellow trader just spotted him taking his most prized possession out for a pleasure cruise.
(6/6)I have sent you the coordinates of his last known location. Start from there.
(1/3)That has to be him, the ship looks much too extravagant to belong to anyone else!(Excited)
(2/3)You have to admire the lengths he goes to in parading his wealth.
(3/3)Especially while people are sheltering in decaying stations not too far from here.
(1/2)I wonder if being obnoxious is his deliberate business strategy?
(2/2)No matter, it will make it all the more enjoyable when we pull the rug from under the Northriver Company.
Let me get that. I will bring it back to your Boron associate.
You want to take it back to the headquarters yourself? Go ahead.
I really hope we can find a way to make the Protectyon more affordable for everyone in Avarice.("Avarice" same as {20005,9033})
We are still working on finding out what this Protectyon is about, right?
(1/3)How very odd. Northriver is a remarkably small company that seems to have shot up out of nowhere, roughly eleven years ago.(contemplative)
(2/3)If what you say is true, then they could not possibly have had the means to develop this themselves.
(3/3)And frankly, while Brantlee is undoubtedly an ambitious businessman, he certainly does not strike me as the... scientific type.(short pause before scientific type)
(1/3)That petty peddler only really got in contact to gloat.(repulsed)
(2/3)Perhaps you can use the occasion to extract some information...(thinking more to himself)
(3/3)His ego is his weakness. Try to bait him into giving something away!(more present again)
(2/4)He is too preoccupied with praising himself to actually betray anything of substance.
(3/4)I know! From what we have gathered he is immensely proud of his ship...(excited realisation)
(4/4)Just go with that, it might lead somewhere!
(2/2)Yes, the winner gets to take the loser's ship, and then we can use it to leverage him for information!
Considering what is at stake here, no one would think worse of you if you were to bend the rules a little in your favour.(contemplative)
(1/2)I think I know where you are going with this, Boso, and yes, it is indeed possible!(appreciative)
(2/2)Brantlee has already transmitted the coordinates for the race track.
(1/2)Although we now have a plan, you still need to keep up appearances.
(2/2)Do not show up in a cheap piece of junk in which you could not possibly win!
A tricked out engine would help with keeping up appearances.
(1/3)With the right materials, you can mod a ship's engine to be significantly faster than it should be.
(2/3)Make sure you install the engine mod on the ship that you intend to race with.
(3/3)Check the briefing I sent, to see how fast the ship should be able to go at a minimum.
This ship is just not fast enough to fool anyone, even with the mod installed.(Apologetical)
(1/4)Okay, good! You have a ship in which you can begin your race.
(2/4)All you have to do now is deploy an identical-looking ship close to the finish line.
(3/4)Oh, and there is no need for this second ship to be anything special.(he almost forgot to say)
(4/4)Actually, the cheaper and less well-equipped this ship is, the more humiliating the loss will be for Brantlee!(gleeful)
(1/2)Do not use the modded ship here.
(2/2)You need to start the race strongly, so you should deploy a different ship of the same type!
(Matter of fact, no judgement)Are you sure this is the ship you want to use for the race?
(1/2)Just remove the captain from the ship, to minimise the chances of someone giving us away.
(1/4)You know, I have to admit I am nervous about this.(with a confidential tone)

(2/4)I know Brantlee only agreed to the race because he thinks there is no way you could win, but I wonder how he will react when he loses. Men like him are certainly not known for losing graciously.(doubtful)
(3/4)But the opportunity is too great! It is a risk worth taking if it helps to improve life for the people of Avarice.(more steadfast, "Avarice" same as {20005,9033})

(4/4)If they were not continuously being shaken down in return for Protectyon, and could focus on actually expanding their business, perhaps the economy could be fundamentally shifted in the Riptide Rakers' favour, long term.(hopeful)
This whole race business is a unique opportunity. We should do our best not to squander it!
(1/6)These materials for equipment modification are not necessarily easy to come by.
(2/6)You might be able to get your hands on them, by doing missions for a Trade Guild or other organisations.
(3/6)If you do not want to put in the effort, though, I have heard rumours of a specific pirate organisation operating in the network.
(4/6)These illusive Duke's Buccaneers are said to be invested in this kind of advanced tech.
(5/6)Though, it is safe to say they will not part with it willingly.
(6/6)I have heard that they are sometimes spotted around hazardous regions. Shall I mark a place for you to investigate?
(1/2)You are carrying all the materials required to improve your race ship's engine.
(2/2)Now you just need to upgrade a suitable ship at a wharf of your choice.
But we went out of our way to tip the scales in our favour! Outrageous!
(2/2)Boso, from what you have told me, these anomalies are entirely unstable with no way to manipulate their destination.(wary)
(1/7)(dejected)I am sorry to hear that this endeavour was unsuccessful.
(2/7)(more energetic)Something just occurred to me, though.

(3/7)Twenty-five years ago, just after the Tide first arose and the conditions in the Avarice system worsened, a team of nomad scientists set up a small research station to study the phenomenon.("Avarice" same as {20005,9033})

(4/7)These scientists were stranded here when the network cut the system off. While the vast majority of the Riptide Rakers took shelter from the Tide among asteroids, the scientists pushed deeper into the system, hoping to identify the cause of the Tide.

(5/7)I do not think they ever made the breakthrough they were looking for. All I know is that they eventually went bankrupt and left, or died by the Tide or by criminals looking to cannibalise their equipment.
(6/7)Remnants of their old station remain, although naturally it is now entirely non-functional.
(7/7)Although their research did not ultimately amount to much, you might be able to salvage something which could point us in the right direction.
Usually it is easier to access a station like this in your spacesuit.
It really does seem like they mean business. Be careful!(calm but worried)
(1/2)With the Syndicate showing up like this, it really does seem like someone is going to great lengths to cover their tracks, does it not?
(2/2)I imagine that in this environment, any kind of leg-up would inevitably yield enormous profits.
I really do feel like we are close to finding out how Brantlee managed to cheat you!
We are about to uncover some sort of Northriver Company secret, I can tell! We need to pursue this!
(1/2)Would you look at that? It is Brantlee!(animated)
(1/4)Their panicked reactions confirm that this is indeed where they obtain their Protectyon.
(3/4)It will be interesting to hear what they have to say for themselves.
(4/4)This feels like our best shot at finding a way to help the disenfranchised people of the Avarice system.("Avarice" same as {20005,9033})
(1/2)It is incredible how the interior of a ship of this size can look so amazingly lavish!(fascinated)
(2/2)Great profit! They really are non-Teladi twins!(upset at seeing them in person)
(1/4)I seriously hope you are not considering this!(alarmed)
(2/4)We have both seen what their business practices do to people's lives!(angry)
(3/4)Lives snuffed out in a fraction of a second, day after day. They could have put an end to it, any time they deemed fit!
(4/4)Oh, and to think that I defended them from criticism for so long, thinking that the Syndicate was the problem.(regretful)
(1/3)This is incredible. How could you betray the people of Avarice like that?(very upset, "Avarice" same as {20005,9033})
(2/3)How dare you?! I considered you a dear friend!(angry)
(3/3)We made profits together! You saved my life.(clearly disappointed, hurt)
I am very curious to see how Northriver may have used Leap of Faith to generate such profits.
Telling the Twins you were not for sale must have felt good!
Are you not curious about that entire system hidden away somewhere? We should check it out!
(1/2)Stop right there! Nowhere to run now, criminal!(very righteous)
(2/2)Prepare to be met with all the might of the Ministry of Finance!(earnest but over the top)
(2/3)I have been separated from my squad!
Just let me get out of here!(idle line)
(1/3)Hey, you.(whispering to get the player's attention)
Yes, you!(whispering to get the player's attention)
Come here!(whispering to get the player's attention)
(3/3)Can I interest you in a purchase?
Just my humble self.(Answer to: Working for anybody?)
(3/4)Engines, thrusters, everything you need to fly off.
(4a/4)Just a couple of credits.(Credits same as {1001,37})
(1/2)Cheaper if you do not.(Answering to "Can I see it?")
(2/2)A Teladi All-round Engine Mk2.(same as {20107,1064}, speak Mk as Mark)
(1/2)Oh, how fast we have progresssed!(After learning that there is a newer engine)
(2/2)Hard to keep up with the new stuff.
Are you trying to insult me?
(2/2)You can find your ship on the docks.
(1/3)So you have come to make sure that I do not impact on your new friends' bottom line?(spiteful)
(2/3)I should have expected as much. A real company man.
(2/7)I might have an idea how you could get them off your back, though.
(3/7)The Syndicate is only in this for the profits.
(4/7)They do not hold a personal grudge against you; they are only paid to care.
(5/7)So, if you can make it an unattractive business proposition to go after you, they will cease to do so.
(6/7)Get them to back off by taking out their leadership and, at the same time, show them that Northriver are not the only ones around these parts with deep pockets!
(1/2)I have received word from my Riptide Raker contacts, that you are selling them affordable Protectyon!(excited)
(2/2)This will save lives. Thank you so very much!(very happy and grateful)
(1/10)Ah, yes, there you are!(just spotted the player walking in)
(2/10)I am glad that you got back before I left. I would have hated to part ways without saying goodbye properly.(relieved)
(4/10)Turning down the Twins' offer must not have been easy; it was certainly a lucrative deal!
(5/10)Truly, I cannot say how I would have acted in your situation, which makes me appreciate your decision all the more.(contemplative tone)
(6/10)Thank you for everything you have done for the people of Avarice, and for me personally!(very grateful)
(7/10)Now it is time for me to return home, and to seek my fortune among the abandoned wreckage once more.
(8/10)But now, of course, with a bit of added perspective.(reflective)
(9/10)Amassing wealth to the detriment of all else might not be quite as admirable as I once thought.
(10/10)Take care, and may many profits await you in the times to come!
(1/5)I have just received word that you are selling Protectyon now, as well.(concerned)
(2/5)You seem to be offering it at a similar price point to the Northriver Company's Protectyon.(getting worked up)
(4/5)I thought we agreed to help the people of Avarice.("Avarice" same as {20005,9033})
(5/5)Now you are just profiting from their misery, just like those loathsome Twins!(angry)

page.title: Mission Teladi NPC 10 / MIN Station Guard / Minor Teladi prisoner
page.descr: Lines for Mission Teladi NPC 10
page.t: (1/2)You! Stop right there! What are you doing here?
(2/2)There has been a breach in security! Explain yourself!
(1/2)Um, very well then... the identification checks out.(clearly intimidated)
(2/2)Your pilot may move on! Apologies for the inconvenience!
(determined, slightly desperate, speaks only to the player and addresses them as a fellow prisoner in all 30288XXX lines)How did you get out? Take me with you!
(loop 3, desperate)It was the other guy's fault!
(desperate)I really did not know that he was police!
(1/2, desperate)"What about the police lights?", he said.
(2/2, desperate)Well, I thought they looked very festive!
(1/2, excited, feeble, addresses only the player in all 302886XX lines)You there! You! Hey! You are not supposed to be here!
(2/2, excited, feeble)I am not supposed to be here either! Get me out! Please!
(pleading, feeble)Oh, please, please, please! You cannot leave me here!
(pleading, feeble)Is there nothing you can do to get me out?
(1/2, epiphany, feeble)Hey, you there! I recognise you!
(2/2, excited, feeble)You came back for me? Oh, please, say that you have come back for me!
(1/2, feeble, just got freed)You really...? Oh, thank you for getting me out of that cell! They were going to let me waste away in there!
(2/2, feeble, grateful)I will never forget this, mark my words.
(loop1, feeble)Please do not leave me here!
(loop2, feeble)Where are you going? Take me with you!
(loop3, feeble, trying to pronounce "Uguras", the name of a male Teladi)I am friends with Urgu... Ugusa... I can help you make profitsss! I promise!

page.title: Mission Teladi NPC 11 / Pirate Hunter
page.descr: Lines for Mission Teladi NPC 11
page.t: (1/5)Attention, all passing ships!(read like a recorded announcement, with authority)
(2/5)The notorious Duke's Buccaneers are believed to operate within this sector.("Duke's Buccaneers" same as {20203,2401})
(3/5)Pilots are advised to exercise caution when close to stations that trade in valuable commodities.

(4/5)This warning is courtesy of the Ministry of Finance, Division for Piratic Relations.(read a bit quicker, like the disclaimer after a lottery commercial; "Ministry of Finance" same as {20203,701})
(5/5)Addendum: now hiring local investigators for anti-piracy probe!(excited, as if a personal message was attached to the formal recording)
(1/7)I see you have been enticed by the Ministry's generous offer.
(2/7)Good, good... then let us talk business.(pleased with herself, imagine her rubbing her hands)
(3/7)The Duke's Buccaneers are a shadowy thorn under the scales of the Ministry of Finance.
(4/7)Their motives, inscrutable. Their expenses, undocumented.("expenses" isn't meant literally here, but alludes to shady dealings)
(5/7)Our task now, is to follow their... transactions and shine a light on their enterprise.("transactions" is a euphemism for "piracy", say it as if it were in quotation marks)
(6/7)First, I require you to find one of their armoured transport ships, which reputedly roam the Jump Gate network.
(7/7)I suggest you begin your search in the sector where you received our broadcast piracy warning.
(1/3)Word has reached me that the Duke's Buccaneers' business in the designated sector has been terminated.(a bit contrite)
(2/3)We may have to move our investigation elsewhere.
(3/3)I am adding the new sector to your mission briefing.
(1/3)Well then... allow me to consult the pirate hunter's handbook.(a bit distracted, as if reading something)
(2/3)The simplest way to spot a specific model of ship may be to set up an Alert.
(3/3)I am sending the necessary instructions to your personal interface.
(1/2)You can define a sector, faction, and an object class.
(2/2)The class of object we are looking for, in case you are wondering, is an M-sized ship.
(1/4)Once you have set up the Alert, the next step is to deploy a monitoring network of satellites across the sector.
(2/4)In case you are wondering where exactly to place them, the Duke's Buccaneers are known to steal from stations that trade in valuable wares.
(3/4)I am adding the names of these stations to your mission briefing.
(4/4)If you have not found them yet, you may have to make use of your Long Range Scanner.(translate "Long Range Scanner" as the tool that performs a {10002,433})
(1/2)I see you have deployed a satellite in the correct sector.(pleased)
(2/2)Now, all we can do is wait for the alert to trigger... or we can deploy further satellites to improve the odds.
(1/3)A Duke's Buccaneers ship has just been spotted by one of your assets!(excited; "assets" can be anything the player owns, like a station, a ship, or a satellite)
(2/3)... but in a completely different sector. Your coverage is impressive!
(3/3)Quick! Approach it in your personal ship so that we can follow its movements.
(1/3)Well what have we here?(imagine the speaker rubbing her hands and going "well, well, well, what do we have here..." while reading out this line)
(2/3)A Duke's Buccaneers transport has just been tagged by a Ministry reconnaissance satellite.
(3/3)I am sending you the tracker data now.
(1/2)I see you have found one of the mystery ships!
(2/2)The next step, then, is to perform a surreptitious deep scan to identify its cargo.
(1/2)Excellent, we can now see the contents of this ship's cargo hold.
(2/2)I will give you a moment to read through its internal accounts.
In case you are contemplating an attack, please restrain yourself until we have completed the mission.
(1/3)It seems that this ship is transporting the proceeds of banditry.(pleased with the player's discovery)
(2/3)All you have to do now is follow it... carefully.
(3/3)I recommend you match speed with your target.
(1/2)An unfortunate loss of profit, but it happens to the best of us.(response to the player blowing up the ship they were supposed to follow)
(2/2)I am sure your search will soon bear fruit again.(encouraging)

(1/4)That old three-eyes must have vacated his brain if he believes that a memorised speech can deter us.(the "old three-eyes" is a male Paranid who has just stiffly ordered the player to "vacate these premises")
(2/4)The fact that you are still alive suggests that the Duke's Buccaneers are hesitant to escalate a quarrel that could draw attention to their position.
(3/4)As long as you do not attack, you should be able to safely gather information with your Scan Mode.("Scan Mode" same as {1002,1156}, but capitalised)
(4/4)Please increase your scan percentage of this station, while I drown the station manager in Ministry credentials and legal enquiries.
(1/6)In case you are wondering, all you have to do is activate your Scan Mode so that the station's modules get highlighted in special colours.
(2/6)That colour will depend on the type of module.
(3/6)Next, you fly close to each module until its colour changes, which means that it has been successfully scanned.
(4/6)For each module scanned in this manner, the overall scan percentage of the station will increase.
(5/6)Do not worry if you cannot reach the full 100%.
(6/6)The secrecy level of some station owners makes full transparency impossible, no matter how advanced your scanner may be.
(1/2)Your scan of the station appears to have reached a sufficient level.
(2/2)The Logical Overview will now yield information about the station's storage levels.
(1/2)Ah yes, "valuable wares" indeed...(impressed, say "valuable wares" as if quoting something from a mission briefing)
(2/2)The Ministry of Finance will want to hear about this... one moment please.(distracted, as if composing a message to someone else)
(1/5)Excellent. I have just received a message from my division.
(2/5)We may have obtained enough intel to come to an... agreement with the Duke's Buccaneers.(pause after "an")
(3/5)This means that our business here is concluded, much to the Ministry's satisfaction.
(4/5)I will transfer the agreed reward to your account.
(5/5)Farewell! After your crash course in surveillance management and target tailing, you will without doubt become a fearsome pirate hunter in your own right.

page.title: Mission Teladi NPC 12 / Gate Opening Witness
page.descr: Lines for Mission Teladi NPC 12
page.t: Sorry, I am busy right now.
(reaction to friendly fire)Hey, will you stop firing?
(reaction to friendly fire)You are wrecking my shields!
(reaction to friendly fire)Why are you shooting at me?
The Teladi Company will not let any opportunity to establish new business relations go to waste!
An unowned system? And no one to trade with?(perplexed)
How very unfortunate. We shall turn towards more promising business ventures.(disappointed)

page.title: Mission Teladi NPC 13 / Scenario Military Pilot
page.descr: Lines for Mission Teladi NPC 13
page.t: Analysis shows substantial damage to critical systems. Total destruction is inevitable.
Further analysis shows that destruction can be delayed.
I will help with the transport, Captain.
Passengers delivered. Lifting off for my next run.
Third done. Will keep radio silence for now, Captain.
This is our last run. Get on board, Captain.
Captain, blockade up ahead. I will try to fly through them.
Blockade up ahead. They have received reinforcements.
Damage sustained. This blockade is going to be a problem.
Blockade breached. It looks like they do not wish to engage the station defences.
I shall help with the repairs, Captain.
Thermal Insulation Panel recalibrated. Destruction is delayed but still inevitable.
Carbon Dioxide Scrubbing Unit cleared. Will keep radio silence for now, Captain.
I have completed all the repairs that I can, Captain.

page.title: Mission Teladi NPC 14 / Scenario Chief Mechanic
page.descr: Lines for Mission Teladi NPC 14 / Scenario Chief Mechanic
page.t: You hit the quota. Well done.
Well paint my face and call me Petulenas, you finished with time to spare!
I am supervisor Henateklis Tismulinis Tansadras VIII.
You have a full ledger of work orders for this shift.
Maybe you will be the first to earn a performance bonus!
But I will be impressed if you fix half the damage...
Care for a drink? They have a new flavour of Fizz!
Welcome... to the third annual Scoot-n-Shoot Tournament!
Sponsored by Swamp Fizz, the refreshing burst of energy to get you through your day.
Egg salad egg salad egg salad!
Rogias! Are you alive? Can you hear me? Can you move?
Management will never pay this ransom.
Only one way to survive this: defuse the bombs.
Do not make this Split suspicious. He might just blow you up as a warning!
You are near a noise sensor. Do not touch your thrusters or collide while inside!
Smart! Make it look like an accident!
You did it! We are saved!
You should find an oxygen station.
He saw that... There must be a more subtle way.

page.title: Mission Teladi NPC 15 / Timelines Hub Teladi Recruit
page.descr: Lines for Mission Teladi NPC 15 / Timelines Hub Teladi Recruit
page.t: Sorry, I am busy right now.
We are the Guardians of Destiny.
We are the Guardians of Destiny!
We are the Guardians of Destiny.
I follow Paranid Tammancktall and the truth of the Creators.
Pray with us when you have time, Guardian Donel.
So we are not Guardians of Destiny? We are... data entry of Destiny?

page.title: Mission Teladi NPC 16 / Ugalirias Rudilis Gantelios IX
page.descr: Lines for Mission Teladi NPC 16 / Ugalirias Rudilis Gantelios IX
page.t: In the name of the Grandmother, I welcome you, stranger.
Perhaps you can visit me at my station?
I hope you will excuse me. We do not get many visitors.
I would dearly love to tell my friends I have met an outsider.
My friends will be envious of our meeting. A stranger in Remembrance!
Leaving so soon? Do come back again. May the Grandmother smile on you, stranger.
I am so pleased that you returned. The Grandmother truly smiles on me this day.
We have been isolated for generations.
Mitsuno's Remembrance is a haven of peace and harmony. Blessed by the Grandmother.
Ah. The Grandmother founded our civilisation.
She is our saviour and the reason why we have enjoyed centuries of peace and prosperity.
Ruler? Ha! No. Remembrance has no ruler. She is wisdom.
They say she sees the future.
I also have a mission for you, if you have interest.
From our limited information, we understand that we have a different way of doing things here in Mitsuno's Remembrance.
We allow a form of barter. This can be for wares or even for ships.
I have been tasked with assessing whether outsiders can stomach barter as a way to make profits.
If you don't mind being my lab Argnu, I can send barter tasks to your mission interface.
I do not know anything about strange signals.
Perhaps it is something to do with the Grandmother.
She is extremely clever and always up to some sort of experiment.
Stranger! I need your help. This is a life and death situation.
And also a possible diplomatic crisis!
My protégé, a young Split by the name of Kal t'Ktt, got a little overexcited by the opening of the gate.
She borrowed a rather nice racing ship and went off exploring the systems.
According to her last message, she's stuck in a Teladi minefield.
I really do not want her to die.
But if the Teladi's first experience of the Quettanauts is that we go around blowing things up, that could put us in a difficult diplomatic position.
If you could rescue Kal, discreetly, that would be a huge service to our people.
Stranger! Thank you so much for rescuing Kal!
Her ship is a rather fine scout. A replica of an ancient vessel built by the Grandmother herself.
If you are, perhaps, interested in purchasing it, do come and see me.
I do not think I will be allowing her to use it to cause more trouble in the future.
Thank you again for rescuing young Kal.
The ship is very special. Built by the Grandmother herself.
She says it is a replica of one she flew many generations ago.
As a proven friend of the Quettanauts, I am happy to sell it to you.
Ah. The Grandmother is very old.
Ship ownership transferred. Take care of her.

page.title: Mission Teladi NPC 17 / Rusiris Libaras Deridos IX
page.descr: Lines for Mission Teladi NPC 17 / Rusiris Libaras Deridos IX
page.t: Sorry, I am busy right now.
Greetings, human. My name is Rusiris Libaras Deridos IX.
Your fellow human, Kaori Chen, transported me here. She has much enthusiasm.
How does one profit from this... Facility?
Human Kaori says we play games here. But I cannot access my credits to wager on these games.
Human Kaori seems to think this is all some kind of interactive entertainment.
Missions are plentiful. We will profit from success.
I must beat the scores of human Kaori. She is a winner.
I shall wager one Argnu steak on your next mission, Harper Donel.
Greetings, friend Harper. I trust you are maintaining good mission scores?

page.title: Mission Teladi NPC 18 / Tumulis Tertasobas Holigis V
page.descr: Lines for Mission Teladi NPC 18 / Tumulis Tertasobas Holigis V
page.t: Sorry, I am busy right now.
Greetings, human stranger. Levelling up, dude.
Is this a traditional human greeting?
Indeed. I am Tumulis Tertasobas Holigis V.
Goodbye, and may you level up, dude Harper.
Kaori is teaching me the ways of the Quettanauts.
I am preparing for my next mission.
The Quettanauts have celebrated my levelling up.
My advice to you is: total player immersion.
Kaori is an inspiration to us all.

page.title: Mission Teladi NPC 19 / Gogoeolos Yahandis Yoyunis II
page.descr: Lines for Mission Teladi NPC 19 / Gogoeolos Yahandis Yoyunis II
page.t: I am Gogoeolos Yahandis Yoyunis II, and my time is valuable. What is your requirement, traveller?
You say there is a Split trapped in a Ministry of Finance restricted zone? Very disturbing.
A new group of bandits after our profits, no doubt!
I do not have time for this. I have an important meeting to attend.
If you and your Split bandit friend are not gone by the time I emerge, you may find yourselves facing a Teladi battle fleet.
Hmmm. Profits. You make a good point.
Return to your Split friend and I shall have the minefield disarmed.
Yoyunis here. The mines are disabled. Move along now.
We shall also be sending an envoy to the Quettanauts.
The Ministry of Finance thanks you for the future profits that will flow.
I shall return to more profitable tasks.

page.title: Mission Teladi Male NPC 20 / Teladi Company Faction diplomat
page.descr: Lines for Teladi Company Faction Diplomat
page.t: (Accepting invitation)The Teladi Company accepts your gracious invite. We are looking forward to doing business with you, and I will arrive shortly.
(Diplomat Arrival Confirmation)I have arrived at your company headquarters.
(Player deteriorates relations, diplomat leaves)How unfortunate. We will all mourn the loss of this profit potential.
(Player requests military support)The Company has deemed it in our interest to support your military endeavours.
(Faction military support has ended)Our military support has come to an end - for the time being. We hope we were able to facilitate your money making schemes.
(Promotion ceremony - intro)I am pleased to engage with you face to face.
(Promotion ceremony - cntd, friendly)We've been watching your actions with great interest and believe you are worth investing in.
(Promotion ceremony - cntd, allied)We're happy that our previous interest in you was not unfounded. You have performed well enough to be rewarded.
(Promotion ceremony - handing over 'medal', friendly)I'm pleased to present you with a new rank amongst our company.
(Promotion ceremony - handing over 'medal', allied)It's an honour to present you with a new rank amongst our company.
(Promotion ceremony)Of course, this rank comes with great benefits.
(Promotion ceremony - fluff line to spread notifications out 1)These benefits are tied to the rank, so if you lose the rank, the benefits go too.
(Promotion ceremony - fluff line to spread notifications out 2)But with your record and our trust, I'm sure we don't have to worry about that.
(Promotion ceremony - fluff line to spread notifications out 3)I hope you find these rewards fitting to the work you've done. May they bring you profit.
(Promotion ceremony - subgroup licence hint)Given your elevation, you may also find opportunities in a number of organisations under our administration. They may be worth your attention.
(Promotion ceremony - outro)Once again, I give thanks for your efforts.
(Promotion ceremony - outro cntd)We look forward to continuing our partnership in the future.

page.title: Mission Teladi Male NPC 21 / Ministry of Finance Faction diplomat
page.descr: Lines for Ministry of Finance Faction Diplomat
page.t: (Accepting invitation)The Ministry of Finance has accepted your invite. I will make my way as soon as I have finished the last of my auditing duties.
(Diplomat Arrival Confirmation)I have just been received by your embassy staff and am looking forward to working with you.
(Player deteriorates relations, diplomat leaves)What an egregious insult... The Ministry is no longer willing to maintain diplomatic relations!
(Player requests military support)Yes... We will dispatch a Ministry patrol shortly.
(Faction military support has ended)We will have to withdraw our military support. Our police forces are required elsewhere.
(Promotion ceremony - intro)You are wise to come in person.
(Promotion ceremony - cntd, friendly)Under our watchful gaze, we have identified you as someone worth approaching to express our gratitude.
(Promotion ceremony - cntd, allied)Your continued service has brought nothing but pride to your peers, myself included. We wish to recognise your efforts with something noteworthy.
(Promotion ceremony - handing over 'medal', friendly)I'm pleased to present you with a new rank amongst The Ministry.
(Promotion ceremony - handing over 'medal', allied)It's an honour to present you with a new rank amongst The Ministry.
(Promotion ceremony)As you can expect, this rank comes with great benefits.
(Promotion ceremony - fluff line to spread notifications out 1)These benefits are tied to the rank. Should you turn against The Ministry, you will not only lose such benefits but any goodwill.
(Promotion ceremony - fluff line to spread notifications out 2)With your record, I am confident to say, that is not to be the case.
(Promotion ceremony - fluff line to spread notifications out 3)We hope you find these rewards fitting for the work you've done. Be proud and profitable.
(Promotion ceremony - subgroup licence hint)In addition, you may also find that certain organisations under our jurisdiction now have interest in you joining their ranks.
(Promotion ceremony - outro)Once again, I thank you for your service.
(Promotion ceremony - outro cntd)We look forward to working with you more in the future.

page.title: Mission Teladi NPC 22 / Quettanaut diplomat
page.descr: Lines for Quettanaut Diplomat
page.t: (Accepting invitation)The Grandmother smiles on us! We are happy to hear that you have invited us. I shall make my way aboard your station without delay.
(Diplomat Arrival Confirmation)I have made it to your station and am very much looking forward to engaging in diplomatic talks.
(Player deteriorates relations, diplomat leaves)It is sad to see that we were wrong about your intentions. The Quettanauts will mourn what could have been.
(Player requests military support)We Quettanauts are a nonviolent people, but we shall see what we can muster.
(Faction military support has ended)I am afraid our military support must come to an end.
(Promotion ceremony - intro)Thanks for taking the time to see me.
(Promotion ceremony - cntd, friendly)You've been making a bit of an impression here!
(Promotion ceremony - cntd, allied)You continue to impress, my friend!
(Promotion ceremony - handing over 'medal', friendly)The station reps have decided that a formal recognition is in order.('reps' short for representatives)
(Promotion ceremony - handing over 'medal', allied)The station reps have unanimously decided to give you a worthier title.('reps' short for representatives)
(Promotion ceremony)This isn't just a formality, though.
(Promotion ceremony - barter hint 1)You may already have more barter offers in your mission interface.
(Promotion ceremony - ship barter hint)Keep an eye out for ships, specifically.
(Promotion ceremony - outro)I think I've been blathering on long enough.
(Promotion ceremony - outro cntd)We really appreciate your help, and hope to see you around.

page.title: Teladi Mini DLC2 Gamestart
page.descr: Lines for Teladi Mini DLC2 Gamestart speaker
page.t: "Retire on Ianamus Zura, you will love it", they said. But I did not love it. It is unsanitary, it is smelly... and far duller than my previous position: Health & Safety. Can you imagine spending decazuras drafting liability shields? Salamander pâté, no. (Translate "Salamander pâté" as "Salamanderpastete" in German) And I am only 132. I might live to 396. Why retire at all? I am no pen-pusher. I am a claws-on-the-ground type of saurian. My clients value that. They still have tasks for me. And I am still very good at... seeing them through.
And here we go again! A "Health & Safety" violation, right on our claws. Encrypted channel, no less. Told you - they still need me!

page.title: Mission Teladi NPC 23 / Relief Pilot
page.descr: Lines for Mission Teladi NPC 23 / Relief Pilot
page.t: Sorry, I am busy right now.
(reaction to friendly fire)Hey, will you stop firing?
(reaction to friendly fire)You are wrecking my shields!
(reaction to friendly fire)Why are you shooting at me?
This is Iginaras Nihamales Saringias III speaking, Health & Safety administration.
Tsh? Sobert? Archive ship? Well... I suppose you could call the Envoy that!
For your own security and continued profitability, I strongly recommend immediate withdrawal.
We observed an anomaly in this sector and initiated an on-site evaluation.
Want to assist me? Colleague Sobert can wait a while longer.
I am presently attempting to decrypt this Data Vault before it gets bit-flipped in the afterglow. It contains security-relevant information!
The Ministry wants it gone. Everybody else wants to get their claws on it!
Sobert has half a kilo of that... Unbihexium aboard the Berenice - snatched it from under the Ektoberyll's hindscales!
I suspected as much, but having the proof makes it feel so much more... devastating!
What am I going to do?
Where is the profit in that? Where?
They destroyed a star... a sun!
But in any case - I would rather we have it than someone else! So let us find colleague Sobert.
I am pleased to meet a fellow Health & Safety colleague out here - ex, I should say. Welcome!
You have chosen a highly unusual location for your retirement! Tsh! I am joking, naturally. Still, I would recommend withdrawal at your earliest convenience.
Colleagues! That is not the Ektoberyll, that is someone else.
Colleague Sobert, do you not see what is happening? Let us place the Unbihexium under the Ministry's custody!
We will never use it as a weapon - in fact, we are going to dispose of it!
Let us make sure they do not get it!
Like I said, no one can synthesise Unbihexium, but everyone wants it.
It will be all but gone in at most 63 jazuras!
Tsh! Do not gaslight me, I am no hatchling!
Unbihexium has a half-life of 4.4 jazuras outside the stasis field.
Not our decision to make, colleague. Not yours, not mine.
Colleagues! There they come. This time it is the Ektoberyll!
The pleasure is all mine, colleague! But what have I been hearing?
You tricked this brave citizen into believing you were transporting documents?
You made short work of them, colleague! Like a true combat veteran...
We have seen the footage! You destroyed a star! You can never have it back.
Watch your fire! Target the threat, not the Envoy!
Salamander paté! Are your sensors misaligned?!
Colleague! Your enthusiasm is noted, but please do not fire at a stellar-scale bomb!
Tsshhh! What are you doing?! Do not fire at us!
The Ministry will not let this go unpunished!
I remember the Beryll. You picked up where they stopped, and took it a giant leap further.
Colleague! My scale plate is still pale, but... you were magnificent. One obstacle less!
I feel sorry for those pilots... they were misled.
You tricked this fine colleague of mine into believing you were transporting documents?
You made short work of them, colleague! Exceptional for a retiree!
Colleague! Thank you so much! I suspect that you are not really a pen-pusher, am I right?
Colleague! Did you know that the Envoy class will enter general production shortly?
Should you ever require another one, you can procure it from Ministry and Argon wharfs. And from our allies, of course!

page.title: Base Categories
page.descr: Names and descriptions of base categories
page.t: A System represents a vast area of space, typically a single solar system. Systems, sometimes known as 'clusters' contain smaller areas called Sectors. Sectors are joined within a System by Superhighways while travel between their containing Systems is via Jump Gates.

Sectors are large areas of interest within a single System. They contain smaller areas of interest called Zones which are all connected within the Sector by Local Highways. The containing Sectors are connected by Superhighways.

Zones are points of interest within a single Sector. Zones are connected through the Local Highway system but not all Zones are directly connected by the same Local Highway to all other Zones in the same Sector.
Highways were first created by JSDD before the shut down of the Jump Gates. Their purpose is to allow bearable travel times through and between Sectors.

Local Highways are unidirectional paths of accelerated traffic used to connect areas of interest, called Zones, within a Sector and reduce travel time. As they operate at lower speeds than the Superhighways, it is fairly safe to enter or leave the Local Highway at any time. Local Highways have opened up fast and convenient mass-traffic and trading lanes between and within Zones.
