I can't get off the station right now and my colleague is too far away, but we want to grab any inventory that remains from that attack before the authorities investigate what happened. You pick up what's left and don't ask any questions. We'll pay you for it.

One of my colleagues has left a haul of items out in the middle of space; they thought it was too dangerous to bring it close to station security. I'm currently unable to fly without drawing attention to myself, so I'll pay well instead to have someone else go out there, find the collection and pick it up without asking too many questions.

One of our many business rivals operates a number of secure stashes in this sector. We want you to carefully open a few of these lockboxes and make their contents disappear. In addition to a credit reward for your troubles, you can keep anything useful that you find.

Greetings. One of our traders was terribly unlucky, and had a ferocious fire break out in their storage. The captain acted swiftly, and used the emergency override to open the cargo door, which immediately suffocated the flames. Unfortunately, resorting to this extreme yet necessary measure, caused all goods to be ejected into space. We are immensely relieved that the ship was able to dock at a nearby station, and we now need to assess the severity of the destruction and perform the required repairs. In the meantime, could you please do us a favour and examine whether anything can be salvaged? That would be splendid, and we will happily compensate you for your assistance.

Mysteriously, we have been unable to locate one of our supply ships after having previously lost contact with it. A scout has been dispatched to the last known location, finding only the medical supplies that the ship had on board. An in-depth analysis and investigation is certainly required to unravel this baffling enigma. For now, you could help us by retrieving these supplies and delivering them safely to us. Potentially, they could even provide some valuable insight into the perplexing disappearance.

With great distress and grief, we share the distressing news that one of our ships transporting medical goods has been intercepted and boarded by an unknown party. However, it seems that the attackers' interest was only in the ship itself, and not the wares on board. While this is an almost insignificantly small blessing compared to the onerous loss, it would be marvellous if you could retrieve what these uncivilised ravages spared.

page.title: Kill Mass Traffic
page.t: There has been a stark increase in criminal traffic on and around this station and we have now been authorised to use lethal force to try to ward them off. Helping us in this endeavour will greatly increase the safety and security of this area, and will also be greatly rewarded.

We're looking to show syndicates like the Scale Plate Pact that they cannot simply get away with major criminal activity within our space, and as they have been advocating acts of violence against us in recent weeks, we have now been authorised to react in kind. Search for criminal traffic around this station and take it out.

We believe a criminal syndicate is planning a major offensive against this station soon, and are preparing for it by sending agents onto the station to take out our defences prior to the attack. If we can cut them off now, we gain a significant advantage, if the pirates decide to attack at all.

Split notice criminal element within station plans to overthrow Patriarch. Unacceptable. Dishonours the whole station. Kill all who seek to defy the rule of law, before station itself draws anger of the Patriarch for failing to deal with them appropriately.

We have noticed a recent uptick in criminal behaviour on one of our stations. We cannot allow such lawlessness to go unchecked. Ensuring humanity's future is an undertaking which can only succeed if there is absolutely no internal strife. We seek to send all criminals a message that cannot be misunderstood. Make sure that you take out all criminal mass traffic on the station in question.

My group is planning an operation on this station, but security's been so tight recently that we need one big distraction to pull it off. We need security to be looking in a completely opposite direction. They'd only be doing this if there was a louder, bigger crime going on, so... you know... start shooting. If you get away, you'll be paid well for it.

I'm looking for someone who doesn't mind getting their hands dirty to cause some chaos while I move some heavy-duty equipment off this station. Station security really need to be looking in a different direction, so when I say chaos I mean a lot of it. The kind you'd hate to witness yourself. It's risky, but if you get through it, there's a good sum waiting for you.

page.title: Repair Signal Leak
page.t: We have identified a number of critical leaks across some of our property in recent times and are hiring third parties to help sealing them. On accepting the contract, you will be assigned a number of leaks across a number of our properties and will be expected to repair them at your discretion.\nNumber of properties: $OBJECTCOUNT$

My organisation is looking to make sure our properties are in prime condition for the next set of inspections and are hiring third-party contractors to help us seal leaks across the properties. We're assigning a number of contractors different properties and different leaks. This contract assigns: $OBJECTCOUNT$x properties.

A number of attacks against our property means that there are now leaks that require fixing. We wish to hire a number of people to help us with this, to make sure the work is done quickly. Each person who signs up will be assigned a number of leaks across a number of properties. We hope this is a manageable load for all.\nNumber of properties: $OBJECTCOUNT$

We don't know whether it was one of our competitors or pirates, but someone has detonated a number of EMPs across our properties and we are hiring people to help us fix the leaks they've caused. We're spreading out the work so that no one person must fix all leaks. If you accept the job, we'll assign you to: $OBJECTCOUNT$x properties.

A number of our properties have recently failed their inspections due to leaks that now have to be fixed before it starts to affect our reputation. We are hiring a number of people to help us fix as many of the problems as possible. If you are willing, you can help us in this endeavour by fixing the specified leaks on: $OBJECTCOUNT$x properties.

Split station fought off enemy attack recently, but enemy caused grave damage. As a result, we are leaking data everyone can access, even enemies of the Patriarchy. Split cannot allow these data leaks any longer. We will give reward for fixing: $OBJECTCOUNT$x properties.

Split recently tried to set up ambush for Argon convoy, but they were prepared and wiped fleet out. Split suspect leaks in Station were being tapped by enemies to gather intel. Cannot allow this to happen again. To ensure successful military operations, leaks need fixed. We will give reward for fixing specified leaks: $OBJECTCOUNT$x properties.

Our stations are not only of industrial and strategic importance; they are also symbols of prosperity and technological supremacy. All other societies should fall in line upon seeing them. To be able to achieve this, the stations have to be flawless. Removing stains on the hull or Signal Leaks has to be an ongoing priority effort. As such, we will pay you for fixing specified leaks: $OBJECTCOUNT$x properties.

page.title: Board Ship
page.t: Lend aid to the boarding operation.
The ship should be handed over to me at the following location: $DESTINATION$

One of our informants has reported that there is a ship passing through the area, which we do not want in the hands of the owner. The time window is short, and we are currently lacking manpower, so we are willing to hire outside help to make sure this ship is intercepted and boarded.\n\nThis intel is still fresh, and local law enforcement may not yet be aware of the planned intervention. Your compensation should cover any additional expenses caused by a skirmish or loss in standing.

A member of the local syndicate, which may have ties to the Scale Plate Pact, has been causing trouble in the area using their very capable ship. They know we're watching them, so we can't make a move, but we're willing to pay to make sure the ship leaves this pirate's possession.\n\nWARNING: Local law enforcement is being kept unaware of this operation to not give the target an early warning, and may react to your attack. We hope that the reward will motivate you to overcome these difficulties.

We're looking to delay one of our competitors beyond delaying their traders or pushing away their customers. We think that if one of their ships were to suddenly leave their service, then they would be pushed back months and we'd be able to gain a significant advantage over them.\n\nWARNING: The local authorities may find this method of doing business somewhat unorthodox. We hope that the generous reward serves as recompense for any trouble you may have to face.

(ma target)Dear recipient,
My only child and heir to my family's estate has decided to put aside etiquette, and is currently wasting his allowance on oversized ships and other such lavish playthings. Ever since I received word of this troubling behaviour, I have been looking for a suitable way to give my insolent progeny a stern warning. If you consider yourself sufficiently skilled in educational measures, please consider delivering this rebuke on my behalf. In my personal experience, taking away his toys would most likely yield the desired results. As the commoners say, you do not realize what you have until it is gone.

WARNING: Unfortunately, the sector administration might regard this as a criminal act, but you will be compensated for the inconvenience this may cause.

(fe target)Dear recipient,
My only child and heir to my family's estate has decided to put aside etiquette, and is currently wasting her allowance on oversized ships and other such lavish playthings. Ever since I received word of this troubling behaviour, I have been looking for a suitable way to give my insolent progeny a stern warning. If you consider yourself sufficiently skilled in educational measures, please consider delivering this rebuke on my behalf. In my personal experience, taking away her toys would most likely yield the desired results. As the commoners say, you do not realize what you have until it is gone.

WARNING: Unfortunately, the sector administration might regard this as a criminal act, but you will be compensated for the inconvenience this may cause.

(ma target)Everyone knows that the universe is dark and full of dangerous encounters. Nevertheless, one of our potential clients refuses to buy our newest, top-of-the-line security system for his cargo fleet. Please demonstrate to him the benefits of such a purchase by boarding one of his ships, ideally in some remote corner to maximise the effect. You do not need to worry about the merchant's wellbeing, since he is well off and can easily replace the lost cargo and crew.\n\nWARNING: The local authorities have not yet approved this form of advertising, so try to be discreet.

(fe target)Everyone knows that the universe is dark and full of dangerous encounters. Nevertheless, one of our potential clients refuses to buy our newest, top-of-the-line security system for her cargo fleet. Please demonstrate to her the benefits of such a purchase by boarding one of her ships, ideally in some remote corner to maximise the effect. You do not need to worry about the merchant's wellbeing, since she is well off and can easily replace the lost cargo and crew.\n\nWARNING: The local authorities have not yet approved this form of advertising, so try to be discreet.

(ma target)$NPCNAME$ is an incompetent, but relentless undercover agent who has been repeatedly causing trouble for enterprising people such as ourselves. At the moment, his strategy seems to entail flying around aimlessly in an oversized transport ship. If this continues, the agent might eventually uncover our operations by sheer luck. We need a permanent solution to this problem, but since we would prefer to keep our insider knowledge hidden, the options are limited. Instead of killing the agent directly, we want you to board his ship and keep it operational for a while. This way, his employers might not notice the true nature of your mission.\n\nWARNING: It goes without saying that your reputation will suffer for this, but you will be compensated accordingly.

(fe target)$NPCNAME$ is an incompetent, but relentless undercover agent who has been repeatedly causing trouble for enterprising people such as ourselves. At the moment, her strategy seems to entail flying around aimlessly in an oversized transport ship. If this continues, the agent might eventually uncover our operations by sheer luck. We need a permanent solution to this problem, but since we would prefer to keep our insider knowledge hidden, the options are limited. Instead of killing the agent directly, we want you to board her ship and keep it operational for a while. This way, her employers might not notice the true nature of your mission.\n\nWARNING: It goes without saying that your reputation will suffer for this, but you will be compensated accordingly.

(ma target)It is no secret that the most successful freebooting types tend to amass wealth well beyond their ability to spend it. Occasionally however, self-declared 'treasure hunters' wildly misinterpret these stories and set their heart on finding such stashes, which are of course entirely fictional. It has now come to our attention that $NPCNAME$ might be in possession of a clue towards one of these purely imaginary locations. He recently purchased a capital mining ship in preparation for his search, and we would in turn pay a considerable amount to anyone willing to board the ship and permanently relieve him of this burden.\n\nWARNING: Depending on your location, the local authorities might frown upon this act of kindness.

(fe target)It is no secret that the most successful freebooting types tend to amass wealth well beyond their ability to spend it. Occasionally however, self-declared 'treasure hunters' wildly misinterpret these stories and set their heart on finding such stashes, which are of course entirely fictional. It has now come to our attention that $NPCNAME$ might be in possession of a clue towards one of these purely imaginary locations. She recently purchased a capital mining ship in preparation for her search, and we would in turn pay a considerable amount to anyone willing to board the ship and permanently relieve her of this burden.\n\nWARNING: Depending on your location, the local authorities might frown upon this act of kindness.

Do you think you've got what it takes to fly, fight and celebrate alongside the greatest heroes of the galaxy? Luckily for you, this might just be the right opportunity to impress the big guys. We all had humble beginnings, so what would you say to boarding a capital ship? Just kidding; a regular trader will do for starters. A huge one like this:
$SHIP$

WARNING: The local authorities might confuse your display of heroism with the actions of a criminal.

A media conglomerate, whose representative would like to remain anonymous, recently employed us to create high-quality stock footage of boarding operations. If you are interested in earning a share of the proceeds, we would like to assign you one of the required ship specifications, details of which you will find below. Curiously, our contractor did not specify the preferred method of obtaining this video material, so we recommend a straight-forward approach to guarantee a convincing level of realism.
$SHIP$

WARNING: The local authorities might be unfamiliar with modern media operations. Please choose your film set accordingly.

Wretched Argon ships fight well. Hard to admit, but Patriarchy can profit from studying their ships. If Split know ships' faults, Split can inflict more damage in battle. Board the ship for us, to demonstrate structural weaknesses, and we will pay you for your effort.\n\nWARNING: Authorities could regard this as criminal act and might act accordingly.

Someone feeling too safe and not want to pay protection money. Must be reminded of threats that require Split protection service. You board ship and receive reward for referral.\n\nWARNING: Authorities could regard this as criminal act and might act accordingly.

page.title: Track Ship
page.t: A known smuggler has been being tracked over the last few weeks but their exact location has now been lost. We know their last known location, and the tracker placed aboard their ship will respond to the frequency provided on acceptance of this mission. If you can locate the ship again and report their location to us, we can take it from there.

We have been tracking a Xenon ship that seemed to be sticking to the outskirts of our systems, keeping out of the way. We think that it was a scout, and has now disappeared to take its information back to Xenon space. Whatever it found, it must not be allowed to relay the information. Seek out the Xenon's location and report it back to us. We can deal with it from there.

We've received worrying reports that a Kha'ak ship has recently been seen nearby. It's a high priority to track this ship down so that we can analyse the threat it poses. Kha'ak ships leave behind a small trace of kyon particles - if you wish to take on the contract to find this ship, we will provide the markers necessary to find them. The contract will be completed on reporting the ship's exact location.

A ship that has been causing us some problems recently has suddenly disappeared and we're worried about what the pilot might be up to. We did manage to place a short-range tracker on the ship before it vanished, but we now need someone to pick up the tracker's frequency and relocate the ship. We will provide you the necessary frequencies, and all you need do is report the ship's exact location once found.

An enemy of the Patriarchy fled captivity and managed to disappear off of Split radars. Recapture is necessary to obtain information and to avoid dishonour. Split are still tracking the general direction, but it is up to you to locate the exact location. And hurry! If you take too long, the captive will escape for good.

Enemy ship ambushed and killed Split Patriarch's son before fleeing battle. Split managed to attach a tracker on ship hull. Patriarch demands revenge. Help Split locate exact location by investigating tracker signal. Then Split pay you and take it from there.

The Terran Secret Service has observed a Segaris Pioneer ship flying in erratic, nonsensical patterns. One possible explanation could be that the pilot is drunk, but we cannot exclude the possibility of something more sinister going on. For all we know, that ship could be spying on behalf of the enemies of the Protectorate. Track the ship, and see where it goes. If you can confirm our suspicions, or put them to rest, we will make it worth your while.

page.title: Kill On Sight Rarely
page.t: Note: the target signature has been loaded into your ship computer. While this mission is active, your ship computer will notify you whenever matches are detected in the vicinity.
At the start of this mission, intelligence reported sightings of matching targets in the following location: $LOCATION$.
At the start of this mission there were no reports of sightings.

An enemy ship has been spotted recently that we worry is significant to their military efforts. Though our intelligence has been unable to unearth the exact ID code for this ship, so we cannot point you to it, we know it's specification, and if you do find it while travelling and remove it on our behalf, we will be more than willing to reward you suitably.\nShip specification:\n$SPECS$

A number of enemy ships have been spotted recently that give us cause for concern. The reports have all been from civilians, and so don't give us enough information to track down the ships, but we believe we have accurate descriptions of what the ships look like. We are looking for someone willing to remove these ships should you come accross them on your travels.\nShip Specifications:\n$SPECS$

We're looking to send a very clear message to local traders, to remind them that we're here and should be taken seriously. We've noticed a weakness in a specific part of the economy and would like to see a ship supporting this part disappear rather spectacularly. If you can find a ship with the following specification and cause this disappearance, we'll make sure you're paid well for it.\nShip Specification:\n$SPECS$

We're looking to send a very clear message to local traders, to remind them that we're here and should be taken seriously. There's a point of weakness in a specific part of the economy right now, and if ships supporting this part were to go up in smoke, then people would know that we're a threat. Find ships with the following specifications and make sure they are destroyed - we'll pay you well for it.\nShip Specifications:\n$SPECS$

A dangerous criminal is loose. As of yet, no one has been able to give us the ID code belonging to their ship, but we have enough reports now to give a good description of the ship specifications. This criminal has a high bounty on their head, and should you find this ship and destroy it after accepting this contract, you will be well rewarded.\nShip specification:\n$SPECS$

A number of dangerous criminals are loose, and though no one has yet been able to report their ships' ID codes to us, reports do indicate that all of these criminals are flying ships with the same specifications. We believe them to be some kind of growing gang, and will pay for their elimination should you come across any member on your travels.\nShip specifications:\n$SPECS$

A former associate of mine, one who had the misfortune of double-crossing me and the fortune of getting away with it, has been seen returning to the area. Though the whelp that told me about this was unable to tell me the ID code of the lowlife's vessel, they were able to describe it. While the opportunity lasts, I will pay handsomely for this ship's destruction.\nShip specification:\n$SPECS$

A group of thugs that used to work for me, before betraying me for another syndicate, have been seen returning to the area. I've collected this information through a variety of sources, so I can't go after the specific ships, but I have an idea of the ships' specifications, and am happy to contract someone to deal with these ships if they happen to come across them on their travels.\nShip Specifications:\n$SPECS$

The enemy has increased their presence in and around our sectors. We cannot allow this to go unchecked or we will eventually find ourselves surrounded. It is important to wear down their strength, so show no mercy whenever you come across them. Weaken their numbers and you will be compensated for the effort.\n\nFaction: $SPECS$
{30154, 2002}(Only multiple enemies expected in this variant)

Sometimes it feels like in war, progress is impossible. The fronts just will not move, and for every ship we shoot down, they produce two more. But it is important to remember that every casualty we inflict makes a difference. Their resources are not endless, just vast. They will run out eventually; we just have to keep up the pressure. Help us in our fight. Destroy the enemy wherever you meet them, and you will be paid well.\n\nFaction: $SPECS$
{30154, 2102}(Only multiple enemies expected in this variant)

Xenon Raiding Parties have been increasingly applying pressure for some time. We have begun to coordinate a counter attack, with the ultimate goal to send a Raiding Party of our own, to penetrate into Xenon space and hit them where it really hurts. Help us by shooting down every Xenon ship you encounter.\n\nFaction: $SPECS$
{30154, 2202}(Only multiple enemies expected in this variant)

Hubris has always been mankind's weakness. The Argon Federation cannot admit that they are just as vulnerable to attack as anyone else. Well, we will show them how flawed their thinking really is. Hit them wherever you find them, and hit them hard. We will make them feel vulnerable, and show them that space does not belong to them.\n\nFaction: $SPECS$
{30154, 2302}(Only multiple enemies expected in this variant)

Following their radical doctrines, these extremists have been steadily escalating random conflicts into all out war. We cannot allow their influence to spread any longer. Shoot down these fanatics whenever and whenever you encounter them. Seek them out. Snuff out their so-called holy light.\n\nFaction: $SPECS$
{30154, 2402}(Only multiple enemies expected in this variant)
(Pirate Variation)We will not abide by Lawlessness

These criminals are becoming more and more reckless. Our station is increasingly hearing stories about ships held up or boarded near the police ships or military installations. Casualties are becoming more and more common. It seems like this lawless scum is set to bleed us of our resources until we are dry. We will not allow that to happen! Show them that they are not safe from us anywhere. Shoot them down wherever these cowards might hide!\n\nFaction: $SPECS$
{30154, 2502}(Only multiple enemies expected in this variant)

The Split families just cannot help themselves; they cannot thrive without conflict. As long as they hold any kind of power, there will be war in the universe. There is only one way anyone can respond to them: actively seek them out and beat them down. It will not be easy, they know how to put up a fight. That is why we are looking for help anywhere we can get it. Help us in our fight, and we will make it worth your while.\n\nFaction: $SPECS$
{30154, 2602}(Only multiple enemies expected in this variant)

While a career in the military offers incredible benefits and unrivalled job security, it is a misconception that you need to join it in order to help keep Sol safe. The Solborn Militia now offers bounty contracts to anyone who is unwilling, or unable, to enlist. We must all come together to keep the enemy at bay!\n\nFaction: $SPECS$
{30154, 2602}(Only multiple enemies expected in this variant)

page.title: Patrol Area
page.t: (Description)We have noticed an increase in enemy chatter recently, which makes us suspect that several of our stations are potential targets for an attack. We will pay you to patrol each of these stations for at least $TIME$ minutes to make sure nothing happens. If you happen to shoot down enemy ships, we will add a bonus on top. How does that sound?

(Description)We have recently lost contact with a number of stations close by. It could just be a temporary outage, but we cannot discount the possibility of an enemy attack, so we need you to check up on those stations. Take a look around each station for $TIME$ minutes and fend off any enemy forces you encounter. We will pay you for flying the route, and increase that sum for each destroyed enemy ship.

We have recently become aware of trading ships disappearing shortly after setting out from several of our stations, and well, traffic decreased, and that's bad news. Apparently some hostile ships were spotted close by, so we need you to check up on these stations and guarantee everyone's safety. Otherwise, we will surely go out of business. Keep an eye out for suspicious activity, and shoot down any hostile forces you encounter.

(Description)We could use some help patrolling one of our sectors to ensure that everything is peaceful. If we can guarantee safety we can focus our efforts on expanding and stabilising our reach. Secure our sector for at least $TIME$ minutes and we will compensate you for your time, and add a bonus for every enemy you protect us from. \nSector: $TARGET$

(Description)We have noticed an increase in pirate raids and enemy faction activity in one of our sectors. We cannot be perceived as weak, and we certainly cannot allow our sovereignty to be questioned! Patrol the sector for at least $TIME$ minutes and shoot down any insurgents you come across! We will pay you for your time, and award an additional bonus for any enemy ship you shoot down. \nSector: $TARGET$
(Split Mission)Kill all enemies of the Split Patriarchy

(Description)Split want to strengthen control over sector. All enemies and criminals must die to demonstrate the Patriarchy's supremacy. We hire fighters like you to help ongoing war effort. Patrol sector for $TIME$ minutes and kill all who are hostile to the Patriarchy. Split pay bonus for every kill.\nSector: $TARGET$
(Split Mission)While Split feud they grow stronger

(Description)The Patriarchy's enemies are numerous. But Split are fighting among families. Very lengthy and brutal fights, that keep attention away from common outside enemies. Split need your help patrolling sector for $TIME$ minutes. Pays well, especially if you kill many enemies of the Patriarchy.\nSector: $TARGET$

(Description)Split face many enemies from within and without. Families are constantly fighting, which draws attention away from intruders. Split pay you to patrol sector for $TIME$ minutes so Patriarch can deal with unruly families. Pays well, especially if you kill many enemies.\nSector: $TARGET$

(Description)Enemies are lying in wait beyond the Gate. If they identify any weakness in our defences, they will home in on it. We cannot afford to let enemies slip through. Once they have breached the perimeter, it would be fairly easy to disappear off our radars. Because defending Sol is such a crucial task, it is in our best interests to hire capable security personnel to supplement to our patrols.\nSector: $TARGET$

(Description)Our sophisticated technology has attracted many prying eyes, and recent intel suggests a barrage of attempts to obtain our secrets. We require a capable person, who is able to dispatch these malicious actors, in order to protect the knowledge that our brilliant minds have accumulated and refined over the years.\n\nSector: $TARGET$

(Description)For the past few days, wares have been disappearing from the docks. We suspect that a network of pirates is bribing workers to look the other way. They smuggle the contraband out in ships, hiding their true faction allegiances. We haven't been able to put an end to this because they can see our patrols coming from far away, and they make sure to stay clear of them. They won't suspect you, though. That's why we need you to patrol the station, scan ships, and eliminate any pirate activity you come across.
(Appended to description)Note: Pirates can conceal their actual faction affiliations. In order to identify pirates, scan any suspicious ship that lingers in the vicinity of the station.

(Description)Several weeks ago, an informant we managed to insert into a vast criminal network tipped us off that pirates have managed to bypass our security. He informed us that these pirates are hiding their faction allegiances to plunder our wares. We pushed him to get deeper into the organisation, but he disappeared before he could send any further information our way. We have not been able to contact him for over a week, so we have to presume he has been compromised and silenced. We might not know which ships are responsible, but we know which stations they target. You need to make sure you uncover who is responsible, and make sure they don't steal from us ever again.

page.title: Escort Ship
page.t: (Description)One of our traders has been tasked with supplying a station with critical wares. Unfortunately, some people do not want that trade run to succeed, and will do everything in their power to stop it dead in its tracks. If you accompany our trader and make sure it arrives at its destination, we will reward you with a slice of the profits.

(Description)It took considerable effort, but we were finally able to get two opposing parties to sit down to negotiations aimed at resolving their conflict. Unfortunately, a third party has become aware of our plans, and is trying very hard to make sure these talks never take place. One of the delegations involved in these talks was attacked, and now their main dignitary is stranded on one of our stations. If you can ensure that his ship makes it to the talks, you will be paid handsomely.

(Description)We are in dire need of mined materials to keep our economy going. Unfortunately, our mining ships have recently been coming under attack by Kha'ak forces. It seems that they are somehow drawn to the ore. We need you to accompany our mining ship and make sure that it can deliver its wares unharmed.

(Description)Our scouts have reported a worrying increase in Kha'ak activity close to our preferred asteroid fields. We are worried that our mining activity has made us a target of Kha'ak raids. We would be willing to pay a significant amount if you can guarantee our mining ship makes its way out of those asteroids and safely back to our station.

page.title: Demo Tutorial
page.descr: Demo tutorial text
page.t:
This tutorial shows you how to teleport using the map.

Teleportation is an advanced skill which needs to be researched. For demonstration purposes this demo has already unlocked this skill.

Use it to teleport to the available locations and try out the scenarios this demo offers.
We found a Data Vault which contains a historical archive of information. We need you to investigate the site and secure the data.
This tutorial will show you how stations are designed. It allows you to accelerate time using the Singularity Engine Time Accelerator \(SETA\) to see a station being constructed.
This tutorial will show you how to spot crystals on distant asteroids and how to collect them. The crystals you find can be sold or used for crafting.
This tutorial shows you how to operate a mining ship, specifically how to find resource rich regions and how to focus your efforts on high-yield asteroids.
This tutorial shows you how wear down an enemy ship in preparation for boarding it with your marines.

page.title: Mentor Master Mission
page.descr: Mission descriptions and objectives for the Mentor mission chain
page.t:
(sent by a mysterious entity. kind of reads like a junk mail)Dear recipient.

I do hope that this message finds you well. The time has come to solve a great scientific mystery and you have been selected to provide aid to one of the greatest minds of the current age! All that is required is a well-maintained ship and an amicable demeanour. On an unrelated note, it is always prudent to acquire a suitable life-insurance policy.

If this opportunity entices you, pay close attention to signal leaks on nearby stations. Should you be skilled in decryption, the path to knowledge will be open to you.

Good day!

(sent by Boso Ta)Dear assistant.

As you may have realised, my previous escape attempt did not quite go to plan. Do not be disheartened! I am already enacting a much improved scheme.

Please view the details in your mission interface.

May we have good fortune!

(mail text)Dear recipient.

I am using this channel of communication to formally extend an invitation for you to join me aboard the mystery installation. The laboratory deep within the bowels of this technological marvel is an absolute treasure trove of scientific discoveries, just waiting to be made. However, in order to begin my research, I shall need an assistant to help me oversee the more mundane aspects of running such a complex installation. Should you be interested in taking on this custodial role, please come and talk to me in person. I shall not be going anywhere!

Here is to a mutually advantageous collaboration!
Boso Ta
Satellites and Resource Probes are available at stations where you can upgrade ships.
Your task will require a Satellite and a Resource Probe.
(joke hint)You can gain a speed boost by boosting.

I fear time grows short for my research. Any longer and I expect other inquisitive minds may also stumble upon the mysterious signals I am investigating. As my assistant, you will experience first hand, a great number of interesting and peculiar scientific oddities. I long for the day that I am free to pursue these myself but alas, my current situation only allows me to watch from afar.

To further progress in our research, we must learn more about this location. Any attempt to excite the anomaly is potentially dangerous and we must reduce that risk to an acceptable level. I have a number of suggestions that should help us understand the anomaly and its effect on nearby space.

I believe we are ready to move to a more active stage in our research. We will attempt to widen the anomaly to gain a clearer reading of what could be on the other side, assuming it is some form of tear through space. As with most experiments worth mentioning, this one will involve some explosives and a risk to the local environment but I have the utmost confidence that we shall achieve our goals to the highest standard.
Check the mission briefing for details on your current task.
The ship currently has $NUM$ person on board.
The ship currently has $NUM$ people on board.
Antimatter Cells(see 20201,201) are usually found for sale at the following stations:

It does seem that the anomaly was indeed a tear to some other location in space and by exciting it, we have inadvertently dragged this huge structure through it. We must make haste and investigate it further before any of the locals report it to some sort of 'scientific authority'. In such an event, this mysterious structure will attract every bored charlatan scientist and our opportunity would be lost!
You need blueprints to build station modules. If you have the credits, you can buy blueprints from a Faction Representative.

Select the station, open its context menu with $INPUT_STATE_INTERACTION_MENU$, and select PLAN BUILD to check if you already own the required blueprints.(PLAN BUILD spelt like {1001,7809}, but in all caps)

Select the station, open its context menu with $INPUT_STATE_WIDGET_INTERACT$, and select PLAN BUILD to check if you already own the required blueprints.(PLAN BUILD spelt like {1001,7809}, but in all caps)
Details to follow. A fast combat ship is preferable.

To enact my plan, I have chartered a number of ships to act as decoy transports while I make my escape by other means. I would like you to escort one of the ships and make sure that they do not come to any harm. I would rather my reputation not take a sizeable hit during my first moments of regained freedom.

Now that I have once again gained my freedom, I can now put all my effort into unlocking the mysteries of this station. My initial findings point to it being some research facility, possibly Terran in origin, but with influences from several other cultures, including Boron. Whether it was a collaborative effort or through stolen technology, I can't say for sure.
We must first make sure that the facility runs as smoothly as possible.

I have successfully interfaced with the research systems of this facility and am ready to pursue a number of projects. Some of these are unique to this facility itself and seem to point to the existence of multiple universes!

We are free to use this research facility as we see fit. I do fear that one day some other inquisitive Boron from another universe will attempt to draw it into their universe, but until that day, it is ours to explore. I leave it to you to decide what avenues of research I should focus on.
I have an insatiable appetite for the history of our civilisations, especially that of the Argon-Xenon conflict. Should you find any historical accounts, I would be very happy to read them.

Some say that the time of exploration is over. I however believe that in this ever changing universe, we must constantly observe and curate everything! I will be monitoring your sensor logs with much interest!
It had been such a long time since I last had such prime BoFu! I do hope that you are able to procure more. Thank you my friend!
Apparently pulled through some spacial rift along with the mysterious Pioneer station, you must find your way to safety.
With control of the station transferred to you, attempt to gain access by constructing a dock.

(Mission Description)I, Boso Ta, having just commandeered a mysterious installation to escape captivity, am in need of a new assistant in order to make full use of it. Ideally, I would put up a network-wide job posting, but time waiting for a reply is time wasted. You were in the area and seem competent enough. What do you say to coming and meeting me in person, so we can hash out the finer details?
(logbook)Perhaps next time I will have better luck.
Deliver a ship with the following criteria:\n

page.title: Diplomatic mentor mission
page.t: (directed at female)You deal with Scale Plate?
(directed at male)What exactly do you do?

The Hatikvah Free League invites our proven friends and allies to help us in a potentially life-changing endeavour. We are a people who do what is necessary to survive in these uncertain times, and now we find ourselves at a crossroads.\nJoin us as we take a new path; expanding our industry, cooperating with our neighbours on major issues, and ensuring our space is a safe haven for all.\nWe are currently in need of reliable pilots, able to represent us in matters of trade and security. If you are interested, please accept this invitation.

Hatikvah is in need of reliable pilots to help project our influence into new areas of business. Be it delivering food supplies, escorting Argon freighters or even clearing out disused mine fields, we hope to become an indispensable force reaching all areas of space.\nWe have signed several new trade contracts which require prompt deliveries. We have provided a courier craft for you to use for this task.

Hatikvah has had dealings with the Scale Plate Pact for quite some time and this has led to us gaining a somewhat unscrupulous reputation. For us to move forward, we have deemed it necessary to break our ties with Scale Plate. Unfortunately, they are not very fond of the idea and have gone so far as to strike several ships.\nDal Busta is helping us deal with the situation, but to do so he needs whatever intel he can get on Scale Plate. Please aid him so he can make the best possible decisions.

If we're to help Hatikvah break ties with Scale Plate while avoiding any hostilities, we'll need to come up with some kind of deal which benefits both sides. Any intel we get on Scale Plate could be instrumental in negotiations.
Using the worm which we've provided, see if you can access some of the databases of one of their stations.

We have come up with a data worm, designed to infiltrate Scale Plate computer systems. We believe the best way to deliver it is via an external vulnerability at one of their stations. You can use your ship's Scan Mode to find such Data Leaks.
A Scale Plate station is known to be in sector: $SECTOR$
With the data we've just gathered, I can see that Scale Plate have several important deliveries due. How about we give them something to worry about for a change?
To craft a $WARE$ you will need the following:

Our strikes against Scale Plate may cause them to think twice before they try another stunt. While this may be a good opportunity to dig up some more information on their operations, we must also stay vigilant.
We're assigning you a sector to help patrol. If we get any leads which you can help with, we'll contact you.
A suspected member of the Scale Plate Pact is making a run through Hatikvah space and we hope to gain some valuable intel by observing her. Stay alert, and don't get too close.
With new information on Scale Plate operations, we need to discuss the best way to move forward.

As time ticks down to the talks between the Scale Plate Pact and the Hatikvah Free League, Dal remains confident in his ability to negotiate an amicable severance between the two quarrelling factions. Anything to appease the elusive Pact lieutenant may go a long way in setting the mood for the discussions.

Dal has met with the Scale Plate Pact lieutenant to discuss the Hatikvah situation and hopefully broker a deal to end hostilities. Meanwhile, Hatikvah ships continue to be harassed by well-equipped Scale Plate raiders and need assistance wherever they can get it.

With our talks progressing with the Scale Plate Pact we must do what we can to not spark any additional tensions. Unfortunately, a number of attack drones have gone rogue and continue to hit Scale Plate targets. We need to deactivate them before things get out of hand.

The brokered agreement states that Hatikvah are to hand off control of a newly constructed factory to Scale Plate, probably to help shore up their production lines. While we expect that the Argon are watching closely, we doubt they will intervene as it's in their own interest that Hatikvah transitions away from our past practices.
To keep things as smooth as possible, Dal has suggested a number of steps to take. Please be sure to take utmost care in your assignment.

We're approaching the moment of truth where Scale Plate must hold up their end of the bargain. So far, all of Dal's advice has borne fruit and we will continue to rely on his insights in these final stages.

That damn Teladi was just looking for some reason to throw that deal in our faces! No time to explain the situation. Just try to keep as many of our people alive while we ask the Argon for assistance.
I believe I have noticed a strange occurrence at our main base of operations. I wish to speak to you, immediately.

Ship wreckage, seemingly belonging to the freighter commanded by Dal Busta, was found close to his last known location. It is possible that the Scale Plate Pact would have attempted to silence him and his crew before taking further hostile actions against the Hatikvah Free League.\n\nThere was no clear evidence of escape pods being launched, nor any report of distress calls in the area.

Ship wreckage of Dal Busta's freighter was found close to his last known location. It appears that they came under attack, most likely by the Scale Plate Pact, perhaps in an attempt to silence him and his crew.\n\nThere appears to have been an attempt to reach the escape pods, but neither Dal nor his crew have been seen since.

(Sent by Kat Lanton, female)Greetings Captain.

I've been asked by Dal to pass on some of our most recent intel to you, in the hopes that it aids you in your assignment. We know where a key Scale Plate Pact station is located and, if you manage to inject the worm into their systems, we're likely to score big! Here's the info:

Station: $NAME$ \($IDCODE$\)
Sector: $SECTOR$

Whether or not you act on that information is up to you.
Kat Lanton

(Invitation Email Description)If you are reading this automated message, you have been identified by the Hatikvah Free League as being capable of aiding us in becoming a fully-fledged, independent nation, aiming to take its place alongside the established powers in the Jump Gate network. Our ultimate goal is to establish a safe haven for all peoples who are struggling, whether that be from the long-lasting consequences of the Jump Gate shutdown, or because they intend to trade in wares others might deem illegal.

We would like you to represent us in matters of trade and security. We have taken on a skilled analyst to work alongside this role, and oversee the project's diplomatic elements. You would, of course, be compensated for your efforts, and the new contacts you make may also open the door to further opportunities for you. If you are interested in joining our cause, please accept our mission offer.

Reen Omara, Hatikvah Executive

page.title: Teladi Trade Guild
page.descr: Texts for the Teladi Trade Guild mission group and sub-mission variants
page.t: The well known and respected Teladi Trade Guild is always looking for skilled and proven traders to bolster our ranks. You have caught our attention and we wish to extend this invitation to you. If you are interested, please meet with me.

The path to profit often is a treacherous one, with both natural and artificial obstacles along the way. We at the Teladi Trade Guild believe that a proactive stance is needed to both protect our assets and clients as well as discourage any heinous acts against us.

Those who wish to make a profit can never help the natural and artificial obstacles that may stand in their way. That, however, does not mean that these obstacles cannot be overcome, and we believe that an active approach to dealing with these obstacles is necessary to protect both our assets and our clients.
We need a number of pilots to go out and deal with a number of potentially dangerous situations.
We are looking for experienced pilots capable of dealing with these problematic issues.
The Teladi Trade Guild is looking to expand its operations and influence in the local area. To do so, we must find opportunities to expand and act on them.
A stagnant operation is an unprofitable one, which is why the Teladi Trade Guild is looking to expand our presence in a number of areas.
A trusted business partner is requested to help us identify such opportunities and potentially provide assets to take advantage of them.
We need a versatile and skilled partner to act in the interests of the Teladi Trade Guild to help us in this endeavour.

An organisation as large and far-reaching as the Teladi Trade Guild will often run into mundane issues which limit its profitability. Should these issues never be addressed, it may well lead to financial loss. This is unspeakable.

We at the Teladi Trade Guild pride ourselves on managing a vast network of traders and leading them to profit. That said, we recognise that minor issues do occur which lead to reduced profit or even a loss.
We need a resourceful pilot to look into such issues and solve them so that we can guarantee hassle-free profit for our members.
An adaptable and skilled pilot is required to help us get a handle on these issues so that we can ensure continued profitability.
Our influence on the market goes far beyond simply ensuring our stations remain stocked and our traders remain active. We are of course here to turn a profit and we will do so by a number of means.

Running such a large and profitable organisation such as our own is a testament to our prowess in trade and management. It also highlights that our many strategies continue to work and bring in additional credits.

Controlling the price of goods with supply and demand is a time-tested technique to maximise our gains in this area. We require a Teladi Trade Guild member to perform a number of tasks to help shift the market in our favor.

Manipulating supply and demand to control the prices of goods works well to maximise our profits. To this end, a Teladi Trade Guild member should perform a number of tasks to help shift the market in our favour.

Intelligence is key to making sound business decisions, especially when that intel concerns your competition. It is also imperative that we keep an eye on our ships to ensure their safety and that they are not taking part in nefarious acts which could lead the Guild itself into disrepute.

Argon and Teladi share an old adage in that knowledge is power; in this case, the power to make a profit for one and all. In order to make the best possible business decisions, it is very important that we keep two eyes on both our competition and our own ships, as often as we can spare them, in order to ensure a broad and deep view of the current situation.
We need a pilot to help expand our sensor network in the local area.
We are looking for someone to help expand our sensor network to this endeavour.

Once an intelligence network has been built, it is vital to the operation that it is maintained, so that we can always have an ear to the ground and ensure not only that our competition remains behind us, but also that our members remain out of trouble.

We are keen to ensure that the vast intelligence network that we have already built is also properly maintained. This will allow us to keep an eye out for any new developments both within our own organisation and for our competition.
We seek a pilot who can help with this maintenance on our sensor network.
We are looking for someone to help make sure our sensor network is well maintained.

Some say that profit thrives in a warzone, and they are not necessarily incorrect, but there is little profit to be found for a trader that has a weapon pointed directly at them. The universe remains a dangerous place, and in order to ensure the safety of our assets and our clients, these dangers must be dealt with accordingly.

Though a lot of steps have been taken since the Jump Gates began to realign to ensure a safer and more peaceful life for all, there are still many dangers across the Jump Gate network. Not only for the sake of our profit, but of course for the sake of our and our clients safety, we must make sure that we deal with these dangers.
We are looking for pilots who feel like they can tackle these dangers, should they be in the form of Xenon incursions, pirates or other, more threatening menaces.
We would like someone to help us deal with these dangers, whatever they may be, without risking a loss of profit.

All economy stems from the natural resources that exist across the Jump Gate network. To give our members and clients the best start to their economic activities, we'd like someone to use resource probes to find strong resource regions in $SPACENAME$. Specifically, you should look for the following resources: $WARENAMES$

We would like to see an increase in the number of natural resources available for us, and in order to do that, we first want to prospect profitable regions. We'd like you to use resource probes in $SPACENAME$ to find strong yields of the following resources: $WARENAMES$

Many of our traders have been complaining about their trade routes being blocked by mines lay down by pirates and their competitors in recent times. We would like someone to deal with these mines so that our traders can go about their business in peace.

We are looking to improve our trading fleet with a new freighter. We have spent significant time looking into areas where we are falling flat and have identified an exact specification for this ship, and would like you to source it for us:\n$FLEET$

As part of our work to improve our intelligence network, we would like you to help build up our satellite network in an area of interest to a number of our members' competitors. This will allow our members to keep a better eye on the competition, and build trust in the Teladi Trade Guild.\n$REQUIREMENTS$

We have identified an area of space that shows a lot of potential to be a popular trading point in the near future. We would like to give our members as much of an advantage as possible, and so would like satellites to be placed in the area so we keep an eye on development and tell our members when the best time to start investing will be.

After a number of Xenon incursions and raids as of late, some of our members have asked us to ensure that their stations are kept safe. We take the safety of our members' assets very seriously, and would like to ask that laser towers be placed around some member stations to show that we are willing to help.

A number of our satellites have been broken by weapon-fire, accidental collisions and of course deliberate attacks and sabotage. As part of the maintenance of our network, we ask you to fly to these satellites and repair their hull to $PERCENTAGE$%.

A number of our members' stations have been suffering from a number of data leaks. This is not only harmful to our members but can also lead to significant problems for us, so we would like to ask that the leaks be dealt with in a timely fashion. We trust you to take care of this for us.

One of our courier pilots has reported that they were forced to drop a number of items while en route to one of our stations. A lot of Credits were paid for these items, so we need you to first find the crate that the items were dropped in, then recover the items for us.

This operation is more sensitive than most: To keep you safe, we will only tell you what you are required to know. We need you to board a station belonging to one of our member's competitors and make your way to the control rooms. From there, it is imperative that you quickly and quietly sabotage the station by hacking into its control panels. Good luck.\n$REQUIREMENT$

One of our courier pilots has got themselves trapped in a mine field and we need someone to lure the mines away from them. The mines should only be detonated if it is sure that our courier will not come to any harm. Once the mines are out of the way, the crew has instructions to resume their flight.

One of our couriers has been caught in a mine field. Though they were able to eject from the ship and pilot themselves to safety, the ship requires recovery. Please board the ship and clear the mine field, then plot a course to the designated station. There you can transfer ownership of the ship back to us.\n$REQUIREMENTS$

One of our members has placed an open request for some items that they seek on our notice board. It is not of very high priority, but if you find yourself with time to spare, you could help us by finding these items and taking them to the pilot. We are sure they would be very grateful for the work.

page.title: Antigone Trade Guild
page.descr: Texts for the Antigone Trade Guild mission group and sub-mission variants
page.t: The Antigone Trade Guild is looking for skilled and proven entrepreneurs to join our organisation and you have been flagged as a prime candidate. If you would like to discuss this further please come and meet me.

At the Antigone Trade Guild, we try to make it as easy as possible for our members to enjoy trading without interruption. Unfortunately, the Jump Gate network is full of both natural and created obstacles, and we must take an active approach to protect our members from them.

Those who are members of the Antigone Trade guild like to enjoy trading with as little interruption as possible. We take a proactive approach to providing this, dealing with any natural and created obstacles quickly and effectively, so that our our members may focus on what is important to them.
We are looking for someone to go out into space and deal with a number of potentially dangerous situations.
We are looking for those who can help us by dealing with these kinds of problematic obstacles.

We at the Antigone Trade Guild are ambitious, and ever looking for ways in which we can expand our operation to help even more traders make money. To this end, we must of course seek out new opportunities and act upon them.

To make sure we are serving our members as best we can, we must always keep moving forwards and look to grow our operation where we can. In order to do this, we are looking to expand our presence in a number of different areas.
We need a skilled and versatile businessperson to help us identify the opportunities we can use to grow and potentially provide assets in order to take advantage of them.
We are looking for a trusted business partner to act towards these interests, potentially providing assets to the Antigone Trade Guild, so that all members might gain from them.

The Antigone Trade Guild, much like the Antigone Republic, is built on people helping each other, even with the most mundane of problems. These problems, should they never be tackled, might cause problems for us all further down the line.

We recognise that our Guild is not yet at the same level as the Teladi Trade Guild, we strive to one day be better, which means learning to manage small problems before the grow and become unsolvable.

We look to solve such problems as quickly and effectively as possible, and we are seeking resourceful pilots to help us in this endeavour. This will help ensure convenient trading for all of our members.
We are looking for an adaptable and resourceful pilot to help us solve such problems quickly and efficiently so that all of our members can continue their endeavours and help us to grow.

At the Antigone Trade Guild it is our highest priority to make sure our members and all of their assets stay in business, and ideally also profitable. To achieve this, it is sometimes necessary to go the extra mile, beyond keeping our member stations in stock and making sure our members can trade at all.

Sometimes in order to keep our members in business and profitable, our number-one priority at all times, it is necessary to use techniques other than keeping our members' stations in stock and giving our members suggestions on where and how to get the best deal.

Controlling the price of goods by removing or adding a ware from the market in bulk not only allows us to ensure our members make a good profit on their trades, but also protects the economy against potential future collapses. We are looking for an Antigone Trade Guild member to help us with tasks relating to this goal.

A commonly-used technique for ensuring long-lasting profits is to manipulate the supply and demand of goods and thus to control their prices. This doubles somewhat as ensurance against potential economic collapse. We're currently looking for one of our members to perform a number of tasks to help shift the market in this way.

We are only able to do our work because of our vast and still growing intelligence network. It allows us not only to keep an eye on economic trends, but also to keep an eye on our competition when it is necessary, as well as working as an early-warning system when our own members reach trouble.

A lot of hard work has already gone into building our intelligence network. One of our greatest assets, it means we can know in advance if one of our members gets into trouble, we can keep an eye on our competition where we find it necessary and of course can quickly identify economic trends worth our members' attention.
We are looking for a pilot to help us further build and expand on the sensor network already in place.
In order to keep us up to date, we seek a pilot who will further build and expand on our sensor network.

It is not much use to build an intelligence network without then maintaining it. It is key to our Guild that this is done, so that we can continue keeping an eye out for market changes that may help our members, as well as helping us to keep an eye on our competition and keep our members out of trouble.

We wish to make sure that our intelligence network is not only expanded, but also properly maintained. This will allow us to notice quickly any changes to the economy that are of interest to our members, as well as enabling us to keep an eye on our competition and to make sure our own members stay out of trouble.
We are looking for a pilot who can help with this maintenance on our satellite network.
We need one of our members to help make sure our sensor network is well maintained.

As an organisation, our main objective is to ensure stress-free trading for all of our members, and this is difficult to achieve when there are so many threats across the Jump Gate network. We need to ensure the safety of our members and their assets, and to do that these need to be dealt with.

The Antigone Republic has been one of the driving forces behind creating a safer and more peaceful Jump Gate network, but there remain many threats that have yet to be dealt with. The Antigone Trade Guild recognises these threats as a danger to its members, and realises that these threats must be dealt with.
As such, we ask that a willing and able member of our Guild help us in tackling some of these dangers, whatever they may be.
To help us in this endeavour, we would like a willing and able member of our guild to deal with some of these threats.

To help our members who are interested in mining, we would like to find some local high-yield regions that we might share with them. We'd like someone to use resource probes to identify profitable mining spots in $SPACENAME$. Specifically, the resource probes should be used to find: $WARENAMES$

We are looking to expand into more mining activities, and would like to see a number of profitable regions in the area prospected to help us with this. We need you to use resource probes in $SPACENAME$ to find strong yields of the following resources: $WARENAMES$

We've been informed by some of our members that they have been held up by mines being placed at Gates and highway entrances along their trading routes, no doubt placed by pirates or their own competition. We would like you to deal with these mines so that our members can go about their business in peace again.

To deter some pirates lingering near our trade routes, we placed a couple of cheap mines. Knowing those pirates, the mines are probably good enough to do some damage to their ships and keep them from making trouble. However, the next inspection from Antigone bureaucrats will reveal, that the mines' software licence is long expired. To avoid paying a fee for using outdated and potentially dangerous technology, we want you to destroy them.

We are looking to grow our own merchant fleet with the addition of a new transporter. After significant work to analyse what exactly it is we need, based on areas where we feel we are falling short, we have identified an exact specification for this ship. We would like you to source it for us:\n$FLEET$

A number of our members have expressed an interest in knowing more about what their competitors are up to. We see an opportunity here to broaden our intelligence network, and so would like you to deploy a number of satellites in an area that we've identified as of interest to our members.

Sources tell us that one particular trader, not a member of our Guild, has the potential to significantly damage trading routes for not one but many of our members. We would like to be able to analyse the situation for ourselves, so we require a satellite to be deployed in the specified location.

A number of our members have been suffering from raids on their stations recently, as well as an increased number of Xenon incursions. The safety of Antigone Trade Guild members and the security of their assets is one of our top priorities, and as such we would like to see laser towers deployed around the affected stations.

Be it from stray weapon fire, accidental conditions or deliberate acts of vandalism or sabotage, a number of our satellites have been taken out of commission. As part of the maintenance to our network, we'd like you to fly to these satellites and repair their hull to $PERCENTAGE$%.

A number of our member stations are suffering from data leaks that are leaking very sensitive trading information, not only to our competition, but potentially also to pirates. We can't allow this data to be used harmfully - we need the leaks dealt with in a timely fashion.

A member of the Antigone Trade Guild was attacked while they were on a trading run, and reported to us that they were forced to drop some of their inventory to make sure it wasn't destroyed. The pilot is fine, at least physically, but unable to retrieve the items. Instead, we would like you to find the crate in which the items were dropped in, and then recover them on our behalf.

We don't usually condone these kinds of operations, but the matter is urgent and needs to be dealt with quickly and quietly. For your own safety, we will only tell you what you need to do. Without asking questions, please make your way to the designated station, board it and make your way to the control rooms. Once there, please use the appropriate equipment to... temporarily disarm the specified panel. Thank you and good luck.\n$REQUIREMENT$

One of our members found a mine field on their trade route and attempted to traverse it instead of going around. They are now stuck in a field of tracking mines. In order to rescue the pilot, we would like someone to lure the mines away from the ship. Be careful: The mines should only be detonated once it is certain that the pilot will not come to harm. When the mines have been cleared, the pilot knows to resume their flight.

One of our members has been caught in a minefield they were trying to traverse on their trade route. Once stuck, they were able to eject into a spacesuit and navigate out of the field, but the ship has been stranded. We'd like it to be returned to its owner. Please board the ship and clear the mine field, then plot a course to the station we've designated. There you can transfer ownership back to us.\n$REQUIREMENTS$

page.title: Argon Federation Police Missions
page.descr: Texts for the 'Argon Federation Police missions' and sub-mission variants
page.t: Pick up passengers and bring them to their destination.

page.title: Scale Plate Pact Missions
page.descr: Texts for the 'Scale Plate Pact missions' and sub-mission variants
page.t: You seem like someone who can get things done. If you want to earn a bit of extra cash, come and meet me. I'm sure we can come to some arrangement.

You don't create an organisation such as ours without making a few enemies along the way and there are a fair few people who would love to see us all spaced.\nWe have a number of individuals targeted, for various reasons. If you have great social skills and don't mind getting your hands dirty, sign up!

We've identified a number of high-value ships that we'd like to see commandeered for our own use. With the size of these ships and the numbers of their crews, we're not going to be able to convince them to bail, so we need to take the ships by force. For that, we need a good boarding crew. We want you to organise one and hand it over to us in return for payment.

We're very aware of how we're seen. We're not blind or deaf to the words pirates and brigands. The fact is we're not very popular, and a lot of people take it upon themselves to make sure we can't profit from the current universal climate. Well, we're not beyond fighting back, and we want to show that we will not be trifled with. If we make Credits along the way, then all the better for it.

The space we operate in is often not too secure when it comes to police presence but that also means we're at risk to a number of other threats out there. Be it Xenon or rival gangs, there's always something getting in our way or laying traps. On the other hand, we have to do the same. If you're available to protect our interests and disrupt theirs, let us know!

As a general rule, when you tell someone they can't have something, they only want it more. With the drugs that most governments have made illegal, this presents us with an opportunity that we're only too happy to take. If you're a safe pair of hands that wants to make some money, we're only too happy to take you on as part of our already very profitable network-wide smuggling operation.

Some of our ships have had quite a bit of trouble moving through nearby sectors recently. As far as we can tell, the satellite networks have been tracking our runs and have helped the locals get the jump on us. Naturally, we'd like to see a number of those satellites gone.
Mines are a very valuable tool, when placed by us. Otherwise, they're a constant annoyance and danger to our ships. We've identified a number of nearby mines which we would like removed.

A local station manager has clumsily forgotten their weekly payment to our cause, leaving us in a rather unfortunate situation. In the case that they overslept, how about making some noise around their station a bit?

Sometimes, the locals forget that space is a dangerous place and the unfortunate job of reminding them falls to you. And while the police deal with that mess, we'll be free to conclude some of our business elsewhere.

(male)We have started to branch out into more 'traditional' markets, earning the trust of a number of local traders. One of our guys needs transport to a local station so that he can broker a potentially lucrative deal.

(female)We have started to branch out into more 'traditional' markets, earning the trust of a number of local traders. One of our guys needs transport to a local station so that she can broker a potentially lucrative deal.

As you can expect, ships go for a high price on the market, especially those hosting very valuable information in their databanks. We have a certain target in mind and we're looking for an experienced partner to take control of the ship and give us access to certain logs. What you do with the ship is up to you.

A number of boarding operations have gone sideways as of late leaving us in need of new blood.
We are looking for $NPCCOUNT$ marines\(s\) for blah blah reason.
$DESTINATION$
$SKILLS$

We're aiming to have a bit more of an explosive presence in the nearby sectors. Too many police ships think they can just wander around like they own the place and the local freighters boost from A to B without a care in the world making them harder to corner.\nWe'd like a number of mines deployed to make things a bit more interesting around here.

Given the dangers to our ships in this area, we've decided that deploying a few mines will give us a bit of an edge should our opponents come after us. We're not expecting miracles but if we can put even a dent on a patrol vessel, it'll be worth it!
There are a number of areas with bottlenecks which we want to exploit by deploying a number of mines. Should we manage to damage or disable a ship, it'll make it a prime target for one of our teams.

(ma target)We've known for some time that $NPCName$ has been snitching on our activities so we began feeding him false info just to throw off the fuzz. It now looks like they're done with him and it's time we clean up this mess. Get it done quick and don't make us look bad.

(fe target)We've known for some time that $NPCName$ has been snitching on our activities so we began feeding her false info just to throw off the fuzz. It now looks like they're done with her and it's time we clean up this mess. Get it done quick and don't make us look bad.
(ma target)\nThey should be aboard the ship with ID: $SHIPID$.
(fe target)\nThey should be aboard the ship with ID: $SHIPID$.

(ma target)A agent of the local authorities has been causing us a whole host of problems. We've learned that their name is $NPCName$ and they're somewhat regarded as a hero in these parts. Unfortunately for them, we can't let them continue the way they are.

(fe target)A agent of the local authorities has been causing us a whole host of problems. We've learned that their name is $NPCName$ and they're somewhat regarded as a hero in these parts. Unfortunately for them, we can't let them continue the way they are.
(ma target)\nThey are most likely aboard the ship with ID: $SHIPID$.
(fe target)\nThey are most likely aboard the ship with ID: $SHIPID$.

One of our factories which produces some of our higher quality goods has been suffering a shortage of a number of resources recently. In order to keep up with demand, we need someone to dedicate some time to ensure said resources get there so production can be pushed to 100%. \n\nThey've requested that the station resource levels be raised above: $STORAGEPERCENT$%

One of our teams have identified a ship as a potential target for future operations but these days, we have to play it smart. We lost sight of this ship and need someone to pick it up so we can continue our preparations.

This is a little ironic but someone has stolen from us. I suppose it can't be helped when you keep the kind of company we do. Anyway, it's a simple task. Find him, rough him up a little and then get our stuff back.

This is a little ironic but someone has stolen from us. I suppose it can't be helped when you keep the kind of company we do. Anyway, it's a simple task. Find her, rough her up a little and then get our stuff back.

page.title: Segaris Pioneer Trade Guild
page.descr: Texts for the Pioneer Trade Guild mission group and sub-mission variants
page.t: The newly established Pioneer Trade Guild is looking for resourceful entrepreneurs to support us in our endeavours, and you have been identified as a potential business partner. This would be a mutually beneficial relationship, so if you would like to enter into an agreement, please come and see me.

As our organisation grows larger, we need to expand our reach and open up new markets. As a result, our members are faced with many obstacles, both natural ones and those created by people looking to slow us down. It is in our best interests to protect our members from these dangers, so that they can continue to grow and strengthen our guild.

All members of the Pioneer Trade Guild need to be guaranteed as little interruption as possible. For this reason, we have created a task force dealing with any natural and artificial obstacles quickly and efficiently. Any disruption of our trade operations, especially this early in the guild's existence could prove to be disastrous.
So, we are looking for someone to patrol space and deal with a number of potentially dangerous situations.
To avoid any difficulties, we are looking for those who can help us by dealing with these hazards.
The Pioneer Trade Guild is always looking for potential growth opportunities, and ways in which we can expand our operations to increase our members' profits. We cannot afford to be complacent.

It is in our members' best interest that this guild keeps growing, and that it opens up new markets and revenue streams. To achieve this growth, the guild is looking to expand its presence in a number of different areas.
Right now, we are in need of an experienced businessperson to help identify and manage potential opportunities, as well as provide assets in order to take advantage of those opportunities.
Now, we hope to find a trusted business partner who is willing to act towards these interests, and potentially provide assets to the Segaris Pioneer Trade, so that all members might gain from them.

As struggling Segaris Pioneers, we are always fighting to secure our continued existence. Solidarity is very important to us, and we help each other, even with seemingly mundane problems. Any problem left unchecked has the potential to spiral into something a lot worse.

We recognise that our Guild, due to its location and relatively small size, is not yet at the same level as our competition. We strive to one day meet them on equal footing; that process begins with us learning to manage small issues before they grow and become unsolvable.

These problems need to be dealt with swiftly and efficiently. We are looking for resourceful pilots to help solve these issues. You would be helping maintain convenient trading conditions for all of our members.

To deal with these issues in a timely fashion, we are looking for an enterprising and experienced pilot. Addressing these seemingly trivial issues now, before they become a bigger deal, will help us significantly as we grow in numbers.

It is an unfortunate reality that the big guilds don't really play fair. So, in order to keep up, the Pioneer Trade Guild also needs to ensure its survival by guaranteeing its members' assets stay in business, and ideally also profitable, by any means necessary.

Coming into an already well-established market as an underdog, it is not surprising that we sometimes have to resort to dishonest means to ensure our continued survival.
