(effect info FAF)The Fallen Families(Fallen Families same as {20203,1701}) are likely to profit from the Split civil war. An increase in the amount of their fleets is to be expected.
(effect info ZYA1)Siding with the Zyarth Patriarchy will stabilise and strengthen the empire and put pressure on their enemies.
(effect info ZYA1)With its multiple endeavours throughout the Jump Gate network, the empire will likely have a high demand for a variety of goods.
(effect info ZYA1)The empire's overall stability could eventually lead to a reduced demand for goods.
(effect info ZYA1)The Patriarchy is likely to resolve the conflict with the Curb rebellion and will continue its mandate to protect the Free Families' space against foreign intruders.
(effect info ZYA2)With a complete victory over separatist forces, the Zyarth Patriarchy will further establish itself in the Free Families' space.
(effect info ZYA2)A more rigorous ban on military ships will make life hard for pirates and criminals among the Free Families.
(effect info FAF)The Fallen Families(Fallen Families same as {20203,1701}) will not fare well with this situation. A decrease in the amount of their fleets is to be expected.
(effect info FAF)The Fallen Families(Fallen Families same as {20203,1701}) will not fare well under a stronger Zyarth Patriarchy. A decrease in the amount of their fleets is to be expected.
(effect info ZYA2)Less-disrupted economies do not favour the opportunists and could eventually stagnate.

(Email Generic Part)In an unprecedented development, the so-called 'Curbs' of the Split Free Families have conspired to create a separatist movement. These former advisors to the Patriarchs and other high-ranking officials have attempted a coup against their own leaders. Their declared aim is to unite the Free Families' forces and fight back against Zyarth Patriarchy occupation.

The Curbs invoke Ghus t'Gullt, the historical Split Patriarch who brought their role into being in order to curb the notorious male Split enthusiasm and improve political decision-making. While some Split families still adhere to this custom, others have long abandoned it. Being involved in, and in many cases responsible for, various administrative functions within the Free Families, has made it possible for the Curbs to attempt this coup.

The creation of a new splinter group within the Split has taken the other members of the Community of Planets by surprise. The Argon Federation, currently at war with the Zyarth Patriarchy over the enslavement of their citizens, has not yet taken any official stance towards this new faction. They cannot officially support this movement because of those same enslavement issues, but off the record they appear to welcome this progressive break with Split tradition and seem hopeful that it could be the beginning of a shift or schism in Split culture. In the long term, a Split population ruled by an all-female court(royal, not judicial) could be expected to be a better negotiating partner than the current Patriarch Zyarth.

(Email variant Cabal Appendix)The Federation's hopes may have been set too high, as the Curbs' declaration of independence has suffered a severe set-back as a result of a Zyarth Patriarchy operation. For the Curbs, trying to sway Split to their side, this was a critical attempt at a display of strength. Their apparent failure to protect their own declaration of indepence has far-reaching consequences, as it has rattled their co-conspirators and any undecided parties. Several Free Patriarchs have already declared their allegiance to the Zyarth Patriarchy and publically condemned this coup of Curbs.

(Email)In their effort to drive out the Zyarth occupation, the Court of Curbs has achieved a major victory. Their numerous attacks have proved too expensive for the Zyarth forces to resist, and have prompted the Colonial Police to retreat. With the Free Families still widely demilitarised from the Zyarth occupation, the protection of the Free Families' sectors now falls under the responsibility of the Curbs.

Eron Alba
- Foreign Affairs Correspondent GalNet

(Email)In their effort to crush the Curb rebellion, the Zyarth Patriarchy has achieved a major victory. Patriarchy Secret Service agents have identified various rebel cells and, in a joint operation, Curb assets and their supporters have been attacked or arrested. The Zyarth Patriarchy have used this incident to seize further assets from both the Curb rebellion and the occupied Free Families. Furthermore, the Patriarchy are claiming to have found records of Fallen Families mercenaries working for the Curbs, and have cracked down on the Fallen Families.

Eron Alba
- Foreign Affairs Correspondent GalNet

(Email)The Zyarth Partriarchy, weakened by the conflict with the Court of Curbs, has fallen prey to factionalism. Patriarch Rhak, a former subject of Patriarch Zyarth, has overthrown Zyarth and taken over the core sectors of the empire. In an effort to stabilise his territorial gains, Rhak has signed a fragile armistice with the Curbs. With some Patriarchs declaring their independence from the new Patriarchy and joining the Free Families, the region remains in turmoil.

High Patriarchs of the Split are frequently replaced by other Patriarchs through military coups or conquests, often after only a short period. Rhak's predecessor, Patriarch Zyarth, had become famous for breaking this cycle and had ruled for decades without being usurped, arguably aided by the isolation caused by the Gate shutdown and the gradual reconnection that followed. Whether the reign of Patriarch Rhak will be as stable and durable as Zyarth's, or will fall victim to some other ambitious Patriarch in the near future, remains to be seen.

Eron Alba
- Foreign Affairs Correspondent GalNet

page.title: Research Missions
page.descr: HQ research missions
page.t: Given their wide use, engines have long since been refined to an exceptional degree but I believe we have not yet reached the pinnacle of these thrust-inducing devices!
You will be taking part in a time trial to help the Crimson Egg Racing League better design their future courses.

Should you perform admirably, you will be rewarded with a face-to-face meeting with the league director, Totonis Hassunas Landonis II(referencing ,1050) herself, as well as a number of components used in race-craft tuning.
We are in need of such components to begin our research. You must make haste!
Well done on meeting the requirements needed to earn the prize we seek.
You are to meet with league director, Totonis Hassunas Landonis II(referencing ,1050) and accept the reward.
(to female)That's a nice ship you have there.
(ticker update)Pace(as in plus or minus the target time)
Docking not allowed during the time trial.
Exiting your ship not allowed during the time trial.

To give us better insights into improving shield technology, we must observe while submitting them to great amounts of strain. While we could do so in a controlled environment, it certainly would not represent the adverse conditions you will experience in real combat.\n\nI request that you expose your vessel's shields to a variety of weapons fire. A number of hits per weapon type should suffice.
(gain data on:)1 more weapon type(used after player has already gained some data)
(gain data on:)$NUM$ more weapon types(used after player has already gained some data)

Enhancing ships hulls will require very specialised equipment to modify the materials at a molecular level. Nanites are a wonderful tool capable of restructuring and repairing all sorts of things and we can use them in our research.
You are to meet a contact who can provide you with a device we need to create our own nanites. Do be wary, as such a device has been known to garner fear and disapproval from several powerful groups.
I'm here for the fabricator.(Reference to Nanite Fabricator 20201,51701)
To better improve the weapon research capability at the headquarters station, a number of particle regulators should be acquired.
Boso Ta suggests that these can be found at a location once used by his former Split captors.
Deep in the bowls of this facility is a seemingly experimental and obviously dangerous device, capable of moving high-mass objects to a predefined position in space.
It apparently requires a great number of resources to activate, so I suggest you get started.
It would be best if we marked the destination location with some form of beacon to allow the device to lock on.
(hint)Speak to Boso Ta when you want to teleport $STATIONNAME$ to a new location.
(hint)Speak to Boso Ta when you want to teleport your headquarters to a new location.
(hint)Objects in the vicinity of the beacon may interfere with the teleportation process or even be destroyed.
(hint)You can initiate the teleportation process again, but it will require resources.
The capability to traverse the multiverse is within reach, but it will require the construction of specialised venture modules.
Sorry, I don't have time for that.
What did you have in mind?

In order for us to host a venue capable of entertaining a vast variety of patrons, we must first gather relevant intelligence. The leisure activities of the many cultures range from the mundane to the extremely dangerous, and we must do our utmost to please our hard-working employees.
(from Boso)If you have finished investigating, please speak to me.

To gather the valuable insights required, we will need to observe individuals during their leisure time. Fortunately, I have devised a number of methods to avoid you having to directly interact with hapless patrons.
By using historical information it is possible to assemble a Singularity Engine Time Accelerator if the right parts are acquired.

page.title: HQ Discovery Mission
page.descr: Terran based HQ discovery story
page.t: With your security clearance now approved, you are to join a team of engineers to carry out some crucial repairs.
{30223,1002} Before the work can begin, there are several tasks to be done.
With your false identity fed into the databases of the Segaris Pioneers, you will be able to join a team of engineers assigned to carry out crucial repairs on a top-secret facility.

You are to join a team of engineers to carry out crucial repairs on a very important installation. You came highly recommended, so I expect that you will carry out your tasks with the utmost professionalism.
Certain items can be found at Black Market traders
Your spacesuit is equipped with a repair laser. Get out of your seat and leave your ship via the transporter room control panel.

(Mission Text )Kuromanckami wants you to work with another of his assistants on this project. Unfortunately, she was conducting an experiment in a hazardous region and managed to get herself trapped. Help your colleague to escape her predicament.

(Objective - investigate)Nav Beacons around the Hazardous Region(Hazardous Region same as {10002,708}, Beacon same as {29109,3801})

(Mission Text )The freelance scientist, Kuromanckami, wants you and your colleague to voyage deep into Terran space. There you will find the expedition site; a piece of Torus wreckage. As your colleague's hardware and software are not entirely legal, you will have to avoid and evade Terran patrols on your way there.
(Mission Text )Be warned that the Terrans may try to prevent you from exploring the Torus remnants.
(Reward Text )Glorious View of a Minuscule Shard of Terran Hubris
(Logbook Text )You successfully sneaked past the Terran forces and reached the Torus wreckage.

(Mission Text )Kuromanckami has tasked the two of you with extracting ancient Terran data from the data center within the Torus wreckage. Your colleague(female colleague) will hopefully be able to interface with the Torus mainframe and download any information the creators of the Terraformers might have left there.
(CustomObjective - )Enter with Expedition Ship('Expedition Ship' same as {30224,201})
(CustomObjective - )Enter HUB with Expedition Ship('Expedition Ship' same as {30224,201})
(Custom Objective - )Find a way to open the airlock

(Mission Appendix - Written Riddle Explanation)The data center consists of 8 switches which need to be activated. The activation or deactivation of switches may also flip the state of others. Take note of which switch affects which.

(Mission Appendix - Written Riddle Explanation)The data center consists of 8 panels which need to be activated. The activation or deactivation of panels may also flip the state of others. Take note of which panel affects which.
(Mission Appendix - Written Riddle Explanation)Switches buzzing with electrical discharges are unresponsive and cannot be activated or deactivated. They remain active or inactive.
(Mission Appendix - Written Riddle Explanation)Panels buzzing with electrical discharges are unresponsive and cannot be activated or deactivated. They remain active or inactive.

(Mission Appendix - Written Riddle Explanation)The Torus AI is trying to protect some switches by making them unresponsive. To regain access, you will need to distract it by working on other switches.
(Mission Appendix - Written Riddle Explanation)The Torus AI is trying to protect some panels by making them unresponsive. To regain access, you will need to distract it by working on other panels.
(Mission Appendix - Written Riddle Explanation)Switches with closed shutters are unresponsive and cannot be activated or deactivated. They remain active or inactive.
(Mission Appendix - Written Riddle Explanation)Panels with closed shutters are unresponsive and cannot be activated or deactivated. They remain active or inactive.
(Mission Text )After successfully obtaining data on terraforming from the Torus, you now need to deliver it to the Segarian chief scientist.
(Logbook Text )You delivered terraforming data from the Torus to the Segarians and unlocked advanced terraforming projects.
(Title)Project Genesis: Terraforming of Terranova in the Segaris System

(Email)Dear Friend,

Our planet Terranova was rendered uninhabitable by the Xenon during the First Terraformer War. Although they did not destroy our cities, the Xenon destroyed the planet's ecosystem.

The monumental effort that was Project Genesis has finally paid off. We, the Segaris Pioneers(same as {20203,2901}), were able to remodel the atmosphere and successfully begin the process of reinhabiting the planet. It was an honour to be appointed to lead this project, and I extend my gratitude, not only to my immediate team and the Segaris Pioneers, but also to people like you, who played a major part in its success. Thank you.

Dr. Rick Feynman
Chief Scientist of the Segaris Pioneers(same as {20203,2901})
(Title)Project Genesis: Terraforming of Sutton in the Gaian Prophecy System

(Email)Dear Friend,

For a long time, we Segaris Pioneers(same as {20203,2901}) have dreamed of turning Sutton into a homeworld, and named the system in which it lies accordingly. It took enormous effort and untold resources to make this project a reality, and it was my honour to be appointed to lead it. Now, this effort is finally bearing fruit and we have successfully begun to settle on Sutton. I extend my gratitude, not only to my immediate team and the Segaris Pioneers, but also to people like you, who played a major role during our work on this project. Thank you.

Dr. Rick Feynman
Chief Scientist of the Segaris Pioneers(same as {20203,2901})

(Email)Agent Hariken,

Command received notice of a major development involving 'Project Genesis'. Awaiting your immediate report.

Mission Command

(Email)Operative,

Command has received notice of a major development involving 'Project Genesis'. Awaiting your immediate report.

Mission Command

(Email)Agent Hariken,

Awaiting your immediate report. You are hereby informed that we are launching an investigation into your disappearance. You are also reminded that absence without official leave is in violation of military criminal law code 5-33.

Mission Command

(Email)Operative,

Awaiting your immediate report. You are hereby informed that we are launching an investigation into your disappearance. You are also reminded that taking absence without official leave is a violation of military criminal law code 5-33.

Mission Command

(Email)Agent Hariken,

You are hereby informed that we are assuming control of any investigations into the Boron. Do not take any action. Stand by for further instructions.

Mission Command

(Email)Operative,

You are hereby informed that we are assuming control of any investigations into the Boron. Do not take any action. Stand by for further instructions.

Mission Command

(Email)Agent Hariken,

You are hereby informed that due to internal restructuring, the Commission for Segarian Affairs has been dissolved. You are hereby indefinitely relieved of duty. Be aware that any disclosure of internal affairs will be prosecuted. Together with this note you will receive compensation.

Mission Command

You are hereby informed that, due to internal restructuring, the Commission for Segarian Affairs has been dissolved. You are therefore relieved of duty. Please be aware that any disclosure of our internal affairs will result in prosecution. Accompanying this notice will be your compensation.

Mission Command

(Player Choice)We ended up in another system.
(Player Choice)I don't have time for this.

page.title: Terran War Introduction Plot
page.t: (Lord of the Rings quote)First Light of the Fifth Day

(Description)Do you have what it takes to step forward and rise up to defend our pristine system, and by extension the entirety of the Gate network? Are you ready to join the esteemed ranks of the Terran heroes of old and stop the Xenon menace dead in its tracks? Then High Command needs YOU to take part in Sol's newest outreach program and assist the Solborn Militia in one of their legendary, daring operations.\n\nPlease find attached the rally point coordinates.
(Logfile)The threat to the Terran Outpost has been subdued, for now.
Stop the miner before he enters the minefield
(give order to friend)I need you to do something for me.
(give order to friend, meaning "go to your ship, lift off and wait")Wait for me outside.
(mail title written by male friend)My Current Location

(mail written by male friend)Hey there,

If you are ready to continue our adventure, hit this handy button and meet me at the location indicated.

Haile
(mail written by male friend, intentionally hasty)what the heck? station almost gone - can meet you at new location. press button okay bye
(mail written by male friend, intentionally hasty)ugh not again!!! got to run same deal - button
(mail written by male friend, intentionally in caps)BUTTON!

(Description)Welcome back, squad. That unfortunate situation could have gone better, but considering the circumstances, you've handled yourselves well enough. If you ask me, it's high time to clue you in on the real operation. While you work, my team will look into the issue of that ownerless Nav Beacon you found during your previous assignment. If there's one thing High Command despises, it's loose ends.

(Logfile, Haile Shinamon same as 30225,101)Despite the chaotic wrap-up of the Solborn Militia project and the loss of Haile Shinamon, Mission Command has deemed you worthy to take part in further special operations.

(Email by male NPC, "Intervention" is short for "Intervention Corps", a branch of the Terran military)Hey there, pilot friend. I've had some time to ponder that whole "Solborn Militia" business, and a few things strike me as odd. Why would Intervention allow them to invade their turf? Whoever is behind this operation must be really throwing their weight around. If our goal is to move up the ranks and get access to high stakes missions, we have to ace this assignment ASAP and impress the big brass.\n\n-Haile
Wait for your wingmate to finish the scan
Find the source of the strange signal
Defend the Outpost until help arrives

(Description)Pilot! I see that you've survived the Solborn Militia's collective trial by fire. I've ordered the other squadrons to assist the Intervention Corps with their clean-up, and then take some well-deserved time off, but you're a special case. What you've encountered on your assignment has left my team with an ever-growing pile of questions. Meet me in my headquarters for a proper debriefing.
(Logfile)You've been made a special operative of the Terran Secret Service. Top secret missions are now available.
I'm ready to make my report.
What is the Solborn Militia, really?
("Lee" refers to 30225,103, a male NPC)Did Lee have it in for us?
("Antigone" is short for the "Antigone Republic")How is the situation with Antigone?
Where do I go from here?
As ready as I can be.

(Description)Well, I'd say we handled that situation well enough. Smart move, sending the two best pilots of the squad to deal with that miner. Anyway, if we've made enough of an impression on Mission Command, we're about to enter proper Cadet-worthy mission territory. I have a feeling that we're at least going to need more powerful engines for that, so let's pay a visit to the nearest Equipment Dock and see what they have in store. I hope it's not too expensive, or else we'll have to fly a few missions on the side.

Haile's shopping list:
Faster engines
Bigger guns
Shields??? As if I'd ever get hit!
A few Satellites
Docking Software is for newbies!
(Logfile)You've followed Haile's advice and upgraded your ship before taking on further tasks for the Solborn Militia.

page.title: Yaki Investigation Plot
page.t: (jab at the political career of a person called Delilah Shiratori, who's last name means "swan" in Japanese)Delilah's Swansong
My Other Spaceship Is The Xenon M0
Put Back Together With Bits Left Over
Actually Three Smaller Ships In A Trenchcoat
My Other Spaceship Is The Argon One

(Description, written by female NPC)Operative! We've recently made a breakthrough in our investigation and are in need of someone who's capable and determined enough to go down a particular rabbit hole. The main objective is to gather information, but judging by our intel, it would be prudent to attempt this task in an agile, yet generously armed military ship. You're about to hunt down a few pirates.
(Logfile)You've tracked down one of the Yaki pirates, but the circumstances of his defeat have only raised further questions.
Find traces of recent Yaki attacks
Use Long Range Scanner from within target area
(name is the same as 30225,105; Defeat: )Obelisk Ikegami's Posse
("Outpost" is short for 30225,1012, the "Solborn Militia Outpost")Any new leads on the Outpost incident?

(Description, written by the male NPC Boso Ta; "Pioneers" refers to the faction "Segaris Pioneers")Assistant! It is good that I hijacked your communications in time, for you would have surely been helpless against this scary and malicious pirate and his downright unnatural fellowship. I now have a most revealing and important announcement to make: I do not trust these miner fellows and their haphazard leader's demeanour. It is paramount that you believe in my intuition, for I am most conversant and knowledgeable on the subject of human communication! Heed my advice: Follow these Pioneers and stay alert, so that we may shine a bright and iridescent light on this most alarming mystery.
(Reward, "connection" is meant both as a way to physically find the Yaki, as well as a proof that the Segaris Pioneers and Yaki collaborate)A Connection to the Yaki
(Logfile)Through sheer perseverance and the exploitation of human emotions, you've managed to find a genuine Yaki ship, which still contains the navigational data for its origin system.
(refers to a female NPC; Talk to:/Confront: )Customs Officer
(fancy way to say "think about what you've learned")Process this new information
(talk to a few highlighted NPCs in a bar)Subtly ask around
Confront(: male or female suspect/specific NPC name)
(suspect can be male or female; Confront: )Suspect
(similar to 30226,2003, just as an objective; Find: )Connection to the Yaki
("Abandoned Asteroid Base" same as 20102,2041)Leave the Abandoned Asteroid Base
(talking to female customs officer; Captain Atreides is a male NPC)Captain Atreides sent me.
(talking to female customs officer)It's simply the risk we take.
(talking to female customs officer; "they" refers to cargo crates)They got scattered during a Yaki attack.
(talking to female customs officer)This all seems rather unconventional.
(talking to female customs officer; "him" refers to Captain Atriedes, a male NPC)I'll make sure to tell him that.
(talking to female customs officer)I could help you deal with those pirates.
(talking to "male" Paranid priest)What do you do here?
(talking to "male" Paranid priest)How is that working out for you?
(talking to "male" Paranid priest)What do you think these people need?
(talking to "male" Paranid priest)Thank you for your insight.
(talking to male Teladi trader)What is your business here?
(talking to male Teladi trader)Seen any "asymmetrical faces" around?
(talking to male Teladi trader; conversation option to pay money)Colour me intrigued. \(Pay: $CREDITS$ {1001,101}(Cr)\)
(talking to male captain)How did you end up here?
(talking to male captain; "Shani" refers to "Tamatha Shani", 30225,103, a female customs officer)Shani says you shouldn't overdo it.
(talking to male captain)What do you mean by that?
(talking to male captain; "Shani" refers to "Tamatha Shani", 30225,103, a female customs officer)Shani commends you for your bravery.
(talking to male captain; "Reuven" refers to "Kasee Reuven", 30225,102, a female rookie miner)Reuven thinks you messed up.
(talking to female rookie miner)What's your job?
(talking to female rookie miner)Good thing I arrived in time.
(talking to female rookie miner)See you around.
(talking to male captain; player reveals themselves as secret service and makes an accusation)Terran Secret Service! You're working with the Yaki!
(talking to female rookie miner; "you" refers to her entire group of miners; "back there" refers to the neighbouring sector)You weren't attacked back there.
(talking to female rookie miner; suggesting that the pirate was seen on the station in the past)That pirate was a regular. You knew him.
(talking to female rookie miner; "you" refers to the entire Segaris Pioneers faction)What are you trading with the Yaki?
(talking to female rookie miner; "them" refers to the Yaki pirates)How can I meet one of them?
(talking to female customs officer; the "friend" is male)I killed your Yaki friend. Surrender.
(talking to female customs officer; "Obelisk" refers to "Obelisk Ikegami", 30225,105, a male pirate)Obelisk's death was an accident. I'm sorry.
(talking to female customs officer; "you" refers to the customs officer and her male friend)You were seen together. Were you close?
(talking to female customs officer)I could go on your behalf.
(tooltip for when an option is not selectable because of insufficient funds)Not enough credits.

(Description; written by male NPC Boso Ta)Outstanding work, assistant! Now that you have finally left this overbearingly sinister asteroid behind you, it is my duty as a scientist to impartially present all available options to you, despite one of them being evidently superior to all the others. To extract the secret and valuable navigational data that is hidden deep within the systems of this curiously intriguing ship, you could theoretically deliver it to your other employer, the Terran Secret Service. However, since those bumbling buffoons are likely to quarantine this beautiful piece of technology in the process, may I instead suggest that you deliver it to me? I will make sure to take great care during my analysis. Of course, should an unfortunate accident claim your new ship along the way, you will have no choice but to discover its elusive and mysterious point of origin on your own.
(Logfile)You've arrived at the doorstep of the Yaki, much to the surprise of their gate guard.
Deliver the Yaki ship to the Secret Service or Boso Ta
Find the Yaki home sector on your own

(Description, written by Boso Ta, a male NPC)What an awesomely frightening discovery! I suggest you temporarily and begrudgingly heed the commands of this quaintly irritable crowd. All of your insights and first-hand accounts would be irretrievably lost, should you expire this far from the safety of my laboratory, after all!
(Logfile; "Haile Shinamon", same as 30225,101, is a male NPC)You've reunited with Haile Shinamon, who showed you the danger which lies at the heart of the Yaki community.
("Haile" refers to "Haile Shinamon", 30225,101, a male friend)Listen to Haile's proposition
(highlights friendly ships that just arrived)Notice the arrival of Yaki conspirators
(talking to female pirate leader)Then why am I still alive?
(talking to female pirate leader)Are you trying to recruit me?
(talking to female pirate leader)What is this place?
(talking to female pirate leader; "they" refers to the NPC's ancestors)How did they survive?
(talking to female pirate leader; "Obelisk" refers to "Obelisk Ikegami", 30225,105, a male pirate)Obelisk was killed in a fight.
(talking to female pirate leader; "Tamatha" refers to "Tamatha Shani", 30225,103, a female customs officer)Tamatha died because of me.
(talking to female pirate leader; the player isn't currently held prisoner, they're just worried)Are you letting me leave?
(talking to male friend)Why did you disappear?
(talking to male friend; "powers" in the sense of superpowers, which is a ludicrous idea)You mentioned something about powers?
(talking to male friend; "Orcanic" refers to female NPC "Kendai Orcanic", 30225,106)What can you tell me about Orcanic?
(talking to male friend)Why did you really disappear?
(Title of the mission thread)The Fate of the Yaki

(Description of the mission thread, written by Boso Ta, a male NPC)What a surprising and terrifying conundrum you have uncovered, assistant! Now that the plight of the Yaki has been made apparent to you, there are so many conflicting goals, so many combinations to choose from! How will you wield all this knowledge?
(Reward of the mission thread; literally meaning that the thread will disappear if you complete or fail all sub-missions)A Clean Slate
(Logfile of the mission tread)You have completed or failed all objectives belonging to the mission.

(Description)Operative, I don't mean to alarm you, but it appears to me that you may have new information about your investigation that you may want to share. My observers tell me that you ventured out into the unknown, and the Terran Secret Service would dearly like to know what it is that you have found. It goes without saying that Commander Lee and his Intervention Corps are ready to pounce, should we give the word.
(Reward; literally meaning that you're completing your official task)A Job Well Done
(Logfile variant 1)The Terrans were informed about the Yaki home base and will from now on periodically send out an invasion fleet.
(Logfile variant 2)The Terrans were told that there's no organised threat, so the Yaki are safe - for now.
(Logfile variant 3; "Yaki's" is plural)The investigation ended before the Terrans could be informed about the Yaki's whereabouts.
(meaning "watch how the events unfold")Await the conclusion
(talking to female superior; option that directs the conversation towards a new subject)About the Yaki...
(talking to female superior)I will need more time.
(talking to female superior)I've reached a conclusion.
(talking to female superior; "their" refers to the Yaki pirates)Yes, and I have located their HQ.
(talking to female superior; "they're" refers to the Yaki pirates)No, they're not organised.
(talking to female superior; option that takes the conversation one step back)On second thoughts... \(back\)

(Description, written by female pirate leader; "Obelisk" refers to "Obelisk Ikegami", 30225,105, a male pirate; "Shinamon" refers to "Haile Shinamon", 30225,101, a male friend; "amplifier" refers to 20102,2061)Pilot, I'm going to be blunt. The Yaki are at the brink of war, both internally and externally. When things inevitably turn sour, we need a backup plan to keep the Terran Protectorate at arm's length. You're let in on this operation because Shinamon vouches for you, because you have access to Terran space, and because we're simply out of options. I need you to continue Obelisk's assignment; to lay a trail, all the way to Earth. With that, the Xenon from this area of the Gate network will swarm Sol in the event that we are forced to activate the amplifier. We'll be rid of the machines for a while, and the Terrans will have their hands too full to continue attacking us. Think about it: two of the greatest threats to the Yaki, and the entire Gate network, tied up at the same time. Make your decision. We depend on you.
(Logfile variant 1)You have triggered a Xenon attack against Sol from the Xenon sectors surrounding the Yaki HQ.
(Logfile variant 2)The Yaki weren't able to activate their amplifier station in time.
("Kendai Orcanic" is a female pirate leader)Listen to Kendai Orcanic's proposition
("Haile" refers to "Haile Shinamon", 30225,101, a male friend)Intercept Haile before he reaches the Secret Service HQ
("Dal Busta" same as 30202,2)Listen to Dal Busta's proposition
Order the Xenon attack against Sol
(talking to female pirate leader)Rewards? Let's pick this up again later.
(talking to female pirate leader)Tell me about the amplifier.
(talking to female pirate leader)Trigger the attack.
(talking to female pirate leader; meaning "push the button")Yes. Punch it.
(talking to female pirate leader; option to decline)Let's not rush it.

(Description, written by Haile Shinamon, a male NPC; "Orcanic" refers to female NPC "Kendai Orcanic", 30225,106)They leave us no choice, really. As long as this amplifier station exists, it will always pose a threat to humanity, so we have to destroy it. I don't think they expect sabotage, but we'll have to be quick, so plan accordingly. Our only advantage is that apart from the hard-liners and our small group of conspirators, many Yaki seem to be pretty accepting of their fate right now, so we might not have to deal with the entire sector when everything goes nova.\n\nAfterwards? Well, I'm hoping that once we pull the rug out from under her feet, Orcanic will finally come to her senses. Maybe there's a path to reconciliation somewhere, but don't count on it.
(Logfile)With the amplifier station destroyed, the threat to Sol subsides.
(translate "conceal" as "to keep secret")Conceal the location of the Yaki HQ

(Description, written by Delilah Shiratori, the player's female superior)Operative, there appears to be a decommissioned warship waiting for you at the marked location. I suggest you see for yourself and put it to good use.
(Logfile)The decommissioned warship has been claimed or destroyed.

(Description; "Commander Lee" is a male NPC)Operative, thanks to your continued efforts and unwavering loyalty, a major new threat to the Sol system was successfully identified. I am pleased to inform you that Commander Lee has personally requested your assistance in the upcoming war of intervention. Periodically, the military resources of the inner sectors of Sol will be pooled to form a mighty invasion fleet. The location of the fleet's flagship will be continuously relayed to your navigation system, until the enemy has been completely obliterated, or the fleet is forced to retreat.
(Logfile variant 1)An attempt to gather a Terran invasion fleet against the Yaki failed because there were too few ships available in the core sectors.
(Logfile variant 2)A Terran invasion fleet was destroyed while attempting to reach the Yaki home base.
(Logfile variant 3)The Yaki have been defeated and the Terran invasion effort has come to an end.
(guidance to flagship)Current Location of Terran Commander

(Description, written by Kendai Orcanic, a female pirate leader)I don't know how to thank you. My people have pooled whatever little they have to reward you for your self-sacrifice. It isn't much, but maybe you'll find something you like.
(Logfile)You've collected what little the Yaki could afford to reward you with.

(Description, written by Delilah Shiratori, the player's female superior; "Commander Lee" is a male NPC)Operative, we've just received a message from Commander Lee. After the successful invasion, the Intervention Corps has given you the exclusive rights to pillage the battlefield as a reward for your crucial involvement. Well earned, I'd say.
(Logfile)You've collected the debris left behind by the Terran invasion of the Yaki home system.

(Description, written by Dal Busta, the player's male mentor)Hey there, partner! Ready to hear another one of my amazing ideas? I've determined that in their current position, all that's keeping the Yaki from peacefully spending credits like normal citizens of the Gate network is their tiny little Xenon problem in and around their home system. If you could just make sure that there's no Xenon presence left in the following systems, that would surely solve the problem and guide the Yaki towards a healthier lifestyle:
(Logfile variant 1)With their Xenon problem solved, the Yaki are now free to trade with their neighbours.
(Logfile variant 2)The Yaki lost all their stations before you could solve their Xenon problem.
Eliminate all Xenon in the specified systems
(talking to male friend; option that starts the conversation about this subject)Yaki Free Trade Project
(talking to male friend; option that accepts the mission)Let's do it.
(talking to male friend; option that delays the mission)Not yet.

page.title: Covert Operations Plot
page.t: (Briefing Description)Now that you have gained a foothold with the Terran Secret Service, your next objective is to study the political landscape of the Commonwealth. It is crucial for this endeavour's success that you establish a rapport with Dal Busta, an influential mediator currently working alongside the Hatikvah Free League. His expertise will be of great help in the coming operation, so recruiting him is a top priority.\n\nAt this point you should keep an eye out for any job listings pertaining to the Hatikvah Free League.
(Logbook Text)You managed to lay the foundation for a Terran covert operation. You should check in with the Terran Secret Service to get the ball rolling.

(Briefing Description)The Terran Secret Service has reached out and expressed their interest in hiring our services. Apparently, they think that my diplomatic prowess and your resourcefulness are well suited for a clandestine operation targeting foreign governments. They were careful not to divulge further information through any communications channels and requested you meet in person for the initial briefing.

(Briefing Description)You are to meet with an Antigone Republic government official who the Secret Service identified as a potential asset. Once we have established contact and confirmed his veracity, it is expected that you extract the otherwise unobtainable confidential information by paying off the asset. Before bribe and data can change hands, though, you will have to take some steps to prepare the data transfer.
(Logbook Text)You almost got caught trying to bribe an Antigone Memorial official for sensitive information on behalf of the Terran government.

(Briefing Description)Since Saman Red was less than forthcoming, we have to acquire the confidential information from somewhere else. The location of this somewhere else, in this case, is highly classified, so you will have to gain access to Argon Federation systems. To do that, you will need to get your hands on the following items:

 1. Bomb Launcher(see {20113,1031})
 2. Spacesuit EMP(see {20201,12301})
 3. Security Decryption System(see {20201,11301})

 Since they are illegal, Security Slicers can be difficult to obtain. They can occasionally be salvaged from destroyed ships, but your best bet is to craft one yourself. You can find the required resources in the Encyclopedia.

(Briefing Description)With the required equipment set aside, we can go about infiltrating the Argon Federation systems, specifically their internal workforce database. If you spoof a repair request, a maintenance ship will lead us right to our target. First, you will have to hack their repair terminal in the Security Office. Then, you need to breach their systems by creating a Signal Leak.\nThis operation takes you deep into enemy territory, so watch your back. You wouldn't want to get compromised now.
(Logbook Text)You managed to hack into Argon Federation systems to fabricate a repair request.

(Briefing Description)Since Saman Red was less than forthcoming, we will have to acquire the confidential information from elsewhere. The location of this 'elsewhere' is highly classified, and will require access to Argon Federation systems. To achieve that, you will need to get your hands on the following items:

 1. Bomb Launcher(see {20113,1031})
 2. Spacesuit EMP(see {20201,12301})
 3. Security Decryption System(see {20201,11301})

(Briefing Hint)Since they are illegal, Security Decryption Systems(see {20201,11301}) can be difficult to obtain. They can occasionally be salvaged from destroyed ships, but your best bet is to craft one yourself. You can find the list of required resources in the Encyclopedia.

(Briefing Description)With our repair request inserted into the system, it will only be a matter of minutes before the Argon have a crew on their way. This relay station is important to them, so they won't risk it going offline. To identify which station acts as a relay for the planetary archives, all you have to do is follow that ship, without getting noticed. If they think they are being trailed, they will abandon the assignment. This is going to be a balancing act. Get too close, and you tip them off. Stay back too far, and you are at risk of losing them. Once we know the station's location, you need to make your way inside the server room. Good luck.
(Logbook Text)You successfully located the Sandwell Archive's relay server room, but were denied access by the assiduous security forces.

(Briefing Description)As expected, access to the server room is strictly limited. Our agents are already working hard on orchestrating a diversion and getting you access to that room. While they do that, we want you to run operations that will weaken the Argon Federation's position.

(Briefing Description)Our analysts have identified the wares with which the Argon Federation is making a large portion of their profits. We want you to compete in their space, to push the price of these wares down. Make sure that you own a station in their space which can produce these wares; then we want you to adjust the selling price downward.
(Objective)Set the required price for the wares

(Briefing Description)For some time now, we have been dealing with some rather unsavoury characters outside the Sol system, with the explicit goal of applying pressure on the Argon Federation. Being a thorn in the Argon Federation's side, the Scale Plate Pact is being armed and partially financed by us. We want you to provide a fully supplied ship for them.
(Briefing Description)The Minotaur Sentinel can be ordered from the Antigone Republic wharf.
(Logbook Text)You pulled off two operations in Argon space on behalf of the Terran Secret Service, and in doing so, weakened the Federation.

(Briefing Description)Your hard work is about to pay off. This is what it has all been leading up to. Our scaly associates are about to stage an assault on the relay station. While they distract the security forces, you will infiltrate the server room and pull everything you can get your hands on out of those archives. This could be the heist of the century and, if you do your job right, no one will even know you pulled this off.
(Logbook Text)Under the cover of a raging pirate assault, you infiltrated the Antigone Republic station and managed to pull a vast amount of classified information off the Sandwell Archives.

(Briefing Description)OK, partner, we actually did it. Before you hand over the data you lifted from the server to the Terran Secret Service, I want to talk to you. Meet me at the HQ, and I will go over all of the options available to us going forward. I'd strongly suggest you think this through; we are walking on very thin ice.

(Briefing Description)We have to fill Saman Red in on the recent developments. If he informs the Argon Federation of what we were involved in, it will be more difficult for the Protectorate to meddle in Commonwealth affairs in the future. Best stay vigilant, though. I do not expect the Terran Protectorate to just let Saman do that.

(Briefing Description)You have decided to side with the Protectorate, after all. To bring an end to this whole affair, follow their instructions to hand over the intelligence. I expect they will want you to clean up any loose ends as well.

(Decision Description)You have in your possession documents containing some of the most valuable intel anyone could hope to gather. If applied properly, that information could help shape the future of the Commonwealth. In the wrong hands, this data could wreak havoc. Now, it is up to you to decide what path to choose.

(Decision Description)Handing over the intel to the Terran Protectorate will facilitate their goal of dividing their rival factions, the Argon Federation and the Antigone Republic. All trade between the two will cease; both factions will be in a much-weakened position and open to outside attacks. However, this wedge between them would also represent a lucrative business opportunity for anyone willing to exploit the situation.

(Decision Description)Exposing the Terran Protectorate's shady conduct involving the Antigone Republic and the Argon Federation will thwart their plan of sowing distrust between the governments. However, it would also constitute a breach of the peace treaty signed by these factions, and would prompt the Argon Federation into action. This choice will result in a war between the Terran Protectorate and the Argon Federation, and anyone looking to supply these warring factions with ships could make a handsome profit.

(Decision Description)If you do not want to upset the status quo, it would be best to destroy the evidence of Terran interference and assert to the Protectorate that you were not able to obtain anything useful. Sometimes, stability is preferable to chaos, if you want to make a steady profit.
(Logbook Text - Support Terran)You decided to hand the intel over to the Terran Secret Service and in doing so damaged relations between the Argon Federation and the Antigone Republic.
(Logbook Text - Support Argon)You decided to side with the Argon Federation and Antigone Republic and handed the intel over as evidence to Saman Red, who leaked the Terran involvement.
(Logbook Text - Neutral)You decided to back out of the operation and destroyed the evidence to maintain the status quo.
(Tooltip)Cessation of trade between ARG and ANT

(Description)Terran Secret Service analysts have identified a potential course of action to strengthen our position within the Gate network. Since you have been exceeding expectations so far, we want to involve you in this undertaking. Approach me about the "Covert Operations" if you want to find out what is required of you to become involved in the operation.

D. Shiratori,
Mission Command - Terran Secret Service

(Description)Subject: Potential Antigone Republic Individual Partnership

Appointment scheduled with Saman Red, head of the Antigone Republic Defence Department. Approach him about potential partnership with regard to company subcontracting. Areas of particular interest: Argon Federation Contracts, Defensive Capabilities, Data Infrastructure

Recommended compensation: 150.000Cr

Set up Advanced Satellite(see {20201,20401}) prior to the meeting to facilitate confidential data transfer.

D. Shiratori,
CFO Trundholm Industries - "Working Towards a Bright Future"

(Description)The Argon Federation's economy is buckling under the pressure of an increase in piracy activity. The frequent pirate attacks are disrupting trade routes and impeding the supply chain. A Federation spokesperson has stated that they are taking these recent developments very seriously, and that they will invest heavily in anti-piracy measures, despite being faced with an economic downturn. This announcement was met with growing criticisms and accusations of fund misappropriation by individual Federation members. It remains to be seen whether the Argon Federation can avert a crisis, or whether it may be in your best interests to short the Argon stock exchange. Yoyunis Tertasobas Zusilas IV - Economics Correspondent CBNN News
(Title)GalNet - Devastating Leak strains Argon Antigone Relations

(Description)In a historic development, classified Argon Federation documents have become widely available to the public. Off the record, a Federation official has commented that this leak of military records and financial information "constitutes a grave threat to the Federation's security."

The leaked data has also revealed outrageous Payroll information and records of mismanaged funds, which have caused unrest amongst Federation citizens. The Argon Federation has yet to comment on the leaked information directly.

While the Community of Planets is awaiting a statement on the contents of the leak, the Argon Federation has levelled a series of accusations at the Antigone Republic. The Republic is responsible for hosting large parts of the Argon Federation's data, and the Federation suspects that they were complicit in distributing the classified information.

The Antigone Republic vehemently denies any involvement in these events, but it is as yet unclear how exactly the information was obtained and distributed by a third party. One person who is suspected by the Argon to be involved is Saman Red, a Civil Servant working in the Antigone Republic Defence Department. His current whereabouts are unknown, and he is wanted by the Federation for questioning.

Due to a growing schism between the Argon Federation and the Antigone Republic, the Federation has recalled various government officials working in Republic space. All military collaboration between the two factions has been suspended, and it is still uncertain if it will resume in the foreseeable future. The Argon Federation has put sanctions in place to prohibit all trade with Antigone until the Republic recognises that it is at fault, and pays reparations for the damage the Federation alleges has been caused.

Eron Alba
- Foreign Affairs Correspondent GalNet
(Title)GalNet - Revelation puts Argon Federation at Odds with the Terran Protectorate

(Description)The persistent tensions between the Argon Federation and the Terran Protectorate have erupted into armed conflict after a renowned Antigone Republic official shared his findings concerning ongoing Terran Operations. The Terran Secret Service has reportedly been involved in several operations, undertaken with the express intent of weakening the Argon Federation and isolating it from its allies.

Among the most grave accusations are that, acting on their orders, an unnamed agent infiltrated an Antigone Republic station under the cover of a pirate attack, to obtain classified information from Argon Federation servers. To cover their tracks, the Terran Protectorate then also reportedly sanctioned the assassination of an Antigone Republic official on foreign ground.

Historically, relations between the Argon Federation and the Terran government have been tense and marred by distrust, but this development comes as a shock to the Commonwealth. When the Sol system reconnected with the Gate network, the Terran government sought to enter into a dialogue with the other inhabitants of the network. While not everyone trusted the newly formed Protectorate and its intrusive methods, it was generally understood that the Xenon were a threat that demanded immediate attention.

The Argon Federation is treating the Terran Protectorate's behaviour as a breach of the non-aggression treaty signed by both sides. The Argon Federation has regarded these hostile acts as a "casus belli", and are currently mobilising their fleets to protect their borders. Their allies, the Antigone Republic, have ceased all trade with the Protectorate.

It appears that the Terran Protectorate was not trying to incite a war, only to weaken their rival's power through clandestine actions. Now, with all of the animosity out in the open, one can only wonder who actually stands to gain from this.

Eron Alba
- Foreign Affairs Correspondent GalNet
(Title)GalNet - Major Scale Plate Pact Pirate Attack leaves Antigone Republic puzzled

(Description)According to our sources, the Antigone Republic has just fallen victim to the largest Scale Plate Pact Pirate attack on record. The pirates' approach was not spotted, due to their use of illegal cover technology, until they had surrounded the station. They demanded that the station surrender and allow them access, before opening fire when the station refused to submit to their demands. Their approach lead Antigone Republic Officials to speculate that this was a coordinated, premeditated attack. However, this attack, and the pirates' seeming lack of a clear intent, in contrast to the sheer force the assault was executed with, has left many security experts confused. For what appeared to be such a well-coordinated attack, it seemed short-sighted.

The Antigone Republic called in Argon reinforcements, which arrived swiftly to combat the pirate fleet. Jointly, Argon and Antigone forces were able to fight the marauders off. This event has once again proved the benefits of a military cooperation between the two governments and, in light of a worrying increase of piracy in both realms, calls for an ever-closer alliance are becoming more frequent.

Still, questions remain. While the intent behind the attack is shrouded in mystery, it is not a huge leap of the imagination to suspect this attack of being part of a larger, but as yet unseen, picture.

Eron Alba
- Foreign Affairs Correspondent GalNet
(Title)Reminder: Scheduled Meeting with Terran Secret Services

(Description)Your presence is requested for a briefing at the Special Operations Command Centre. We want to talk to you about the next steps in our joint operation. If you are interested in helping us shape the political climate of the Commonwealth and engaging in political outreach programmes on our behalf, join the conference at the Secret Service Bureau offices.

D. Shiratori,
Mission Command - Terran Secret Service
(Player Choice)What can we do about it?
(Player Choice)I trade wares all over the universe.
(Player Choice)Mutual associates set up a meeting.

page.title: HQ Warping
page.descr: Texts for the research mission to teleport the HQ
page.t: I must speak with you regarding an experiment I have devised. Please come and see me as soon as you can, so that I can explain it in detail.

This experiment is designed to apply what we have learnt so far through our research, as well as what was observed during the events that brought this station to this location.\n\nMy ultimate goal is to relocate this facility, in an instant, to any sector that we wish. However, this particular experiment will be limited to this current sector: $SECTOR$
You wanted to speak about something?
(tooltip)There is an active terraforming project in this cluster.

page.title: Improve Station Defences
page.t: After a recent review, our station defences have come under much criticism, especially given our proximity to such dangerous sectors. We have hired a specialist to help improve our existing defences as well as coordinate the deployment of new ones. We're looking for an experienced freelancer to join our team and aid the specialist in their tasks.

As you probably know, I have been hired to lead the overhaul of defences at a local station. Over the years I have worked on a great many engineering projects; from destroyers to wharfs, carriers to torpedos, I've seen it all! This should be a nice change of pace, assuming we don't get a Xenon fleet making a bee-line for us. Follow my lead and we'll turn this waste of hull plating into a fortified base in no time.

I don't think the manager of this station knows a spacefly from a warhead. It took me two minutes to boost the power grid in this lab by 30%. That's even 20% over the 'safety-limit', but I made it stick. Before I can even get started on the weapons, I see all sorts of improvements to be made but I'll need materials. Don't worry, I'll be sure to mark this all down in the invoice so we get reimbursed.

Outrageous! The manager of this station accuses us of blowing the budget on 'trivial and dangerous tweaks'. I got so angry that I've practically lost my voice! So, this is what we're going to do. I'm going to play their game and straighten out their turret barrels, while you go out and deploy a number of defensive laser towers, the cheap kind. We'll leave this place better than we found it, split the remaining funds and move on.
I'd say that's a job well done. Now, let's get out of here and get on with our lives. Best make it quick.

(ma specialist)Thank you for your honesty in this matter. This 'specialist' has been under investigation for some time and we drew the short straw on having him mess with our station. Thankfully, it seems to have paid off and he is now in custody. Rest assured, we would have intervened should you be coerced into doing something illegal. For now, take this as thanks.

(fe specialist)Thank you for your honesty in this matter. This 'specialist' has been under investigation for some time and we drew the short straw on having her mess with our station. Thankfully, it seems to have paid off and she is now in custody. Rest assured, we would have intervened should you be coerced into doing something illegal. For now, take this as thanks.
I'd call that a job well done. I've sent you the first payment but the remaining amount will have to wait until the transfer from the station is complete. I'll be in touch.

(ma specialist)Hello captain. I represent the station which was in need of defence improvements, some time ago. As you may have gathered, the specialist we hired was not as capable as he led on and has since been arrested on multiple counts including racketeering and reckless endangerment. Thankfully, no one was hurt and we can put the matter to rest.\nThe investigation has also cleared you of any wrongdoing, so we see fit to reimburse you with the originally agreed payment.

(fe specialist)Hello captain. I represent the station which was in need of defence improvements, some time ago. As you may have gathered, the specialist we hired was not as capable as he led on and has since been arrested on multiple counts including racketeering and reckless endangerment. Thankfully, no one was hurt and we can put the matter to rest.\nThe investigation has also cleared you of any wrongdoing, so we see fit to reimburse you with the originally agreed payment.

page.title: Assisted Task
page.t: This ship does not meet the specified requirements:

The readings on these crystals are off the charts! Everything is now ready for the big experiment. Remember, we need a ship with mining capabilities and an ample supply of resource probes to identify a dense deposit of high-quality Nividium. While you log the exact spot with a probe and collect a few asteroid chunks, I will let my instruments get to work.

I hereby declare this experiment a great success! I have already collected a sample of the Nividium deposit for further studies, so feel free to gather as much as you like for your own purposes. Now, let us return to my lab so I can fetch your reward.
With your assistance, the scientific community has gained valuable insights into the nature and application of Nividium. A share of the project funding has been transferred to your account.

I am looking for a qualified research assistant with a mining rig to accompany me while I perform my next experiment. If this sounds like your line of work, I have one specific request to get things started. Could you deliver the following assortment of crystals to me for preliminary analysis? You should be able to find them growing on asteroids in this sector.

As part of our outreach and acquisitions programme, we are now offering a unique training opportunity to aspiring prospectors, all expenses included. Our finest professionals have been tasked with sharing their many years of experience with all applicants. To apply, simply dock your mining rig at this refinery and speak to your assigned staff member.
Excellent work! Now, let us return to the refinery to conclude your training.
Dear participant, thank you for attending our introductory course! As a parting gift, we are providing you with an allowance to kickstart your very own mining operation.

Freelance scientist looking for pilot. Must be able and discreet. Job is to find, scan and break up a dense Silicon asteroid somewhere in this sector. Cannot leave post to make preparations. Bring own mining ship and probes.
Well, this did not quite yield the results I was hoping for. There is no need to worry though; you will still receive the reward we agreed upon, as long as you keep quiet about today's job.
If you carry on like this, you will do well for yourself. Here is a little something to tide you over.

With levels of public concern about nutrition constantly rising, it was only a matter of time before our enterprise came under a tidal wave of scrutiny. To calm this torrent of accusations, we plan to conduct a semi-independent survey of local ice deposits. Any pilot willing to help us stay afloat is hereby invited to dock at the specified ice refinery and notify our water purification specialist.

That settles it; my instruments show no untenable accumulation of radioactive waste in the ice! Please return me to my post at the refinery and feel free to sell this excellent batch of clean ice to the local trade agent.
With your help, this company's good name has been cleared once more. Please accept the attached reward as a token of thanks.

The Teladi Trade Guild is where some of the network's most promising individuals gather in one place with the aim of one day achieving the very greatest of profits. One of these individuals was scheduled to lead a hands-on seminar on mineral prospecting but is currently indisposed, and we would be pleased if you could step in.
Thank you for showing me the ropes, but this never-ending stream of mandatory courses is starting to get on my nerves. Please take me back so I can continue with my own studies.

The Teladi Trade Guild is not inclined to waste valuable time and resources on the research of technology that is already common knowledge elsewhere in the network. One of our competitors, about whom you will certainly have heard, has recently demonstrated an increase in mineral-gathering efficiency, and we are very interested in learning the details. While you find and gather some of the specified resources, one of our scientists will analyse the distinct markings that our competitor's instruments might have left on the asteroids.
Excellent work, but I am afraid that any further analysis will have to wait until we are back at the Guild. Let us leave this place as quickly as possible.

The success of any primary industry rises and falls with its connection to ample resource deposits. It is our continued duty to provide such burgeoning enterprises with the knowledge needed to improve their prospecting efficiency. As chance would have it, you agreed to a mandatory, periodical skill check by subscribing to our job market; much like every other entry level member of the Antigone Trade Guild. You will of course be accompanied by one of our esteemed supervisors, who will record your performance.
Most satisfactory. My superiors will be overjoyed to study the recording of your flawless performance. Let us return to the Guild offices posthaste.

As one of the most prestigious and envied enterprises in the network, it suits us to always be well-informed about our competitors' supply situation. The board of advisors has selected you to take part in a large-scale prospecting initiative, during which you will be accompanied by one of our economic reconnaissance specialists. Please find details of your task below.
Great work. Now let us return to the Guild offices. Once I have evaluated the intel, we will certainly gain an edge over our competitor!

Our Guild is still establishing itself on the markets, and many of our members, coming from a scientific background, are inexperienced in how to trade or turn a proper profit. One of our members was scheduled to lead a basic seminar on mineral prospecting, but something came up. Can you fill in?
Much appreciated. I still have some way to go, but I am starting to get the hang of things. Can you please take me back to the station?

Being a newly formed Guild puts us at a disadvantage in a lot of areas, but it can also be an opportunity. Before we commit to developing and producing mining technology, we have the luxury of analysing our competition's mining instruments, to see what works and what we can improve on. So, find and gather some of the specified resources, and one of our scientists will accompany you and analyse the distinct markings that were left by the competition to extrapolate what tech might have been used on the asteroids.

Great work. I have already noted down a few interesting things, but further analysis will have to wait until I have returned to the Guild offices. Once the findings are properly evaluated, we will surely be able to keep up with the competition!

page.title: Retrieve Dead Drop
page.t: The destination does not support docking for ships of size L and greater.
The destination does not support docking for ships of size M and greater.
(Tooltip Collect the items before trying to deliver them){30135,105}
(ma)(before accepting)Greetings, pilots.\nI am tasked with the inspection of one of our military assets. To carry out my task I need transport for a round trip.

(ma)(after accepting){30232,2002}\n\nThis inspection is supposed to look like standard procedure, but we are there to investigate an incident. Our inside source placed a case with vital information on the asset's docking bay. After you have taken me there, pick it up and report back to me immediately. We need to keep this to ourselves, so once you have secured the package just mention the HQ to me to let me know.
(Logbook)Internal Affairs thanks you for your cooperation and discretion during our military inspection.
Greetings, you updated the mission briefing?
(deliver item)I have a message from HQ.
(ma)(before accepting)In order to conduct my investigation I need a transport to a couple of destinations.

(ma)(after accepting)The key witness we are flying to will not be able to come forward openly, but has placed the required evidence in a case on the docking bay. As soon as you pick it up, get right back to me. Be discreet. They are not supposed to know what we are up to. Afterwards I'll need another transport.
(Logbook) My client asked me to thank you for your contribution.
Greetings, you updated the mission briefing?
(ma)(before accepting)Greetings, pilots.\nIn order to make some regulatory inspections, I need a transport.

(ma)(after accepting)We have reason to believe that the local authority has violated regulations and covered it up. A whistleblower on the inside promised us data to prove the veracity of these accusations. You will need to find a case that has been deposited at their docking bay and deliver it to my contact. I will keep you updated on the specifics as we go.
(Logbook)My client asked me to thank you for your contribution.
Greetings, you updated the mission briefing?

(ma)(Briefing before accepting)A guild member is suspected of having broken various contracts. To clear these suspicions I am scheduled to have a brief meeting on the company's trading ship and check the ship's manifest. I need transport to the trading ship and back afterwards.

(ma)(Briefing after accepting){30232,10102}\n\nThe trader in question will deny these accusations and has probably manipulated the ship's manifest to hide all proof, but I am not known to waste my time on pointless formalities. I have a source on the inside who can provide the proof I am after. I want you to not only be my chauffeur, but also to retrieve a package from the trading ship's docking bay while we are there.

(Logbook)Hello captain. You helped me get the proof I needed to verify the broken contracts and punish the perpetrator. In the name of the Trade Guild and all righteous traders I thank you for your cooperation.
(Show Mission Briefing Update)Greetings, Guild Member. There is a mission update?
(Ready to depart)Understood. I'm ready to depart.
(Handover Package)I have something for you.(Usually: Deliver: $AMOUNT$x $WARE$ from {1002,3000409})

page.title: Bring Research Items
page.t: Processing Panel Units are dropped from Xenon ships.

(Description)Oh hey, you!
You look like someone resourceful, would you mind helping me out? Until recently, I was employed as head of Research and Development at Jinko-Tekina Technologies, the industry-leading ship manufacturing company. While working on their ship designs, in my free time and using company resources, I also pioneered a new kind of experimental on-board computer: a sentient machine, able not only to interpret information, but also to predict it, and to learn. A computer able to feel empathy and appreciate arts, to be self-aware and sapient.
Think of the effects such a computer, with a personality, could have on the crew, too. No more need for dangerous missions to be manned. Lone pilots would have someone they could talk to on those long delivery runs... It would have changed everything. But alas, my superiors grew restless when progress temporarily stalled on my other projects, and things escalated when they became aware of what I was pursuing. They didn't believe I could actually pull it off, but still, they didn't want their brand to be associated with A.I. Research, and some board members even became scared, and voiced ethical concerns. How very narrow-minded of them. I was this close to success, but they fired me, and in doing so cut off all of my funding.
However, I was able to smuggle out most of my research and various company resources with me when I left. Now, stranded on this wharf, I intend to finish what I started, and change the universe forever, for the better.
I just need some technical parts to finish my work, but I can't acquire them myself for fear of leaving my project unguarded. They are fairly common processing units, you should be able to find them attached to... well, Xenon ships. If you bring me what I need, not only will I pay you for your work, but you'll be remembered in history as the person who made it all happen!

(Description)So... it didn't work out the way I had hoped it would. The moment I slotted the panel in and activated the computer, everything shut down, and the processing unit started to go up in flames. If I didn't know better, I would say you brought me shoddy parts.\nBut I am not saying that, because I trust you implicitly, friend! You are integral to this undertaking, and you have proved your worth. I must have merely got a few wires crossed. It's not a big deal, only a minor setback. When this work is finished we will look back on this and laugh - and the machine will laugh with us. Will laugh the loudest, in fact!\nI will not give up now! I have come so far, and the work we're doing here is important. Unfortunately, it will take some effort to overhaul the design and fix the damage. You wouldn't mind getting me some more parts? I will make it worth your while!

(Description)It is good to see you again! The parts you supplied me with were exactly what I needed. The computer is operational! I was able to boot it up and talk to it! A sentient machine, developed by me, Corin King! And all thanks to your help! Oh, if only my former colleagues could see me now. When they found out about what I was working on they were so full of doubt - "No way will you be able to do alone what legions of scientists took thousands of years to succeed", they said. "We don't even know if you are naïve or delusional", they said. Pah, naysayers!\nWell, anyway, I am afraid after about a minute the entire system shut down, and now it is completely unresponsive. I think I need to do some readjustments. If you could get me these parts I need, I could get the computer back up again, and then I will show them all!

(Description)I don't know what happened, friend.
I went over my calculations over and over again. I already got it to work before... I... Thank you for helping me out in the past, but I think I'm done. I was so close to actually achieving something great here. I could feel it in my bones, you know... But now this?
All I ever wanted was to matter, to change things for the better. It would have been a glorious breakthrough, wouldn't it? Oh, I was naive, wasn't I? How can you even leave a mark in history, when the universe is so vast, and each one of us so tiny in this endless space...
Endless? Yes, that is it, friend! The universe is endless, and so are the possibilities of success! And so what does it matter if I am tiny in the greater scheme of things? No one would care, or even notice, if I failed. And if I don't fail - if I succeed, against all odds - I will have done my part to improve things. I cannot lose my drive now, I need to continue my research. I am so close I can almost taste that sweet, metallic taste of success. Please, help me out... Bring me the processing pieces that I need to finish my work.

(Description)This work sure does feel like a slog sometimes. One minute you think you are done, and the next it seems like you will never ever make it all work. And if it seems overwhelming, if you look at the work that lies ahead, and you ask yourself, "How will I ever finish this?" well, then you just have to focus on what is literally right in front of you. In this specific case, it is a piece of the machine that is in desperate need of some new processing parts. Could you help me out here, friend?

(Description)The last batch of experiments were a failure. A disastrous one, in fact. But if I only get past this hurdle, I am confident that I can make this whole "sentient machine" business work. I already came this far, right? Listen, it is not a secret that my success rate leaves something to be desired, so I really appreciate your trust in my abilities, and your support in general. Speaking of which, I have this list of units I need you to get for me. I am confident that with these I will make some real progress!

(Description)I spotted some shady-looking people snooping around the docks. I suspect my previous employer probably sent them. They must have realised I took some things from them when I left. Things that are not easily replaced. Luckily I hide my work well, so that no one can just take it away from me. Oh, what a set-back that would have been, right, friend?\nSpeaking of set-backs, I am afraid I have reached some kind of impasse in my research. The avenues I am investigating now seem promising, but I cannot continue without more processing parts. Would you mind helping me out?

(Description)Hello friend,\nI am afraid my previous trial run failed spectacularly. Not only did the computer not do what it was supposed to, but the electric charge, which resulted from me booting up the sentient computer, fried several processing units. I don't know why that happened. I checked my calculations so many times before activating the machine... It really should have worked. Could you help me replace the broken hardware while I go over these equations again? Here is the list of parts I need.
Consciousness-expanding substances are dropped by lockboxes and enemy ships.

(Description, addressing player, "network" refers to "the Jump Gate network")Do you consider yourself a connoisseur of art, an admirer of beauty in things both corporeal and intangible? Then hear my plight, and let it rouse you to decisive action! In the life of a true network-class artist like myself, there is never a day without work, never a moment without fanning the flames, or the font of inspiration is sure to run dry. During the years of unburdened youth, I drank freely from this well, and my creative urges seemed inexhaustible. This last handful of years, however, has shown me the fragility of the symbiosis between that primitive construct we call the body, and my exuberant mind. I now realise that my self depended on... liberating accessories, to put the corpus at rest and bask in the limitless latitude of my artistic psyche. Now, if this tale has not opened the floodgates of compassion in one such as you, then do not bother reading further, for you are lost! Lost, I say! Anyone else, I beseech you to come to my aid, and quickly! There isn't a single second to lose, if we intend my next work of art to be anything but a true masterpiece, like its countless cousins that came before!

(Description, addressing player)Ooooooooh, these... thingies you brought me last time really did the job, buddy! Great stuff, great stuff, great stuff, yeah, what did I want to ask you again? Oh, that's right, I can't hold my hands right. Hold things with my hand-thingies right, that is. But my brain, oh buddy, my brain has gone in all directions. Like, at the same time. I'm feeling so expanded, you won't even believe. But my hands... buddy, that got me thinking. You know, maybe there's such a thing as balloons. Balance, I mean, but not right here, because it's over there, somewhere. No, waaaaay over there. Because I don't have it right now, not even a little bit. Anyway, go get it for me. More of these thingies, that is, and I swear I won't use them all at once next time. Deal? Deal.

(Description, addressing player)Aha, this is it! A few adjustments to my dispenser, and I remain in full control of my senses and motor abilities while still reaping the benefits of heightened cranial stimulation! My thoughts move so quickly, I can hardly grasp them. But when I do, oh, when I do, every single one of them has the potential to become another masterpiece in its own right! Like this one, for example, no wait... that one! No, I lost it again. Dearest assistant, I fear that my current predicament is robbing me of my ability to calmly assess, contemplate and consider, like a true artist should! This free flow of epiphanies gives me a thousand beginnings for my next masterpiece, but obscures my intuition for a proper end! And as we know, the end justifies the means, so go! Fetch me more of these substances. At least the consumption rate has stabilised, so I will attempt to make the most of what I still have at my disposal.

(Description, addressing player, "Arthur" is the speaker's name, referring to {30233,10002})Marvellous, brilliant, superbly spectacular! A true masterpiece, I say! My masterpiece, they will say, but in this moment we share together, both of us know that artistic genius is merely one side of the proverbial credit-token. My friend, when I departed on this journey of perfection, I hid a sprouting fear; the fear that once the machinery I had concocted was set into motion, I may be unable to make it stop. But this never-ending sprint of actualisation... it fulfils me, it truly does.
