The main story in the Facility has concluded. You can keep playing missions and interact with the inhabitants of the Facility, or continue into the Open Universe, where you can find out how the events of Timelines have affected the present day Jump Gate network.
(Hub story guidance)Show Sae the hideout you found while exploring
(Hub story guidance)Collect all materials required to assemble the hacking tool
Any news on the escape plans?

page.title: Timelines Sandbox Epilogue
page.descr: Timelines sandbox epilogue texts
page.t:
(Mission Description, written from Boso's perspective)Assistant!

There is so much we do not yet know about this marvellous, mysterious installation we cohabit. And further more, there is so much we do not yet know about the ever-expanding Jump Gate network. I was able to pick up some readings that seem to indicate that perhaps the network has grown again. Even more interestingly, I am picking up signals that seem to be related to our HQ somehow.

Please, do come and see me. We must talk about these findings in person!
(Objective Text)Investigate the strange signals coming from beyond Ianamus Zura IV(Ianamus Zura IV same as {20004,150011})

(Mission Description, written from an ambiguous perspective)Clearly this system's inhabitants are a peculiar and previously unknown people. There is no mention of them in any accessible Commonwealth records, yet they seem to have access to ships and technology developed that has only been made available in recent years.\n\nAll of this is highly unusual, and must be investigated further!
(Mission Title)A Different Way of Doing Things
(Mission Reward)A deeper understanding of a new culture

(Mission Description, written from Gantelios' perspective)Here in Mitsuno's Remembrance(Mitsuno's Remembrance same as{20003,7010001}), we do things somewhat differently. For most of our day-to-day trading we rely on good-faith lending, and more importantly, bartering. If you are interested, perhaps you can participate in our customs. We need to see how well we can integrate our system with the way other inhabitants of this network are doing things.

(Mission Description, written from Kal t'Ktt's perspective)Split need urgent help! Eager to explore network, Split got trapped in mine field with racing ship. Worse, incident threatens to sour relations between Quettanauts and Ministry of Finance. And even before relations formally established!\n\nIf you help Split out, Split promise Quettanauts will be eternally grateful! Perhaps Split can even be persuaded to part with sweet ride?
(Mission Reward)Receiving the recognition of the Quettanauts

(Mission Description, written from Gantelios' perspective)You have helped us out a lot now. The Grandmother, who you could say is the closest thing we have to a leader, would like to meet you in person. I know you have questions, and perhaps she will be able to answer some of the more pressing ones for you.
(Mission Title)I Like What You've Done with the Place

(Mission Description, written from Kaori's perspective)What's up, stranger?

I have been searching the universe for accessible Sohnen technology for the longest time! Now that you have brought this mysterious Boron-led installation to my attention, I would appreciate it if you could introduce me to your scientific friend. You wouldn't mind, right? You being his assistant and all...

I imagine a meeting could prove highly productive for both parties! What do you say?

(Mission Description, written from Boso's perspective)Assistant!\n\nThat is such a fascinating vessel you have found there! I could not help but notice that some of the readings I am receiving from it share a remarkable resemblance to tech that I have been working with on this very installation... This discovery is as fascinating as it is puzzling. Please, do come and see me at your earliest convenience!
Boso Ta did. He's... a scientist.
What do you think about the Sohnen?
The signals were sent by Kaori Chen.
I'm looking for a signal source.
This could mean new trade opportunities.

page.title: Kaori Recruitment
page.descr: Text for the Kaori Recruitment mission
page.t: (Scenario Title, needs to be descriptive for functionality reasons)The Recruitment Mission

(Scenario Description)During local chrono concept [CE 2042], a sentient of species "Human" [{30600,1401}], Terran descent, identified as "Kaori Chen", is detained within a medsec facility orbiting the fifth body, due to a minor jurisdiction infraction. An unforeseen sequence of exogenous events has escalated the specimen's probability of termination.

Preservation of this sentient specimen is imperative, as dictated by currently immutable coherence trajectories. Immediate action is mandated; coercive measures are to be eschewed to prevent further timeline-vector decoherence.

The embodied sentient will be materialised aboard the medsec facility; it is tasked with strategically persuading the target specimen to pre-emptively vacate the detention area. Physical force must be avoided. Failure to comply will result in a high likelihood of unfavourable timeline developments.
(Scenario Objective Text)Convince Kaori to come with you
(Scenario gameplay summary)Persuade the prospective recruit Kaori Chen to join the Facility.
(Scoring Description)The more convincing your arguments, the higher you will score.
(Stat Description)An abstraction of how convinced Kaori was by your efforts to persuade her.
(Stat Name)Failed to convince Kaori in time
(Stat Description)If you failed to convince Kaori to come with you before the impedance bubble collapsed, the score is set to 0.
Come with me if you want to live.

page.title: Diplomacy Feature Introduction
page.descr: Text for the Diplomacy Feature Introduction
page.t: (Mission Description)As your relations with various factions improve, you can invite diplomats to your Headquarters. They serve as liaisons and can do anything that you would otherwise need to visit the faction rep for, including selling blueprints and conducting promotion ceremonies. To invite such a diplomat, you need to visit a friendly Faction Representative.

(Mission Description)Dal has reached out to let you know that you can hire diplomatic agents. You will be able to send them on missions to further your own ends, either through diplomacy or espionage.\n\nHireable agents are often found on Infrastructure Stations. Usually, you will have to seek out agents on your own, but this time, Dal was able to make contact directly, and send you all the relevant information.
(Custom Action)Wait for the Agent Action to complete

page.title: Terraforming Missions
page.t: Will this make me mo...(cut off before saying "money")
What's the return on inv...(cut off before saying "investment")

(Email Text)Assistant!

I thought you would like to know that, with our terraforming efforts successfully completed, life is now thriving on the planet surface! There is undoubtedly plenty of work left to do for everyone on-site, but I suggest you take a moment to appreciate how far you have come in the pursuit of shaping and changing our universe for the better. To this end, I have attached a brief broadcast which was produced to celebrate your achievements. Outstanding work!

Boso Ta

page.title: Terraforming Missions Tharka's Cascade
page.t: The Terraformers began work on this planet before they changed into the Xenon we know today. Instead of abandoning the world, they seem to be stuck in a cycle, maintaining everything in a state that's ideal for human habitation. Except they instantly kill anyone who tries to go there.\nIf we were able to access the AGI cores, we might just get a chance to take this planet fully intact. Or we simply carpet bomb the whole thing and rebuild from scratch.

page.title: Terraforming Missions Scale Plate Green
page.t: After the Xenon overran Scale Plate Green and devastated the planet, the few survivors struggled to make a living and eventually joined up with criminals out of desperation, turning to a life of crime and forming what is now called the Scale Plate Pact. Many of them would choose to return home, were they able to do so in peace.

page.title: Terraforming Missions Getsu Fune
page.t: Several problems, not obvious to the casual observer, make habitation on this planet difficult. Nonetheless, it's an attractive prospect for citizens of the Antigone Republic, and they would surely be very grateful if someone were to take care of the aforementioned difficulties for them.
(Mission reward)Antigone Republic moves in, stops expanding

page.title: Terraforming Missions Frontier Edge
page.t: This beautiful planet is already almost perfect for life as we know it. The biggest problem isn't actually planetside, but in space: the nearby Xenon are a constant threat and have thus far been an effective deterrent to any kind of settlement effort. Perhaps someone with enough military clout to throw around could convince the Antigone Senate to greenlight immigration as soon as infrastructure exists.
(Mission reward)Antigone Republic moves in, stops expanding

page.title: Terraforming Missions Atiya's Misfortune
page.t: Atiya's Misfortune e. This planet is absolutely perfect for settling down on if you like hourly earthquakes, not breathing and being on fire. \(Don't worry, it's a dry heat.\) The heavy Xenon presence in space is just the cherry on top.\nWhy would you even try to make this a liveable world when there is so much lower hanging fruit out there? Well, I could quote several inspirational quotes at you, but in the end it boils down to this: you would become legendary. A hero in your own lifetime, and well beyond.
(Mission reward)Antigone Republic moves in, stops expanding

page.title: Terraforming Missions Black Hole Sun
page.t: Black Hole Sun is an exclave of the Argon Federation, separated from the core systems by the Antigone Republic. The Argon Federation is working hard to show that they support all of their colonies, especially remote ones like this one. As a symbol of this, they want to make this system more stable by enabling planetside habitation.

Dear Sir/Madam,\nIt has come to our attention that a clerk at this institution has contacted you, unsolicited and without the proper paperwork. Rest assured that we are conducting a thorough internal investigation and will apply proper disciplinary action. We hope that you did not experience any undue distress as a result of this and remain at your service,\nIIA HR

Hey. I don't know if you remember me. I sent you a message about how awesome you're being by literally creating new habitable worlds? Turns out that was "improper behaviour" so I got demoted and disciplined. Anyway, long story short, I decided to give the private sector a try. I'm on that station of yours with the cool rock in the middle. Just give me a job where I can enable more awesomeness, all right?

page.title: Terraforming Missions Eighteen Billion
page.t: Contrary to official statements by the Teladi Company, the name of the system refers to a historical and, to them, very embarrassing charitable donation by one Isemados Sibasomos Nopileos IV. Some Teladi still hold her idealistic motives dear, though, and try to live by her example.\nThey are currently looking to enlist a like-minded, charitable person to establish affordable living conditions on the planet. They can't offer much in the way of payment, but is a good deed not its own reward?
(Mission reward)A warm and fuzzy feeling deep inside

page.title: Terraforming Missions Memory of Profit
page.t: This former economic powerhouse is under-performing. Data suggests that nostalgia can increase profits by up to seven percent, so the board has approved a bounty on reinvigorating the local economy. The reward is exclusive rights to supply local workshops with precious metal.

page.title: Terraforming Missions Ocean of Fantasy
page.t: Decades ago, this formerly lush planet was devastated during the test firing of an experimental Xenon weapon. It will be hugely expensive and require enormous effort, but we have a plan that will restore this world to its former beauty.
(Mission reward)A unique blueprint for a Welfare Module(Welfare Module singular of {1001,9620})

page.title: President's End Scenario 1
page.descr: Text for President's End scenario 1
page.t:
During local chrono concept [NT 742], an unprecedented assault is initiated within the sector designated "President's End", dominated by the species catalogued as "Human" [{30600,1401}], Argon descent. The aggressors, a hive-sentient species catalogued as "Kha'ak" [{30600,1406}], present a substantial threat to the sector's inhabitants and infrastructure.

This anomalous event sequence requires an immediate and comprehensive re-evaluation of the highly irrational behavioural patterns of the involved biologicals, to ensure continuation of predictive coherence within the constraints of observed ground truth.

The embodied sentient is tasked with orchestrating a strategic withdrawal, postponing the demise of its crew and local population, while simultaneously gathering essential data on the assailants. While survival of the sentient is unlikely, their actions to disseminate knowledge will have profound impacts. Failure to execute this reconnaissance will result in substantial informational disadvantages, critically diminishing the survivability of future engagements with species [{30600,1406}].
(Scenario gameplay summary)After waking up injured amidst a battle, salvage resources from the wreckage of destroyed ships to protect yourself and your remaining crewmates. Survival is not expected.
Your construction vessel has been attacked by an unknown enemy, and the crew has been forced to make a daring escape.
(Hints)Open the map \($INPUT_ACTION_OPEN_MAP$\) to review the transmitted sector data.
GOAL["Stave off inevitable demise to perform futile acts of reconnaissance"]
Move fast and scour the sector for survivors, or any information which can be used against your new foe.
$NUMBER$ points per enemy.(NUMBER is more than 1)
$NUMBER$ points per black box safely recovered.(NUMBER is more than 1)
Number of data packets successfully sent \(scored on percentage of data found and transmitted\).
Found an abandoned ship to help you.

page.title: Historical - Save Earth
page.descr: Text for Historical - Save Earth scenario
page.t: 1 point per $AMOUNT$ people. An estimated $DEATHSPERSEC$ people are killed by the Terraformers every second until the fleet has regrouped.

(Scenario description)A shoal of autogenic pre-sentients has launched unsanctioned incursions into the ancestral system of a species catalogued as "Human" [{30600,1401}]. Commencing on local chrono concept [CE 2145-01-02], the hostilities escalated to include targeted kinetic impacts on body three, resulting in mass casualties and systemic infrastructural collapse.

This event sequence diverges from established projections and has been classified as an anomaly. An immediate and comprehensive re-evaluation of the behavioural patterns of involved biologicals under existential duress is mandated to restore predictive coherence with ground truth.

The embodied sentient, species "Human", Terran descent, identified as "Nathan Ridley Gunne", fights against the incoming fleet aboard a combat vessel. Upon return to his command ship, identified as "USC Dragonfyre", Gunne regroups Earth's battered fleet remnants. Aiming to neutralise the threat through strategic deterrence rather than combat engagement, Gunne will explore any clue that may lead to operational success, as mission failure would result in the elimination of his species.
(Scenario gameplay summary)Combat a swarm of hostiles aboard a fighter spacecraft. Upon returning to your command vessel, aid and regroup the remnants of your scattered fleet.

page.title: Xenon M0 Battle Scenario
page.descr: Text for the Xenon M0 battle scenario
page.t: (Scenario Title; trial as in challenge, adversity)Brennan's Trial

(Scenario Description)Following the catastrophic malfunction of its vessel's Jump Drive during local chrono concept [CE 2912] respectively [NT 742], resulting in unintended stranding, a sentient of species "Human" [{30600,1401}], Terran descent, identified as "Captain Kyle William Brennan", is compelled to assist local co-sentients in their conflict with the autogenic pre-sentients designated "Xenon" [{30600,1407}].

While this event sequence itself is not directly endangered by immutable timeline-vector decoherence, its pivotal nature significantly modulates the assembly latent. Enhanced exploration is mandated to deepen understanding of spacetime dynamics.

The embodied sentient, "Captain Kyle William Brennan", is tasked with the critical mission of intercepting and neutralising the pre-sentients' superweapon before it reaches densely populated areas. Equipped with the latest technological advancements, the sentient's vessel must achieve mission success to prevent widespread catastrophic outcomes across all sectors of province [032A-0047] inhabited by species [{30600,1401}].
(Custom Action)Wait for allied reinforcements to join up
(Scenario gameplay summary)Take command of a ship prototype and engage swarms of enemy fighters, and their superweapon, head on.
(Scoring Description)Rated based on general performance and Xenon ships killed.
(Stat Description)Rewards a score bonus based on the number of Xenon killed.
XBTF(abbreviation of the first X game)

page.title: Wave Attack Scenario
page.descr: Text for the Wave Attack scenario
page.t:
(Scenario Description)An aggregation of autogenic pre-sentients, identified as "Xenon" [{30600,1407}], has commenced unprovoked hostilities against orbital infrastructure installations, ostensibly to disrupt resource flows.

Prior projections assigned this event sequence a lower confidence than observed timeline-vectors suggest. It is advisable to re-evaluate this event sequence until a confidence level of 3\053 sigma is attained, to ascertain predictive coherence.

The embodied sentient is tasked with repelling the advancing tide of autogenic pre-sentients by any necessary means, including the use of destructive force. Failure to protect the orbital installations will likely result in significant resource disruption and potential societal upheaval in adjacent sectors.
(Scenario gameplay summary)Defend a station from successive enemy waves by deploying defences and targeting attackers.
GOAL["Neutralise enemy incursion before causing destruction of assigned target"]
(Mission Text)Defend the station against the Xenon attackers.
(Mission Text)A highly valuable target is currently located on the station and needs to be extracted. Expect heavy resistance.
Xenon capital ship damage taken in %
You can deploy mines and laser towers to assist you in defending the objective.
Collected drops are not shown in your ship storage, but are automatically tracked and will be used once resupplying is possible.
A new weapon has been installed on your ship. Make sure that you adjust your weapon groups by pressing $INPUT_ACTION_OPEN_COCKPIT_MENU$.
(Logbook Text)Dock at the resupply ship for an upgrade. You can also replenish ammunition there, as well as get repairs done.
(Logbook Text)Additional reinforcements have been dispatched to aid you.

(Scenario Description)The orbital installation identified as "Antigone" is at the epicentre of an escalating conflict between the autogenic pre-sentients identified as "Xenon" [{30600,1407}] and "Human" [{30600,1401}], Argon descent. During local chrono concept [NT 215], an attack is launched on the installation, threatening its integrity.

In this event sequence, the potential to influence the assembly latent remains contingent upon highly irrational biological behavioural patterns. Comprehensive re-evaluation of timeline divergences is essential to refine understanding of spacetime dynamics.

The embodied sentient is piloting a defence vessel tasked with protecting the orbital installation "Antigone". Failure to repel the attack may lead not only to the installation's destruction but also potentially plunge the inhabitants of province [032A-0047] into a protracted war-like conflict.
(Scenario gameplay summary)Delay the destruction of an allied station by eliminating waves of enemies.
GOAL["Provide assistance to Argon Confederation(see {20203,4001}) in timeline-defining event"]

page.title: Seek And Destroy Scenario
page.descr: Text for the seek and destroy scenario
page.t:
(Scenario Description)An ideological schism within the species identified as "Paranid" [{30600,1403}] escalates into open conflict following the unexpected linkage of stellar junctions between opposing factions. Unprepared for such an event, each faction struggles to maintain control.

To enhance understanding of predictive coherence concerning species with adaptive neuro-morphology such as [{30600,1403}], it is imperative to evaluate their adaptive strategies during intra-species conflicts.

The embodied sentient, belonging to the warrior breed of "Paranid" [{30600,1403}], must utilise its expertise in aggressive manoeuvre tactics and precision strikes to counteract the opposing faction effectively. Failure to neutralise this threat is unacceptable, as it could precipitate the collapse of the societal construct identified as "Holy Order of the Pontifex".
(Scores Description)Stronger foes are more valuable targets.
(Scenario gameplay summary)Within the allotted time, locate and eliminate as many hostiles as possible.
Holy Order High Command(Holy Order High Command, Holy Order same as {20203,504})
(Mission Reward)Holy Order Sovereignty(Holy Order same as {20203,504})

page.descr: Text for the weaken station scenario
page.t: Stinger(Shipname, as in something that stings)

(Scenario Description)An impending military operation by the species identified as "Human" [{30600,1401}], Argon descent, targets a critical orbital installation controlled by the autogenic pre-sentients identified as "Xenon" [{30600,1407}]. Given its strategic significance, the installation boasts heavy fortifications and is equipped with large-size directed energy emitters.

Accurately projecting this event sequence's outcome variability is essential for assessing the efficacy of biological entities in high-stakes scenarios. This contributes to the maintenance of predictive coherence within the constraints of observed ground truth.

The embodied sentient is tasked with infiltrating the orbital installation and systematically disabling its large-size directed energy emitters. Success in this mission will secure a tactical advantage, while failure is likely to result in a significantly elevated rate of combat casualties.
(Scenario gameplay summary)Target a station and destroy as many turrets as possible in the shortest time. Utilise the station's geometry for cover to ensure survival.
(Scoring Description)Completing the task in less time, and with more remaining hull, results in a better score.
(Stat Name)Number of turrets destroyed by the player
(Stat Description)Rewards a score bonus based on the number of turrets taken out.
(Stat Description)Rewards a score bonus if at least one defence drone was shot down during combat.

page.title: Weaken Fleet Scenario
page.descr: Text for the weaken fleet scenario
page.t:
(Scenario Description)A joint military operation involving species identified as "Human" [{30600,1401}], Argon descent, and "Paranid" [{30600,1403}] aimed at disrupting enemy supply lines is facing critical failure. Contrary to tactical intelligence reports, the targeted vessel is defended by a squadron of bomber-class units, significantly increasing the threat level to the allied forces.

Despite extensive efforts, maintaining predictive timeline-vector coherence in complex multi-species scenarios continues to present challenges. A comprehensive re-evaluation of timeline divergences is mandated to reach a confidence level of 4-sigma.

The embodied sentient is tasked with engaging and neutralising as many bomber-class units as possible within the limited engagement window, before the primary allied forces enter the combat zone. Failure to neutralise a sufficient number of these units will substantially increase the probability of an adverse outcome for the joint operation.
(Scenario Objective Text)Bombers before the allied fleet arrives
(Scenario gameplay summary)Swiftly and accurately eliminate all bombers defending an enemy supply ship to prevent your allies from falling victim to their missiles.
(Scoring Description)Destroying more bombers in less time, and with less damage sustained, will result in a better score.
(Stat Description)A time bonus added to the score in seconds if all targets have been destroyed before time ran out.
(Stat Description)Rewards a score bonus if no ships under your control were destroyed.
(Stat Name)Player ship did not take damage to the hull?
(Stat Description)Rewards a score bonus if the player's personal ship did not take damage to the hull.
(Stat Description)Rewards a score bonus if the player's personal ship survived the engagement.
GOAL["explore cooperation initiative between carbon based species"]
Focus your attention primarily on the enemy bombers, and make good use of your subordinate wingmen, to turn the tides of battle to your advantage.

page.title: Disable Capship Scenario
page.descr: Text for the disable capship scenario
page.t:
(Scenario Description)The species identified as "Human" [{30600,1401}], Argon descent, is exposed to a critical vulnerability along one of its border regions. Signals intelligence has intercepted information regarding the imminent approach of a capital combat vessel operated by the autogenic pre-sentients identified as "Xenon" [{30600,1407}]. Although reinforcements are dispatched, their arrival at the combat theatre is anticipated to be delayed.

Accurately projecting outcome variability is essential for assessing the efficacy of biological entities in high-stakes scenarios. This contributes to the maintenance of predictive coherence within the constraints of observed ground truth.

The embodied sentient will command a combat wing tasked with disrupting and delaying the capital ship's offensive operations. Priority targets include the vessel's weapon turrets and propulsion systems. Effective engagement is essential, as failure to sufficiently impair the capital ship may result in the overwhelming and incapacitation of the reinforcements.
(Scenario gameplay summary)Coordinate with your wingmen to efficiently disable an enemy capital ship by removing its turrets and engines.
(Scoring Description)Disabling the capital ship more quickly will result in a better score.
(Stat Name)Personally destroyed at least one surface element?
(Stat Description)Rewards a score bonus if the player destroyed at least one surface element.
(Stat Name)Spacesuit Bombs destroyed at least one surface element?
(Stat Description)Rewards a score bonus if the player detonated a Spacesuit Bomb that took out at least one surface element.

page.title: Trading Scenario
page.descr: Text for the trading scenario
page.t: Hebe(named after the Goddess of Greek mythology)

(Scenario Description)After the closure of stellar junctions, the sentient inhabitants of body four in the sector designated "Black Hole Sun" within province [032A-0047] confront a significant logistical challenge. Previously a community thriving on interstellar imports, these sentients are now compelled to reconstruct a self-sufficient economy.

Although no timeline-vector decoherence is expected, ethical ramifications of rearranging stellar junctions mandate urgent exploration, insofar as the implementation of fire-break scenarios to curtail the spread of autogenic pre-sentients grows more prevalent.

The embodied sentient is tasked with augmenting personal wealth, which is paramount for bolstering the community's economic resilience. The sentient will operate at the edge of its jurisdictional boundaries but will ensure not to transgress them. This delicate balance aims to maximise economic recovery efforts without compromising legal or ethical standards.
(Scenario gameplay summary)Pilot your trade ship to earn the maximum amount of Credits in the shortest time possible.
(Scoring Description)Rated based on your trading performance. Make credits more quickly to improve your rating.
(Stat Name)Made over 15k Cr profits with one trade?

Building and operating an ever-expanding fleet of interstellar trading vessels represents a significant endeavour.

While this event sequence is not at risk of immutable timeline-vector decoherence, a deeper understanding of the behavioural patterns of species [{30600,1405}] is crucial to ensure predictive coherence at a confidence level of 3\053 sigma.

The embodied sentient, a recently hatched specimen of species [{30600,1405}], is driven to ascend the ranks within the societal construct identified as "The Company". Tasked with overseeing a sizable trading fleet, its primary goal is to enhance the efficiency and profitability of operations, furthering the species' dominance in interstellar commerce.

(Scenario Description)The species identified as "Paranid" [{30600,1403}], positioned in a junction loop of province [032A-0047] due to its propensity for constructive conduct of interstellar trade, often prioritises spreading the tenets of its faith, known as "Holy Three-Dimensionality". The challenge of balancing devout conviction with profit-making during wartime poses a significant dilemma.

To enhance understanding of predictive coherence in species with adaptive neuro-morphology such as [{30600,1403}], it is imperative to evaluate their adaptive strategies when a set of contradictory goals necessitate behavioural re-structuring by the involved specimen.

The embodied sentient, a member of the merchant breed of species [{30600,1403}], is uniquely equipped to navigate this complex landscape. Tasked with leveraging both its combat manoeuvre tactics and its acumen in negotiating trade deals with species considered "unholy" by its peers, this specimen must effectively balance martial prowess with diplomatic skill to uphold both its economic interests and religious doctrines.
(Scenario gameplay summary)Trade to earn the maximum amount of Credits as quickly as possible while navigating an active war zone.

(Scenario Description)A resource-rich asteroid mining operation, primarily involving the species "Human" [{30600,1401}], Argon descent, and "Paranid" [{30600,1403}], faces operational disruption following an attack by a shoal of autogenic pre-sentients [{30600,1407}]. The assault has destroyed numerous autonomous excavation units, essential mining equipment, and depleted already gathered raw materials.

Although not at risk of timeline-vector decoherence, predictive confidence in complex multispecies scenarios remains a significant challenge. A re-evaluation of the assembly latent is mandated to determine possible solutions for avoiding minus omega scenarios. Communal virtualisation into presence cloud partials is regarded a remote possibility.

The embodied sentient, a pilot identified as "Erfmancklest" from the species "Paranid" [{30600,1403}], is believed to possess below-average spatial skills but is irreplaceable at this time. Although the joint venture's leading sentient, "Seena Hammond", is doubtful of Erfmancklest's ability to recoup the incurred losses and secure vital follow-up assignments, she has no choice but to trust him.
(Scenario gameplay summary)Operate a small mining ship to retrieve a cargo hold's worth of Ice as swiftly as possible.

(Scenario Title)Rise and Mine(pun on "rise and shine", you're playing a young miner)

(Scenario Description)During local chrono concept [NT 778] respectively [CE 2948], stellar junctions in the region designated "Getsu Fune" begin to fluctuate, causing significant delays in resource and reinforcement deliveries. This logistical challenge forces a once tentative alliance among species "Human" [{30600,1401}], Argon descent, "Paranid" [{30600,1403}], and "Teladi" [{30600,1405}] to solidify, confronting a looming threat from the adjacent replication grounds of the autogenic pre-sentients.

This pivotal event sequence modulates the quantum wave function, hinging on the observational and decision-making processes of individual sentients. Advancing a specific specimen in a complex multi-species hierarchy may assist alignment with temporal ground truth; further assessment of spacetime dynamics is therefore mandated.

The embodied sentient commits to mastering a skill set known as "speed-mining" to excavate essential raw materials as quickly as possible. Despite the profession's challenges, the sentient's older biotwin donates an aging ship and offers guidance. Together, they take substantial steps towards securing a stable future, setting the stage for future developments.
(Scenario gameplay summary)Operate a small mining vessel and collect as much Ore as possible within the designated time frame.

(Results Screen Description)Gather more units of Ore within the time limit to improve your score. You can sell resources to the refinery station to make space in your cargo hold for the next haul. Prioritise asteroids with high yields to fill up your ship more quickly.

(Scenario Description)By local chrono concept [NT 784], respectively [CE 2954], all stellar junctions in the region "Getsu Fune" have ceased operations, isolating the area. With the immediate threat from the autogenic pre-sentients neutralised, the hive-sentient species "Kha'ak" [{30600,1406}] emerges as a formidable competitor for dwindling resources.

This evolving event sequence converges on the local sentients' strategy to evacuate the region via conventional means. Based on prior timeline-vector projections, this sequence is marked by a 3-sigma confidence of anomalous decoherence, mandating an immediate sequence re-evaluation to ascertain predictive coherence with observed ground truth.

The embodied sentient, designated "Kit Almeera", is assigned a shift overseeing both excavation operations and defensive activities. While also flying combat sorties herself, she must simultaneously utilise her strategic skills to ensure production efficiency and staff safety.
(Scenario gameplay summary)Command a mining fleet to collect as much Ore or Silicon as possible within the time limit. Defend your miners against Kha'ak attacks.

(Results Screen Description)Gather more units of Ore and Silicon within the time limit to improve your rating. Ore and Silicon gathered by other ships that you own also count towards this goal. Identify ideal resource-gathering locations and mark them with resource probes to speed up the resource collection of the ships that you don't fly personally. Adjust the orders of your mining and fighting ships on the map to keep them safe from harm, and to efficiently destroy any enemies that appear. If necessary, you can order your miners to sell Ore and Silicon to a nearby refinery station to free up cargo space.
(Score Details)1 point per unit of Ore or Silicon.
(Score Details)$NUMBER$ points per ship or rescued spacesuit.
(Score Details)$NUMBER$ points per crew member that survived the destruction of their ship by being ejected in a spacesuit, and then docking at an allied ship.

(Scenario Title)Seasoned Miners Like You(in the sense of "such as you", quotes line {10136,306130402})

(Scenario Description)During local chrono concept [NT 781], respectively [CE 2951], a close-knit multi-species community has established itself as the backbone in the region designated "Getsu Fune". When exogenous threats disrupt regular operations, community members work courageously despite considerable risks. Recently, however, a lesser-known project has begun to divert resources at an alarming rate.

Tracing potentially pivotal event sequences in the assembly latent suggests further perturbations due to individual decision-making. The vector of the quantum wave function collapse has not yet been established beyond 2-sigma, necessitating behavioural re-modelling of the involved specimens.

The embodied sentient, designated "Sarn Hammond" of the species "Human" [{30600,1401}], Argon descent, has expended significant energy towards advancement since local chrono concept [NT 778]. Now bearing the title "Prospector", he leads "speed-mining" raids in complex situations unsuited for autonomous excavation units and sentient mining operators with less specialised skillsets.
(Scenario gameplay summary)Operate a medium mining vessel and collect as much Ore or Silicon as possible within the allotted time. Remain vigilant for enemy scouts.

(Results Screen Description)Gather more units of Ore and Silicon within the time limit to improve your score. You can sell resources to the nearby refinery stations to make space in your cargo hold for the next haul. Prioritise asteroids with high yields to fill up your ship more quickly. When the attacks begin, consider staying close to a station and venturing out when the coast is clear.
(Scenario Title)17th Getsu Fune Asteroid Smasher Showdown

(Scenario Description)I'm confused. Are they conducting behavioural experiments; and if so, to what end? And who are "they"? Sure, they treat us well - yes. But they never ask for consent. Whenever I attempt to voice objections, it's as though there's a blind spot in my mind.

Otherwise, I'm free to think my own thoughts and wander around the facility. They don't restrict our movement, but everyone seems too occupied with their "missions" to even try exploring. Except for me. It's like one of those dreams where you silently scream, but people just give you bewildered glances.

I found this - I don't even know what it is. A peculiar place between places, pitch black; so much so that at first I thought I must have gone blind. But my thoughts are my own here, always, and that gives me solace. After a while, I started making myself at home. Even brought in a Nodus Interlink from the other side. Nobody stopped me. Why, though? Why?

Well, I discovered Erfmancklest in the mission assembly latent recently. When it comes to spatial awareness, he must be the most challenged Paranid ever! But he's so tenacious; he never gives up. I like him! I don't know whether Paranid have dreams; but they certainly have aspirations. What if I infer a mission from the assembly latent that finds him at his best? Put him in a ship pulverising asteroids to a cheering crowd. Something to aspire to for sure!
(Objective)Create chunks of debris: $CURRENTAMOUNT$ / $DESIREDAMOUNT$ \(for $SCORE$\)(CURRENTAMOUNT and DESIREDAMOUNT are numbers, SCORE is a number of stars like "3 stars")

(Scenario Description)After the discontinuation of stellar junctions prompted a fierce resource race, the sentients of "Getsu Fune" consolidated all habitation and production facilities into a unified orbital megastructure capable of traversing real space. Denominated "Project Funanori", the completion of this structure depends critically on large quantities of increasingly rare resources, foremost among them Nividium.

This event sequence is at risk of immutable timeline-vector decoherence. Spacetime dynamics suggest further perturbations and misalignment with predictive ground truth. To ensure the operational success of the involved sentients, an immediate reassessment of vector paths in the assembly latent is mandated. Confidence levels below 4-sigma are unacceptable.

The embodied sentient, designated "Sibasomos Muudes Bendalas II", commands the excavation fleet to extract the remaining resources while facing constant threats from the species "Kha'ak" [{30600,1406}]. Balancing the timing of exiting the operational theatre with securing a sufficient amount of raw materials is paramount. Mission failure will lead to the cessation of "Project Funanori" and the eventual demise of the local multi-species population.
(Scenario gameplay summary)Command a mining fleet to collect as much Nividium as possible. Order retreat to the nearest station before your fleet is overwhelmed.

(Objective)Reach the station with your fleet, and as much Nividium as possible

(Results Screen Description)Gather more units of Nividium, protect your miners, and make your fleet reach the safety of Funanori Station more quickly to improve your rating. Nividium gathered by other ships that you own also counts towards this goal. Adjust the orders of your mining and fighting ships on the map to keep them safe from harm, and to efficiently destroy any enemies that appear. If necessary, you can order your miners to transfer resources to the large mining vessel Nagatabi to free up cargo space.

page.t: Use Scan Mode to find leaks more easily.
Don't be seen by cameras, don't shoot cameras, don't be heard inside noise sensors, don't shoot bombs while they're on camera.
Lap(in a racing context, shown as "Lap X/Y")

(Scenario description #1)Operating and maintaining an orbital space installation demands seamless coordination between service automatons and biological sentients, necessitating continual technical skill enhancement in the dynamic environment of outer space.

While stable in terms of timeline-vector coherence, the influence of individual biologicals on this event sequence poses a predictive constraint. A detailed evaluation of self-motivation and resolve among non-pivotal sentients is therefore highly advisable.

The embodied sentient, a specimen of the semi-aquatic species "Teladi" [{30600,1405}], possesses an inherent understanding of three-dimensional environments. Now, it faces the challenge of adapting these skills to navigate maze-like structures inside the orbital installation. Racing towards the finish line, the sentient must choose between the long but safe path or taking dangerous shortcuts. Success will qualify it for full membership on the installation's operations team.
(Score description #1)Finish the course faster to improve your rating.
(Scenario gameplay summary #1)In your spacesuit, navigate the obstacle course with maximum speed.

(Scenario description #2)Personal determination to continually enhance knowledge and skills has made this sentient an invaluable asset to the operations team. Despite deriving deep satisfaction from restoring broken equipment and installations, the sentient now faces unprecedented hazardous situations that occur with alarming frequency.

While the event sequence maintains stability in terms of timeline-vector coherence, the influence of individual biologicals continues to present a predictive constraint. A detailed evaluation of self-motivation and resolve among non-pivotal sentients is advisable.

The embodied sentient, renowned for its situational awareness and technical prowess, is confronted with the most exhausting maintenance shift of its career. A cascade of technical malfunctions, electrical hazards, dosimeter warnings and even fire, intensifies the pressure.
(Score description #2)Repair more quickly to improve your rating.
(Scenario gameplay summary #2)Utilise your spacesuit's repair laser to restore an extensively damaged station module. Evade lethal hazards including fire, electricity, and radiation.

(Scenario description #3)Continuously operating and maintaining a large orbital installation in high-stakes environments can exert considerable psychological stress on individual sentients. To mitigate this and enhance mental well-being, prioritising inter-sentient relationships through frequent recreational activities is essential. The "Maze Tournament", occurring once every local chrono concept cycle, is one such popular activity designed to encourage camaraderie and strategic thinking.

Observation of non-pivotal sentients engaging in non-threatening scenarios is invaluable for improving understanding of evolving spacetime dynamics and is therefore highly encouraged.

The embodied sentient is keen to participate in this cycle's "Maze Tournament", leveraging its familiarity with the venue and spatial manoeuvring skills. Additionally, this event presents an opportunity to utilise its newly acquired tactical railgun rifle for targeting practice, blending fun with functional training. However, the railgun's recoil presents an unforeseen challenge.
(Score description #3)Finish the course faster, hit all targets, and don't miss shots to improve your rating.
(Scenario gameplay summary #3)In your spacesuit, complete three laps of an interior obstacle course, shooting targets along the way.

(Scenario description #4)Remaining alert is critical in high-stakes environments. Unlike previous incidents attributed to technical malfunctions, a serious threat has emerged: an unknown individual has hidden explosive charges within the Maze, with the detonators rapidly counting down. The only sentient present capable of defusing the explosives in time is this specimen.

Detrimental timeline-vector decoherence is assured if this event sequence results in catastrophic structural failure. To preserve predictive coherence within the constraints of observed ground truth, an immediate re-evaluation of spacetime dynamics is mandated.

The embodied sentient, a proficient member of the species "Teladi" [{30600,1405}], is urgently tasked with locating and disarming explosive charges before the counter reaches zero, while avoiding CCTV surveillance and acoustic detectors set up by the saboteur. Failure to do so may jeopardise the installation's structural integrity, lead to civilian casualties, and result in minus omega for the sentient itself.
(Score description #4)Neutralise the bombs faster, without raising suspicion, to improve your rating.
(Scenario gameplay summary #4)In your spacesuit, neutralise bombs inside a station module while avoiding detection by the perpetrator.
Make it look like an accident

page.title: Station Refugee Rescue Scenario
page.descr: Text for the station refugee rescue scenarios
page.t: (mission name: Station Rescue)Escape from Faulty Logic: The Ferryman

(mission description)This still feels so surreal! The question that haunts me the most is who "they" are - who has this kind of technology? Is it the Paranid? They do have fairly advanced tech - yes. But to this level? I doubt it. Then who?

There's something missing inside of me, and I can't quite put my finger on it. Am I slowly losing my mind? I haven't been to the other side for quite some time now. I haven't talked to anybody, not to a real person. Wait - I just realised, I don't like the sound of that: "real person". What's a "real" person, anyway?

Now, running inference on the assembly latent is still returning fascinating event sequences that I need to explore in more depth. I chanced upon a vector leading to a pilot tasked with evacuating civilians from a damaged orbital structure. I don't know if that pilot will ever be "real", but if the structure collapses, many people will perish.
(score description)Performing more rescues in less time results in better scores and ratings. The time between docking and undocking is not counted towards your score.
(score stat description)The number of civilians rescued.

(score stat description)A good rescue efficiency is $NUM_RESCUES_TO_BEAT$ rescue runs at 1 rescue run every $TIME_TO_BEAT$ $TIME_UNIT_MINUTES$. Your rescue rate: $TIME_PLAYER$ $TIME_UNIT_MINUTES$. Your number of rescues: $NUM_RESCUES_PLAYER$.
(mission name: Station Rescue - Engineer)Escape from Faulty Logic: The Mechanic

(mission description)It's been a long time since I first came here. How long, I can't tell. I should be hungry and thirsty, yet I'm not. I feel so certain that I have a past, but I can't recall even a single event. There's a nagging feeling of anxiety rising in me. I'm not well. I'm not even sure that I'm... that I'm me.

Whenever I close my eyes, I see visualisations of vectors in the assembly latent, like floaters in my eyeballs. I imagine a stale draft coming from somewhere, but in reality, the air is still - well, if there is air at all! If I'm not eating, maybe I'm not breathing either? Sensory deprivation does weird things to your mind.

There's a vector in the assembly latent that made me aware of a mechatronics engineer frantically trying to keep a damaged orbital structure operational. The vector resembles a Lorenz attractor and appears to be causally bound to a cascading set of event sequences. That mechatronics engineer may seem inconsequential at first, but he's really not. Let's see where this is going.
(score description)Repairing more modules allows the rescue ship to perform more rescue runs. Repairing more modules in less time results in better scores and ratings.
(score stat description)The number of modules you repaired.
(score stat description)A good repair efficiency is $NUM_REPAIRS_TO_BEAT$ repairs at 1 repair every $TIME_TO_BEAT$ $TIME_UNIT_MINUTES$. Your repair rate: $TIME_PLAYER$ $TIME_UNIT_MINUTES$.
(mission name: Station Rescue - Escort)Escape from Faulty Logic: The Safeguard

(mission description)I'm beginning to suspect that "they" let me wander on purpose. I find it increasingly difficult to come up with another explanation. They let me drag the interlink in here, and I can still hook up to it without any issues whatsoever! Nothing stops me from accessing the assembly latent and rearranging vectors, creating mission profiles as I go. Why is that? One would think that someone with that kind of tech would detect my intrusion and lock me out instantly.

So, what can I do? For now, I will continue with what I've been doing all along - all the while feeling uneasy, as if invisible eyes are watching me from the shadows. The hair on my arms stands on end. If I even have hair and arms, that is.

Following the prevalent vector in this cascade leads me to a fighter pilot who is supposed to destroy a blockade so that a ship carrying evacuees can escape to safety. It's causally correlated to the strange Lorenz attractor I found earlier, and the outcome of this battle appears to be significant. I need to know more about it.
(score description)Destroying more of the blockade allows the rescue ship easier passage between the stations. Destroying more of the blockade in less time results in better scores and ratings.

(score stat description)A good kill efficiency is 1 kill every $TIME_TO_BEAT$ $TIME_UNIT_MINUTES$ in $NUM_WAVES_TO_BEAT$ waves. Your kill rate: $TIME_PLAYER$ $TIME_UNIT_MINUTES$. The number of waves you encountered: $NUM_WAVES_PLAYER$.
(various interaction texts. includes player conversation options.)

(loading screen info texts: Station Rescue - Engineer)

An approaching vessel's propulsion system was intentionally disabled by a utility-fog composed of an unknown type of nanoassembler.

This deviating event sequence risks immutable timeline-vector decoherence. The volatile nature of the utility-fog and the potential technological relics could significantly alter assemblies latent. A comprehensive re-evaluation is required to ensure predictive coherence.

The embodied sentient will lead a search-and-recovery operation in the debris field at the Lagrange point to extract the presumed technological relics. Precautions against the utility-fog have been implemented, but heightened activity from both the autogenic pre-sentients and the "Paranid" [{30600,1403}] indicates a keen interest in the debris, suggesting imminent confrontations.

This anomalous event sequence presents a significant risk of timeline divergence, due to unpredictable behavioural patterns in multi-species conflict scenarios. A comprehensive re-evaluation will ensure predictive coherence within the constraints of observed ground truth.

Failure to successfully retrieve and safeguard Brennan could critically impair the prospects for a favourable resolution of the conflict.

page.title: Racing Scenario
page.descr: Text for the racing scenario
page.t:
(Asteroid Dash Description)Continuous workloads under the stressful conditions of outer space can exert considerable psychological stress on individual sentients. To mitigate this and enhance mental well-being, fostering inter-sentient relationships through recreational activities is essential. One such activity is the popular "Asteroid Dash", a competitive yet friendly space race through a challenging course of asteroids with powered vessels.

Observation of non-pivotal sentients participating in such non-threatening scenarios provides invaluable insights into evolving spacetime dynamics and is highly encouraged.

The embodied sentient is eager to engage in this leisure activity. By completing the race and retrieving the trophy, it aims to establish its competitive rank among its co-sentients, reinforcing social bonds and demonstrating its prowess in a friendly yet challenging environment.

(Spaceport Stride Description)Continuous workloads under the stressful conditions of outer space can exert considerable psychological stress on individual sentients. To mitigate this and enhance mental well-being, fostering inter-sentient relationships through recreational activities is essential. The "Spaceport Stride" is one such popular event - a competitive yet friendly race through a spaceport's urban environment, dotted with a series of technological obstacles that test agility and strategic thinking.

Observation of non-pivotal sentients participating in such non-threatening scenarios provides invaluable insights into evolving spacetime dynamics and is highly encouraged.

The embodied sentient is eager to engage in this leisure activity. Completing the race and retrieving the trophy not only aims to reinforce its competitive rank among its co-sentients, but also strengthens social bonds and showcases its prowess in navigating complex environments in a spirited yet challenging setting.

(Station Circuit Description)Continuous workloads under the stressful conditions of outer space can exert considerable psychological stress on individual sentients. To mitigate this and enhance mental well-being, fostering inter-sentient relationships through recreational activities is essential. The "Station Circuit" is an anticipated event, featuring a competitive yet friendly race that winds around several orbital installations, each presenting unique navigation challenges and requiring adept manoeuvring skills.

Observation of non-pivotal sentients participating in such non-threatening scenarios provides invaluable insights into evolving spacetime dynamics and is highly encouraged.

The embodied sentient is eager to engage in this leisure activity. Completing the race and retrieving the trophy not only aims to reinforce its competitive rank among its co-sentients, but also strengthens social bonds and showcases its prowess in navigating zero-g environments. This race offers a spirited yet challenging opportunity to demonstrate agility and strategic piloting.

(Asteroid Dash B Description)I'm still familiarising myself with the concepts of the assembly latent. It's like a Feynman diagram, but with a directional vector - a vector in latent spacetime. It sounds crazy, but they, whoever "they" are, seem to be pre-collapsing wave functions without actually collapsing them, allowing for accurate predictions far into the future.

What I do not understand, however, is why they would want to predict the outcome of a race. Maybe it's just a fluke of the assembly latent, irrelevant. But it's speaking to me. It's like the latent knows who I am... better than I do myself. I'm tempted, really tempted, to shift the latent laterally and award myself the Dart.

It's not like I'm stealing the ship, is it? So no harm in trying. Maybe I'm forgiven for indulging for a while when it gives me some urgently needed solace!

(Spaceport Stride B Description)What surprised me the most is that Kaylah Daniels came out of retirement for this tournament. I seem to have a vague idea of who she is, but can't recall specifics, although I know I should.

Well, I guess, technically, Kaylah didn't come out of retirement; but here, in the assembly latent, her representation did. Her potential future self, so to speak. And I, my own subjunctive self, wasn't half bad, was I?

I know I shouldn't, because there are more pressing issues at hand, but I really, really want to try it again. Feels too good not to! Just some tweaking of the vector parameters, and then I'll fire up the interlink again to do one more race. I have a good feeling about this!

(Station Circuit B Description)I mean, come on! Two is nothing. I really want to do one more. I'm on a lucky streak. I mean, the vector in the assembly latent is on a lucky streak, of course. This whole set of event sequences speaks to me as if it read my soul. It seems to know things about me that even I don't.

Let's see. One more race. I'll adapt the parameters to accommodate for the event sequences of the previous race, and then I'll let my hands - my virtual hands - do what they know how to do: fly the Dart to victory and into history.

Admittedly, I'm a bit worked up over this. I don't know why I love this so much, but I do.

(Scenario description)Careful examination of captured pre-sentient units has revealed a critical flaw in their behavioural circuitry, which can be triggered by external radio interference, allowing for manipulation of their fight-and-flight patterns. On local chrono concept [CE 2144-12-24], a prototype transmitter array required to exploit this vulnerability is being escorted to the command centre, under significant risk of destruction.

Emerging from prior projections, this event sequence is classified as an anomaly with a high likelihood of cascading timeline perturbations. An immediate re-evaluation of spacetime dynamics is required to restore predictive coherence with observed ground truth.

The embodied sentient is tasked with defending the transmitter array prototype against autogenic pre-sentients, ensuring it reaches its intended operational status before the pre-sentients can develop countermeasures. Failure to ensure the safe delivery of the prototype will critically elevate the extinction probability for species [{30600,1401}] to 99.9 percent.
(Scenario gameplay summary)With your fighter, a squad-mate, and several laser towers, protect a communication satellite array against waves of hostiles.

page.title: Fleet Battle Scenario
page.descr: Text for the fleet battle scenario
page.t: Tensions over the ownership of a spatial volume in province [032A-0047] designated "True Sight" between species "Paranid" [{30600,1403}] and "Human" [{30600,1401}], Argon descent, threaten to escalate into armed conflict. The dispute not only pits species against species but also divides individuals within each group, challenging their beliefs and loyalties.\n\nWhile compatible in principle, both species "Paranid" [{30600,1403}] and "Human" [{30600,1401}] exhibit irrational behaviour patterns. This event sequence allows for the refinement of predictive coherence in multi-species ethical decision making.
(Scenario gameplay summary)Command a fleet of military ships to defend a station until reinforcements arrive.
Earn points based on the station's remaining hull integrity. The closer the station's hull is to the threshold value of 60%, the more points are available.
Average remaining hull integrity of all allied ships, expressed as a percentage.
No owned ships lost, or all bailed personnel rescued before they ran out of oxygen. Increases score to next higher star rating.
Sided with neither Argon nor Paranid.

This sentient, a specimen of the species "Paranid" [{30600,1403}], is confronting a large shoal of hostile autogenic entities with undetermined sentience status, controlled by a pre-sentient CPU-type vessel. The entities are on the verge of entering restricted space, posing an imminent threat.

This event-sequence serves to assess the influence of the Paranid's highly adaptive bi-layered neuro-morphology on its tactical capabilities. Insights gained will be instrumental in refining predictive coherence.

The embodied sentient, holding the rank of "Prior Admiral", commands an Armada tasked with defending the spatial volume designated as "Godrealm of Paranid" against the encroaching shoal of autogenic entities. A failure in this critical mission would significantly undermine the species' strategic capabilities, potentially affecting outcomes in future conflicts.
(Scenario gameplay summary)As a fleet commander, coordinate an armada of military vessels to fend off an enemy incursion.
A Xenon fleet has been spotted in the system beyond the gate. The Priest Duke bestows upon you the honour of commanding this Paranid armada to defeat the enemy fleet.

I've been going over it in circles, again and again. "They" are not the Paranid; I don't see any unusual groupings of three in the assembly latent maths, which would be a dead giveaway. "They" are also not the Boron. Coercion of sentient beings into compliance is not something the Boron would do. I mean, it's subtle, yes, but still. Not Boron-like at all. The Split? Well, I guess they wouldn't have any qualms, but honestly, we're being treated way too humanely here for it to be the Split.

So let me add things up. I've been here for what feels like weeks. Didn't hydrate, didn't eat. Didn't go to the bathroom. Still, I'm pristine like on day one. I don't know what I am, exactly. But I know now that I'm not... not me. I'm not me!!! They keep letting me hack the assembly latent and connect to the interlink. Their technology allows for pre-emptively collapsing quantum wave functions to observe future event sequences. No species that I know of has technology that advanced. None. Not even close.

Now, what conclusions do I draw from these observations? Well, firstly, like it or not, I'm part of the experiment. Secondly, maybe, just maybe, it's the gate-builders. Ancients, as they're called in some texts. Others call them the Sohnen. I'm pulling my hair, but I have no better explanation. But still, the question remains: Why, though? Why?

Before I go, I want to explore one more vector that I found. It's touching on the meaning of consciousness, responsibility, and consequences. There's this semi-sentient machine, a mighty Xenon CPU ship commanding a fleet of semi-sentient attack ships, thrown into battle against a Paranid armada. The Xenon are expected to take them all out, one after the other, against all odds. If they can do that, it may mean that all sentient life in the universe is ultimately doomed. Let's hope they can't.
Eliminate the Paranid forces with efficiency.
